summary_zh: 在光场（Light-Field, LF）成像系统中，相机阵列提供的密集空间采样可支持对焦重调、深度估计等强大的后期处理功能。但实际光场采集过程中常出现硬件故障，导致阵列中一台或多台相机失效，生成缺失子孔径图像，最终降低重建质量。本文针对光场相机阵列的失效/缺失视图恢复问题，提出一种新型生成式框架，通过利用精心筛选的邻域相机子集的信息合成缺失视图。该框架将筛选得到的邻域图像，以及标注了邻域视图位置和目标视图位置的位置编码图输入条件生成对抗网络（conditional Generative Adversarial Network, cGAN），训练网络生成几何一致的缺失视图。在合成和真实光场数据集上的大量实验表明，本文方法生成的重建结果视觉合理、光度精度高，在视图插值任务的定量和定性评估中均优于现有基线方法，为容错光场图像采集提供了鲁棒高效的解决方案。

title: BenthicFlow: Generating Extensible Underwater Environments via Flow Matching
title_zh: BenthicFlow：基于流匹配（Flow Matching）生成可扩展水下环境
authors: Joaqu\'in Figueira, Camile Lendering, Manfred Gonzalez-Hernandez, Giacomo D'Amicantonio, Erkut Akdag, Egor Bondarev
abstract: Computer vision applications for 3D scene understanding in underwater environments remain challenging due to the lack of high-quality 3D data and the inability of surface-trained models to generalize to underwater scenes. To address this challenge, an emerging trend is to employ generative models to close the data domain gap. However, existing methods assemble large scenes by stitching independently generated tiles post hoc with separately trained models, while demonstrating heterogeneous landscapes only within individual survey sites. We introduce BenthicFlow, a unified framework based on a single conditional flow-matching model that jointly generates aligned textures and depth maps. A MultiDiffusion-inspired sampling procedure reconciles overlapping windows throughout the generative trajectory, enabling spatially extensible RGBD mosaics without a separate stitching model. The generated mosaics are subsequently lifted into explicit 3D benthic environments using surface-aligned Gaussian surfels. Experiments across geographically distinct survey sites demonstrate that BenthicFlow preserves site-specific appearance while generating coherent, large-scale 3D scenes that closely match the target distributions. Code and trained models are available at https://github.com/jacomof/BenthicFlow.
summary_zh: 水下环境3D场景理解的计算机视觉应用长期面临两大挑战：高质量3D数据匮乏、在地表数据集上训练的模型无法泛化到水下场景。为解决该问题，当前学界的新兴研究方向是利用生成模型缩小数据域差距。但现有方法大多通过独立训练的模型逐块生成场景片段，事后拼接得到大场景，仅能在单个勘测站点内生成异质性景观。本文提出BenthicFlow，这是一个基于单条件流匹配模型的统一框架，可同步生成对齐的纹理图与深度图。该框架采用受MultiDiffusion启发的采样流程，在整个生成轨迹中协调重叠窗口，无需额外拼接模型即可生成空间可扩展的RGBD马赛克图。生成的马赛克图后续可通过表面对齐高斯面元（Gaussian surfels）转换为显式的3D底栖环境。在多个地理分布不同的勘测站点开展的实验表明，BenthicFlow在保留站点特有外观特征的同时，可生成连贯的大规模3D场景，与目标数据分布高度匹配。代码与训练好的模型可访问https://github.com/jacomof/BenthicFlow获取。

title: CaRGo-T: Causal Reasoning Graph-of-Thought improves Multimodal Humor Comprehension
title_zh: CaRGo-T：因果推理思维图（Graph-of-Thought）提升多模态幽默理解能力
authors: Abhilash Nandy, Rahul Seetharaman, Aman Bansal, Rounak Saha, Manav Nitin Kapadnis, Millon Madhur Das, Pawan Goyal, Niloy Ganguly
abstract: Large-scale vision-language models (VLMs) have demonstrated remarkable versatility across a wide range of multimodal tasks. However, understanding humor remains challenging because humorous content often depends on subtle interactions among entities, events, context, and implicit relationships across image and text modalities. These interactions can involve complex chains of reasoning that are difficult to capture through conventional prompting or linear chain-of-thought reasoning. In this work, we propose CaRGo-T (Causal Reasoning Graph-of-Thought), a reasoning framework that represents the causal and contextual relationships underlying multimodal humor as a lightweight graph-based reasoning structure. The graph is serialized into a code-based representation generated by a VLM, which can subsequently be interpreted by the same or a different VLM to produce the final prediction in zero-shot or in-context learning settings. We evaluate CaRGo-T on humor understanding and humor detection across four datasets spanning diverse forms of comedic content, including satire, sarcasm, and memes. Experiments with state-of-the-art commercial and open-source VLMs show that CaRGo-T consistently improves performance over existing reasoning-based baselines, achieving gains of approximately 1-20% on humor understanding and 1-3% on humor detection. Further analysis using mutual information indicates that the reasoning representations produced by CaRGo-T contain more information relevant to the target output than those generated by baseline reasoning approaches. Code is available at https://github.com/abhi1nandy2/CaRGo-T.
summary_zh: 大规模视觉语言模型（VLMs）已在各类多模态任务中展现出极强的通用性，但幽默理解任务仍存在较大难度：幽默内容通常依赖跨图像、文本模态的实体、事件、上下文与隐式关系之间的微妙交互，这类交互涉及复杂的推理链，难以通过传统提示方法或线性思维链推理捕获。本文提出CaRGo-T（Causal Reasoning Graph-of-Thought，因果推理思维图）推理框架，将多模态幽默背后的因果与上下文关系表示为轻量的基于图的推理结构。该图可序列化为由视觉语言模型生成的代码化表示，后续可由同一或其他视觉语言模型解析，在零样本或上下文学习场景下输出最终预测结果。我们在涵盖讽刺、反讽、梗图等各类喜剧内容的4个数据集上，从幽默理解与幽默检测两个任务维度对CaRGo-T开展评估。针对当前最先进的商用与开源视觉语言模型的实验表明，CaRGo-T性能始终优于现有基于推理的基线方法，在幽默理解任务上性能提升约1-20%，在幽默检测任务上提升约1-3%。基于互信息的进一步分析表明，CaRGo-T生成的推理表示相比基线推理方法包含更多与目标输出相关的信息。代码可访问https://github.com/abhi1nandy2/CaRGo-T获取。

title: An end-to-end-trained vision-language model for native-language prostate pathology report generation
title_zh: 面向原生语言前列腺病理报告生成的端到端训练视觉语言模型
authors: Christian Grashei, Fabian G\"ulhan, Maximilian Legnar, Fabian St\"ogbauer, Cleo-Aron Weis, Carolin Mogler, Peter Sch\"uffler
abstract: Prostate cancer is among the most frequently diagnosed malignancies worldwide, and structured reporting of each biopsy core burdens pathologists. Existing tools frame this as classification, leaving pathologists to assemble coherent reports, while many slide-level vision-language models rely on English-centric encoders that transfer poorly to other clinical languages. We present a slide-level framework generating prostate biopsy reports that is language-independent by construction: tokenizer and model are trained from scratch, demonstrated here in German. To address paired-data scarcity, an automated pipeline uses a locally deployed large language model to split composite reports into core-specific image-text pairs, yielding 17,344 pairs from 2,402 historical cases without manual annotation. Evaluated for clinical attributes rather than linguistic similarity, the model achieves 96.2% F1 for malignancy detection and 65.2% for Gleason grading, competitive with an FDA-cleared classifier. Grading is further validated on three external cohorts with latent-space augmentation. Institutions can thus train native-language reporting models on their own archives.
summary_zh: 前列腺癌是全球确诊率最高的恶性肿瘤之一，对每块活检组织的结构化报告撰写给病理医生带来了极大工作负担。现有工具将该任务建模为分类任务，后续仍需病理医生自行整合生成连贯报告，且多数切片级视觉语言模型依赖以英语为中心的编码器，迁移到其他临床语言时性能表现很差。本文提出一种切片级前列腺活检报告生成框架，其设计天然具备语言无关性：分词器与模型均从零开始训练，本文以德语场景验证了该框架的有效性。为解决配对数据稀缺问题，我们搭建了自动化流水线，通过本地部署的大语言模型将复合报告拆分为单块活检对应的图文对，无需人工标注即可从2402份历史病例中得到17344组图文对。评估指标聚焦临床属性而非语言相似度，该模型的恶性病变检测F1值达96.2%，格里森（Gleason）分级F1值达65.2%，性能与获得FDA认证的分类器相当。我们进一步在3个外部队列上通过隐空间增广验证了分级性能，各医疗机构可基于自身存档数据训练适配本土语言的报告生成模型。

title: How Merge-Tolerant Are Vision Transformers for Wheat Phenotyping?
title_zh: 面向小麦表型分析的视觉Transformer对合并操作的容忍度有多高？
authors: Simon Rav\'e, Pejman Rasti, David Rousseau
abstract: Vision-based wheat phenotyping requires repeated measurements under deployment constraints, from growth-stage recognition to wheat-head counting and organ segmentation. Plain Vision Transformers (ViTs) provide a common architecture for these tasks, but quadratic attention limits high-throughput and edge inference. Training-free token merging is attractive because it can be inserted into trained models without retraining. We provide a systematic benchmark of ToMe and Mutual Pair Merging across growth-stage classification, wheat-head detection, and wheat-organ segmentation, measuring task quality, throughput, token count, and peak GPU memory, with additional Raspberry Pi 5 measurements. The benchmark reveals a clear hierarchy: classification is highly merge-tolerant, while detection and segmentation are constrained by repeated instances, thin organs, dense boundaries, reconstruction, and runtime overhead. Optimized attention backends can erase apparent speedups, so deployment value must be profiled on the target runtime rather than inferred from token count.
summary_zh: 基于视觉的小麦表型分析需要在部署约束下完成多次测量，覆盖生长阶段识别、麦穗计数、器官分割等任务。普通视觉Transformer（ViT）是这类任务的通用架构，但注意力机制的二次复杂度限制了其高通量推理与边缘端部署能力。无需训练的令牌合并技术可直接插入已训练模型，无需重新训练，具备很高的实用价值。本文针对生长阶段分类、麦穗检测、小麦器官分割三类任务，对ToMe与互配对合并（Mutual Pair Merging）两种无训练令牌合并方法开展系统性基准测试，测量指标包括任务精度、吞吐量、令牌数量与峰值GPU内存占用，同时补充了树莓派5上的实测结果。基准测试结果呈现清晰的层级规律：分类任务对合并操作的容忍度极高，而检测与分割任务受重复实例、细器官、密集边界、重建需求与运行时开销的约束，合并容忍度较低。优化后的注意力后端可能抵消令牌合并带来的表观加速效果，因此部署收益必须在目标运行环境下实测得到，不能仅通过令牌数量推断。

title: MIVIFI: Bridging Perspective and Fisheye Domains for Training Multi-View Fisheye Image Generation Models
title_zh: MIVIFI：桥接透视域与鱼眼域以训练多视图鱼眼图像生成模型
authors: Matthias Neuwirth-Trapp, Beg\"um Altunbas, Jiayi Wang, Yan Xia, Maarten Bieshaar, Xinyu Huang, Daniel Cremers
abstract: Achieving 360{\deg} coverage is critical for the visual perception systems of autonomous vehicles. Fisheye cameras offer a cost-effective solution by enabling full surround coverage with as few as two sensors. However, existing multi-view fisheye datasets are limited, and synthesizing rare corner cases typically requires computationally expensive 3D simulations, hindering the training. While generative models have achieved significant success in standard perspective imagery, their application to wide-angle distortion remains unexplored. In this work, we formally introduce the novel problem of multi-view fisheye image generation conditioned on volumetric semantic representations and present two distinct methods. We first propose SyntheOcc-FE, which adapts the SyntheOcc architecture to fisheye data. While effective, this method is constrained by the scarcity of fisheye datasets, which limits its generalization. To overcome these limitations, we propose our second method, MIVIFI (multi-view fisheye), which leverages cross-domain learning with Equirectangular Projections. By bridging the gap between dataset domains using KITTI-360 fisheye images alongside nuScenes multi-view standard images, our approach enables high-fidelity manipulation of scene content. This framework enables the structural modification of semantic occupancy inputs to introduce or eliminate specific actors and facilitates the rendering of diverse meteorological conditions and illumination scenarios absent in the limited fisheye datasets. Quantitative and qualitative experiments demonstrate that our methods achieve robust photorealistic multi-view fisheye image generation and highlight the specific advantages of our cross-domain strategy for handling data scarcity.
summary_zh: 实现360度全视角覆盖对自动驾驶汽车的视觉感知系统至关重要，鱼眼相机仅需2个传感器即可实现全环绕覆盖，是极具性价比的解决方案。但现有多视图鱼眼数据集规模有限，合成罕见极端场景需要计算成本极高的3D仿真，阻碍了相关模型的训练。生成模型已在标准透视图像领域取得显著进展，但针对广角畸变场景的应用仍有待探索。本文正式提出以体语义表示为条件的多视图鱼眼图像生成新任务，并给出两种不同的实现方法：首先提出SyntheOcc-FE，将SyntheOcc架构适配到鱼眼数据场景，该方法效果显著但受鱼眼数据集稀缺限制，泛化能力有限。为克服该缺陷，我们提出第二种方法MIVIFI（multi-view fisheye，多视图鱼眼），利用等距柱状投影（Equirectangular Projections）实现跨域学习。通过结合KITTI-360鱼眼图像与nuScenes多视图标准图像搭建跨数据集域间桥梁，该方法可实现场景内容的高保真编辑。该框架支持对语义占用输入进行结构修改，新增或移除特定目标，还可渲染有限鱼眼数据集不存在的各类气象条件与光照场景。定量与定性实验均表明，本文提出的方法可生成鲁棒且具备照片真实感的多视图鱼眼图像，验证了跨域策略在解决数据稀缺问题上的独特优势。

title: Pointing-VLA: Typed Spatial Grounding Interfaces for Vision-Language-Action Manipulation
title_zh: Pointing-VLA：面向视觉-语言-动作操控的带类型空间接地接口
authors: Xiwen Chen, Zelin Li, Zhiruo Zhou, Huiming Chen, Chenwei Wang, Xiaojun Zhu
abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models often expose spatial grounding through autoregressive text coordinates or opaque action tokens, creating brittle interfaces between multimodal reasoning and robot execution. We present Pointing-VLA, a typed hidden-state spatial readout built on Embodied-R1. Geometry-specific heads predict normalized points, object-functional grounding (OFG) heatmaps, and visual trajectories without serializing geometry as text. For the evaluated Bridge/WidowX and physical pick-place deployments, an explicit execution contract assigns PICK to source-conditioned OFG and PLACE to Pointing, providing direct stage-aligned spatial targets. Pointing-VLA achieves SOTA performance on Bridge/WidowX, averaging 72.9\% across the evaluated four-task set without Bridge-specific finetuning under collision-enabled CuRobo execution. Pointing and OFG show complementary strengths across native and cross-dataset evaluations. The OFG/contact readout transfers to NORA-1.5, preserving or improving success while reducing recorded controller time by more than 20$\times$; typed heads are also 6.68--6.90$\times$ faster than Embodied-R1 text decoding on a shared external suite. When integrated as spatial guidance for a $\pi_{0.5}$ action policy, Pointing-VLA raises autonomous real-robot success from 52.7\% to 80.7\% across three visual contexts. These results establish typed spatial readouts as an efficient, inspectable interface between embodied reasoning and robot execution.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通常通过自回归文本坐标或不透明动作令牌实现空间接地，导致多模态推理与机器人执行环节之间的接口十分脆弱。本文提出Pointing-VLA，这是构建在Embodied-R1基础上的带类型隐状态空间读出模块：面向几何任务的专用头可预测归一化点、对象功能接地（OFG）热力图与视觉轨迹，无需将几何信息序列化为文本。在Bridge/WidowX仿真平台与实体机器人抓取放置部署场景下，显式执行契约将抓取任务分配给源条件对象功能接地模块，将放置任务分配给Pointing模块，直接输出与阶段对齐的空间目标。Pointing-VLA在Bridge/WidowX平台上取得了当前最先进的性能，在启用碰撞检测的CuRobo执行环境下，无需针对Bridge数据集微调，在4项评估任务上的平均性能达72.9%。Pointing模块与对象功能接地模块在原生数据集与跨数据集评估中展现出互补优势。对象功能接地/接触读出模块可直接迁移到NORA-1.5模型，在保持甚至提升任务成功率的前提下，将控制器运行时长缩短20倍以上；在共享外部测试套件上，带类型头的解码速度比Embodied-R1的文本解码速度快6.68-6.90倍。将Pointing-VLA作为空间引导集成到π₀.₅动作策略中时，实体机器人在3种视觉场景下的自主任务成功率从52.7%提升至80.7%。上述结果证明，带类型空间读出是具身推理与机器人执行之间高效、可解释的接口方案。

title: A Simulator-Grounded Framework For Constructing Verifiable Muscle-Grounded QA From 3D Tongue Meshes
title_zh: 基于模拟器的从3D舌网格构建可验证肌肉接地问答的框架
authors: Seungho Eum, Unsang Park
abstract: Existing articulatory corpora based on real-time MRI and electromagnetic articulography capture tongue shape and motion but do not provide traceable labels for the muscle-driven process that generated an observed configuration. We introduce a simulator-grounded data-construction framework and instantiate it as 3DTongueQA. Controlled 11-dimensional muscle activations are mapped to fixed-topology tongue meshes with the ArtiSynth Badin finite-element model, converted into structured biomechanical records, and rendered as deterministic QA on muscle state, geometry, and target-directed change. We screen 295,157 configurations, retain 295,115 valid meshes, and construct 891,156 QA records per language. Language naturalization changes only surface form and is verified against the source records; English and Korean instantiations demonstrate construction-level portability. A swappable SpiralNet++--Qwen3-8B baseline reaches 62.9 $\pm$ 9.2 Muscle EM, 74.0 $\pm$ 0.2 Value Accuracy, and 65.9 $\pm$ 4.7 Direction EM, while mismatching the paired mesh reduces Muscle EM to 2.2; a dataset-leakage-controlled anchor-held-out model retains 80.4--98.6\% of the full-inventory scores on unseen anchors. Task-specific structured readouts further reach 88.7 $\pm$ 0.7 Muscle EM and 93.3 $\pm$ 1.0 Direction EM. These complementary results show that the constructed supervision supports both efficient structured prediction and heterogeneous natural-language QA rather than being tied to a particular decoder architecture.
summary_zh: 现有基于实时磁共振成像与电磁 articulography（发音动作描记）的发音语料库可捕获舌部形状与运动信息，但无法为生成观测构型的肌肉驱动过程提供可追溯标签。本文提出基于模拟器的数据构建框架，将其实现为3DTongueQA数据集：通过ArtiSynth Badin有限元模型将受控的11维肌肉激活值映射为固定拓扑结构的舌网格，转换为结构化生物力学记录，进一步生成关于肌肉状态、几何特征与目标导向变化的确定性问答对。我们共筛选295157组构型，保留295115个有效网格，为每种语言构建891156条问答记录。语言自然化仅改变表层形式，所有内容均可通过源记录验证；英语与韩语版本的实现证明该框架具备构建层面的可移植性。可替换的SpiralNet++--Qwen3-8B基线模型的肌肉精确匹配（EM）指标达62.9±9.2，数值准确率达74.0±0.2，方向精确匹配指标达65.9±4.7；若将配对的舌网格替换为不匹配样本，肌肉精确匹配指标将降至2.2；通过数据集泄露控制的锚点留出实验显示，在未见过的锚点样本上，模型仍可保留全数据集训练得分的80.4%-98.6%。面向任务的结构化读出模块进一步将肌肉精确匹配提升至88.7±0.7，方向精确匹配提升至93.3±1.0。上述互补结果表明，本文构建的监督数据可同时支持高效结构化预测与异构自然语言问答，不与特定解码器架构绑定。

title: Bridge Damage Detection from Low-Light UAV Imagery via Degradation-Aware Mixture-of-Experts Enhancement
title_zh: 基于感知退化的混合专家增强实现低光照无人机图像桥梁损伤检测
authors: Hu Wang, Hongxu Pu, Zhiqi Hu, Fangzhou Lin, Wang Wang
abstract: Poor illumination obscures small, low-contrast defects in UAV bridge imagery, reducing the reliability and operational flexibility of automated inspection. This paper investigates whether degradation-aware image restoration can improve bridge damage detection under low-light conditions and transfer from synthetic degradations to real inspection scenes. We propose DaL- MoE, a detector-agnostic restoration front end trained with an ISP-aware low-light synthesis pipeline and equipped with degradation-aware guidance estimation and complementary experts for noise suppression, color adjustment, and structural-detail recovery. On paired synthetic data, DaL-MoE achieves 23.12 dB PSNR and 0.8482 SSIM, increasing YOLOv11m box mAP50 from 0.3097 to 0.4923 and mask mAP50 from 0.2281 to 0.3529. On real low-light UAV imagery without paired normal-light references, sim-to-real evaluation shows improved defect visibility and more complete detections than direct inference on raw low-light inputs. Future work will develop low-light-aware bridge damage detectors with stronger cross-scene generalization across bridge sites, imaging conditions, and illumination levels.
summary_zh: 光照不足会掩盖无人机桥梁巡检图像中对比度低的细小缺陷，降低自动化检测的可靠性与操作灵活性。本文研究感知退化图像恢复技术是否可提升低光照条件下的桥梁损伤检测性能，以及是否可从合成退化场景泛化到真实巡检场景。本文提出DaL-MoE，这是一个与检测器无关的恢复前端，通过感知图像信号处理（ISP）的低光照合成流水线训练，内置感知退化引导估计模块，以及分别用于噪声抑制、色彩校正与结构细节恢复的互补专家模块。在配对合成数据集上，DaL-MoE的峰值信噪比（PSNR）达23.12dB，结构相似性（SSIM）达0.8482，将YOLOv11m的边界框mAP50从0.3097提升至0.4923，掩膜mAP50从0.2281提升至0.3529。在无配对正常光照参考图的真实低光照无人机图像上，仿真到真实场景的评估结果显示，与直接在原始低光照输入上推理相比，该方法提升了缺陷可见度，检测结果更完整。后续工作将开发面向低光照场景的桥梁损伤检测器，提升其在不同桥址、成像条件与光照水平下的跨场景泛化能力。

title: Training-Free Pseudo-Fusion for Composed Image Retrieval with Diffusion Models and Multimodal Large Language Models
title_zh: 结合扩散模型与多模态大语言模型的组合图像检索无训练伪融合方法
authors: Fan Xu, Luis A. Leiva
abstract: Composed Image Retrieval (CIR) is an emerging paradigm in content-based image retrieval that enables users to formulate compositional queries by combining a reference image with an auxiliary modality, usually text-based. This approach supports fine-grained search where the target image shares structural elements with the user-provided image while incorporating the modifications specified by the auxiliary text. Conventional CIR methods rely on multimodal fusion to combine visual and textual features into a joint query embedding, which requires training modules that align composed queries with the targets. In this work, we propose PeFuse (for pseudo-fusion), a training-free framework that leverages pretrained Diffusion Models and Multimodal Large Language Models to bridge modalities via generative conversion. We introduce two novel strategies: uni-directional and bi-directional conversion, which convert CIR into four single-modality retrieval problems. These methods reformulate CIR as either intra-modal or cross-modal single-query retrieval tasks, bypassing the need for dedicated task-specific training. Extensive experiments on standard benchmarks demonstrate that converting CIR into text-to-image retrieval tasks is more effective than alternative conversion strategies, achieving competitive or superior performance compared with state-of-the-art methods, while maintaining high flexibility thanks to replaceable components of the conversion pipeline. These results highlight the effectiveness of the pseudo-fusion paradigm for zero-shot CIR. Our code is publicly available at: https://github.com/StevenXuf/PeFuse4CIR.
summary_zh: 组合图像检索（CIR）是基于内容的图像检索领域的新兴范式，支持用户通过组合参考图像与文本等辅助模态构造组合查询，实现细粒度搜索：目标图像与用户提供的参考图像共享结构元素，同时融入辅助文本指定的修改内容。传统组合图像检索方法依赖多模态融合将视觉与文本特征合并为联合查询嵌入，需要训练专门的模块对齐组合查询与目标样本。本文提出PeFuse（pseudo-fusion，伪融合），这是一种无需训练的框架，利用预训练扩散模型与多模态大语言模型，通过生成式转换实现模态间桥接。本文提出两种新策略：单向转换与双向转换，将组合图像检索任务拆解为4个单模态检索问题。该方法将组合图像检索重构为模态内或跨模态单查询检索任务，无需针对任务做专门训练。在多个标准基准数据集上开展的大量实验表明，将组合图像检索转换为文搜图检索任务的效果优于其他转换策略，性能与当前最先进方法相当甚至更优，同时得益于转换流水线的可替换组件，具备极高的灵活性。上述结果验证了伪融合范式在零样本组合图像检索任务上的有效性。代码可访问https://github.com/StevenXuf/PeFuse4CIR获取。

title: Loopy: Seamless Video Loop Generation via Anchored Looping Shift of Positional Embedding
title_zh: Loopy：基于位置嵌入锚定循环移位的无缝视频循环生成
authors: Haotian Dong, Wenjing Wang, Chen Li, Jing Lyu, Xin Wang, Di Lin
abstract: Looping videos are essential for practical applications such as web graphics, game development, and social media. However, existing approaches typically fail to generate high-quality looping videos due to the neglect of how video generation models perceive temporal order and how this relates to the looping behavior. In this work, we are the first to reveal that position embedding at different attention layers within DiT exhibits varying levels of positional control, with the most pronounced layer acting as an anchor. We formulate this anchored layer as the reference point of the looping video, offering strong contextual priors for the remaining layers to facilitate the generation of seamless and coherent video content. Based on this insight, we propose an anchored position embedding shifting strategy that applies layer-specific shift lengths according to each layer's temporal control effect, effectively transforming DiT's temporal perception from a straight line to a circle. Leveraging this strategy, we develop a general framework, Loopy, for high-quality looping video generation, supporting both RGB and RGBA videos, while also enabling advanced AIGC features such as identity control and style transfer. Experiments demonstrate that our approach significantly improves temporal consistency and visual fidelity in generated looping videos. The released model is available on our website: https://donghaotian123.github.io/Loopy.
summary_zh: 循环视频是网页图形、游戏开发、社交媒体等实际应用场景的核心需求，但现有方法通常忽略视频生成模型对时序顺序的感知机制及其与循环行为的关联，难以生成高质量循环视频。本文首次发现，扩散Transformer（DiT）不同注意力层的位置嵌入具备不同程度的位置控制能力，其中控制作用最显著的层可作为锚点。本文将该锚定层定义为循环视频的参考点，为其余层提供强上下文先验，助力生成连贯无缝的视频内容。基于该发现，本文提出锚定位置嵌入移位策略，根据各层的时序控制效果设置层专属移位长度，将扩散Transformer的时序感知范围从直线转换为环形。基于该策略，本文开发了通用框架Loopy，用于生成高质量循环视频，同时支持RGB与RGBA视频，还可实现身份控制、风格迁移等高级AIGC功能。实验表明，本文提出的方法可显著提升生成循环视频的时序一致性与视觉保真度。发布的模型可访问项目主页https://donghaotian123.github.io/Loopy获取。

title: Grounding Isn't Knowing: Do VLMs Need Object Localization for Spatial Reasoning?
title_zh: 锚定不等于认知：视觉语言模型（VLM）进行空间推理是否需要物体定位？
authors: Xiwei Liu, Yulong Li, Xinlin Zhuang, Xuhui Li, Zhixiang Lu, Haolin Yang, Imran Razzak, Yutong Xie
abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) can answer spatial questions, yet the mechanisms connecting object grounding to spatial reasoning remain poorly understood. It is underexplored whether spatial reasoning internally requires precise objects localization, or can bypass explicit localization through global layout cues. In this work, we investigate two representative model families, LLaVA-1.5 and Qwen2.5-VL, using a suite of mechanistic interpretability tools, including token ablation, layer-wise probing, attention knockout, and causal mediation analysis. We find that spatial relation prediction follows a staged grounding-to-reasoning process in which object-aligned tokens establish coarse target-reference anchors, while precise bounding-box boundaries are not required. Positional information becomes decodable before relation decisions emerge, and a small set of attention heads mediates the causal effects of both localization and spatial reasoning. The two tasks share early grounding-related processing but ultimately rely on partially distinct specialized pathways. Through rigorous experiments, we provide a token-, layer-, and head-level account of how VLMs transform object grounding into spatial relations, showing that knowing where objects are is not equivalent to knowing how they relate.
summary_zh: 视觉语言模型（VLM）可回答空间类问题，但物体锚定与空间推理之间的作用机制仍不明确。目前学界尚未充分探索空间推理在内部实现时是否需要精确定位物体，还是可通过全局布局线索绕过显式定位。本研究选取两类代表性模型系列LLaVA-1.5和Qwen2.5-VL，采用包括令牌消融、逐层探测、注意力掩除、因果中介分析在内的全套机制可解释性工具开展实验。研究发现，空间关系预测遵循从锚定到推理的分阶段流程：与物体对齐的令牌可建立粗略的目标-参考锚点，无需精确的边界框信息；位置信息可在关系判断生成前完成解码，且仅需少量注意力头即可同时介导定位与空间推理的因果效应。两项任务共享早期锚定相关处理流程，但最终依赖部分相互独立的专用路径。通过严谨实验，本研究从令牌、层、注意力头三个层面阐释了VLM如何将物体锚定信息转化为空间关系，证明知晓物体的位置并不等同于知晓物体间的关联关系。

title: From Generation to Simulation: How Far Are World Models from Being True Simulators?
title_zh: 从生成到仿真：世界模型距离成为真正的模拟器还有多远？
authors: Tong Wang, Huan Deng, Mucheng Yang, Yang He, Xiaohui Kuang, Gang Zhao
abstract: With the rapid progress of diffusion models and large-scale video generation, generative world models are increasingly expected to replace traditional simulators, including physics engines, game engines, and reinforcement-learning environments. Yet the remaining distance from generation to simulation lacks a systematic assessment. We present a capability-based study using an external yardstick: eight capabilities of a traditional simulator, namely asset construction, physics engine, interaction, controllability, stability, state feedback, diversity, and evaluation metrics. We trace three main technical routes--latent dynamics, video generation, and joint-embedding prediction--and map exactly 200 representative works published from 2018 to June 2026 onto these capabilities. Our analysis shows that world models have achieved functional substitution in interaction and controllability for specific scenarios, but remain short of traditional simulators in formal guarantees of physical laws, structured state feedback, and reproducible long-horizon evolution. State feedback is the most neglected cross-route shortcoming: only 6 of 163 implementation papers expose a runtime interface for querying entity states or physical parameters. We identify six research directions: formalized physics, a unified action interface, first-class state feedback, long-horizon stability, downstream-utility evaluation, and cross-route hybridization. Project page: https://github.com/AtongWang/world-model-simulators
summary_zh: 随着扩散模型与大规模视频生成技术的快速发展，生成式世界模型被寄予厚望，有望替代物理引擎、游戏引擎、强化学习环境等传统模拟器。但目前学界尚未对生成技术到仿真能力的差距开展系统性评估。本研究提出一套基于能力的评估框架，采用传统模拟器的8项核心能力作为外部标尺：资源构建、物理引擎、交互性、可控性、稳定性、状态反馈、多样性、评估指标。研究梳理了潜动力学、视频生成、联合嵌入预测三大主流技术路线，将2018年至2026年6月发表的200篇代表性研究成果逐一映射到上述能力维度。分析结果显示，世界模型已在特定场景下的交互性与可控性维度实现功能替代，但在物理定律的形式化保证、结构化状态反馈、可复现的长时序演化等方面仍与传统模拟器存在明显差距。其中状态反馈是跨技术路线最受忽视的短板：163篇落地实现类文献中仅6篇提供了可查询实体状态或物理参数的运行时接口。本研究最终明确了六大未来研究方向：形式化物理、统一动作接口、一等公民级状态反馈、长时序稳定性、下游效用评估、跨技术路线融合。项目主页：https://github.com/AtongWang/world-model-simulators

title: Cultural Moment Benchmark: Evaluating Video Cultural Reasoning and Grounding in Southeast Asia
title_zh: 文化时刻基准集（CMB）：面向东南亚的视频文化推理与锚定能力评估
authors: Burak Satar, Zhixin Ma, Cheng Yu-Tong, Huy Hoang Tran, Phuong Anh Nguyen, Chong-Wah Ngo
abstract: Cultural understanding in video means more than recognizing what is visible; it requires grasping the symbolic and temporal significance of cultural concepts. We decompose this into three abilities: naming what a concept symbolizes, visually recognizing it on video, and locating its sub-events in time. Existing video-cultural benchmarks tend to test what is seen, collapsing these three abilities into a single score that hides the bottleneck. We introduce the Cultural Moment Benchmark (CMB): 306 expert-curated concepts from seven countries in Southeast Asia across five categories. We evaluate each concept through three stages, one per ability. Given a description, Stage 1 (S1) selects from four candidate concept names, Stage 2 (S2) selects from four candidate video moments, and Stage 3 (S3) predicts the start and end times of the moment in a video. To keep each stage focused on a distinct ability, we use three design choices: semantic-similarity distractors (S1, S2), unlabeled video moments (S2), and free-form localization on a different example video (S3). Across six vision-language models, failure modes vary by ability and modality. i) Even the strongest closed-source models score below 30% when all three stages must be correct; ii) The three abilities do not fully cascade: naming a concept correctly helps half the models recognize it on video, but recognizing it has little effect on locating the sub-event in time; iii) Audio is complementary, redundant, or distracting depending on the concept, more often distracting in non-Latin-script countries; removing both audio and subtitles hurts Games and Music the most. Our 14-rater human study shows that even Expert raters score below chance on concepts from a neighboring country, indicating that CMB requires country-specific cultural knowledge. CMB acts as a diagnostic harness, attributing failures to a specific ability or modality.
summary_zh: 视频场景下的文化理解不止于识别可见内容，还要求把握文化概念的符号意义与时序特征。本研究将文化理解能力拆解为三个维度：解读文化概念的符号含义、在视频中视觉识别对应文化概念、在时间轴上定位文化概念对应的子事件。现有视频文化基准集通常仅测试视觉识别效果，将三项能力合并为单一得分，掩盖了真实的能力瓶颈。本研究提出文化时刻基准集（Cultural Moment Benchmark, CMB）：涵盖东南亚7个国家的306个经专家标注的文化概念，共分为5个大类。每个概念的评估分为三个阶段，分别对应一项能力：给定描述的前提下，阶段1（S1）从4个候选概念名称中选出正确项，阶段2（S2）从4个候选视频片段中选出匹配项，阶段3（S3）预测视频中对应文化时刻的起止时间。为保证每个阶段仅聚焦单一能力，本研究采用三项设计策略：S1与S2阶段设置语义相似干扰项、S2阶段使用无标注视频片段、S3阶段在不同示例视频上执行自由形式时序定位。在6款主流视觉语言模型上的测试结果显示，不同能力与模态对应的失败模式存在显著差异：1）即使是性能最强的闭源模型，在要求三个阶段全部答对时得分也低于30%；2）三项能力不存在完全的级联效应：正确命名文化概念仅能帮助半数模型提升视频识别效果，而完成视觉识别对时序定位子事件的帮助十分有限；3）音频对文化理解的作用随概念不同呈现互补、冗余或干扰三种状态，在使用非拉丁文字的国家场景下音频更常产生干扰；移除音频与字幕对游戏和音乐类文化概念的性能影响最大。本研究开展的14名评分员参与的人类实验显示，即使是专家级评分员，对邻国文化概念的得分也低于随机猜测水平，证明CMB需要特定国家的专属文化知识才能完成。CMB可作为诊断工具，将模型失败归因到具体的能力维度或模态。

title: When the Edit Changes the Patient: Measuring Identity Preservation in Counterfactual Retinal Images
title_zh: 编辑改变患者属性时：反事实视网膜图像中的身份保留度测量
authors: Andrea Posada, Wenke Karbole, Bach Ngoc Doan, Alexander Weers, Solmaz Abdolrahimzadeh, Maria Patsiamanidi, Kahkashan Haider, Vaishali Khare, Daniel Rueckert, Andrew Lotery, Sobha Sivaprasad, Martin J. Menten
abstract: Counterfactual medical image generation aims to modify an existing image to reflect a hypothetical scenario in which certain characteristics of the imaged subject are altered, while keeping their identity fixed. Most existing works repurpose established image editing methods, which do not directly supervise identity preservation. Instead, they assume that identity is implicitly preserved by anchoring generation to the source image. This assumption is rarely tested and may fail in domains where biometric cues are subtle, such as retinal optical coherence tomography (OCT). In this work, we explicitly measure identity preservation for three groups of text-conditioned editing methods - source-anchored, structured-prompt, and paired-training - using referee classifiers, embedding alignment scores, and a blind reader study. We find that all methods produce high-quality OCT images with comparable editing success, yet their identity preservation differs markedly. Source-anchored editing frequently alters the depicted subject, while paired-training preserves it best. We argue that future work on medical counterfactual generation must explicitly measure and report identity preservation alongside image realism and editing success.
summary_zh: 反事实医学图像生成的目标是修改现有图像，以呈现成像对象特定特征发生改变的假设场景，同时保留成像对象的身份信息。现有多数研究直接复用成熟的图像编辑方法，并未对身份保留过程施加直接监督，而是假设生成过程锚定源图像即可隐式保留身份。该假设很少得到验证，在视网膜光学相干断层扫描（OCT）这类生物特征线索十分细微的领域很容易失效。本研究采用裁判分类器、嵌入对齐得分、双盲阅片研究三类方法，对源锚定编辑、结构化提示编辑、配对训练编辑三类文本条件编辑方法的身份保留效果开展量化评估。研究发现，所有方法生成的OCT图像质量均较高，编辑成功率相近，但身份保留性能差异显著：源锚定编辑频繁改变成像对象的身份，而配对训练方法的身份保留效果最优。本研究指出，未来反事实医学生成相关工作必须在图像真实性、编辑成功率之外，额外对身份保留度进行显式测量与报告。

title: AnaDiffusion: Anatomically CompositionalLatent Diffusion for Controllable 3D Brain MRI Generation
title_zh: AnaDiffusion：面向可控3D脑MRI生成的解剖组合式潜扩散模型
authors: Huiwen Han, Lulin Liu, Bangya Liu, Yuanhao Cai, Nuo Chen, Xiaoqing Wang, Ziqian Xie, Chenyu You, Shuiwang Ji, Degui Zhi, Zhiwen Fan
abstract: 3D brain MRI generation has made significant advances in medical imaging, simulation, and controllable anatomical analysis. However, existing generative models typically synthesize 3D volumes monolithically, often overlooking regional anatomical structures and limiting local controllability. To address these limitations, we introduce AnaDiffusion, an anatomically compositional latent diffusion framework that factorizes the generation process into distinct, anatomically meaningful regions, followed by part-to-whole assembly and global refinement. Our approach first trains part diffusion models to capture local structural priors. We then inject an assembled anatomical composite of the parts into the whole-brain latent representation and continue denoising. This mechanism enables the model to resolve global context while preserving the injected anatomy. As a result, AnaDiffusion produces both explicit part assets and a globally coherent volume, thereby enabling controllable part editing without requiring subject-specific dense segmentation maps at inference time while maintaining consistent part-to-whole brain structure. On the subject-disjoint ADNI test split, AnaDiffusion achieves the lowest FID across the whole brain, left and right hemispheres, cerebellar-brainstem complex, and seam regions. It also achieves the best cerebellar and second-best ventricular and brainstem absolute Cohen's d values among the evaluated methods. In localized editing experiments, paired MS-SSIM demonstrates high target transfer and off-target preservation, supporting controllable part replacement with minimal unintended anatomical alterations.
summary_zh: 三维脑部磁共振成像（3D脑MRI）生成技术已在医学影像、仿真、可控解剖分析领域取得显著进展，但现有生成模型通常以整体方式合成三维体数据，往往忽略区域解剖结构，限制了局部可控性。为解决上述缺陷，本研究提出AnaDiffusion——一种解剖组合式潜扩散框架，将生成过程拆解为多个相互独立、具备明确解剖意义的区域，再通过局部到整体的组装与全局优化完成生成。该方法首先训练局部扩散模型学习局部结构先验，再将组装完成的解剖组合体注入全脑潜空间表示，继续执行去噪过程。该机制使模型既能兼顾全局上下文，又能保留注入的解剖结构信息。最终AnaDiffusion可同时输出显式的局部部件资产与全局连贯的体数据，实现无需推理时输入受试者专属稠密分割图的局部部件可控编辑，同时保证局部部件与全脑结构的一致性。在受试者互斥的ADNI测试集上，AnaDiffusion在全脑、左右半脑、小脑-脑干复合体、拼接区域的弗雷歇 inception 距离（FID）均达到最低值，在所有参评方法中小脑的绝对科恩d值表现最优，脑室与脑干的绝对科恩d值位列第二。局部编辑实验中，配对多尺度结构相似性（MS-SSIM）结果显示目标区域迁移效果好、非目标区域保留度高，可在最小化非预期解剖结构改动的前提下实现可控的部件替换。

title: Misanthrope: A Privacy-Preserving Keypoint Detector
title_zh: Misanthrope：面向隐私保护的关键点检测器
authors: Francesco Vultaggio, Predrag Djindjic, Markus Gerke, Sebastian Tschiatschek, Phillipp Fanta-Jende
abstract: Image matching is a core component of applications such as Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM), Visual Localization, and Structure from Motion (SfM). However, the local image features central to this task are vulnerable to inversion attacks, which enable adversaries to reconstruct privacy-sensitive scene content from local features. These attacks pose a particular threat in distributed computing scenarios where the pre-computed features leave edge devices to be processed by remote servers. In this work, we introduce Misanthrope, a novel privacy-preserving keypoint detector trained through self-distillation to avoid detecting keypoints on people---a predominant source of privacy-sensitive content in most localization scenarios---thus mitigating inversion attacks at the source rather than through post-hoc obfuscation. We demonstrate how inverted images from traditional feature detection pipelines can be used to detect and re-identify people in the scene, while Misanthrope is able to mitigate these attacks. Furthermore, Misanthrope maintains image matching performance on par with the state of the art and even surpasses it in challenging settings where people act as distractors, such as phototourism and in-the-wild odometry. On the Image Matching Challenge 2021 Phototourism test set, Misanthrope is the top-performing sparse feature extractor in 7 out of 9 scenes. We make our model and its evaluation script available here: https://github.com/fratopa/misanthrope
summary_zh: 图像匹配是同步定位与建图（SLAM）、视觉定位、运动恢复结构（SfM）等应用的核心组件。但该任务依赖的局部图像特征极易受到反演攻击，攻击者可从局部特征中重建出场景中涉及隐私的敏感内容。这类攻击在分布式计算场景下威胁尤为突出：预计算的特征需要从边缘设备传输到远程服务器进行处理。本研究提出Misanthrope——一种新型隐私保护关键点检测器，通过自蒸馏训练避免在人物区域检测关键点（人物是多数定位场景下最主要的隐私敏感内容来源），从源头缓解反演攻击，而非依赖事后混淆处理。实验证明，传统特征检测流水线输出的特征经反演生成的图像可被用于检测并重新识别场景中的人物，而Misanthrope可有效抵御这类攻击。同时Misanthrope的图像匹配性能与当前最优水平相当，在人物作为干扰项的挑战性场景（如旅游摄影场景、野外里程计场景）下性能甚至超过现有最优方案。在2021年图像匹配挑战赛旅游摄影测试集的9个场景中，Misanthrope在7个场景下的性能位列稀疏特征提取器第一。本研究已公开模型与评估脚本：https://github.com/fratopa/misanthrope

title: Coarse Indexing, Fine Evidence: Decoupling Temporal Granularity in Long-Video RAG
title_zh: 粗粒度索引、细粒度证据：长视频检索增强生成（RAG）中的时间粒度解耦
authors: Zhe Jin, Zhimin Lin, Bin Zheng, Junhua Fang, Huihua Yang
abstract: Graph-based retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) provides a scalable paradigm for long-video understanding, but existing systems typically inherit a fixed temporal granularity from video segmentation when constructing their retrieval index. We argue that this design unnecessarily couples indexing granularity with evidence granularity: coarse representations can often suffice for locating relevant temporal regions, while fine-grained evidence remains important for downstream reasoning. We propose \textbf{Density-Aware Graph Construction (DAGC)}, a training-free approach that decouples a query-independent coarse retrieval index from the original fine-grained evidence space. DAGC constructs a compact, density-adaptive graph index by merging visually redundant neighboring chunks, while preserving mappings to the original temporal units. Retrieved coarse regions are subsequently expanded back to the original chunk granularity for fine-grained evidence refinement and answer generation. Experiments on MLVU, VideoMME, and LongVideoBench show that DAGC retains only about 40--50\% of the original graph nodes and achieves $1.3$--$1.7\times$ end-to-end wall-clock acceleration while preserving approximately 99\% of the original QA performance. The gains transfer across different LVLM backbones and video RAG pipelines, suggesting that long-video RAG need not maintain the same temporal granularity for indexing and evidence reasoning.
summary_zh: 基于图的检索增强生成（RAG）为长视频理解提供了可扩展的技术范式，但现有系统在构建检索索引时通常沿用视频分割得到的固定时间粒度。本研究指出，该设计不必要地将索引粒度与证据粒度耦合：粗粒度表示通常足以定位相关时序区域，而细粒度证据对下游推理仍十分重要。本研究提出密度感知图构建（Density-Aware Graph Construction, DAGC）方法，这是一种无需训练的方案，可将与查询无关的粗粒度检索索引与原始细粒度证据空间解耦。DAGC通过合并视觉冗余的相邻视频块构建紧凑的、密度自适应的图索引，同时保留到原始时序单元的映射关系。检索得到的粗粒度区域可后续扩展回原始视频块粒度，用于细粒度证据优化与答案生成。在MLVU、VideoMME、LongVideoBench三个基准集上的实验显示，DAGC仅保留原始图约40%~50%的节点，端到端运行速度提升1.3~1.7倍，同时保留约99%的原始问答性能。该性能增益可迁移到不同的大视觉语言模型骨干与视频RAG流水线，证明长视频RAG无需为索引过程与证据推理过程设置相同的时间粒度。

title: ENCORE: Entropy-Guided Cropping and Attention Regularization for Robust Vision--Language Understanding
title_zh: ENCORE：面向鲁棒视觉语言理解的熵引导裁剪与注意力正则化框架
authors: Yuanhao Sun, Huawei Ji, Jiaxin Ding, Luoyi Fu, Xinbing Wang
abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) perform well on diverse vision-language tasks, but transformer-based visual encoders split images into fixed-resolution sub-images, compromising object integrity in lightweight VLMs. Existing methods only focus on the visual modality and fail to dynamically preserve the integrity of prompt-relevant regions, limiting performance. In this work, we observe that the early-layer image-text entropy of cross-modal attention strongly correlates with answer grounding quality and task accuracy. Building on this finding, we propose \textbf{ENCORE}, an entropy-guided framework with two components: At inference, an \textbf{Entropy-based Cropping Strategy} (ECS) evaluates a small set of candidate crops and selects the one with minimal entropy, preserving contiguous regions relevant to the prompt. At training, \textbf{Entropy Regularization Training} (ERT) augments next-token prediction with an entropy term that sharpens attention on key visual tokens while down-weighting irrelevant ones. Experiments on ten VQA benchmarks show that ENCORE, fine-tuning only 0.14\% of parameters, achieves an average 1.43\% accuracy gain and state-of-the-art performance among recent 2B-parameter VLMs. Our code is released in https://github.com/baokou-fw2/ENCORE.
summary_zh: 视觉语言模型（VLM）在各类多模态任务上表现优异，但基于Transformer的视觉编码器会将图像拆分为固定分辨率的子图，导致轻量级VLM中的物体完整性受损。现有方法仅聚焦视觉模态，无法动态保留与提示相关区域的完整性，限制了模型性能。本研究发现，跨模态注意力的早期层图文熵与答案锚定质量、任务准确率高度相关。基于该发现，本研究提出ENCORE——一种熵引导框架，包含两个核心组件：推理阶段采用基于熵的裁剪策略（ECS），评估少量候选裁剪区域并选择熵最小的区域，保留与提示相关的连续区域；训练阶段采用熵正则化训练（ERT），在令牌预测损失中加入熵项，强化关键视觉令牌的注意力权重，同时降低无关令牌的权重。在10个视觉问答基准集上的实验显示，ENCORE仅微调0.14%的参数即可实现平均1.43%的准确率提升，在近期发布的20亿参数级VLM中性能达到最优水平。代码已开源：https://github.com/baokou-fw2/ENCORE

title: Optimize Surgical Triplet Recognition: A Knowledge-Driven Mixture-of-Experts Solution
title_zh: 优化手术三元组识别：知识驱动的专家混合（MoE）解决方案
authors: Yiyi Zhang, Yuchen Yuan, Ying Zheng, Jialun Pei, Jinpeng Li, Zheng Li, Pheng-Ann Heng
abstract: Surgical action triplet recognition constitutes a critical task in context-aware robot-assisted surgery, facilitating automatic surgical action perception by identifying instrument, verb, target, and their association. However, existing works struggle to analyze such complex surgical scenes due to three main issues: (1) component-level optimization conflicts caused by entangled feature spaces, (2) category-level optimization conflicts arising from severe data imbalance, and (3) lack of domain knowledge guidance that limits model interpretability and robustness. To address these challenges, we propose a Mixture-of-Experts-guided Co-Optimization (\textit{MoeCo}) framework powered by knowledge-driven learning. Within the co-optimization pipeline, to first mitigate component-level conflicts, we introduce a component-tailored adapter that disentangles task-specific features across spatial-temporal regimes, facilitating effective component specialization. Next, we develop a coordinated gradient learning strategy to handle category-level conflicts, which adaptively rebalances positive-negative gradients to enhance the perception of rare categories. Notably, inspired by surgical domain expertise, we introduce a knowledge-driven mixture-of-experts mechanism that dynamically integrates multimodal large language model-guided knowledge via activated experts, thereby enriching the co-optimization pipeline with more expressive and robust representations. Extensive experiments on the public CholecT45 and CholecT50 datasets confirm the effectiveness of the proposed co-optimization pipeline and the superiority of dynamic priors integration via the knowledge-driven mixture-of-experts mechanism.
summary_zh: 手术动作三元组识别是上下文感知机器人辅助手术的核心任务，通过识别手术器械、动作动词、操作目标及其关联关系实现手术动作的自动感知。现有方法因三类核心问题难以分析复杂手术场景：1）特征空间纠缠导致的组件级优化冲突；2）数据严重不平衡导致的类别级优化冲突；3）缺乏领域知识指导，限制了模型的可解释性与鲁棒性。为解决上述挑战，本研究提出知识驱动学习赋能的专家混合引导协同优化框架（Mixture-of-Experts-guided Co-Optimization, MoeCo）。在协同优化流水线中，首先引入组件定制适配器，在时空维度解耦任务专属特征，缓解组件级冲突，实现各组件的有效专精；其次开发协同梯度学习策略，自适应重新平衡正负梯度权重，提升稀有类别的感知能力，解决类别级冲突。特别地，本研究受外科领域专业知识启发，提出知识驱动的专家混合机制，通过激活的专家动态整合多模态大语言模型提供的知识，为协同优化流水线生成更具表达力与鲁棒性的表示。在公开数据集CholecT45与CholecT50上的大量实验验证了所提协同优化流水线的有效性，以及知识驱动专家混合机制整合动态先验的优势。

title: ParallelWorld: Test-Time Scaling for Embodied Reasoning
title_zh: ParallelWorld：面向具身推理的测试时缩放框架
authors: Min Chen, Shengjun Zhang, Yuxin Li, Zhang Zhang, Xin Fei, Chong Xia, Yueqi Duan
abstract: Embodied Reasoning constitutes a fundamental capability of embodied intelligence, serving as the basis for autonomous perception, reasoning, and interaction within physical environments. Recent studies have shifted the paradigm of embodied reasoning from static perception toward dynamic exploration, where agents acquire task-relevant information through interactions with the environment. However, existing active reasoning approaches generally generate exploration trajectories incrementally without long-horizon planning. Even recently emerged test-time scaling frameworks often resort to myopic, single-step lookaheads, which struggle to resolve the delayed feedback inherent in complex, occluded spatial environments. To address this limitation, we propose ParallelWorld, a multi-horizon test-time scaling framework for embodied reasoning. Instead of greedy, single-step trials, ParallelWorld empowers agents to simulate and evaluate multi-step future trajectories in parallel before committing to an action. Specifically, we introduce a verifier-guided tree-search paradigm. Starting from the current state, ParallelWorld branches into multiple parallel trajectories and rolls them out continuously across a multi-step horizon. At each simulation step, a verifier agent evaluates the intermediate state transitions, dynamically pruning unpromising branches and prioritizing paths with the highest information gain. Once the multi-step prospective simulation is complete, the agent synthesizes the long-horizon outcomes to commit to the optimal action sequence. Finally, an answer agent performs reasoning over the selected trajectory to produce the final reasoning. Extensive experiments on ESI-Bench demonstrate that ParallelWorld consistently improves active perception and reasoning performance.
summary_zh: 具身推理是具身智能的核心能力，是智能体在物理环境中实现自主感知、推理与交互的基础。近期研究将具身推理的范式从静态感知转向动态探索，智能体可通过与环境交互获取任务相关信息。但现有主动推理方法通常以增量方式生成探索轨迹，缺乏长时序规划能力，即使是近年出现的测试时缩放框架也往往采用短视的单步前瞻策略，难以处理复杂、存在遮挡的空间环境中固有的延迟反馈问题。为解决该缺陷，本研究提出ParallelWorld——面向具身推理的多前瞻测试时缩放框架。不同于贪心的单步试错模式，ParallelWorld支持智能体在执行动作前并行模拟与评估多步未来轨迹。具体而言，本研究引入验证器引导的树搜索范式：从当前状态出发，ParallelWorld生成多条并行轨迹，在多步前瞻范围内持续推演；在每步模拟中，验证器智能体评估中间状态转移，动态剪枝低价值分支，优先推进信息增益最高的路径；多步前瞻模拟完成后，智能体综合长时序输出结果确定最优动作序列；最终由推理智能体基于选中的轨迹完成推理，输出最终结果。在ESI-Bench基准集上的大量实验证明，ParallelWorld可持续提升主动感知与推理性能。

title: Simplified Cross-Modal Calibration for Heterogeneous Event-RGB Stereo Systems
title_zh: 异质事件相机-RGB立体系统的简化跨模态标定方法
authors: Nico Hessenthaler, Adam T. M\"uller, Nicolaj C. Stache
abstract: Accurate extrinsic calibration between event-based and frame-based cameras remains a practical bottleneck for heterogeneous stereo systems. Existing approaches often require sensor or target motion, precise synchronization, or computationally expensive event-to-image reconstruction. We propose a simple, motion-free cross-modal calibration framework that uses a temporally modulated, blended ChArUco target presented on standard consumer displays. By alternating between the original pattern and a partially blended version, the target reliably triggers events while remaining continuously observable to a frame-based camera, avoiding blank frames and reducing synchronization constraints to a coarse, trigger-based alignment. We discretize events into frames coarsely aligned with the RGB images, apply lightweight denoising, and perform ChArUco-based intrinsic and stereo extrinsic calibration. Extensive experiments assess robustness to blending opacity, display brightness, external illumination, viewing angle, and handheld acquisition. Compared to the strongest motion-based reference (E2Calib + Kalibr) and a non-motion-based reference (Plasberg et al.), our approach reduces the mean reprojection error by $44\%$ and $6\%$, respectively, while substantially simplifying the calibration procedure. Finally, we demonstrate practical utility in a robotic eye-to-hand calibration case study, showing consistent transformations and stable downstream geometric measurements even under partial occlusions. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/nhessenthaler/simple-evrgb-cal.
summary_zh: 事件相机与帧式相机之间的高精度外参标定始终是异质立体系统落地的实际瓶颈。现有方法通常要求传感器或标定靶标运动、精确同步，或是计算成本极高的事件转图像重建过程。本文提出一种无需运动的简易跨模态标定框架，采用在普通消费级显示屏上呈现的时序调制混合ChArUco标定靶标。通过在原始图案与部分混合版本之间交替切换，该靶标可稳定触发事件，同时始终保持对帧式相机可见，避免出现空白帧，将同步约束降低至基于触发信号的粗对齐级别。我们将事件离散化为与RGB图像粗对齐的帧，应用轻量级去噪算法，随后基于ChArUco完成内参与立体外参标定。大量实验验证了该方法对标定靶标混合透明度、显示屏亮度、外部光照、观测角度以及手持采集场景的鲁棒性。与当前性能最优的基于运动的参考方案（E2Calib + Kalibr）和无运动参考方案（Plasberg et al.）相比，本文方法的平均重投影误差分别降低44%和6%，同时大幅简化了标定流程。最后，我们在机器人眼手标定案例研究中验证了该方法的实用价值：即使存在部分遮挡，也能输出一致的变换结果与稳定的下游几何测量值。代码开源地址为：https://github.com/nhessenthaler/simple-evrgb-cal。

title: WildHandBench: A Benchmark for Handwritten Text Understanding that Challenges MLLMs and Humans
title_zh: WildHandBench：面向手写文本理解的基准数据集，可同时挑战多模态大语言模型与人类能力
authors: Jun Zhang, Qiao Zhao, Cheng Cui, Jianying Qu, Zhongkai Sun, Jianwen Yang, Changda Zhou, ZhuoXin Liu, Shubin Han
abstract: We present WildHandBench, a benchmark containing 500 handwritten documents across three structures (free text, tables, formulas), four languages, and nine real-world scenarios. We introduce a Prior-Driven Error (PDE) metric that quantifies whether errors originate from language priors rather than visual evidence. Evaluating 18 state-of-the-art models together with calibrated human baselines, we find: (1) the best model achieves only 71.85% overall; (2) humans outperform all models yet the gap is narrow (77.09% vs. 71.85%); and (3) model errors are qualitatively different from human errors -- 63-91% of model errors are prior-driven versus only 49% for humans, exposing systematic reliance on language priors that conventional accuracy metrics cannot capture.
summary_zh: 本文提出WildHandBench基准数据集，包含500份手写文档，覆盖3种结构（自由文本、表格、公式）、4种语言与9类真实场景。我们提出先验驱动误差（Prior-Driven Error, PDE）指标，用于量化模型误差是否来源于语言先验而非视觉证据。通过对18个当前最优模型与经过校准的人类基准进行联合评估，得到如下结论：（1）性能最优的模型整体准确率仅为71.85%；（2）人类表现优于所有模型，但二者差距较小（77.09% vs 71.85%）；（3）模型误差与人类误差存在本质差异：63%~91%的模型误差属于先验驱动型，而人类的该占比仅为49%，这暴露了模型对语言先验的系统性依赖，而传统准确率指标无法捕捉该特性。

title: WADE: A Reasoning-Annotated Benchmark for Multi-Instance Floating-Waste Grounding with Compact Vision-Language Models
title_zh: WADE：面向紧凑型视觉语言模型多实例漂浮垃圾定位的推理标注基准数据集
authors: Md. Asaduzzaman Shuvo, Ahsan Farabi, Md. Abdul Ahad Minhaz, Mahedi Hasan, Israt Khandaker, Ibrahim Khalil Shanto, Muhammad Nomani Kabir
abstract: Floating waste in inland waterways threatens aquatic ecosystems and requires timely monitoring under cluttered, multi-object conditions. Existing aquatic-waste datasets provide limited geographic coverage, sparse multi-instance annotations, and little supervision beyond boxes and labels. Compact vision-language models (VLMs) therefore remain insufficiently evaluated for jointly localizing, classifying, counting, and explaining floating waste. We introduce WADE, a reasoning-annotated benchmark containing 2,167 images from rural Bangladesh, 13,608 bounding boxes, and ten waste categories. Each annotation is associated with class-level recognition rules covering visual cues, likely confusions, and discriminative features. We evaluate six VLMs under zero-shot, two-shot, reasoning-guided, and fine-tuned settings using detection, counting, and hallucination metrics. For resource-efficient adaptation, we jointly fine-tune Qwen3-VL-2B on boxes, labels, and reasoning chains using QLoRA. Fine-tuning increases recall from 0.0248 to 0.2339 and F1 from 0.0257 to 0.2163, while reducing image-level hallucination from 0.6836 to 0.0883. However, over three-quarters of instances remain undetected, establishing WADE as a challenging benchmark for dense floating-waste grounding with compact VLMs.
summary_zh: 内陆航道中的漂浮垃圾会威胁水生生态系统，需要在杂乱多目标场景下开展实时监测。现有水生垃圾数据集的地理覆盖范围有限，多实例标注稀疏，除边界框与类别标签外几乎没有额外监督信息，因此紧凑型视觉语言模型（VLM）在漂浮垃圾的联合定位、分类、计数与可解释性分析任务上的评估仍不充分。本文提出WADE推理标注基准数据集，包含采集自孟加拉国乡村地区的2167张图像、13608个边界框与10类垃圾，所有标注均附带覆盖视觉线索、易混淆样本与区分性特征的类别级识别规则。我们在零样本、两样本、推理引导与微调设置下，基于检测、计数与幻觉指标对6个视觉语言模型开展评估。为实现资源高效适配，我们使用量化低秩适配（QLoRA）在边界框、标签与推理链上联合微调Qwen3-VL-2B模型。微调后模型的召回率从0.0248提升至0.2339，F1值从0.0257提升至0.2163，同时图像级幻觉率从0.6836降至0.0883。但目前仍有超过四分之三的实例无法被检测到，说明WADE是面向紧凑型视觉语言模型的密集漂浮垃圾定位任务的高难度基准数据集。

title: Quality Inspection of Printed Circuit Board Pin Insertion via Semantic Segmentation and Board-Level Feature Extraction
title_zh: 基于语义分割与板级特征提取的印刷电路板插针插入质量检测
authors: Nils Rabeneck, Andr\'e Kiunke, Nicole Hoess, Wolfgang Mauerer
abstract: Quality control during printed circuit board (PCB) assembly is a critical step in ensuring reliable electronic products. Detecting misaligned pins during or after pin insertion remains a particularly challenging inspection task. This paper presents an automated defect detection method for identifying incorrectly inserted pins on PCBs. The proposed pipeline combines semantic segmentation using a U-Net architecture with contour-based feature extraction and logistic regression for board-level pass/fail classification. Segmentation masks are used to derive contour representations of individual pins, from which board-level features -such as average contour size- are extracted and used to train a logistic regression classifier. We evaluate the method on two datasets: an industrial collection of real-world PCB images, and a publicly available PCB pin-inspection dataset with substantially different visual characteristics. To assess the effectiveness of the proposed approach, a comparison against PatchCore, an anomaly detection technique new to be applied to pin inspection, as well as instance segmentation-based pin detection is made. The developed method achieved Area Under the Receiver Operating Characteristic Curve (ROC-AUC) values of 0.990 on a random test set split from the industrial data and 1.000 on the public dataset indicating strong separation between pass and fail boards. The results indicate that the proposed approach is a promising candidate for automated pin inspection in industrial environments and achieves strong performance on datasets with substantially different visual characteristics after dataset-specific training.
summary_zh: 印刷电路板（PCB）组装过程中的质量控制是保障电子产品可靠性的核心环节，在插针插入过程中或插入完成后检测错位插针是极具挑战性的检测任务。本文提出一种用于识别PCB插针插入错误的自动缺陷检测方法，所提出的流水线融合了基于U-Net架构的语义分割、基于轮廓的特征提取与逻辑回归算法，用于实现板级的合格/不合格分类。利用分割掩码得到单个插针的轮廓表示，从中提取平均轮廓尺寸等板级特征，用于训练逻辑回归分类器。我们在两个数据集上评估该方法：一个是采集自工业场景的真实PCB图像数据集，另一个是视觉特性差异极大的公开PCB插针检测数据集。为验证所提方法的有效性，我们将其与首次应用于插针检测的异常检测技术PatchCore、以及基于实例分割的插针检测方法进行对比。所开发方法在从工业数据中随机划分的测试集上的受试者工作特征曲线下面积（ROC-AUC）达到0.990，在公开数据集上达到1.000，可实现合格板与不合格板的精准区分。结果表明，所提方法是工业场景下自动插针检测的可行方案，在经过数据集专属训练后，可在视觉特性差异极大的数据集上取得优异性能。

title: Motion-Based Tokenization for Cross-Dataset Egocentric Gaze Modeling
title_zh: 面向跨数据集第一视角视线建模的基于运动的令牌化方法
authors: Virmarie Maquiling, Zhuojiang Cai, Enkelejda Kasneci
abstract: Gaze is increasingly used as an input signal for vision and multimodal models, yet no consensus exists on how to represent it across datasets. Raw traces preserve detail but are noisy and device-dependent, while coarse event labels are easy to model but can discard local motion structure. We formulate event-aligned, fixed-horizon angular displacement as an interpretable, event-conditioned motion vocabulary and compare it with event-only, spatial, absolute-angle, learned vector-quantized, and continuous representations. To assess transfer alongside target predictability and token collapse, our evaluation combines next-token prediction with target-domain regret, low-order target references, paired bootstrap, order sensitivity, motif overlap, and frozen structural probes. In an event-aligned headset benchmark, angular-motion tokens have lower target-domain regret than frozen-codebook VQ tokens in one transfer direction, while the reverse direction is inconclusive. The probes reveal complementary representation properties, and event-only tokens show that low perplexity can retain little motion information. On a third egocentric dataset, a matched comparison of I-VT, native, and frame-span interfaces shows that event construction materially changes transfer: native events have the lowest regret into EGTEA, while frame-span events have zero motif overlap and fail severely as a source. Motion-based tokenization therefore provides a compact representation for event-aligned egocentric gaze streams, while the evaluation identifies how target predictability and event construction shape cross-dataset conclusions.
summary_zh: 视线正逐渐作为输入信号应用于视觉与多模态模型领域，但目前学界尚未就跨数据集的视线表示方法达成共识。原始视线轨迹可保留细节，但存在噪声高、依赖采集设备的问题；而粗粒度事件标签易于建模，但可能丢失局部运动结构。本文将事件对齐、固定时域跨度的角位移构造为可解释的、以事件为条件的运动词汇表，并将其与纯事件表示、空间表示、绝对角度表示、学习得到的向量量化表示以及连续表示进行对比。为评估模型的迁移性、目标可预测性与令牌坍缩特性，我们的评估方案融合了下一词预测、目标域遗憾值、低阶目标参考、配对自举、顺序敏感性、模式重叠与冻结结构探针等多种方法。在事件对齐的头显基准测试中，角运动令牌在其中一个迁移方向上的目标域遗憾值低于冻结码本向量量化令牌，而另一方向的对比结果无统计显著性。探针结果揭示了不同表示的互补特性，纯事件令牌的低困惑度特性说明其几乎无法保留运动信息。在第三个第一视角数据集上，对I-VT、原生事件、帧跨度三类接口的对照实验表明，事件构造方式会显著改变迁移性能：原生事件向EGTEA数据集迁移的遗憾值最低，而帧跨度事件的模式重叠度为0，作为源域时迁移性能极差。因此基于运动的令牌化方法可为事件对齐的第一视角视线流提供紧凑表示，同时本文的评估方案明确了目标可预测性与事件构造方式对跨数据集实验结论的影响机制。

title: Results of the 1st Asynchronous CASTLE Challenge at the Joint Egocentric Vision Workshop in Conjunction with CVPR 2026
title_zh: CVPR 2026同期联合第一视角视觉研讨会首届异步CASTLE挑战赛结果
authors: Luca Rossetto, Werner Bailer, Cathal Gurrin, Graham Healy, Omar Shahbaz Khan, Stevan Rudinac, Klaus Sch\"offmann, Allie Tran
abstract: This report summarizes the contributions and results of the 1st Asynchronous CASTLE Challenge at the Joint Egocentric Vision Workshop in conjunction with CVPR 2026.
summary_zh: 本报告总结了与CVPR 2026同期举办的联合第一视角视觉研讨会上首届异步CASTLE挑战赛的各项贡献与最终结果。

title: AquaFlow: A Monocular Gaussian Splatting SLAM for Underwater Streaming Reconstruction
title_zh: AquaFlow：面向水下流式重建的单目高斯溅射SLAM系统
authors: Yingxiang Xu, Kerui Ren, Wenqi Guo, Changjian Jiang, Tao Lu, Linning Xu, Mulin Yu
abstract: Recent monocular 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) streaming reconstruction methods have achieved impressive performance by balancing reconstruction quality and efficiency. However, extending these frameworks to underwater scenes remains challenging due to severe visual degradation, such as light attenuation and scattering, which degrades camera pose tracking and distorts scene geometry. To address these challenges, we propose AquaFlow, a monocular Gaussian Splatting streaming reconstruction framework for efficient and high-fidelity underwater reconstruction. Specifically, AquaFlow fine-tunes a 3D vision foundation model on large-scale underwater data for robust pose and pointmap estimation, and introduces a medium-guided incremental Gaussian initialization strategy for streaming mapping. Furthermore, we develop a streaming-compatible hybrid scene representation that integrates structured, distance-conditioned neural Gaussians with a physics-inspired optical model to compensate for underwater image formation effects, enabling accurate scene reconstruction. We evaluate AquaFlow on a comprehensive dataset of 62 diverse underwater trajectories, collected from both public benchmarks and in-the-wild web videos across various scales. Extensive experiments demonstrate that AquaFlow achieves state-of-the-art tracking and rendering performance, reducing average localization error by 13.2% and improving PSNR by 4.74 dB compared to WaterSplat-SLAM.
summary_zh: 近期的单目3D高斯溅射（3DGS）流式重建方法通过平衡重建质量与效率取得了优异性能，但将这类框架扩展到水下场景仍面临诸多挑战：水下存在光衰减、散射等严重的视觉退化问题，会降低相机位姿跟踪精度、扭曲场景几何结构。为解决上述问题，本文提出AquaFlow，一种面向高效高保真水下重建的单目高斯溅射流式重建框架。具体而言，AquaFlow在大规模水下数据上微调3D视觉基础模型，实现鲁棒的位姿与点云图估计，同时引入介质引导的增量高斯初始化策略用于流式建图。此外，我们开发了适配流式处理的混合场景表示，将结构化、距离条件化的神经高斯与物理启发的光学模型相融合，补偿水下图像生成效应，实现精准场景重建。我们在覆盖多种尺度、由公开基准数据集与野外网络视频采集得到的62段不同水下轨迹构成的综合数据集上评估AquaFlow。大量实验结果表明，AquaFlow取得了当前最优的跟踪与渲染性能，与WaterSplat-SLAM相比，平均定位误差降低13.2%，峰值信噪比（PSNR）提升4.74dB。

title: NemoSplat: Feed-Forward 4D Gaussian Splatting for Media-Aware Underwater Reconstruction
title_zh: NemoSplat：面向介质感知水下重建的前馈4D高斯溅射方法
authors: Xiaopeng Guo, Wai Chung Tse, Yipeng Zhu, Hanwen Zhang, Huajian Huang, Sai-Kit Yeung
abstract: Reconstructing photorealistic scenes in unconstrained underwater environments remains challenging due to severe media-induced light scattering and unpredictable dynamic objects. Recent feed-forward visual foundation models have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in generalized novel view synthesis and tracking. However, when directly applied to aquatic videos, optical attenuation and motion interference fatally corrupt their feature aggregation, leading to severe tracking and reconstruction failures. To overcome these limitations, we present NemoSplat, the first feed-forward 4D Gaussian Splatting framework tailored for media-aware dynamic reconstruction directly from uncalibrated marine videos. Beyond providing robust estimations of camera poses and dense scene depth, we devise a Promptable Dynamic Disentangler that utilizes a confidence-aware fusion strategy of learned dynamic probabilities and optional semantic text priors, effectively isolating massive transient entities. Furthermore, to counteract visual degradation, a Media-Aware Gaussian Predictor is formulated to jointly estimate intrinsic 3D Gaussian attributes alongside physical media parameters, rendering pristine scene appearance in a single forward pass. Additionally, we introduce a large-scale underwater dataset with massive dynamic elements to facilitate training and evaluation. Extensive experiments on our dataset demonstrate that NemoSplat achieves state-of-the-art tracking accuracy and high-fidelity rendering.
summary_zh: 无约束水下环境中存在严重的介质诱导光散射与不可预测的动态物体，实现照片级真实感场景重建仍极具挑战性。近期的前馈视觉基础模型在通用新视角合成与跟踪任务上展现出优异性能，但直接应用于水下视频时，光学衰减与运动干扰会严重破坏其特征聚合过程，导致跟踪与重建失败。为克服上述局限，本文提出NemoSplat，首个专为无标定海洋视频的介质感知动态重建定制的前馈4D高斯溅射框架。该框架不仅可输出鲁棒的相机位姿与稠密场景深度估计结果，还设计了可提示动态解耦器，采用置信度感知的融合策略结合学习得到的动态概率与可选的语义文本先验，可有效分离大量瞬态实体。此外为抵消视觉退化影响，本文构造了介质感知高斯预测器，可联合估计3D高斯的固有属性与物理介质参数，仅需单次前向传播即可渲染出纯净的场景外观。本文还引入了包含大量动态元素的大规模水下数据集，为模型训练与评估提供支撑。在自建数据集上的大量实验表明，NemoSplat取得了当前最优的跟踪精度与高保真渲染效果。

title: DRAgent: Discriminative Reasoning Agent for Referring Expression Segmentation
title_zh: DRAgent：面向指代表达分割的判别推理智能体
authors: Yujie Qi, Luyan Zhang
abstract: Referring Expression Segmentation (RES) aims to generate a pixel-level mask for the object specified by a language expression. Recent methods based on multimodal large language models (MLLMs) often rely on one-pass coordinate prediction for visual localization, which serializes continuous spatial locations as discrete text tokens and may lead to localization bias and alignment errors. To address these issues, we propose DRAgent, an MLLM-driven discriminative reasoning (DR) framework for RES. Instead of requiring the MLLM to generate localization coordinates, DRAgent first constructs a detector-generated candidate space and then uses the MLLM as a visual-semantic target discriminator. Specifically, the MLLM performs reliable target selection among potential distractors through a two-stage DR mechanism, which first screens high-recall candidates and then performs instance-wise verification. The selected target box is subsequently used as a spatial prompt for a foundation segmentation model to produce the final pixel-level mask. Furthermore, we construct a self-consistency-filtered reasoning-chain data pipeline for LoRA-based fine-tuning, providing more reliable supervision for enhancing the MLLM's discriminative reasoning capability. Experiments demonstrate that DRAgent achieves competitive performance on RefCOCO, RefCOCO+, and RefCOCOg.
summary_zh: 指代表达分割（RES）的目标是生成语言表达式所指定目标的像素级掩码。近期基于多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的方法通常依赖单次坐标预测实现视觉定位，该方法将连续空间位置序列化为离散文本令牌，可能引入定位偏差与对齐误差。为解决上述问题，本文提出DRAgent，一种由多模态大语言模型驱动的面向指代表达分割的判别推理（DR）框架。该框架不要求多模态大语言模型生成定位坐标，首先构建由检测器输出的候选空间，随后将多模态大语言模型作为视觉-语义目标判别器使用。具体而言，多模态大语言模型通过两阶段判别推理机制从潜在干扰项中完成可靠的目标筛选：第一阶段筛选出高召回率的候选目标，第二阶段完成实例级验证。筛选得到的目标框随后作为空间提示输入基础分割模型，生成最终的像素级掩码。此外，本文构建了经过自一致性过滤的推理链数据流水线，用于基于低秩适配（LoRA）的微调，为增强多模态大语言模型的判别推理能力提供更可靠的监督信号。实验结果表明，DRAgent在RefCOCO、RefCOCO+与RefCOCOg数据集上取得了极具竞争力的性能。

title: FOVEA: Focused On-Demand Visual Evidence Adaptation for Cache-Friendly Multimodal Speculative Decoding
title_zh: FOVEA：面向缓存友好型多模态投机解码的聚焦式按需视觉证据适配方法
authors: Hengjie Zhu, Dayan Wu, Zihao Zhang, Xinze Liu, Jingxuan Yu, Peng Fu, Zheng Lin, Weiping Wang, Ding Wang
abstract: Multimodal speculative decoding accelerates vision-language models by allowing a lightweight draft model to propose candidate tokens for parallel verification by a larger target model. Existing methods typically condition the drafter on a fixed visual interface, such as a predefined visual-token budget or a static compressed representation. However, our controlled visual-budget analysis shows that visual demand varies substantially across tasks and decoding stages, which means more visual input is not always beneficial. Actually, insufficient evidence may weaken visual grounding, while excessive context adds overhead and may disrupt drafting. We propose FOVEA (Focused On-demand Visual Evidence Adaptation), a cache-friendly approach that builds a reusable visual memory and dynamically retrieves a bounded subset for a draft state. A cumulative-mass rule determines both how many and which entries are selected. The selected entries are aggregated into a visual readout and fused with the current draft hidden state through a lightweight gated residual correction. Rather than inserting visual tokens into the autoregressive context, the correction modifies only the representation passed to the language-model head. Experiments across multiple vision-language backbones and multimodal benchmarks show that FOVEA improves draft acceptance and end-to-end decoding speed, achieving up to $2.13\times$ speedup over autoregressive decoding. These results demonstrate that state-conditioned evidence retrieval is an effective alternative to reusing a fixed visual representation throughout multimodal generation.
summary_zh: 多模态投机解码通过轻量级草稿模型生成候选令牌，由更大的目标模型并行验证，从而加速视觉语言模型的推理过程。现有方法通常让草稿模型依赖固定的视觉接口，例如预定义的视觉令牌预算或静态压缩表示。但我们开展的受控视觉预算分析表明，不同任务与解码阶段的视觉需求差异极大，并非视觉输入越多性能越好：视觉证据不足会削弱视觉 grounding 能力，而过多的上下文会增加计算开销，甚至干扰草稿生成过程。本文提出FOVEA（Focused On-demand Visual Evidence Adaptation，聚焦式按需视觉证据适配），一种缓存友好的方法，可构建可复用的视觉记忆，并针对草稿状态动态检索有界的视觉子集。累积质量规则用于确定检索条目的数量与具体条目。选中的条目被聚合为视觉读出结果，通过轻量级门控残差校正与当前草稿隐藏状态融合。该方法无需将视觉令牌插入自回归上下文，仅修改输入语言模型头部的表示。在多个视觉语言骨干网络与多模态基准上开展的实验表明，FOVEA可提升草稿接受率与端到端解码速度，相比自回归解码最高实现2.13倍的加速比。结果表明，基于状态的证据检索是多模态生成过程中复用固定视觉表示的有效替代方案。

title: Large-Small Model Collaboration for Zero-Shot Surgical Phase Recognition
title_zh: 面向零样本手术阶段识别的大小模型协同方法
authors: Yiyi Zhang, Ying Zheng, Wenxin Fan, Yu Zhu, Yuchen Yuan, Litao Zhao, Zheng Li, Pheng-Ann Heng
abstract: Task-specific lightweight models for surgical phase recognition excel at capturing temporal dynamics but generalize poorly under domain shift. Conversely, surgical foundation models (FMs) offer superior transferability via large-scale pretraining, yet their lack of explicit temporal modeling often yields temporally inconsistent predictions, leading to degraded performance. To exploit the complementary strengths of both paradigms, we propose \textbf{La}rge-\textbf{S}mall \textbf{T}emporal adaptation (\textbf{LaST}), a novel large-small collaborative framework that enables zero-shot adaptation to unseen clinical domains. In LaST, the FM initiates the pipeline by generating frame-level phase priors that serve as initial weak supervision. To effectively utilize these noisy phase priors, we introduce an iterative temporal refinement scheme that integrates dynamic quality control to filter reliable predictions and dual-model cross-learning to mitigate confirmation bias. Simultaneously, the lightweight model leverages its intrinsic temporal modeling ability to progressively correct inconsistent predictions and enhance overall accuracy across iterations. At the end, a cycle replay strategy is employed to close the loop: the refined, more accurate predictions are utilized as upgraded supervision signals for the subsequent iterations, fostering a self-reinforcing evolution of both label quality and model capability. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LaST achieves robust adaptation to unseen domains for zero-shot surgical phase recognition, outperforming the baseline (PeskaVLP) by 24.85\%-43.17\% in accuracy and even surpassing fully supervised linear probing and several state-of-the-art few-shot approaches. Codes will be released at https://github.com/YIYIZH/LaST.
summary_zh: 面向手术阶段识别的任务专用轻量模型擅长捕捉时间动态，但在域偏移场景下泛化性能较差；与之相对，手术基础模型（Surgical Foundation Models, FMs）通过大规模预训练具备优异的迁移能力，但其缺乏显式时间建模的特性往往会产生时间不一致的预测结果，导致性能下降。为了融合两类范式的互补优势，本文提出LaST（Large-Small Temporal adaptation，大小模型时间自适应），一种全新的大小模型协同框架，可实现对未见临床域的零样本自适应。在LaST框架中，首先由基础模型生成帧级阶段先验作为初始弱监督信号。为了有效利用这些存在噪声的阶段先验，本文提出了一种迭代式时间优化方案，融合动态质量控制机制筛选可靠预测结果，同时通过双模型交叉学习缓解确认偏误。与此同时，轻量模型利用其原生的时间建模能力，在迭代过程中逐步修正不一致的预测结果，提升整体精度。最后采用循环重放策略形成闭环：经过优化的更准确的预测结果将作为升级后的监督信号用于后续迭代，推动标签质量与模型性能的自增强演化。大量实验表明，LaST可在零样本手术阶段识别任务中实现对未见域的鲁棒自适应，其精度相比基线方法PeskaVLP提升24.85%~43.17%，性能甚至超过全监督线性探测方法与当前最优的少样本方法。相关代码将发布于https://github.com/YIYIZH/LaST。

title: Stochastic Separability of Embedding Manifolds
title_zh: 嵌入流形的随机可分性
authors: Liqing Zhang
abstract: The theorem not only uncovers geometric and statistical properties of the object embedding manifolds, but also provides a novel mechanism for representation learning in deep networks.
summary_zh: 该定理不仅揭示了目标嵌入流形的几何特性与统计特性，还为深度网络中的表征学习提供了一种全新的机制。

title: UniMem: Unifying Multimodal Memory and Control for Vision-Language-Action Models
title_zh: UniMem：面向视觉-语言-动作模型的多模态记忆与控制统一框架
authors: Lars Osterberg, Maggie Wang, Mac Schwager
abstract: While Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have leveraged internet-scale pretraining and task-focused finetuning to achieve strong performance on long-horizon tasks, they often struggle with non-Markovian tasks that require memory. Existing approaches to memory typically involve additional Vision-Language-Models (VLMs) for long-term memory management, introducing a memory bottleneck and a fractured training pipeline. Conditioning on multiple historical frames can provide the VLA with access to more descriptive features of past scenes, but can degrade performance if frames are chosen at arbitrary, fixed intervals. To address these limitations, we present UniMem, a framework that unifies high-level, multimodal memory and low-level control under one backbone. UniMem employs an event classifier for memory updates, a keyframe encoder for dense spatial memory, and a keyframe caching technique to minimize overhead during policy rollouts. We evaluate UniMem across five simulation and four hardware tasks targeting sequential and spatial memory, demonstrating that our unified, single-model system outperforms fixed-interval image sampling baselines (93.4% vs. 68.2%) in simulation and hierarchical baselines (80.0% vs. 43.5%) in hardware, while offering faster inference and a simple training pipeline for easy adoption. Project website: https://losterberg3.github.io/unimem-vla/
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（Vision-Language-Action, VLA）模型借助互联网规模预训练与任务定向微调，在长周期任务上取得了优异性能，但在需要记忆能力的非马尔可夫任务中往往表现不佳。现有记忆相关方法通常引入额外的视觉语言模型（Vision-Language-Models, VLMs）实现长期记忆管理，会带来记忆瓶颈问题与碎片化的训练流水线。以多帧历史图像为条件可以让VLA获取过去场景更具描述性的特征，但如果以任意固定间隔选取帧反而会导致性能下降。为解决上述局限，本文提出UniMem框架，在单个骨干网络下统一高层多模态记忆与低层控制功能。UniMem采用事件分类器实现记忆更新，关键帧编码器实现稠密空间记忆，同时使用关键帧缓存技术最小化策略推演过程中的开销。本文在5个仿真任务与4个硬件任务上针对序列记忆与空间记忆能力对UniMem开展评估，结果表明该单模型统一系统在仿真场景下性能优于固定间隔图像采样基线（93.4%对比68.2%），在硬件场景下性能优于分层基线（80.0%对比43.5%），同时具备更快的推理速度与更简单的训练流水线，便于落地应用。项目主页：https://losterberg3.github.io/unimem-vla/

title: Toward Sub-1 kB Identity-Preserving Face Compression: A Benchmark of Codecs, a Custom Learned Codec, and Studies of Resolution, Demographic Fairness, Recompression, and Adversarial Robustness
title_zh: 面向低于1kB的身份保留人脸压缩：编解码器基准测试、定制化学习编解码器及分辨率、人口统计公平性、重压缩与对抗鲁棒性研究
authors: Petr Hurtik, Jakub Sochor
abstract: Sub-kilobyte identity preservation is feasible, but which codec to deploy depends entirely on the budget. At 1024 bytes and the 112 px working resolution the problem is close to solved: modern codecs hold Color FERET equal-error rate under 0.35 percent on the ArcFace anchor. At 512 bytes the field re-sorts: AVIF, HEIF, JPEG XL and legacy JPEG collapse to 28 to 98 percent false-non-match rate at FMR 1e-4, while WebP, JPEG-AI and our byte-budgeted learned codecs stay out of that band, with 24.3 percent for WebP against 6.9 percent for our accurate variant in the wild. That re-sort, not the 1024-byte ranking, is the operational result: a codec chosen at 1 kB is not the codec to deploy at half that.
summary_zh: 亚千字节级的人脸身份保留压缩是可实现的，但具体部署哪类编解码器完全取决于比特预算。在1024字节、工作分辨率为112像素的条件下，该问题已接近得到解决：现代编解码器在ArcFace锚点上的Color FERET等错误率可控制在0.35%以下。当比特预算降至512字节时，性能排名发生重构：AVIF、HEIF、JPEG XL与传统JPEG在FMR（错误匹配率）为1e-4的条件下，错误非匹配率高达28%~98%，而WebP、JPEG-AI与本文提出的面向比特预算优化的学习编解码器性能远优于上述区间，其中WebP的错误非匹配率为24.3%，本文提出的高精度变体在真实场景下仅为6.9%。这种低比特下的性能重构而非1024字节下的排名才具备实际指导意义：在1kB预算下选择的编解码器并不适用于仅为其一半的比特预算场景。

title: Following Motion for Sequential Modeling in Video Frame Interpolation
authors: Jaehyun Park, Nam Ik Cho
abstract: State Space Models (SSMs) have surfaced as a promising architecture in Video Frame Interpolation (VFI), as they can capture long-range dependencies with linear computational complexity. However, their predefined scanning order limits their effectiveness in modeling the dynamic motion trajectories inherent in VFI problems. To tackle this challenge, we propose Motion-Guided Mamba for Video Frame Interpolation (MGMVFI), an adaptation of the selective state space model tailored explicitly for VFI. MGMVFI introduces Motion-Guided Serialization (MGS), which leverages optical flow to define a motion-adaptive 1D input order for the SSM. This aligns the causal state updates with semantically related tokens, enabling motion-consistent feature propagation, particularly for large and dynamic motions. Additionally, to mitigate the unreliable feature representations caused by inaccurate optical flow estimates, we introduce contextual synthesis that utilizes the surrounding spatial context for robust inter-frame feature synthesis. These components are seamlessly integrated within our tailored Mamba architecture, which also employs a lightweight refinement block to enhance local detail reconstruction at a reduced computational cost. Extensive experiments on standard VFI benchmarks demonstrate that MGMVFI achievesstate-of-the-artperformance,particularly on complex and dynamic motions, thereby establishing a new direction for sequence modeling in video interpolation.

title: Mapping the Concept Landscape: Structural Perception of Global Distributions for Transparent Data Pruning
title_zh: 概念景观映射：面向透明数据剪枝的全局分布结构感知方法
authors: Dongyue Wu, Tao Ma
abstract: Existing data pruning methods predominantly rely on high-dimensional feature embeddings to measure sample importance. However, these compressed vectors often obscure fine-grained semantic interactions, leading to suboptimal coverage of rare semantic concepts in the pruned subsets. In this paper, we propose Mapping the Concept Landscape (MCL), a novel structural perception framework for transparent data pruning. Instead of abstract embeddings, we represent each image-caption pair as an explicit sample-level graph comprising entities, events, and attributes. By integrating these individual graphs into a comprehensive dataset-level graph, we characterize the global distribution of semantic concepts and quantify their rarity across the entire corpus. Based on this structured perception, we develop a greedy concept-coverage maximization algorithm that iteratively selects samples to maximize the marginal gain of high-value, under-represented concepts. Experimental results on various benchmarks demonstrate that our method not only achieves superior pruning efficiency compared to state-of-the-art methods but also provides a transparent and interpretable audit trail for the selection process.
summary_zh: 现有数据剪枝方法大多依赖高维特征嵌入衡量样本重要性，但这类压缩向量往往会掩盖细粒度的语义交互，导致剪枝后的子集对稀有语义概念的覆盖度达不到最优。本文提出MCL（Mapping the Concept Landscape，概念景观映射），一种面向透明数据剪枝的全新结构感知框架。该框架不使用抽象嵌入，而是将每一个图文对表示为由实体、事件和属性组成的显式样本级图结构。通过将所有个体图整合为一个覆盖全数据集的综合图，可刻画语义概念的全局分布，量化所有语料中各概念的稀有度。基于该结构化感知结果，本文开发了一种贪心概念覆盖度最大化算法，通过迭代选择样本，最大化高价值、低代表性概念的边际增益。在多个基准数据集上的实验结果表明，本文方法相比当前最优方法不仅具备更优异的剪枝效率，还可为样本选择过程提供透明可解释的审计轨迹。

title: VeCAS: Vessel-Focused Contrast-Free Angiogram Synthesis for Vascular Interventions
title_zh: VeCAS：面向血管介入手术的聚焦血管结构的无造影剂血管造影合成方法
authors: De-Xing Huang, Chen-Yu Wang, Hao Liang, Xiao-Hu Zhou, Mei-Jiang Gui, Tian-Yu Xiang, Qin-Yi Zhang, Chen Wang, Xiao-Liang Xie, Shi-Qi Liu, Ming-Yuan Liu, Zhen-Chang Wang, Zeng-Guang Hou
abstract: X-ray angiography relies on iodinated contrast agents to visualize vascular structures during image-guided interventions. However, contrast administration carries risks of adverse events, motivating the development of contrast-free alternatives. Generating X-ray angiograms directly from non-contrast X-ray images offers a potential solution, but existing approaches remain limited by (i) insufficient control over vascular localization and (ii) inefficient modeling of redundant background content. To address these challenges, we propose VeCAS, a two-stage vessel-focused contrast-free angiogram synthesis framework that separates vascular structure localization from angiographic appearance synthesis. In Stage I, a discriminative model localizes vascular structures in non-contrast X-ray images, while cross-modality latent distillation transfers vessel-sensitive knowledge from X-ray angiograms during training. In Stage II, a vessel-focused inpainting model synthesizes angiographic appearance within the localized vascular regions while preserving the non-vascular background. Experiments on an in-house lower-limb vascular intervention dataset show that VeCAS outperforms the comparison methods in terms of vascular structural fidelity and image quality. Visual Turing tests and physician assessments indicate the perceptual realism of the synthesized angiograms. In addition, robotic guidewire navigation experiments in vascular phantoms show that VeCAS guidance reduces the time to target by 41.4% and the number of operation steps by 40.7% compared with non-contrast guidance. Together, these results suggest the potential of VeCAS to serve as ``meta contrast agent'' for vascular interventions.
summary_zh: X线血管造影依赖碘造影剂在影像引导介入手术中显示血管结构，但造影剂注射存在引发不良事件的风险，推动了无造影剂替代方案的研究。直接从非造影X线图像生成X线血管造影是一种可行的解决方案，但现有方法存在两点局限：（1）对血管定位的控制能力不足；（2）对冗余背景内容的建模效率低下。为解决上述挑战，本文提出VeCAS，一种两阶段的聚焦血管结构的无造影剂血管造影合成框架，将血管结构定位与血管造影外观合成两个任务分离。第一阶段中，判别模型定位非造影X线图像中的血管结构，训练过程中通过跨模态潜蒸馏从X线血管造影中迁移血管敏感知识。第二阶段中，聚焦血管的修复模型在已定位的血管区域内合成血管造影外观，同时保留非血管背景内容。在自研的下肢血管介入数据集上的实验结果表明，VeCAS在血管结构保真度与图像质量上均优于对比方法。视觉图灵测试与医师评估结果证明了合成血管造影的感知真实性。此外，在血管体模上开展的机器人导丝导航实验显示，与非造影引导方案相比，VeCAS引导可将到达靶点的时间缩短41.4%，操作步骤数减少40.7%。上述结果表明VeCAS具备作为血管介入手术的“元造影剂”的应用潜力。

title: SiZeUp: Fast 3D Proxy from Aerial Images via Depth Ordinal Loss
title_zh: SiZeUp：基于深度序损失从航拍图像快速生成3D代理模型
authors: Wenjun Zhou, Yunshan Li, Qiaoyu Zhu, Weidan Xiong, Hao Zhang, Daniel Cohen-Or, Hui Huang
abstract: We present SiZeUp, a fast and scalable approach for constructing large-scale 3D urban proxy models directly from calibrated oblique aerial imagery. Our method adopts a height-from-footprint representation, reducing 3D building abstraction to a low-dimensional optimization problem in which building footprints are extruded by a single height parameter. To enable efficient and robust height estimation, we introduce an ordinal depth consistency loss that enforces agreement between the relative depth ordering of rendered proxies and depth priors predicted by a monocular depth model. This is realized through a differentiable renderer that maps parametric building proxies into multi-view depth images, allowing gradients to be propagated from depth supervision to building heights. Our ordinal formulation produces stable optimization in practice and avoids explicit feature matching or dense point cloud reconstruction. Rather than relying on metric depth, which can be unreliable under monocular scale ambiguity, our ordinal depth consistency loss operates on relative depths, providing a more reliable signal across views. Combined with an efficient dynamic view selection, our approach achieves a 23-52$\times$ speedup over state-of-the-art proxy reconstruction pipelines while maintaining comparable proxy-level coverage and volume consistency, making it well suited for large-scale urban modeling tasks.
summary_zh: 本文提出SiZeUp，一种可扩展的快速方法，可直接从经过标定的倾斜航拍图像构建大规模3D城市代理模型。该方法采用基于足迹的高度表示，将3D建筑抽象简化为低维优化问题，仅需单个高度参数即可对建筑足迹进行拉伸生成3D模型。为实现高效鲁棒的高度估计，本文提出序深度一致性损失，约束渲染得到的代理模型的相对深度排序与单目深度模型预测的深度先验保持一致。该机制通过可微渲染器实现，可将参数化建筑代理模型映射为多视图深度图像，支持从深度监督信号到建筑高度的梯度反向传播。本文提出的序公式在实际应用中可实现稳定优化，无需显式特征匹配或稠密点云重建。不同于易受单目尺度歧义影响的不可靠度量深度，本文的序深度一致性损失基于相对深度计算，在多视图下可提供更可靠的监督信号。结合高效的动态视图选择策略，本文方法相比当前最优的代理重建流水线实现了23~52倍的速度提升，同时保持了相当的代理模型覆盖度与体积一致性，非常适用于大规模城市建模任务。

title: Direct, Parallel, or Sequential? A Comparative Study of Training-Free Multi-Subject Image-to-Video Generation
title_zh: 直接、并行还是串行？面向无需训练的多主体图像转视频生成的对比研究
authors: Yanliang Qi, Kexi Chen, Muchao Ye, Haomiao Ni
abstract: Text-conditioned image-to-video (I2V) generation has advanced rapidly, yet generating videos with multiple subjects remains challenging. A model must simultaneously preserve the appearance of each subject, assign distinct motions, and maintain coherent spatial and temporal interactions. This paper presents a systematic study of three representative paradigms for training-free multi-subject I2V generation: direct, parallel, and sequential generation. Direct generation applies a pretrained I2V model to the complete reference image and prompt, requiring all subjects and motions to be synthesized jointly.
