summary_zh: 随着越来越多机器人智能体在人类环境中通过扫描并共享3D表示（例如用于集群学习、云侧规划或协同建图）完成作业，采集到的点云不仅会暴露场景中的物体，还会泄露敏感空间上下文信息，比如房间功能、或居住者从未同意披露的信息。传统点云编码器无法从原理层面对该问题进行管控：要么完整保留所有信息，要么完全丢弃所有信息。为此本文提出RoboShape，一种在冻结的Sonata编码器基础上、由信息论引导的压缩头结构。我们基于Donsker-Varadhan互信息（MI）公式对体素级嵌入进行投影，具体而言，最大化嵌入与物体级理解之间的互信息，同时最小化嵌入与隐私属性之间的互信息。在三个真实室内激光雷达数据集上的测试结果表明，RoboShape生成的嵌入体积缩小87.5%，保留了98.7%的物体分类效用，同时将敏感属性预测准确率降低了39.3%。其生成的隐私保护型嵌入在网络传输或训练下游任务模型时成本更低。我们开源了RoboShape代码库，为机器人领域提供了一种不依赖特定编码器的实用工具，用于构建紧凑、具备隐私感知能力、可直接部署的感知流水线。

title: Gate Voltage Effect on Pulse Detection Efficiency of Perimeter-Gated SPADs
title_zh: 栅极电压对边缘门控单光子雪崩二极管（pg-SPAD）脉冲探测效率的影响
authors: Hunter Guthrie, Md Sakibur Sajal, Zexi Liu, Marc Dandin
abstract: Perimeter-gated single-photon avalanche diodes (pg-SPADs) are known for their dynamic dark noise modulation capabilities. They are reported to trade noise for photon sensitivity under continuous illumination. However, the implications of this trade-off have not heretofore been studied with pulsed optical systems. This work bridges this gap. We demonstrate that pg-SPADs fabricated in a 0.35 $\mu$m standard CMOS process trade-off pulse detection efficiency for a reduction in the the spread of spurious events within a burst window. Consequently, herein, we propose guidelines for the optimal use of pg-SPADs in pulsed LIDAR applications in view of the observed trade-off.
summary_zh: 边缘门控单光子雪崩二极管（pg-SPAD）具备动态暗噪声调制能力，现有研究表明其可在连续光照场景下通过牺牲噪声性能换取光子灵敏度提升，但该权衡关系在脉冲光学系统中的影响此前尚未得到研究。本文填补了这一研究空白，验证了采用0.35μm标准CMOS工艺制备的pg-SPAD可通过牺牲脉冲探测效率，降低突发窗口内伪事件的分布范围。基于观测到的权衡特性，本文提出了pg-SPAD在脉冲激光雷达应用中的最优使用准则。

title: Differentiable Voxelization of Surface Representations
title_zh: 表面表示的可微分体素化方法
authors: Tobias Djuren, Ugo Finnendahl, Markus Worchel, Hendrik Meyer, Marc Alexa
abstract: Different shape representations facilitate different computations. Surface representations, in particular meshes, are often used for modeling, whereas volume representations are useful for spatial queries such as intersection or containment. Optimizing a surface representation based on a volumetric properties by gradient descent requires the derivatives of the volume relative to its bounding surface. We derive this gradient for winding numbers and show that it can be efficiently computed for volumetric values sampled on a regular grid (voxel representation) and surface parameters based on vertex sets (triangle meshes). This enables an efficient solution for a variety of optimization problems. We demonstrate the practical use of this approach at the examples of deforming meshes to resolve intersections, being manufacturable by cutting with a bandsaw from three directions, and creating shapes that are close to tiling 3D space.
summary_zh: 不同的形状表示适用于不同的计算场景：表面表示（尤其是网格）通常用于建模，而体表示则适用于相交、包含性判断等空间查询任务。基于体属性通过梯度下降优化表面表示，需要得到体相对于其包围表面的导数。本文针对环绕数推导得到该梯度，证明其可基于规则网格采样的体值（体素表示）和基于顶点集的表面参数（三角网格）实现高效计算，为各类优化问题提供了高效解决方案。本文通过多个场景验证了该方法的实用性：变形网格以消除相交、实现可通过三个方向带锯切割的可制造性、生成可紧密铺满3D空间的形状。

title: As-Rigid-As-Possible Regularization for Implicit Surfaces
title_zh: 面向隐式表面的尽可能刚性（ARAP）正则化方法
authors: Tobias Djuren, Markus Worchel, Ugo Finnendahl, Marc Alexa
abstract: Implicit surface representations have regained popularity because of their use in machine learning. A common component in optimization is regularization, penalizing the deviation of the surface from its original shape. The popular as-rigid-aspossible (ARAP) energy strikes a good compromise between realistic deformation behavior and efficient computation, at least for piecewise linear meshes. We develop an approach for computing the ARAP energy of a deformation function based on point sampling of the surface. The implicit representation is exploited to provide differentials in each sample. The evaluation is efficient and exact in each sample (up to numerical precision). We demonstrate the general applicability of the method to neural shape processing in several applications and contrast its properties with alternatives from the literature.
summary_zh: 隐式表面表示因在机器学习领域的应用重新受到广泛关注。正则化是优化过程中的常见组件，用于惩罚表面偏离原始形状的程度。目前主流的尽可能刚性（As-Rigid-As-Possible, ARAP）能量函数在真实变形行为和计算效率之间实现了良好平衡，不过该特性此前仅在分段线性网格上得到验证。本文提出一种基于表面点采样计算变形函数ARAP能量的方法，利用隐式表示获取每个采样点的微分，计算过程高效且在数值精度范围内每个采样点的结果完全精确。本文通过多个神经形状处理应用验证了该方法的普适性，并将其性能与现有文献中的替代方案进行了对比。

title: Reward-Free Continual Adaptation for Resilient Space Robots
title_zh: 面向高韧性空间机器人的无奖励持续自适应方法
authors: Andrej Orsula, Miguel Olivares-Mendez, Carol Martinez
abstract: Space robots operate in extreme environments where hardware degradation can critically compromise traditional control strategies. While continual reinforcement learning offers a promising mechanism for online adaptation, it inherently requires access to a reward signal during deployment. However, precise reward computation in space is often infeasible due to the lack of external tracking systems and the overall complexity of the environment. To address the challenge of unobservable rewards, we introduce a reward-free continual learning framework that leverages latent-state world models. By pre-training a model-based agent across diverse simulations, the world model learns a robust predictor of the reward structure within its latent space. Upon deployment to an environment with severe hardware degradation, we freeze the observation encoder and reward predictor to update only the transition dynamics of the world model through unsupervised rollouts. By training the policy entirely on imagined trajectories generated by this updated world model, the agent adapts to altered dynamics without receiving new rewards. We demonstrate our approach across simulated planetary traversal, orbital navigation, and precision assembly tasks subjected to severe morphological failures.
summary_zh: 空间机器人在极端环境下作业时，硬件退化会严重破坏传统控制策略的性能。尽管持续强化学习为在线自适应提供了极具前景的实现路径，但该方法在部署阶段天然需要获取奖励信号。然而受外部跟踪系统缺失、环境整体复杂度高等因素限制，空间场景下的精确奖励计算通常难以实现。为解决奖励不可观测的挑战，本文提出一种基于隐状态世界模型的无奖励持续学习框架。通过在大量不同仿真场景下预训练基于模型的智能体，世界模型可在隐空间中学习到鲁棒的奖励结构预测器。当部署到存在严重硬件退化的环境中时，我们冻结观测编码器和奖励预测器，仅通过无监督推演更新世界模型的转移动力学。完全基于更新后的世界模型生成的想象轨迹训练策略，智能体即可在不获取新奖励的前提下适应变化后的动力学特性。本文在存在严重形态故障的行星表面穿越、轨道导航、精密装配三类仿真任务上验证了所提方法的有效性。

title: ROS2SmolVLA: Enabling Small Vision-Language-Action Models for Integration into Industrial-Grade Lightweight Robots
title_zh: 具备类组织结构的仿生关节覆盖皮肤设计，用于提升肌肉骨骼人形机器人的本体感知能力
authors: Nils Mandischer, Noah B\"ockmann, Ludwig Holl, Lars Mikelsons
abstract: Industrial demand changes the paradigms of production. Due to smaller batch sizes and more variations in products, companies face a growing challenge to adopt more adaptive production systems. In particular, robot-based automation is usually static and fails to respond to constantly changing processes. Vision-Language-Action (VLA) Models are a promising opportunity to mitigate this challenge by generating robot actions based on the observed system state. However, current research either focuses on large models that cannot be computed on premise, creating compliance and security challenges, or use lab-grade robot hardware that obscures exploitation in real industrial settings. In this work, we adapt Hugging Face's SmolVLA for Universal Robots lightweight robots. Further, we release the open-source repository ROS2SmolVLA that implements an interface for ROS 2 to SmolVLA, and makes it applicable for industrial-grade hardware. By this, we allow a lenient adoption into lab and industrial environments. We validate the functionality of SmolVLA for a Universal Robots UR10e using a pick-and-place task and give implementation guidelines. Our findings support that SmolVLA is a well-suited option for small-sized tasks that need to be computed on premise.
summary_zh: 肌肉骨骼人形机器人的本体感知目前主要依赖肌肉传感进行估计，关节周围皮肤形变的作用尚未得到充分探索。在生物系统中，分布在软组织中的机械感受器可补充肌肉反馈，支撑可靠的关节状态估计。本文提出一种具备类组织分层结构的仿生关节覆盖皮肤，将压力敏感和拉伸敏感元件集成在关节覆盖组织中。所提出的皮肤被部署在肌肉骨骼人形机器人Musashi-W上，本文对其独立本体感知能力、以及与肌肉传感的融合效果进行了评估。实验结果表明，仅使用该皮肤即可实现平均误差约3度的关节角度估计，与肌肉传感融合后可进一步提升估计精度。得益于关节覆盖式结构，该皮肤可从机械层面降低外部干扰对肌肉的影响，多模态融合方案也有望识别出仅靠肌肉传感难以解析的外部刺激。本文提出了仿生关节覆盖皮肤的设计方法，证明这类具备类组织结构的皮肤可作为扩展肌肉骨骼人形机器人本体感知系统的有效路径。

title: Design of a Biomimetic Joint-Covering Skin with Tissue-Like Structure to Enhance Proprioception in a Musculoskeletal Humanoid
authors: Akihiro Miki, Shun Hasegawa, Yoshimoto Ribayashi, Kento Kawaharazuka, Kei Okada
abstract: Proprioception in musculoskeletal humanoids is typically estimated primarily from muscle sensing, while the role of cutaneous deformation around joints remains insufficiently explored. In biological systems, mechanoreceptors distributed within soft tissue complement muscle feedback and support reliable joint state estimation. This study presents the design of a biomimetic joint-covering skin with a tissue-like layered structure that integrates pressure- and stretch-sensitive elements within the joint-covering tissue. The proposed skin is implemented on the musculoskeletal humanoid Musashi-W, and its independent proprioceptive capability as well as its integration with muscle sensing are evaluated. Experimental results show that the proposed skin alone achieves joint angle estimation with an average error of approximately 3 degrees. Furthermore, integration with muscle sensing improves estimation accuracy. Owing to its joint-covering structure, the skin may mechanically mitigate the influence of external disturbances on the muscles, and the integration of multiple modalities suggests the possibility of contributing to the identification of external stimuli that are difficult to interpret using muscle sensing alone. This work presents a design methodology for biomimetic joint-covering skin and demonstrates that such tissue-structured skin can serve as an effective approach for extending proprioceptive systems in musculoskeletal humanoids.

title: Guided Riemannian Optimization (GuRO): Bridging Model Predictive Control and Decision Transformers
title_zh: 引导黎曼优化（GuRO）：打通模型预测控制与决策Transformer的融合路径
authors: Hossein Abdi, Satya Prakash Dash, Mingfei Sun
abstract: Decision-making in high-dimensional, nonlinear systems remains a central challenge in robotics. While model-based methods like Model Predictive Control (MPC) offer sample efficiency and interpretability, their performance degrades when the dynamics model is inaccurate or long-horizon predictions are required. Conversely, model-free reinforcement learning (RL) learns policies directly from interaction but suffers from high sample complexity and unstable optimization. Recent advances in sequence modeling have inspired transformer-based decision-making frameworks that can unify MPC and RL, but their training typically faces significant optimization challenges due to highly non-convex loss landscapes. In this work, we propose a novel framework that integrates MPC with RL in a sequence decision-making framework and leverages a curvature-aware optimization to efficiently tackle non-convex loss landscapes. MPC provides predictions of locally optimal trajectories that guide the decision transformer, removing the need for extensive offline pretraining. To address the slow and unstable convergence of traditional optimizers, we train the policy in a Riemannian parameter space using an efficient Riemannian (curvature-aware) method, leading to faster and more robust optimization. We evaluate our framework on high-dimensional quadruped control tasks and demonstrate consistent improvements over strong baselines, including TRPO, SAC, and Online Decision Transformer, achieving higher returns and faster convergence.
summary_zh: 高维非线性系统的决策是机器人领域的核心挑战。尽管模型预测控制（MPC）这类基于模型的方法具备样本效率高、可解释性强的优势，但当动力学模型存在误差或需要进行长程预测时，其性能会出现明显下降。与之相对，无模型强化学习（RL）可直接通过交互学习策略，但存在样本复杂度高、优化过程不稳定的问题。近期序列建模领域的进展催生了可统一MPC和RL的基于Transformer的决策框架，但这类框架的训练过程通常会因高度非凸的损失曲面面临显著的优化难题。本文提出一种新型序列决策框架，将MPC与RL相融合，利用曲率感知优化方法高效处理非凸损失曲面。MPC可输出局部最优轨迹的预测结果引导决策Transformer，无需进行大量离线预训练。为解决传统优化器收敛速度慢、不稳定的问题，本文在黎曼参数空间中采用高效的黎曼（曲率感知）方法训练策略，实现了更快、更鲁棒的优化。本文在高维四足机器人控制任务上对所提框架进行评估，结果表明其性能始终优于TRPO、SAC、在线决策Transformer等主流基线方法，可实现更高的累计回报和更快的收敛速度。

title: Spinning Quadrotor: Hover Thrust Augmentation with Passive Lifting Surfaces
title_zh: 自旋四旋翼：基于被动升力面实现悬停推力增益
authors: Aniketh Parkala, Harikumar Kandath
abstract: Conventional multirotor aerial vehicles actively suppress yaw rotation during hover, expending power to maintain a fixed heading despite the fact that yaw regulation is not required for force balance or altitude control. This paper challenges that paradigm by proposing a spinning quadrotor architecture that intentionally operates at a sustained yaw rate, converting power traditionally spent on yaw regulation into useful aerodynamic effects. A dynamic model of the spinning quadrotor is developed, analysis for low Re range is conducted to choose an airfoil for lifting surfaces. Preliminary hardware tests show a 22% reduction in thrust required. These findings suggest that intentional yaw rotation, rather than being suppressed, can be exploited as a design mechanism for efficient and robust multirotor flight.
summary_zh: 传统多旋翼飞行器在悬停阶段会主动抑制偏航旋转，消耗功率维持固定航向，而偏航调节本身并不参与力平衡或高度控制。本文对该传统范式提出挑战，提出一种自旋四旋翼架构，可在持续偏航速率下运行，将原本用于偏航调节的功率转化为有用的气动效应。本文建立了自旋四旋翼的动力学模型，针对低雷诺数区间开展分析，为升力面选择合适的翼型。初步硬件测试结果表明，该架构可将所需推力降低22%。研究结果表明，主动利用而非抑制偏航旋转，可作为设计机制实现多旋翼飞行器的高效鲁棒飞行。

title: Shaping the Evolutionary Dynamics of Robot Morphology via Adaptive Control Learning
title_zh: 基于自适应控制学习塑造机器人形态的演化动力学
authors: Junru Song, Yang Yang, Yaqing Xu, Ying Wen, Wei Peng, Guozhen Li, Wei'en Zhou, Wen Yao
abstract: Robot co-design via bi-level optimization couples within-lifetime controller learning for fitness evaluation with cross-generational morphological evolution. Prior work has established that well-adapted morphology facilitates faster control learning, a property termed morphological intelligence. Yet how control learning reciprocally shapes morphological evolution remains unexplored. This paper examines both directions for a holistic account of brain-body interplay. We first show that morphological contributions to control learning decouple into two orthogonal dimensions. We formalize the convergence speed as morphological intelligence and identify the performance ceiling as a complementary quantity termed true potential. A concise functional relation is then established to jointly characterize both quantities from individual learning curves, which, when aggregated at the population level, capture evolutionary profiles. Through extensive experiments on simulated voxel-based soft robots, we reveal that premature fitness evaluation systematically underestimates true potential and biases selection towards fast learners. This restricts design space exploration, compromising both optimization efficiency and morphological diversity. Notably, the widely recognized morphological Baldwin effect emerges as an artifact of this bias rather than a general evolutionary tendency. We therefore propose AdaControl, which monitors disproportionate selection for morphological intelligence during evolution and allocates minimally sufficient control learning for unbiased fitness evaluation. With AdaControl, a simple genetic algorithm rivals state-of-the-art generative-model-based co-design methods in discovering diverse high-performing designs while cutting computation by up to 80% versus exhaustive control.
summary_zh: 基于双层优化的机器人协同设计方法，将用于适应度评估的生命周期内控制器学习与跨代形态演化相结合。现有研究已经证明，适配性良好的形态可加快控制学习速度，该特性被称为形态智能。但控制学习反过来如何塑造形态演化的机制尚未得到探索。本文对脑体交互的双向作用进行全面分析，首先证明形态对控制学习的贡献可解耦为两个正交维度：将收敛速度形式化为形态智能，将性能上限定义为互补属性“真实潜力”。随后本文建立了简洁的函数关系，可从个体学习曲线中同时提取上述两个属性，在种群层面聚合后即可表征演化特征。通过在仿真体素软机器人上开展大量实验，本文发现过早的适应度评估会系统性低估真实潜力，将选择过程偏向学习速度更快的个体，进而限制设计空间探索，损害优化效率和形态多样性。值得注意的是，广泛认可的形态鲍德温效应实际上是该偏差的产物，而非通用演化趋势。为此本文提出AdaControl方法，可在演化过程中监测针对形态智能的过度选择行为，分配刚好足够的控制学习资源实现无偏适应度评估。搭配AdaControl后，简单的遗传算法在发现多样化高性能设计的任务上性能可媲美当前最先进的基于生成模型的协同设计方法，同时相比穷尽式控制学习方案最多可降低80%的计算量。

title: Switched Turn-based Adaptive Source Seeking Strategy using Estimation and Information-driven Direction of Improvement
title_zh: 基于估计与信息驱动改进方向的切换式回合制自适应源搜索策略
authors: Shubhra Banerjee, Satadal Ghosh
abstract: Source seeking arises in applications such as gas leak localization, radiation monitoring, and environmental surveillance, where the origin of an unknown signal field must be estimated from spatial measurements. In practice, the source location is not directly observable and must be inferred from noisy scalar measurements collected during motion.In robotic source seeking, estimation and motion are closely linked: measurements improve the source estimate, while the chosen trajectory affects the quality of future measurements.Existing loop-based geometric strategies generate feasible motion but do not explicitly use estimation uncertainty to regulate direction updates.This paper presents a loop-based source-seeking framework that combines Extended Kalman Filter (EKF) estimation with Fisher Information Matrix (FIM)-based direction selection. The source estimate is updated during motion, and the heading is changed at loop boundaries using both estimation uncertainty and predicted information gain. A measurement-based stopping condition is used to detect convergence without requiring prior knowledge of the source location.Simulation results under stationary and moving source scenarios demonstrate improved tracking performance and reduced estimation error compared to purely information-driven or estimate-driven strategies.
summary_zh: 源搜索技术可应用于气体泄漏定位、辐射监测与环境巡检等场景，这类场景需要通过空间测量值估计未知信号场的源头位置。实际应用中，源位置无法直接观测，必须通过运动过程中采集的含噪标量测量值进行推断。在机器人源搜索任务中，状态估计与运动控制高度耦合：测量值可提升源位置估计的精度，而选择的运动轨迹又会影响后续测量的质量。现有基于环路的几何策略可生成可行运动路径，但未显式利用估计不确定性来调整方向更新规则。本文提出一种基于环路的源搜索框架，将扩展卡尔曼滤波（Extended Kalman Filter, EKF）估计与基于费希尔信息矩阵（Fisher Information Matrix, FIM）的方向选择相结合：运动过程中持续更新源位置估计，在环路边界处同时结合估计不确定性与预测信息增益调整航向，采用基于测量值的停止条件判断收敛，无需提前获知源位置的先验信息。静止源与移动源场景下的仿真结果表明，与纯信息驱动或纯估计驱动的策略相比，该方法的跟踪性能更优、估计误差更低。

title: Macro-Action Topological Navigation under Noisy Localization using Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: 噪声定位场景下基于强化学习的宏动作拓扑导航
authors: Simon Hakenes, Tobias Glasmachers
abstract: Navigating large, photorealistic 3D apartments from raw pixels is widely considered infeasible for plain reinforcement learning. We build an agent that does it anyway, estimating its own pose from the camera alone. The agent has to reach several target objects in sequence, and their positions change between episodes, so it must explore to find them. It builds on our earlier object-centric topological controller, which still read the agent's true pose and its object detections from the simulator. Here we replace that true pose with an onboard, object-centric estimate. For each object we keep a bank of ORB features that, when the object is seen again, yield a rough pose measurement, which a minimal Extended Kalman Filter (EKF) fuses with a motion model. As on a real robot, the executed motions are noisy. The estimate drifts, but the agent and the nearby objects drift together, so a locally consistent pose is enough to follow each short edge and then home in visually on the target, which lets us replace full SLAM with a much smaller model, closer to how biological navigation appears to work. In the photorealistic Habitat simulator, the agent reaches its target objects from vision alone, with a pose that only needs to be locally consistent.
summary_zh: 仅依靠原始像素在大尺度、真实感渲染的3D公寓环境中完成导航任务，普遍被认为是普通强化学习方法无法实现的目标。本文构建了一个可完成该任务的智能体，仅通过相机估计自身位姿。该智能体需要按顺序抵达多个目标物体，且目标物体的位置在不同训练轮次中会发生变化，因此智能体必须通过探索找到目标。本研究在前期提出的以物体为中心的拓扑控制器基础上进行改进：原有控制器可从仿真环境中读取智能体的真实位姿与物体检测结果，本文将真实位姿替换为机载的、以物体为中心的位姿估计结果。我们为每个物体维护一组ORB特征，当物体被再次观测到时可生成粗略位姿测量值，再通过轻量型扩展卡尔曼滤波（EKF）将该测量值与运动模型进行融合。与真实机器人场景一致，本研究中智能体的实际执行运动存在噪声，位姿估计会发生漂移，但智能体与附近物体的位姿会同步漂移，因此仅需局部一致的位姿即可完成每段短边的移动，随后通过视觉聚焦到目标上，该特性让我们可以用远轻量的模型替代完整同步定位与地图构建（SLAM）方案，其工作机制更接近生物导航的原理。在真实感渲染的Habitat仿真环境中，该智能体仅依靠视觉即可抵达目标物体，且仅需位姿保持局部一致性。

title: RoboRacer Arena: Scaling High-Fidelity Autonomous Racing in Isaac Sim
title_zh: RoboRacer Arena：在Isaac Sim中扩展高保真自主赛车仿真
authors: Mihaela-Larisa Clement, Agnes Poks, Ezio Bartocci
abstract: RoboRacer offers a standardized platform for research using 1:10-scale autonomous vehicles, but the variety of available tracks hinders the process of acquiring policies. Although existing occupancy-grid simulators allow for the quick addition of new maps, they fail to include physical contact, while 3D simulators require each circuit to be implemented as a separate asset, thus limiting their scalability. In order to overcome this issue, we have developed RoboRacer Arena, a system that creates 3D racing environments directly from occupancy maps. Our method starts by using a flood fill algorithm to extract the drivable corridors and to identify the track boundaries, which are then used to establish the barriers. A distance field is calculated to define the collision boundaries. The track surfaces, collision properties, and materials are assembled into a USD stage, which allows for the automated and reproducible generation of the environment in Isaac Sim. The input maps can be obtained from SLAM sessions, from rescaled Formula 1 circuits, or from natural-language descriptions. When the input is based on natural language, we use Gemma 4 31B to generate a track specification without specifying any coordinates or geometry. To guarantee consistency and reproducibility, we apply geometric screening, procedural generation, and raster-level validation. The simulation environments are initialized in a time range of 1.18 to 2.48 seconds, with the initialization time increasing linearly as the raster size increases. In 30 matched trials involving 10 tracks and 3 seeds, 21 maps were generated and all passed validation. RoboRacer Arena currently contains 130 tracks and supports the generation of tracks from natural language. In benchmark tests, the system attains 8,707 vehicle-steps per second when using 256 parallel rigid-body vehicles, excluding the time taken for rendering and policy execution.
summary_zh: RoboRacer为1:10比例自主车辆研究提供了标准化平台，但现有可用赛道的多样性不足，制约了策略获取的效率。现有基于占据栅格的仿真器可快速添加新地图，但无法模拟物理接触效果；而3D仿真器需要将每条赛道作为独立资源进行开发，可扩展性受限。为解决该问题，本文开发了RoboRacer Arena系统，可直接从占据地图生成3D赛车环境。该方法首先通过漫水填充算法提取可行驶廊道、识别赛道边界，以此生成赛道护栏；再计算距离场定义碰撞边界；最后将赛道表面、碰撞属性与材质整合为USD场景，在Isaac Sim中实现自动化、可复现的环境生成。输入地图可来自SLAM建图结果、按比例缩放的F1赛道，或是自然语言描述：当输入为自然语言时，使用Gemma 4 31B生成不包含坐标与几何参数的赛道规格。为保证一致性与可复现性，研究引入了几何筛选、过程式生成与栅格级验证机制。该仿真环境的初始化耗时在1.18~2.48秒区间，且初始化时间随栅格尺寸增大呈线性增长。在覆盖10条赛道、3个随机种子的30组对照试验中，共生成21张地图且全部通过验证。目前RoboRacer Arena内置130条赛道，支持从自然语言生成赛道。基准测试结果显示，当并行运行256台刚体车辆时，系统可实现每秒8707步的车辆仿真步长，该统计值未包含渲染与策略执行的耗时。

title: Free-Energy-Gated Plasticity for Real-Time Online Motor Learning in Physical Human--Robot Interaction
authors: Hiroki Sawada, Jun Tani
abstract: Fully online embodied learning requires synaptic adaptation to acquire new behaviors while preserving previously learned dynamics during ongoing interaction. We extend the Predictive-Coding-inspired Variational Recurrent Neural Network (PV-RNN) to continuously adapt its synaptic weights and propose Free-Energy-Gated Plasticity (FEGP), which regulates the effective learning rate according to variational free energy. In real-time physical human--robot interaction, a randomly initialized network acquired three cyclic motor patterns without offline pretraining, replay, or task-boundary signals, with all three patterns emerging in autonomous rollouts. Controlled experiments over ten randomized teaching streams and five network initializations per stream showed that FEGP substantially improved repertoire coverage and retention of previously acquired patterns after they left the recent observation window. Neither a constant learning rate matched to the gate's time-averaged effective rate nor replay of the same gain values with disrupted temporal organization reproduced these improvements. These results indicate that the temporal allocation of plasticity relative to model--environment mismatch, rather than simply its average magnitude or distribution, is critical for maintaining previously acquired behaviors during continued online learning.

title: InstructMove: A Text-Indispensable Benchmark for Instruction-Following Manipulation
title_zh: InstructMove：面向指令跟随型机械臂操作的文本依赖型基准测试集
authors: Mengao Zhao, Ziang Li, Chaodong Huang, Mengchen Ma, Haoyi Jiang, Yiwei Jin, Xinjie Wang, Yun Du, Xuewu Lin, Taojun Ding, Hongyu Xie, Jackson Jiang, Chunlei Yu, Kaihua Zhang, Lichao Huang, Liu Liu, Tianwei Lin, Zhizhong Su
abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have made general-purpose robot manipulation increasingly plausible by conditioning robot actions on natural-language instructions. A key test of such generality is whether policies actually follow language instructions. Yet many manipulation benchmarks leave this ability underdetermined: the intended object or destination is often visually salient or uniquely feasible, allowing policies to succeed without grounding the instruction. We argue that instruction-following evaluation should be text-indispensable: multiple actions should be visually and physically plausible, while only one should be consistent with the language instruction. We introduce InstructMove, a text-indispensable benchmark for instruction-following manipulation. InstructMove instantiates this principle in pick-and-place scenes with semantic distractors, decomposing instruction following into category identification, attribute discrimination, spatial reasoning, and compositional pick-and-place. InstructMove supports a train-eval protocol with InstructMove training data and held-out evaluation tasks, with additional diagnostics for language dependence. Experiments with representative VLA policies show that InstructMove provides a controlled testbed for diagnosing visual shortcuts and that InstructMove simulation data can improve real-world instruction-following manipulation performance. Code: https://github.com/HorizonRobotics/RoboOrchardSim
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（Vision-Language-Action, VLA）模型通过让机器人动作以自然语言指令为条件，大幅提升了通用机器人操作的可行性。这类模型通用性的核心检验标准是控制策略是否真的能够遵循语言指令，但现有多数操作基准测试集无法充分验证该能力：测试场景中的目标物体或目标位置通常视觉特征突出，或是唯一可行的选择，导致策略无需对指令进行语义接地即可成功完成任务。本文认为指令跟随评估应当满足文本依赖特性：即场景中存在多个视觉、物理层面均可行的动作，且仅有一个动作符合语言指令的要求。基于该原则本文提出InstructMove，一款面向指令跟随型操作的文本依赖基准测试集。InstructMove在包含语义干扰项的抓取放置场景中落地该评估原则，将指令跟随任务拆解为类别识别、属性区分、空间推理与组合式抓取放置四类子任务。InstructMove提供配套的训练评估协议，包含专属训练数据与预留的评估任务，同时支持语言依赖度诊断。针对主流VLA策略的实验表明，InstructMove可作为受控测试平台诊断视觉捷径问题，且InstructMove生成的仿真数据可提升真实场景下指令跟随操作的性能。代码开源地址：https://github.com/HorizonRobotics/RoboOrchardSim

title: CSymPlan: Certified Symbolic Planning and Control for High-DOF Manipulators
title_zh: CSymPlan：面向高自由度机械臂的可认证符号规划与控制
authors: Aditya Narendra, Ashok Kumar Saini, Mahathi Anand, Mahmoud Khaled, Fares J. Abu-Dakka, Abdalla Swikir
abstract: Robot manipulators are commonly engineered around a decoupled motion-generation stack: a planner computes a collision-free path and a lower-level controller tracks the resulting reference. This separation is computationally convenient, but it can produce references that are difficult to execute under actuator limits, tracking error, model mismatch, and small obstacle clearances. We present CSymPlan, a certified symbolic planning and control framework for high-DOF manipulators with two complementary implementations: an offline implementation that precomputes certified reach-avoid feedback policies for known workspaces; and an online implementation that synthesizes or updates symbolic policies at runtime from changing task and perception information using parallelization. The offline implementation reduces the manipulator dynamics to a sampled perturbed double-integrator model in operational space through feedback linearization, treats torque-realization errors, modeling inaccuracies, and measurement uncertainty as bounded disturbances, and refines the synthesized symbolic policy to the Franka FR3 through a quantization--lookup--torque realization pipeline. The online implementation uses the same abstraction and refinement interface, but replaces the precomputed policy table with a runtime pFaces request--synthesis--execution loop. In randomized simulated benchmarks and perception-driven Franka FR3 experiments, both implementations complete reach-avoid tasks with zero safety violations; whenever no certified action exists, the robot holds, replans, or stops safely instead of executing an uncertified command.
summary_zh: 机器人机械臂通常采用解耦的运动生成架构：规划器计算无碰撞路径，底层控制器跟踪生成的参考轨迹。这种分离设计在计算层面十分便捷，但生成的参考轨迹可能在执行器约束、跟踪误差、模型失配、障碍物间隙较小的场景下难以落地。本文提出CSymPlan，面向高自由度机械臂的可认证符号规划与控制框架，包含两种互补实现方案：离线实现可针对已知工作空间预计算可认证的到达-规避反馈策略；在线实现可基于并行计算，在运行时根据动态变化的任务与感知信息合成或更新符号策略。离线实现方案通过反馈线性化将机械臂动力学简化为操作空间内的采样扰动双积分模型，将力矩实现误差、建模误差与测量不确定性视为有界扰动，再通过量化-查表-力矩生成流水线将合成的符号策略适配到Franka FR3机械臂。在线实现采用相同的抽象与适配接口，将预计算策略表替换为运行时pFaces请求-合成-执行循环。在随机仿真基准测试与基于感知驱动的Franka FR3实体实验中，两种实现方案均可在零安全违规的前提下完成到达-规避任务；当不存在可认证动作时，机器人会保持当前状态、重新规划或安全停机，不会执行未经过认证的指令。

title: Privileged Critic Training Enables Sensor-Free Thruster Fault Adaptation in End-to-End RL
title_zh: 特权评论家训练实现端到端强化学习下无传感器推进器故障自适应
authors: Ricard Marsal I Castan, Miguel A. Olivares-M\'endez
abstract: Fault-tolerant navigation for thruster-actuated robots requires online adaptation to failures that are neither binary nor fully observable: thrusters may degrade continuously, fail dead, or jam stuck-open. Classical fault detection pipelines require dedicated sensors unavailable at deployment; oracle controllers that observe the true failure state are equally impractical. We show that privileged critic training is sufficient for sensor-free fault adaptation: giving the PPO value function access to the true degradation state dgt during training, while the actor receives only standard task observations, shapes a policy that compensates for failures at deployment without any dedicated fault sensing. We propose RAFT (Recurrent Asymmetric Fault Tolerant), a policy with recurrent memory trained with a privileged asymmetric critic. Evaluated on a floating-platform robot (8 thrusters, 1 reaction wheel) under up to four simultaneous thruster failures, RAFT achieves 70.2% success at four concurrent failures, closing 84% of the gap from a failure-naive baseline (4.8%) to an oracle policy that sees the full degradation state at deployment (82.4%). All code, checkpoints, and data are open-source.
summary_zh: 由推进器驱动的机器人的容错导航能力要求系统能够在线适配非二元、非完全可观测的故障场景：推进器可能出现连续性能退化、完全失效或卡滞故障。传统故障检测流水线需要部署场景下不具备的专用传感器，而可观测真实故障状态的先知控制器同样不具备实用性。本文研究表明，特权评论家训练足以实现无传感器故障自适应：训练阶段让PPO算法的价值函数访问真实退化状态dgt，而策略网络仅接收标准任务观测值，最终生成的控制策略可在部署阶段无需任何专用故障传感即可补偿故障影响。本文提出RAFT（Recurrent Asymmetric Fault Tolerant，循环非对称容错）策略，该策略带有循环记忆模块，采用特权非对称评论家完成训练。在搭载8台推进器与1个反作用轮的漂浮平台机器人上开展测试，在最多4台推进器同时故障的场景下，RAFT的任务成功率可达70.2%，将无故障先验基线（4.8%）与可观测全部退化状态的先知策略（82.4%）之间的性能差距弥补了84%。所有代码、模型 checkpoint 与数据均已开源。

title: SuperMap: A Spatio-Temporal SLAM System for Visual-Language Navigation
title_zh: SuperMap：面向视觉语言导航的时空同步定位与地图构建（SLAM）系统
authors: Shibo Zhao, Guofei Chen, Honghao Zhu, Zhiheng Li, Changwei Yao, Nader Zantout, Seungchan Kim, Wenshan Wang, Ji Zhang, Sebastian Scherer
abstract: We demonstrate SuperMap on benchmarks and real robots, including dynamic scenes with appearance/disappearance and relocation, and provide ablations and runtime analysis. We release the full system as open-source to provide the community with a deployable baseline for open-vocabulary spatio-temporal mapping. Project website: superodometry.com/supermap.
summary_zh: 本文在公开基准测试集与实体机器人平台上对SuperMap开展验证，测试场景包含存在物体出现/消失、重定位问题的动态场景，同时提供了消融实验结果与运行时性能分析。本研究将完整系统开源，为领域社区提供可直接部署的开放词汇时空建图基线方案。项目主页：superodometry.com/supermap。

title: Triplet2Track: A Hierarchical System with Object-Centric Representations for Reliable Long-Horizon Manipulation
title_zh: Triplet2Track：面向可靠长时域机械臂操作的以对象为中心表征分层系统
authors: Jianxiang Liu, Gaojing Zhang, Chuan Wen, Qipeng Liu, Yuxuan Zhao, Ning Guo, Wenzhao Lian
abstract: Ensuring reliability in uncertain environments remains difficult for long-horizon robotic manipulation. End-to-end VLA models are data-heavy and opaque, making diagnosis and verification difficult. Hierarchical pipelines are more interpretable, but their plans are often weakly grounded in observations, weakly aligned with low-level actions, and computed without online feedback, leading to open-loop behavior and hallucinations. To address these issues, we introduce the Triplet-to-Track System (TTS), a closed-loop long-horizon imitation learning system that uses human videos to reduce reliance on robot-collected data. TTS represents high-level subgoals as instance-grounded triplets, translates them into continuous track priors for execution, and monitors task progress from observations for online replanning. Across diverse real-world long-horizon tasks, TTS achieves a 74.8\% average success rate and supports object-level and compositional generalization.
summary_zh: 在不确定环境下保障长时域机器人操作的可靠性仍是领域难点问题。端到端视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型数据需求量大且决策过程不透明，难以开展诊断与验证；分层流水线可解释性更强，但生成的规划通常与观测值的接地性弱、与底层动作对齐度低，且计算过程未引入在线反馈，容易出现开环行为与幻觉问题。针对上述问题，本文提出Triplet-to-Track System（TTS），一款闭环长时域模仿学习系统，利用人类演示视频降低对机器人采集数据的依赖。TTS将高层子目标表示为实例接地三元组，将其转换为连续的轨迹先验用于执行，同时基于观测值监控任务进度以支持在线重规划。在多个真实场景长时域任务中，TTS的平均任务成功率达74.8%，支持对象级泛化与组合式泛化。

title: LLM-Based Selection of Incongruent Verbal and Nonverbal Behavior for Virtual Humans
title_zh: 基于大语言模型的虚拟人类言语与非言语不一致行为选择方法
authors: Parisa Ghanad Torshizi, Stacy Marsella
abstract: Nonverbal behavior generation systems for virtual agents often take an utterance as input and generate nonverbal behaviors that emphasize or illustrate the content of the verbal channel. However, human nonverbal behavior is shaped by more than the content of the speech. It is also influenced by speaker roles, interpersonal relationships, social context, and the cognitive and emotional states of the interactants. As a result, the nonverbal channel may reinforce, weaken, qualify, or even contradict the verbal channel. It may also reveal internal states that are hidden or only indirectly implied in speech, including emotional "leakage" that may be incidental to the immediate interaction. Modeling this richer relationship between verbal and nonverbal behavior is important for designing virtual agents that exhibit realistic, human-like behavior. It is especially critical in training contexts that require nuanced social interpretation, such as counseling simulations involving virtual patients. Drawing on Ekman's framework of verbal nonverbal relationships, we propose a taxonomy of categories in which mismatches between verbal and nonverbal behavior can occur. We then examine alternative approaches for realizing these behaviors using large language models, focusing on whether LLMs can select contextually appropriate mismatched verbal and nonverbal behaviors from a given dialogue and social interaction context. Finally, we evaluate the resulting behaviors in a human-subject study, assessing whether context-driven nonverbal behavior, when embodied in a virtual human, produces the intended effects on observers.
summary_zh: 现有虚拟智能体非言语行为生成系统通常以语音文本为输入，生成用于强调或阐释言语内容的非言语行为，但人类的非言语行为不仅受语音内容影响，还会受到说话人角色、人际关系、社会语境、交互双方的认知与情绪状态的影响。因此非言语通道可能强化、弱化、限定甚至矛盾于言语通道的内容，还可揭示语音中隐藏或间接暗示的内部状态，包括与当前交互无关的情绪“泄露”。对言语与非言语行为之间的复杂关系建模，是开发具备真实类人行为的虚拟智能体的核心要求，在需要精细社会解读的训练场景（如包含虚拟患者的心理咨询仿真）中尤为关键。本研究基于Ekman提出的言语-非言语关系框架，提出了言语与非言语行为失配场景的分类体系，随后探索了利用大语言模型实现这类行为的不同方案，重点验证大语言模型是否可从给定对话与社交交互语境中选择符合上下文的失配言语-非言语行为。最终通过人类受试者研究对生成的行为开展评估，验证语境驱动的非言语行为在虚拟人类实体化呈现后，是否可对观察者产生预期的影响效果。

title: Physics Filtering Favors the Generalization of Robot Learning
title_zh: 物理滤波有助于提升机器人学习的泛化能力
authors: Jindou Jia, Shixuan Han, Meng Wang, Gen Li, Zihan Yang, Sicheng Zhou, Kexin Guo, Jianfei Yang, Xiang Yu, Wei Wang, Lei Guo
abstract: Living organisms exhibit extraordinary adaptability to unseen environments through their intrinsic physical structures and lifelong feedback-driven learning. Endowing robots with comparable generalization is critical for reliable operation in the real world. While recent approaches attempt to improve generalization by scaling training data, such strategies remain impractical for robotics, where collecting real-world demonstrations at the scale of large language models is prohibitively costly and slow. Contrary to this reliance on massive datasets, we show that robots can generalize effectively under dynamics uncertainties even with limited training data by leveraging a feedback mechanism, namely PhyFilter, that corrects learning outputs with physics-filtered learning residuals. PhyFilter operates as a lightweight, model-agnostic module whose parameters can be automatically optimized through an auto-learning algorithm, eliminating manual tuning and enabling seamless integration with diverse robot policies. We validate PhyFilter across four representative robotic systems, demonstrating that it enables quadruped robots to generalize to unseen terrains, payload variations, and speed ranges; drones to flight under unseen wind disturbances; aerial manipulators to achieve centimeter-level in-air capture despite wind and mass uncertainties; and acceleration differentiators to remain robust with distribution shift. These results show that physics-filtered feedback can serve as a powerful alternative to massive data scaling.
summary_zh: 生物可通过自身固有物理结构和终身反馈驱动的学习，对未见过的环境表现出极强的适应性。赋予机器人相当的泛化能力是其在真实世界中可靠运行的关键。近期研究尝试通过扩大训练数据规模提升泛化能力，但这类策略在机器人领域仍不具备可行性：机器人领域要收集大语言模型量级的真实世界演示数据，成本极高且速度极慢。与依赖海量数据集的思路不同，本文提出一种反馈机制PhyFilter（物理滤波模块），可通过经物理滤波后的学习残差修正学习输出，即使在训练数据有限的情况下，机器人也能在动力学不确定性下实现有效泛化。PhyFilter是轻量型的模型无关模块，其参数可通过自学习算法自动优化，无需人工调参，可无缝适配各类机器人策略。本文在四类代表性机器人系统上对PhyFilter进行了验证：该方法可使四足机器人泛化到未见过的地形、载荷变化和速度区间；使无人机在未知风扰下完成飞行；使空中机械臂在风场和质量不确定性下实现厘米级的空中抓取；使加速度差分器在分布偏移场景下保持鲁棒性。结果表明，物理滤波反馈可成为替代海量数据扩增的有效方案。

title: VikPath: A Vision Kansformer Framework for Effective Obstacle Avoidance in Self-Supervised Pathfinding
title_zh: VikPath：面向自监督路径规划高效避障的视觉Kansformer框架
authors: Junyao Wang, Yulin Xu, Mohammad Abdullah Al Faruque
abstract: Pathfinding is a fundamental problem in artificial intelligence and autonomous systems. Traditional heuristic-based algorithms, such as A*, rely on predefined heuristic functions to guide the search process. Although effective in structured environments, their search efficiency can degrade substantially in complex, obstacle-rich scenarios, where handcrafted heuristics may provide limited guidance. Recent studies have explored learning-based approaches to improve pathfinding efficiency; however, most existing methods rely on supervised learning and require labels generated by conventional planners or obtained through manual annotation. As a result, their performance is inherently influenced by the quality of the underlying supervision and may degrade when the labeling heuristics fail to capture complex environmental structures. Moreover, existing methods primarily optimize for path length while paying limited attention to obstacle clearance and trajectory smoothness, which can lead to paths that are difficult or unsafe to execute in real-world environments. To address these limitations, we propose $\Design$, a self-supervised pathfinding framework that jointly considers obstacle proximity and path smoothness. At its core, our novel \textit{Vision Kansformer} module learns representations of obstacle distributions without relying on labeled trajectories, enabling the model to better adapt to complex environments. We further introduce a sharp-turn penalty to encourage smoother and more practically executable paths. Extensive experiments demonstrate that, compared with state-of-the-art (SOTA) approaches, $\Design$ achieves an average of 3.28\% greater obstacle clearance and 87.07\% lower inference latency while maintaining smooth path generation.
summary_zh: 路径寻路是人工智能与自主系统领域的基础问题。传统基于启发式的算法如A*算法，依赖预定义的启发式函数引导搜索过程。这类算法在结构化环境中表现优异，但在复杂、障碍物密集的场景中搜索效率会大幅下降，人工设计的启发式函数能提供的指导十分有限。近期研究探索了基于学习的方法提升路径寻路效率，但现有多数方法依赖监督学习，需要由传统规划器生成或人工标注的标签，因此其性能本质上受底层监督信号质量的影响，当标注用的启发式函数无法捕捉复杂环境结构时，性能会出现明显下降。此外，现有方法主要针对路径长度优化，对障碍物间隙和轨迹平滑度的关注度不足，生成的路径在真实环境中难以执行甚至存在安全隐患。为解决上述局限，本文提出自监督路径规划框架VikPath，可同时兼顾障碍物距离和路径平滑度。该框架的核心是全新的Vision Kansformer（视觉Kansformer）模块，无需依赖标注轨迹即可学习障碍物分布的表征，使模型更好地适配复杂环境。本文还引入了急转弯惩罚项，鼓励生成更平滑、实际可执行的路径。大量实验表明，与当前最优（SOTA）方法相比，VikPath的障碍物间隙平均提升3.28%，推理延迟降低87.07%，同时可生成平滑路径。

title: Exact Finite-Length Theory of Uniform Car Parking: Spatial Laws, Absorption, and Aggregation
title_zh: 均匀停车过程的精确有限长度理论：空间规律、吸附与聚集
authors: Ganesh P Kumar
abstract: The uniform car-parking process is the one-dimensional random sequential adsorption of unit cars on a segment of finite length $s$: cars arrive at uniformly random positions and park wherever they fit, until no gap admits another. This paper develops the exact finite-$s$ theory. The joint density of the parked positions is resolved into jamming cells, on each of which it is a rational function, and evaluated by a subset recursion in $O(2^n n)$ operations; the marginal and gap order statistics are obtained as hyperlogarithms whose weight is fixed by the number of coordinates integrated out; and the absorption count and the aggregate quantities are treated through the integral equation descending from R\'enyi.
summary_zh: 均匀停车过程是单位长度车辆在有限长度s的线段上的一维随机顺序吸附过程：车辆从均匀随机位置驶入，停放在所有可容纳的空位中，直到没有剩余间隙可以容纳下一辆车。本文建立了精确的有限s理论：将停放车辆位置的联合密度分解为多个阻塞单元，每个单元上的联合密度为有理函数，可通过子集递归在O(2^n n)的运算复杂度下求解；边缘分布和间隙顺序统计量可表示为超对数函数，其权重由积分消去的坐标数量确定；吸附计数和聚集相关量可通过由Rényi提出的积分方程推导求解。

title: Physical Agentic AI: An Architecture for Orchestrating a Robot Crew with LLMs
title_zh: 物理智能体AI：基于大语言模型的机器人群组协同架构
authors: Xinyuan Liu, Eren Sadikoglu, Riana Chatterjee, Ransalu Senanayake
abstract: Agentic AI frameworks interpret open-ended task goals and decompose them into multi-step plans. Richer information about embodiment-specific capabilities, physical preconditions, and cross-robot coordination improves grounding, but does not eliminate infeasible, mistimed, or unsafe physical actions. Physical robot crews therefore require an explicit architectural interface between semantic planning and execution, where every planned action is verified against robot capabilities, system state, and workflow constraints before actuation. This paper introduces Physical Agentic AI, a framework for skill-grounded robot agent orchestration, in which each robot exposes a typed library of executable skills while a foundation model planner decomposes a task into phases and assigns each phase to a robot-skill pair. A Robot Orchestration layer exposes the skill library, robot state, named locations, and workflow contracts to a non-actuating Mission Planner, while a deterministic Robot Orchestrator validates and authorizes one skill at a time. We evaluate on a drone-UGV search-and-dispatch mission, where every mission in every condition is executed live in Gazebo, and on a humanoid-quadruped transportation task using hardware-equivalent skill interfaces plus two physical trials on a Unitree G1 and Go2. Varying planner knowledge and runtime enforcement independently, we find that retrieval raises skill grounding from 51% to 96% yet leaves informed planners dispatching 23-29% of faulted steps. Per-dispatch enforcement reduces false dispatch to 0% with no false blocks, and a held-plan ablation confirms that the gate, not plan variation, is responsible. Live execution makes the difference physical: without enforcement all eight injected faults crossed the orchestration boundary and six produced robot motion; with enforcement all eight were refused before motion.
summary_zh: 智能体AI框架可解读开放式任务目标，并将其分解为多步规划。与实体相关的能力、物理前置条件和跨机器人协同的丰富信息可提升规划的落地性，但仍无法完全避免不可行、时序错误或不安全的物理动作。因此物理机器人群组需要在语义规划层和执行层之间设置明确的架构接口，所有规划动作在驱动执行前，都需要经过机器人能力、系统状态和工作流约束的校验。本文提出Physical Agentic AI（物理智能体AI），这是一套面向技能落地的机器人智能体协同框架：每个机器人对外暴露一套强类型的可执行技能库，由基础模型规划器将任务分解为多个阶段，并将每个阶段分配给对应的机器人-技能组合。机器人协同层将技能库、机器人状态、命名位置和工作流契约暴露给非执行端的任务规划器，由确定性的机器人协同器逐个校验并授权技能执行。本文在无人机-地面无人车（UGV）搜索与派送任务中完成了全条件下的Gazebo实时仿真验证，还在人形机器人-四足机器人的运输任务中完成了等效硬件技能接口测试，并在Unitree G1和Go2实体机器人上完成了两次物理试验。通过独立调整规划器知识和运行时强制校验规则，本文发现检索机制可将技能落地率从51%提升至96%，但仍会出现23%~29%的错误步骤被知情规划器下发的情况。逐次下发校验机制可将错误下发率降至0，且不会出现合法动作被误拦截的情况，控制变量实验证实校验门限而非规划变异是性能提升的核心原因。实体执行场景下校验的作用尤为突出：无校验时8个注入故障全部越过协同边界，其中6个触发了机器人运动；启用校验后所有8个故障都在机器人运动前被拦截。

title: Enhancing Sim2Real Transfer for Torque-Controlled Robots through Real2Sim Dynamics Estimation and Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: 基于实到虚动力学估计与强化学习提升力矩控制机器人的Sim2Real迁移能力
authors: Davide Bargellini, Alex Pasquali, Andrea Govoni, Riccardo Zanella, Gianluca Palli
abstract: Transferring reinforcement learning policies from simulation to Real-World robots remains a major challenge, particularly when dealing with low-level torque control, where even small modelling inaccuracies can lead to unstable or unsafe behaviours. In this work, we propose a Real2Sim2Real pipeline that improves Sim2Real transfer for torque-controlled robotic arms by combining trajectory matching, parameter optimization via genetic algorithms, and domain randomization. Using the 7-DOF Franka Emika Panda robot, we first identify friction, inertia, and gravity compensation parameters by minimizing the error between real and simulated joint trajectories. These calibrated dynamics are then used to train a TQC-based reinforcement learning agent in simulation. The trained policy is evaluated in both Gazebo and MuJoCo environments, and finally deployed on the real robot. Our results demonstrate a significant improvement in tracking accuracy and policy robustness after parameter tuning, with smooth policy transfer from simulation to the Real-World across multiple target-reaching tasks. This work highlights the effectiveness of accurate physical modelling in enabling stable and generalizable torque-based reinforcement learning policies.
summary_zh: 将强化学习策略从仿真环境迁移到真实机器人仍然是领域的核心挑战，针对底层力矩控制场景的难度尤为突出：即使极小的建模误差也可能导致不稳定甚至不安全的行为。本文提出Real2Sim2Real流水线，结合轨迹匹配、基于遗传算法的参数优化和域随机化方法，提升力矩控制机械臂的Sim2Real（从仿真到现实）迁移性能。本文以7自由度Franka Emika Panda机器人为实验平台，首先通过最小化真实关节轨迹与仿真关节轨迹的误差，辨识得到摩擦力、惯性和重力补偿参数。随后使用校准后的动力学模型，在仿真环境中训练基于TQC的强化学习智能体。训练得到的策略先后在Gazebo和MuJoCo仿真环境中完成评估，最终部署到实体机器人上。实验结果表明，参数校准后策略的轨迹跟踪精度和鲁棒性得到显著提升，可在多个目标到达任务中实现从仿真到真实世界的平滑迁移。本研究验证了精确物理建模对实现稳定、可泛化的力矩控制强化学习策略的有效性。

title: WorldToken: Time-First Sequence Modeling for Robotic Imitation Learning
title_zh: WorldToken：面向机器人模仿学习的时间优先序列建模方法
authors: Chunkai Yang, Andong Yang, Chao Gao
abstract: Robot policies receive heterogeneous observations at each decision step, yet sequence models differ in how they organize these inputs over time. We introduce WorldToken, a time-first policy instantiation that fuses multiview images, proprioception, and task conditioning within each policy timestep into one world token. A causal temporal Transformer models the resulting world-token sequence, and a diffusion action head generates action chunks. On 23 RoboCasa tasks, an 85.3M-parameter policy trained from scratch apart from a frozen pretrained CLIP text encoder achieves 59.45% mean closed-loop success using 2,900 generated demonstrations per task. A complete factorial sweep over five dataset sizes, five model sizes, and two training seeds shows consistent gains from additional target-domain data and diminishing returns beyond moderate model size. Under same-checkpoint history truncation, reducing visible history to one or two policy timesteps lowers closed-loop success for all 50 RoboCasa policies. On RMBench Blocks Ranking, reducing visible history from 146 to 8 seconds lowers evaluator success from 95% to 28%, while an exploratory extended rollout sustains the reference swap sequence for over 850 seconds. These results establish the empirical feasibility of the complete WorldToken instantiation and characterize its data-scaling and temporal-context behavior under the tested recipes. They do not establish superiority over alternative sequence organizations or isolate which components of the complete implementation drive the observed performance.
summary_zh: 机器人策略在每个决策步都会接收异质观测，但不同序列模型组织时序输入的方式存在差异。本文提出WorldToken，这是一种时间优先的策略实例化方法，可在每个策略时间步内将多视角图像、本体感知信息和任务条件融合为单个世界令牌。通过因果时序Transformer对生成的世界令牌序列建模，再由扩散动作头生成动作块。在23项RoboCasa任务上，除冻结预训练CLIP文本编码器外从零训练的85.3M参数策略，在每个任务仅使用2900条生成演示数据的情况下，平均闭环成功率可达59.45%。覆盖5种数据集规模、5种模型规模和2种训练种子的全因子对照实验表明，补充目标域数据可稳定提升性能，当模型规模超过中等阈值后性能收益开始递减。在相同检查点的历史截断设置下，将可见历史长度缩减为1~2个策略时间步时，所有50个RoboCasa策略的闭环成功率均出现下降。在RMBench积木排序任务中，将可见历史长度从146秒缩减至8秒后，评估成功率从95%降至28%，而探索性的长序列滚动可将参考交换序列的维持时长提升至850秒以上。上述结果验证了完整WorldToken实例化的经验可行性，明确了其在测试配置下的数据缩放特性和时序上下文行为特征，但并未证明该方法优于其他序列组织方式，也未分离出实现中各组件对性能的贡献占比。

title: What is the effect of running-specific prostheses on long jumps? Optimization-based prediction and analysis using biomechanical models
title_zh: 专用跑步假肢对跳远的影响是什么？基于生物力学模型的优化预测与分析
authors: Anna Lena Emonds, Johannes Funken, Wolfgang Potthast, Katja Mombaur
abstract: Long jumpers with below the knee amputation (BKA) that take off from their running-specific prosthesis (RSP) improved performances significantly over the last years. The long jump biomechanics differs compared to athletes without BKA and the question arises whether the spring-like properties of the RSP facilitate achieving long jumping distances. The aim of this work is to propose a long jump model for athletes with and without BKA, to evaluate it and to apply it for comparing long jump motions with and without RSP. We establish rigid multi-body system models of one athlete with and one athlete without below the knee amputation (BKA). Long jump motions are computed by solving a specific optimal control problem (OCP) with constraints enforcing a physically correct dynamics, both for motion reconstruction or motion synthesis. With the proposed long jump model, we are able to compute realistic long jump motions. We discuss the causes of differences in measured long jumps and show directions for eliminating them. For both athletes, the synthesized solutions reveal potential for performance improvement. The jumping distance of the athlete without BKA is 64cm (6.9%) longer than the one of the athlete with BKA in the synthesized solutions.
summary_zh: 近年来，使用专用跑步假肢（RSP）完成起跳的膝下截肢（BKA）跳远运动员的成绩得到了显著提升。膝下截肢运动员的跳远生物力学特征与健全运动员存在明显差异，RSP的类弹簧特性是否有助于提升跳远成绩是领域关注的核心问题。本文旨在建立可同时适配健全运动员和膝下截肢运动员的跳远模型，完成模型验证后对比两类运动员使用/不使用RSP的跳远运动特征。本文分别为一名膝下截肢运动员和一名健全运动员建立刚性多体系统模型，通过求解带动力学物理约束的特定最优控制问题（OCP），完成跳远运动的重建与合成。基于提出的跳远模型可生成符合真实特征的跳远运动，本文讨论了实测跳远成绩差异的成因，给出了消除差异的优化方向。两类运动员的合成运动结果均显示出明确的性能提升空间，在合成最优解中，健全运动员的跳远距离比膝下截肢运动员的跳远距离长64cm，相对提升幅度为6.9%。

title: A Unified Neural-Aided Alignment and Calibration Method for AUVs
title_zh: 面向自主水下航行器的统一神经网络辅助对准与标定方法
authors: Guy Damari, Zeev Yampolsky, Itzik Klein
abstract: Autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs) rely on the fusion of inertial navigation systems (INS) and Doppler velocity logs (DVL) for accurate navigation. Before deployment, this fusion requires a DVL initialization pipeline consisting of two stages: alignment, which estimates the rotation between the INS and DVL frames, and calibration, which estimates the DVL error terms. Conventionally, both stages are solved with model-based algorithms that demand complex vehicle maneuvers, surface-level satellite reference measurements, and simplified error models, making initialization time-consuming, trajectory-dependent, and sensitive to sensor quality. In this work, we propose a fully neural- aided DVL initialization pipeline that replaces both stages with two complementary neural networks: ResAlignNet for alignment and DCNet for calibration. The unified pipeline operates in situ on a single nearly constant-velocity trajectory and uses the same inputs as the model-based baseline. Using real-world data recorded across five distinct sensor error-term combinations, the proposed pipeline reduces the velocity root mean squared error by an average of 68.7% over the model-based baseline, using only 25s of data for initialization.
summary_zh: 自主水下航行器（AUV）依赖惯性导航系统（INS）与多普勒测速仪（DVL）的融合实现高精度导航。在部署前，融合系统需要完成两阶段的DVL初始化流程：第一阶段为对准，估计INS坐标系与DVL坐标系之间的旋转关系；第二阶段为标定，估计DVL的误差项。传统方案采用基于模型的算法求解两个阶段，要求航行器完成复杂机动、在水面获取卫星参考测量，且依赖简化的误差模型，导致初始化耗时长、轨迹依赖性强、对传感器质量敏感。本文提出全神经网络辅助的DVL初始化流水线，用两个互补的神经网络替代原有两个阶段：用于对准的ResAlignNet和用于标定的DCNet。该统一流水线可在几乎匀速的单段轨迹上原位运行，输入与基于模型的基线方法完全一致。基于5组不同传感器误差组合的真实场景数据测试表明，仅使用25秒数据完成初始化的情况下，本文提出的流水线相比基于模型的基线方法，速度均方根误差平均降低68.7%。

title: EMPIRE: Explicit Manipulation Planning as a Learnable Intermediate Representation for Egocentric Hand-Motion Forecasting
title_zh: EMPIRE：将显式操作规划作为可学习中间表示的第一视角手部动作预测框架
authors: Wen Wang, Ruibing Hou, Hong Chang, Shiguang Shan, Xilin Chen
abstract: Forecasting dexterous hand motions from egocentric observations is fundamental to intelligent interactive systems. Existing VLM-based methods typically map observations directly to future motions, overlooking the underlying manipulation process that governs hand-object interactions. Moreover, end-to-end optimization couples manipulation learning with motion synthesis, causing motion-generation gradients to interfere with the pre-learned manipulation-aware representations. To overcome these limitations, we propose EMPIRE, a two-stage framework that introduces Explicit Manipulation Planning as an Intermediate Representation for Egocentric hand-motion forecasting. Stage I: Learn to Plan. EMPIRE first learns explicit manipulation plans from multimodal context to capture the progression of hand-object interactions. Stage II: Learn to Act. A motion generator synthesizes future bimanual hand motions conditioned on frozen planner representations, preventing motion-generation gradients from affecting manipulation planning. To support our method, we further construct EMPIRE-651K, a bimanual hand-motion forecasting dataset comprising 650,910 training windows across 111 tasks, each paired with an explicit per-hand manipulation plan. Under identical training and evaluation protocols, EMPIRE achieves state-of-the-art forecasting accuracy, with an MPJPE of 84.53 mm and a finger-relative error of 38.97mm. We release the code and dataset at https://github.com/wangwen-banban/EMPIRE.
summary_zh: 从第一视角观测预测灵巧手动作是智能交互系统的核心基础能力。现有基于视觉语言模型的方法通常直接将观测映射为未来动作，忽略了支配手物交互的底层操作过程。此外，端到端优化将操作学习与动作生成耦合，导致动作生成梯度会干扰预训练得到的操作感知表征。为解决上述局限，本文提出EMPIRE两阶段框架，将显式操作规划作为第一视角手部动作预测的可学习中间表示。第一阶段为规划学习：EMPIRE首先从多模态上下文学习显式操作规划，捕捉手物交互的演进过程。第二阶段为动作执行学习：动作生成器基于冻结的规划器表征生成未来的双手动作，避免动作生成梯度干扰操作规划过程。为支撑该方法，本文进一步构建了EMPIRE-651K双手动作预测数据集，包含111项任务共650910个训练窗口，每个窗口都配有逐手的显式操作规划。在完全相同的训练和评估协议下，EMPIRE取得当前最优的预测精度，平均关节位置误差（MPJPE）为84.53mm，手指相对误差为38.97mm。本文开源了代码和数据集，项目地址为https://github.com/wangwen-banban/EMPIRE。

title: LD4WAM: Learning Latent Dynamics from Human Videos for World Action Models
title_zh: LD4WAM：面向世界动作模型从人类视频中学习潜动力学的方法
authors: Zhenhao Shen, Jiaqi Liang, Jasper Lu, Feng Jiang, Yuran Wang, Chuanbo Wei, Jiayi Liu, Jianchun Yang, Qize Yu, Jiadi You, Ce Hao, Guanqi He, Chen Xie, Ruihai Wu
abstract: Human video is playing an increasingly central role in training World Action Models (WAMs), owing to its diversity and low collection cost relative to teleoperated robot data. However, most WAMs learn from such video only by predicting pixel-level future frames, giving dynamics that are not directly actionable, whereas motion retargeting recovers directly actionable actions but leaves a large visual gap across embodiments. We therefore propose motion-aligned latent dynamics as an embodiment-agnostic representation to bridge video priors and low-level actions. We further present LD4WAM, which pairs a Latent Dynamics Model trained with semantic reconstruction and real motion alignment with a World Dynamics Action Model built as a mixture-of-transformers (MoT), which preserves full future-video generation and uses learnable queries to distill these latent dynamics from generated futures for action conditioning. Pretrained on our curated unified dataset of over 5{,}000 hours of human and robot data, LD4WAM performs strongly in RoboTwin simulation and on real robots equipped with both grippers and dexterous hands, while generalizing well to unseen objects and backgrounds.
summary_zh: 相比于遥操作机器人数据，人类视频的多样性更强、采集成本更低，在世界动作模型（WAM）训练中发挥着越来越重要的作用。但现有多数世界动作模型仅通过预测像素级未来帧从人类视频中学习，得到的动力学特征无法直接映射为可执行动作；而动作重定向方法虽然可以恢复出直接可执行的动作，但不同实体之间存在巨大的视觉域差。针对该问题，本文提出动作对齐的潜动力学作为实体无关表征，打通视频先验知识与底层可执行动作的映射通道。本文进一步提出LD4WAM方法，将通过语义重建和真实动作对齐训练得到的潜动力学模型，与基于混合Transformer（MoT）架构构建的世界动力学动作模型相结合，既保留完整的未来视频生成能力，又通过可学习查询从生成的未来序列中蒸馏得到用于动作条件约束的潜动力学特征。在包含超过5000小时人类和机器人数据的统一精选数据集上完成预训练后，LD4WAM在RoboTwin仿真环境和搭载夹爪、灵巧手的实体机器人上均取得优异性能，同时对未见过的物体和背景表现出良好的泛化能力。

title: WAM-OPD: On-Policy Distillation for World Action Models
title_zh: WAM-OPD：面向世界动作模型（World Action Models, WAM）的在线策略蒸馏
authors: Liuhaichen Yang, Zhuang Jiang, Chenchao Sheng, Zezhi Tang
abstract: World action models (WAMs) couple visual future prediction with robot action generation, but accelerated students can lose task capabilities during distillation and later encounter states that are poorly represented by offline data. We study whether on-policy distillation (OPD) can repair such a student without requiring sparse-reward reinforcement learning. We introduce WAM-OPD, a deployment-consistent post-training recipe for a video-first WAM. The student acts in the environment and therefore determines the history distribution. A frozen teacher labels those student histories with coherent video and action targets, while the student action branch is trained under its own generated video plan, as it is at deployment. Joint video and action losses update lightweight adapters in the shared backbone, together with an action flow-matching regularizer. In preliminary RoboTwin 2.0 studies on two tasks, the released one-video/one-action-step Flash-WAM improves from 0.0% to 58.3% success on HANDOVER MIC, and from 16.7% to 33.3% on PUT OBJECT CABINET. These task-specific results are an initial capability proof rather than evidence of broad or uniform generalization. They nevertheless suggest that dense teacher supervision on student-induced histories is a promising post-training interface for video-first WAMs.
summary_zh: 世界动作模型（WAM）将视觉未来预测与机器人动作生成相结合，但经过加速的学生模型在蒸馏过程中可能损失任务能力，后续还会遇到离线数据表征不足的状态。本文研究在线策略蒸馏（On-Policy Distillation, OPD）是否能够在不依赖稀疏奖励强化学习的前提下修复这类学生模型。我们提出WAM-OPD，这是一套面向视频优先型WAM的部署一致性后训练方案：学生模型在环境中执行动作，自主决定历史数据的分布；冻结的教师模型为这些学生生成的历史数据标注连贯的视频与动作目标，同时学生的动作分支在自身生成的视频规划下完成训练，与实际部署时的运行状态保持一致。视频损失与动作损失共同更新共享主干网络中的轻量适配器，同时搭配动作流匹配正则项。在RoboTwin 2.0平台上针对两项任务的初步研究结果显示，开源的单视频/单动作步长Flash-WAM在HANDOVER MIC任务上的成功率从0.0%提升至58.3%，在PUT OBJECT CABINET任务上的成功率从16.7%提升至33.3%。这些针对特定任务的结果仅为初步的能力验证，不代表模型具备广泛或均匀的泛化能力，但仍表明针对学生生成历史数据的密集教师监督是视频优先型WAM极具前景的后训练接口。

title: GCS-Bridging: Restoring Connectivity of Disconnected Convex Sets for Graph-of-Convex-Sets Motion Planning
title_zh: GCS-Bridging：面向凸集图（Graph-of-Convex-Sets, GCS）运动规划的非连通凸集连通性恢复方法
authors: Xiaokai Zhou, Baoshi Cao, Yang Liu, Kui Sun, Boyu Ma, Zhengpu Wang, Zongwu Xie
abstract: Graph-of-Convex-Sets (GCS)-based trajectory optimization represents collision-free regions in configuration space as a finite collection of convex sets and directly performs collision-free trajectory planning over these sets, substantially simplifying the planning process. However, existing GCS-based trajectory planning methods generally assume sufficient connectivity among the convex regions and do not explicitly address cases in which the start and goal regions belong to different connected components of the initial GCS map. To address this limitation, we propose GCS-Bridging, which reconnects disconnected convex regions through collision-free point paths followed by convex region inflation, thereby recovering the feasibility of otherwise disconnected GCS planning problems. Extensive simulations across multiple IRIS-related algorithms and scenarios demonstrate that GCS-Bridging restores missing start-to-goal connectivity in the initial GCS map with a 99.8% success rate. In addition, a hardware experiment on a single-arm Franka platform in a real-world scenario with initially disconnected start and goal regions validates the effectiveness of the proposed method in practical motion planning. Project website: https://zhouxk1997.github.io/GCS_Bridging/
summary_zh: 基于凸集图（GCS）的轨迹优化将构型空间中的无碰撞区域表征为有限个凸集的集合，直接在这些凸集上执行无碰撞轨迹规划，大幅简化了规划流程。但现有基于GCS的轨迹规划方法普遍假设凸区域之间具备充足的连通性，没有显式处理起始区域和目标区域属于初始GCS地图不同连通分量的场景。针对这一局限，本文提出GCS-Bridging方法，通过无碰撞点路径后续搭配凸区域膨胀的方式重新连接非连通的凸区域，恢复原本不可行的GCS规划问题的可行性。在多种与IRIS相关的算法和场景下开展的大量仿真实验表明，GCS-Bridging恢复初始GCS地图中缺失的起点到终点连通性的成功率达99.8%。此外，在真实场景下起始区域与目标区域初始非连通的单臂Franka平台上开展的硬件实验，验证了该方法在实际运动规划中的有效性。项目主页：https://zhouxk1997.github.io/GCS_Bridging/

title: The Imitator Game: Benchmarking Robot Imitative Ability Beyond Action Prediction
title_zh: 模仿者游戏（The Imitator Game）：超越动作预测的机器人模仿能力基准测试集
authors: Xunzhe Zhou, Yiyang Cai, Fengyi Wang, Ran Ju, Hanxiang Ren, Ruizhe Liu, Yu Zhang, Qian Luo, Feng Chen, Pei Zhou, Yi Ma, Yanchao Yang
abstract: Humans imitate at the level of intent: given a demonstration, we infer its goal and carry it out with whatever tools, objects, and layouts are at hand. Current robot policies instead learn observation-to-action mappings from visual inputs and language instructions, without explicitly inferring the demonstrated task. Learning from human video thus remains largely trajectory-level: models can replay motions in near-identical scenes, but still struggle to imitate what the demonstrator intends rather than merely what they do. We introduce The Imitator Game, a four-level benchmark (L0-L3) that progressively widens the gap between the human demonstration and the robot's own scene, isolating where trajectory replay ceases to suffice and task understanding becomes necessary. We pair it with IG-10K, the largest environment-aligned paired human-robot dataset to date and the only one instantiated across all four levels in both real and simulated settings (20,000+ paired episodes, 50+ tasks, 6 domains), and Imitator Arena, an open platform for blind A/B human evaluation. Across nine state-of-the-art models, performance is stable from L0 to L2 but collapses at L3, identifying functional substitution - achieving the same intent through a different object affordance - as the decisive barrier to intent-level imitation. Human-video-conditioned models outperform caption-conditioned ones, yet every model falls below 13% zero-shot success on unseen tasks; fine-tuning IG-10K-pretrained models with only $10$ paired human-robot demonstrations yields large gains that grow with pretraining scale. The project website and access to Imitator Arena are available at https://imitator-game.github.io.
summary_zh: 人类的模仿行为是意图层面的：收到演示后，人类会推断演示的目标，再利用手边的任意工具、物体和布局完成任务。而当前的机器人策略仅从视觉输入和语言指令中学习观测到动作的映射，没有显式推断演示的任务。因此从人类视频中学习目前仍大多停留在轨迹层面：模型可以在几乎完全相同的场景中复现动作，但仍难以模仿演示者的意图，而非仅仅复刻演示者的动作。本文提出「模仿者游戏」，这是一个包含L0到L3四个层级的基准测试集，逐步拉大人类演示与机器人自身场景之间的差距，定位轨迹复现不再适用、必须开展任务理解的边界场景。我们同时配套发布了IG-10K数据集，这是目前规模最大的环境对齐人-机器人配对数据集，也是唯一一个在真实和仿真场景下覆盖全部四个层级的数据集（包含20000+配对片段、50+任务、6个领域），以及「模仿者竞技场」这一面向盲测A/B人类评估的开源平台。在9个当前最优模型上开展的测试显示，模型性能在L0到L2层级保持稳定，但在L3层级骤降，说明功能替代——通过不同的物体可供性实现相同意图——是意图层面模仿的核心障碍。基于人类视频条件的模型性能优于基于字幕条件的模型，但所有模型在未见过的任务上的零样本成功率均低于13%；仅使用10组配对人-机器人演示对经过IG-10K预训练的模型进行微调即可获得显著性能提升，且提升幅度随预训练规模增大而提高。项目主页与「模仿者竞技场」的访问地址为：https://imitator-game.github.io。

title: Beyond Instance Slots: Semantically Rich World Models for Physical Interaction Planning
title_zh: 超越实例槽：面向物理交互规划的语义丰富世界模型（Semantically Rich World Model, SR-WM）
authors: Juntao Cheng, Jingkai Wang, Yijun Shen, Xiansheng Chen, Zhiwei Yu
abstract: World models for physical interaction are typically trained to predict future observations or latent features; however, a planning-oriented model must answer a fundamentally different question: whether a candidate action produces a task-consistent future while preserving essential relations.Monolithic state representations obscure the underlying entities, while standard instance-level object slots merely identify \emph{what} is present without specifying \emph{what role} each entity plays in the task context. To bridge this gap, we present the Semantically Rich World Model (SR-WM), a task-conditioned world model structured around five functional roles: gripper, target, goal, relation, and phase.Within SR-WM, a visual entity encoder extracts soft entity hypotheses from pretrained patch features, allowing segmentation masks to serve as optional proposal priors without mandating them as required state representations or inference inputs.A role binder subsequently maps these hypotheses to task-specific roles, while an action-conditioned dynamics model predicts role transitions alongside fine-grained semantics, including grasp/contact, predicate establishment, relation preservation, fixture state, and phase change.Crucially, this unified role state grounds downstream multi-candidate action generation, stage-aware reranking, and violation-aware suffix resampling.Our comprehensive evaluation protocol spans all four LIBERO simulation suites, cross-suite transfer, perception diagnostics, and action-sensitivity analysis.Ultimately, this formulation transforms object-centric prediction into a semantic interface linking visual dynamics with planning-oriented decision making.
summary_zh: 面向物理交互的世界模型通常被训练用于预测未来观测或隐特征，但面向规划的模型必须回答一个本质不同的问题：候选动作是否能生成符合任务要求的未来状态，同时保留核心关系。单体状态表征会掩盖底层实体，而标准的实例级对象槽仅能识别场景中存在什么物体，无法说明每个实体在任务上下文中发挥什么作用。为弥补这一缺陷，本文提出语义丰富世界模型（SR-WM），这是一个任务条件化的世界模型，围绕五大功能角色构建：夹爪、目标物、任务目标、关系和阶段。在SR-WM中，视觉实体编码器从预训练的补丁特征中提取软实体假设，允许分割掩码作为可选的提议先验，无需将其强制设为必需的状态表征或推理输入。随后角色绑定器将这些假设映射到任务特定角色，而动作条件化动力学模型预测角色转换以及细粒度语义，包括抓取/接触、谓词建立、关系保留、夹具状态和阶段变化。关键的是，该统一角色表征为下游的多候选动作生成、阶段感知重排序和违规感知后缀重采样提供了基础。本文设计的综合评估方案覆盖全部四个LIBERO仿真套件、跨套件迁移、感知诊断和动作敏感性分析。最终，该框架将以对象为中心的预测转化为连接视觉动力学与面向规划决策的语义接口。

title: DreamMimic: Learning Visuomotor Whole-Body Loco-Manipulation via World Model
title_zh: DreamMimic：基于世界模型的视觉-全身移动操作学习框架
authors: Jie Yin, Xingyu Lai
abstract: Vision-based whole-body loco-manipulation on humanoid robots is challenging due to partial observability, contact-rich dynamics, and the difficulty of learning long-horizon behaviors from high-dimensional visual inputs. We present \href{https://github.com/DreamMimic/DreamMimic}{DreamMimic}, a framework that distills privileged teacher policies into vision-based humanoid controllers via world-model-assisted distillation. Instead of using a Dreamer-style RSSM for planning, we repurpose it to learn predictive latent dynamics that serve as both a representation space and an action-conditioned multi-step supervision signal, while exposing compact predictive features to the student policy to reduce long-term drift. Beyond standard reconstruction objectives for proprioceptive and visual observations, we add auxiliary prediction heads for privileged state, contact, object state, and reward estimation. These heads provide additional supervision related to agent--object interaction and task progress, encouraging the latent representation to retain signals that are useful for contact-rich loco-manipulation. We further introduce Performance-Conditioned Guidance (PCG), a reward-driven adaptive distillation schedule that computes performance scores for both teacher and student to dynamically balance guidance and exploration. PCG prevents both premature teacher annealing and excessive teacher interference in challenging visual settings. Experiments on OMOMO and BEHAVE show improved tracking-based loco-manipulation performance over strong vision-based baselines, without exposing online privileged interaction states to the student at deployment. Qualitative simulations further examine morphology and simulator changes. These results suggest that world models can provide a useful mechanism for stabilizing visual policy distillation in contact-rich humanoid behaviors.
summary_zh: 人形机器人的视觉全身移动操作任务极具挑战性，存在部分可观测性、富接触动力学特性复杂、难以从高维视觉输入中学习长程行为等难点。本文提出DreamMimic框架，通过世界模型辅助蒸馏，将特权教师策略蒸馏为基于视觉的人形机器人控制器。该框架没有使用Dreamer风格的随机隐状态递归网络（RSSM）做规划，而是复用其学习预测性隐动力学，将其同时作为表征空间和动作条件化多步监督信号，向学生策略输出紧凑的预测特征以减少长期漂移。除了针对本体感知和视觉观测的标准重构目标外，该框架还增设了针对特权状态、接触、物体状态和奖励估计的辅助预测头。这些头提供与智能体-物体交互和任务进度相关的额外监督，引导隐表征保留对富接触移动操作有用的信号。本文进一步提出性能条件化引导（Performance-Conditioned Guidance, PCG）机制，这是一种奖励驱动的自适应蒸馏调度方案，通过计算教师和学生的性能得分，动态平衡引导与探索的权重。PCG可以避免在复杂视觉场景下出现教师过早退火、教师过度干预的问题。在OMOMO和BEHAVE数据集上开展的实验表明，与现有最优的基于视觉的基线方法相比，该框架的基于跟踪的移动操作性能更优，且部署时不会向学生暴露在线特权交互状态。定性仿真实验进一步验证了该方法在机器人形态和仿真器变更场景下的鲁棒性。上述结果表明，世界模型可以为稳定富接触人形机器人行为的视觉策略蒸馏提供有效机制。

title: Meta-Ctrl: Guaranteed Plan Generation by Decoupling Syntactic and Semantic Constraints
title_zh: Meta-Ctrl：通过解耦句法与语义约束实现有保障的规划生成
authors: Gwen Yidou-Weng, Edward Sun, Tianyi Ma, Metin Alp Dogan, Benjie Wang, Allen Peng, Guy Van den Broeck, Yuchen Cui
abstract: LLMs generate fluent plans for robots but routinely violate the syntactic and se8mantic constraints they must satisfy to execute, and existing remedies trade formal guarantees against plan quality: soft methods (affordance scoring, grounded decoding) give no guarantee, while symbolic planners (LLM+P) discard the LM's commonsense. We propose \textbf{Meta-Ctrl}, a constrained-decoding framework that guarantees the encoded constraints while preserving the base LM's plan quality. Meta-Ctrl introduces \emph{meta-tokens}---a compact vocabulary of grounded actions---enforcing syntax at the token level and semantics (preconditions, goals, ordering) at the action level, an exact factorization that cuts the memory of constrained decoding from over 107TB to under 2GB. With it, a small open-weight LM becomes competitive where it otherwise sits at the bottom of the leaderboard: on WAH-NL under the LoTa-Bench protocol it reaches the highest reported subgoal success rate, exceeding GPT-4's, with consistent gains across the Embodied Agent Interface. We further demonstrate it on a real tabletop robot, where every generated plan satisfies its preconditions and goals by construction. Project website: https://meta-ctrlg.github.io/.
summary_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）可以为机器人生成流畅的规划，但生成结果经常违反执行所需的句法和语义约束，现有解决方案无法同时兼顾形式化保障和规划质量：软约束方法（可供性评分、 grounded解码）无法提供任何保障，而符号规划器（LLM+P）则会丢弃大语言模型的常识能力。本文提出Meta-Ctrl，这是一个约束解码框架，可在保证编码约束得到满足的同时保留基础大语言模型的规划质量。Meta-Ctrl引入元令牌（meta-tokens）——一套紧凑的落地动作词汇表，在令牌层面强制执行句法约束，在动作层面强制执行语义（前置条件、目标、顺序）约束，这种精确的分解将约束解码的内存占用从超过107TB降低至2GB以下。借助该框架，小型开源大语言模型可以在原本排名垫底的任务上达到与大模型相当的性能：在LoTa-Bench协议下的WAH-NL任务上，其达到了已公开结果中最高的子目标成功率，超过了GPT-4的表现，且在整个具身智能体接口上均获得一致的性能提升。本文进一步在真实桌面机器人平台上验证了该方法，所有生成的规划在构造层面就满足前置条件和目标要求。项目主页：https://meta-ctrlg.github.io/。

title: Contact-Rich Robotic Manipulation in Construction via Zero-Shot Learning: A Diffusion Policy-Guided Adaptive Control
title_zh: 面向建筑场景的零样本学习富接触机器人操作：扩散策略引导的自适应控制方法
authors: Roman Ibrahimov (Princeton University), Salma Mozaffari (Princeton University), Arash Adel (Princeton University)
abstract: Construction robotics and automation offer promising means of improving productivity, alleviating workforce shortages, and reducing workers' exposure to physically demanding tasks. However, reliable contact-rich robotic assembly remains challenging under tight tolerances, fabrication inaccuracies, and uncertain contact dynamics. To address this challenge, we present a framework coupling diffusion policies trained on simulation-generated pose and force/torque data with an L1-inspired adaptive controller that corrects policy-predicted actions online to compensate for unmodeled contact dynamics. We benchmark the framework against baselines in timber joinery, pipe fitting, and sequential full-scale truss assembly. It achieves 100% success on single-task assemblies and 90-100% success across sequential truss assembly subtasks, with lower, more stable contact forces than the baselines. By enabling zero-shot sim-to-real transfer for force-aware contact-rich assembly, the framework reduces costly, labor-intensive real-world data collection for policy training and advances scalable, robust automation of multistage assembly, motivating extension to broader contact-rich manipulation tasks in construction.
summary_zh: 建筑机器人与自动化技术为提升生产效率、缓解劳动力短缺、减少工人高强度作业暴露提供了可行路径。但在公差严格、制造精度不足、接触动力学不确定的场景下，实现可靠的富接触机器人装配任务仍极具挑战性。针对该问题，本文提出一套融合框架：将在仿真生成的位姿和力/力矩数据上训练的扩散策略，与类L1自适应控制器相结合，后者在线校正策略预测的动作，补偿未建模的接触动力学误差。针对木构件连接、管道装配、连续全尺寸桁架装配任务开展的基准测试表明，该框架在单任务装配上的成功率达100%，在连续桁架装配子任务上的成功率达90%~100%，且接触力比基线方法更低、更稳定。该框架实现了力感知富接触装配的零样本仿真到真实场景迁移，减少了策略训练所需的高成本、高人力投入的真实数据采集工作，推动了多阶段装配的可扩展、鲁棒自动化技术发展，可进一步拓展至建筑领域更多富接触操作任务。

title: EndoNav: Semantic-to-Geometric Grounding for Language-Guided Robotic Endoscopic Examination
title_zh: EndoNav：面向语言引导的机器人内窥镜检查的语义到几何锚定方法
authors: Jecia Z. Y. Mao, Hisashi Ishida, Kathryn Jung, Masaru Ishii, Russell H. Taylor, Manish Sahu
abstract: Minimally invasive procedures performed within confined anatomical spaces depend on continuous endoscopic visualization. Current robotic endoscope systems can stabilize or reposition an endoscope, but they do not possess relevant context to provide effective visualization assistance. We present EndoNav, an anatomy-grounded natural-language framework that translates high-level surgeon commands into autonomous endoscopic visualization behaviors within patient-specific sinonasal anatomy. Spoken surgeon commands are transcribed and interpreted by an endoscopic viewpoint agent conditioned on a patient-specific anatomical scene representation. Rather than generating robot motion directly, the viewpoint agent generates structured visualization objectives that are converted into target viewpoints and inspection trajectories, which are then executed through geometry-constrained endoscope motion planning and joint-space control. We evaluate EndoNav using a structured three-pass sinus examination across three CT-derived anatomical models. For one cadaveric specimen, autonomous visualization is compared with sinus examinations performed by two resident surgeons. EndoNav achieved mean visualization IoUs of 87.04% and 84.37% relative to the two surgeon examinations, compared with an inter-surgeon IoU of 87.44%, while recovering 92.91% and 93.20% of surgeon-observed anatomical surfaces, respectively. These results demonstrate the feasibility of grounding high-level anatomical commands into patient-specific geometric objectives and translating them into anatomically constrained robotic visualization behaviors.
summary_zh: 在受限解剖空间内开展的微创手术依赖连续的内窥镜可视化操作。现有机器人内窥镜系统可以稳定或重新定位内窥镜，但缺乏相关上下文信息，无法提供有效的可视化辅助。本文提出EndoNav，这是一个基于解剖学的自然语言框架，可将外科医生的高层指令转化为患者特定鼻窦解剖结构内的自主内窥镜可视化行为。外科医生的语音指令经过转录后，由基于患者特定解剖场景表征的内窥镜视点智能体进行解析。该视点智能体不直接生成机器人运动，而是生成结构化的可视化目标，再将其转换为目标视点和检查轨迹，最终通过几何约束的内窥镜运动规划和关节空间控制执行。本文在3个CT生成的解剖模型上通过结构化的三阶段鼻窦检查流程对EndoNav进行评估。针对1具尸体标本，将自主可视化结果与2名外科住院医师开展的鼻窦检查结果进行对比：EndoNav可视化结果与两名外科医生检查结果的平均交并比（IoU）分别为87.04%和84.37%，与两名外科医生之间的检查交并比87.44%相当，且分别覆盖了外科医生观测到的解剖表面的92.91%和93.20%。上述结果证明，将高层解剖指令锚定到患者特定几何目标，并将其转化为解剖约束下的机器人可视化行为具备可行性。

title: Ludi${}_{\scriptscriptstyle 0.1}$: An Agentic System for Socially Intelligent Robots
title_zh: Ludi₀.₁：面向社交智能机器人的智能体系统
authors: Wooseong Chung, William Cong, Jakub Dworakowski, Ethan Ewer, Tri Wahyu Guntara, Yeonwoo Jeong, Tianchong Jiang, Chaewon Kim, Hyunseo Kim, Jinwoo Kim, Jinyeon Kim, Yea-Seul Kim, Jack Kunde, Kangwook Lee, Sangheon Lee, Robert Nowak, Junha Roh
abstract: Robot foundation models have substantially advanced perception and control, but natural human-robot collaboration requires more than executing isolated commands. A robot must recognize ambiguity, maintain context across turns, communicate its intentions, and revise ongoing behavior as the user's intent changes. We present $\scriptstyle\mathsf{Ludi}_{\scriptscriptstyle 0.1}$, an agentic system for socially intelligent robots that integrates interactive speech, multimodal reasoning, memory, navigation, and learned manipulation. Its decision-making core is a fine-tuned vision-language model trained on multi-turn interaction traces spanning ambiguous requests, clarifications, corrections, interruptions, mixed social and task dialogue, and multi-step tasks. A purpose-built harness manages the model-tool interaction loop, while specialized navigation and manipulation policies execute physical skills. Ludi${}_{\scriptscriptstyle 0.1}$ demonstrates a practical path toward fluid human-robot collaboration today while producing the multimodal interaction traces needed to develop a more deeply integrated foundation model for robots and people.
summary_zh: 机器人基础模型在感知和控制领域取得了显著进展，但自然的人机协作要求机器人不能仅执行孤立的指令：机器人必须能够识别歧义、跨轮次维护上下文、传达自身意图，并在用户意图变更时修正正在执行的行为。本文提出Ludi₀.₁，这是一个面向社交智能机器人的智能体系统，集成了交互式语音、多模态推理、记忆、导航和学习到的操作能力。其决策核心是经过微调的视觉语言模型，训练数据覆盖多轮交互轨迹，包含歧义请求、澄清、纠错、打断、混合社交与任务对话以及多步骤任务场景。专用的管理组件负责管理模型与工具的交互循环，专用的导航和操作策略负责执行物理技能。Ludi₀.₁为当下实现流畅的人机协作提供了可行路径，同时可生成多模态交互轨迹，为后续开发人机深度融合的机器人基础模型提供支撑。

title: DELTA: Deformable Elevation-Based Local Terrain Attention Encoder for Sparse-Terrain Quadrupedal Locomotion
title_zh: DELTA：面向稀疏地形四足机器人运动的可变形基于高程的本地地形注意力编码器
authors: Sanghyun Park, Moonkyu Jung, Jemin Hwangbo
abstract: Stable quadrupedal locomotion on sparse terrain requires selecting state-relevant terrain evidence for precise foot placement. Model-based foothold planners provide precise foothold selection but rely heavily on explicit model assumptions. Recent attention-based map encoding (AME) studies show that end-to-end reinforcement learning (RL) can learn implicit foothold guidance. However, the computational cost of dense AME encoding grows with map resolution, limiting its scalability to fine-grained sparse terrain. We propose DELTA, a Deformable Elevation-Based Local Terrain Attention encoder. DELTA predicts state-conditioned sampling locations, forms terrain evidence tokens from adaptive local elevation patches, and attends only to a fixed-size token set. With fixed sampling and patch settings, DELTA's encoder cost is independent of map resolution. Experiments show that DELTA achieves final traversal performance comparable to AME at the standard resolution while improving learning efficiency. This fixed encoder cost enables the use of higher-resolution terrain maps, improving traversal on fine-grained sparse terrain. DELTA also demonstrates strong generalization to unseen mixed evaluation courses composed of continuous and discrete terrain elements. Beyond simulation, DELTA demonstrates successful sim-to-real transfer on RAIBO2. Analysis of the learned sampling offsets and attention weights shows that DELTA samples steppable regions and attends to terrain evidence relevant to future touchdowns without foothold labels or attention supervision.
summary_zh: 四足机器人在稀疏地形上的稳定运动需要选择与状态相关的地形信息以实现精确的足点放置。基于模型的足点规划器可以实现精确的足点选择，但高度依赖显式的模型假设。近期基于注意力的地图编码（AME）研究表明，端到端强化学习（RL）可以学习隐式的足点引导，但密集AME编码的计算成本随地图分辨率提升而增长，限制了其在细粒度稀疏地形场景下的可扩展性。本文提出DELTA，即可变形基于高程的本地地形注意力编码器。DELTA预测状态条件化的采样位置，从自适应本地高程补丁中生成地形信息令牌，仅对固定大小的令牌集合执行注意力计算。在固定采样和补丁设置下，DELTA编码器的计算成本与地图分辨率无关。实验结果表明，在标准分辨率下DELTA的最终通行性能与AME相当，同时提升了学习效率。固定的编码器成本允许使用更高分辨率的地形地图，提升了机器人在细粒度稀疏地形上的通行能力。DELTA在由连续和离散地形元素组成的未见过的混合评估路径上也表现出优异的泛化性能。除仿真场景外，DELTA在RAIBO2机器人平台上成功实现了仿真到真实场景的迁移。对学习到的采样偏移和注意力权重的分析表明，DELTA可以在无需足点标签或注意力监督的前提下，采样可通行区域并关注与未来足点接触相关的地形信息。

title: Design of a Human-Assistance Robot System with Contextual Action Recognition
title_zh: 具备上下文动作识别能力的人体辅助机器人系统设计
authors: Amanuel Ergogo, Teresa Zieli\'nska
abstract: This paper presents a conceptual design for a proactive human assisting robot system capable of recognizing human activities and responding proactively. The system leverages contextual human activity recognition to interpret human actions across diverse contexts, while behavior trees are utilized to define dynamic and interpretable robot behaviors. We outline the system architecture, incorporating contextual human action recognition (HAR), behavior trees (BTs), and ROS, using the Spot robot platform as a representative example. We explain how HAR enables the robot to provide proactive assistance, discuss its limitations, and introduce methodologies for contextual HAR to address these limitations, thereby enhancing the robot's decision-making in complex human activity scenarios.
summary_zh: 本文提出一种主动式人体辅助机器人系统的概念设计方案，该系统可识别人类活动并做出主动响应。系统利用上下文人体动作识别（Human Activity Recognition, HAR）技术在多样上下文场景中解读人类行为，同时采用行为树（Behavior Trees, BTs）定义动态且可解释的机器人行为。本文以Spot机器人平台为典型示例，概述了融合上下文人体动作识别、行为树与机器人操作系统（Robot Operating System, ROS）的系统架构，阐释了人体动作识别技术如何使机器人提供主动辅助服务，讨论了现有技术的局限性，并介绍了可解决上述局限的上下文人体动作识别方法，从而提升机器人在复杂人类活动场景中的决策能力。

title: Stakeholder Insights for Designing In-Home Social Robots for Dementia Disorientation Detection and Caregiver-Aware Intervention
title_zh: 面向痴呆症定向障碍检测与照料者感知干预的居家社交机器人设计利益相关者洞察
authors: Emmanuel Akinrintoyo, Nicole Salomons
abstract: Disorientation is a common and distressing experience for people living with dementia. It often manifests as confusion about time, place, or personal context.
