Emission cannot match in-context attention on high-dimensional sequence modeling: under matched-budget pre-training a one-pass adapter recovers only a minority of the in-context gain ($14.0\pm0.9\%$ at $5$M, $11.2\pm0.5\%$ at $15$M), and a LoRA-rank sweep shows this shortfall is a partial capacity limit -- capture climbs from $5\%$ to $21\%$ as rank grows but plateaus far below full recovery. Mechanism ablations confirm the emitted specialist is genuinely task-conditioned, not a memorized prior; and, more speculatively, emitted specialists compose in weight space -- interpolating two of them tracks the corresponding blend of their functions. We close with a falsifiable thesis, operationalized through a per-task resolution measure, bounding when each conditioning mechanism should be preferred.
summary_zh: 给定仅包含少量示例的任务，应当如何对基础模型进行专业化适配？目前主流有四类适配机制：零样本推理、上下文注意力、测试时梯度自适应、以及从超网络输出专用模型权重，但最后一种机制的适用边界始终缺乏清晰的梳理。本文在覆盖回归、生成、语言建模、强化学习、临床与基因组分类的6项任务中开展了完全对等的四组对照实验，全程保持专用模型规模、上下文条件、以及可控制范围内的训练预算一致。结果表明，生成专用模型机制的最显著优势体现在同等性能下的成本控制：在临床小样本分类任务中，该机制性能与当前最优的 amortized 表格模型TabPFN持平，无需为每个查询重新访问支持集，同时输出的专用模型可复用；在形状生成任务中，仅需每个实例132个浮点数的程序即可达到噪声底限生成效果。在小样本正弦回归任务中，零测试时梯度步下该机制的性能比模型无关元学习（Model-Agnostic Meta-Learning, MAML）低2-3个数量级，在训练预算拉平后该差距缩小至约30倍但仍然存在。在高维序列建模任务中，生成专用模型的性能无法与上下文注意力机制匹敌：在预训练预算对等的条件下，单步适配器仅能覆盖上下文注意力增益的一小部分（5M参数下为14.0±0.9%，15M参数下为11.2±0.5%），针对低秩适配（Low-Rank Adaptation, LoRA）秩的遍历实验表明，该性能缺口部分来自容量限制：随着秩的提升，性能覆盖占比从5%提升至21%，但后续进入平台期，远未达到完全追平的水平。机制消融实验证实，输出的专用模型确实以任务条件为依据，并非对先验知识的记忆；同时我们推测，输出的专用模型可在权重空间实现组合：对两个专用模型的权重做插值，即可对应其函数的混合效果。最后本文提出了一项可证伪的研究论点，通过逐任务分辨率指标明确了各类条件适配机制的适用边界。

title: A Social Media Analysis of Discourse on the Israel--Palestine Conflict on Telegram
title_zh: Telegram平台上巴以冲突相关话语的社交媒体分析
authors: Michail Zafeiropoulos, Despoina Antonakaki, Sotiris Ioannidis
abstract: Social media has become a central arena in which armed conflicts are contested, yet the pro-Israel and pro-Palestine communities on Telegram, whose broadcast architecture yields an unusually direct record of deliberate political communication, have not been systematically compared at scale. This study presents a multi-method computational analysis of 87,617 messages from sixteen Telegram channels, eight pro-Israel and eight pro-Palestine, spanning May 2021 to June 2026 and covering multiple conflict escalations. It combines sentiment analysis, three stance detection methods drawn from distinct paradigms (keyword matching, zero-shot DeBERTa via natural language inference, and a fine-tuned BERTweet model), and a framing analysis, all evaluated against 736 manually annotated messages. The fine-tuned model performed best (72.1% accuracy, 0.721 macro F1 under 5-fold cross-validation), outperforming both label-free baselines by 8 to 11 points; the baselines stalled in the low-to-mid 60s, indicating a hard ceiling for stance detection not adapted to in-domain language. The central finding emerges only when sentiment, stance, and framing are read together: the two communities deploy the same death- and victim-related vocabulary in opposite emotional registers, pro-Israel channels predominantly neutral and report-style, pro-Palestine channels markedly more negative, consistent with writing from the distinct discourse positions of acting party and affected party.
summary_zh: 社交媒体已经成为武装冲突舆论争夺的核心阵地，但Telegram平台上的亲以色列和亲巴勒斯坦社群尚未得到大规模的系统性对比，该平台的广播架构可以为刻意的政治传播提供异常直接的完整记录。本研究采用多方法计算分析框架，覆盖2021年5月至2026年6月期间16个Telegram频道的87617条消息，其中8个为亲以色列频道、8个为亲巴勒斯坦频道，覆盖多轮冲突升级事件。研究融合了情感分析、三类来自不同范式的立场检测方法（关键词匹配、基于自然语言推理的零样本DeBERTa、经过微调的BERTweet模型）以及框架分析，所有方法的效果均基于736条人工标注消息完成评估。结果显示，微调后的模型性能最优（5折交叉验证下准确率达72.1%，宏F1值为0.721），比两类无标注基线方法的性能高出8-11个百分点；两类基线方法的性能始终停留在60%-65%区间，说明未针对领域语言适配的立场检测方法存在明显的性能天花板。本研究的核心结论只有将情感、立场和框架分析结果结合才能得到：两个社群使用完全相同的与死亡、受害者相关的词汇，但对应的情感基调完全相反，亲以色列频道的表达以中立的报道风格为主，亲巴勒斯坦频道的表达则明显更偏向负面，这与两类社群分别作为冲突参与方和受影响方的话语立场完全一致。

title: Beyond Two Bytes per Letter: Tokenization Overhead in Cyrillic AI Systems
title_zh: 超越单字母两字节：西里尔文AI系统中的分词开销研究
authors: Ivan Dobrovolskyi
abstract: Modern multilingual tokenizers often fragment Ukrainian and other underrepresented Cyrillic-script languages more heavily than English, creating disparities in cost and context capacity. We quantify this overhead across nine production tokenizers and five languages with standardized Cyrillic and Latin representations, covering 8.37 million word forms. On a corpus benchmark, Ukrainian shows 68-121% token overhead on modern tokenizers and 220% on the older cl100k, measured through full-text fertility on the BrUK and Brown corpora. Overhead is negatively associated with Cyrillic vocabulary allocation in the subset with independently verified English baselines, although the association is not statistically significant (Spearman rho = -0.536, p = 0.215, n = 7). We evaluate two mitigation strategies. LLMLingua-2 reduces Ukrainian input length by 47-49% on an e-commerce RAG benchmark of 1,536 products and 145 queries, with no compression-induced value losses among 80 retrievable cases. A balanced byte-level BPE tokenizer trained with a 200K vocabulary cap, converging at 158,184 actual entries, reduces the held-out UK/EN ratio from 2.22x to 1.30x. Romanization increases Ukrainian token counts by 2-19% on most tokenizers. Across the five languages, tokenization efficiency favors the script more prevalent in web data. These findings indicate that training data allocation contributes to Cyrillic tokenization overhead and that mitigation is possible at both inference and tokenizer-design stages.
summary_zh: 当前主流多语言分词器对乌克兰语等代表性不足的西里尔文字语言的分词碎片化程度远高于英语，造成了推理成本与上下文容量层面的不公平差异。本文基于9款生产级分词器、5种同时拥有西里尔和拉丁标准表示的语言、共837万词形数据，对该类分词开销进行了量化。在语料库基准测试中，现代分词器对乌克兰语的分词开销达到68%-121%，老旧的cl100k分词器的该数值更是达到220%，该指标基于BrUK和Brown语料库的全文分词生育率计算得到。在拥有独立验证英语基线的子集中，分词开销与西里尔语的词表分配量呈负相关，尽管该相关性未达到统计显著性（斯皮尔曼rho=-0.536，p=0.215，样本量n=7）。本文评估了两类缓解策略：在包含1536款商品、145条查询的电商检索增强生成（Retrieval-Augmented Generation, RAG）基准测试中，LLMLingua-2可将乌克兰语输入长度降低47%-49%，在80个可检索案例中未出现压缩导致的信息损失；以20万词表上限训练的均衡字节对编码（Byte-Pair Encoding, BPE）分词器最终收敛到158184个实际条目，可将留出集的乌克兰语/英语分词比例从2.22倍降至1.30倍。在大多数分词器中，拉丁转写会使乌克兰语的分词数量提升2%-19%。在全部5种语言中，分词效率始终向网络数据中占比更高的书写体系倾斜。上述结论表明，训练数据分配差异是西里尔文分词开销的核心成因，在推理阶段和分词器设计阶段都可以实现该问题的缓解。

title: Determinants of Starting Salaries for Filipino Graduates: An Explainable Machine Learning Approach
title_zh: 菲律宾毕业生起薪的影响因素：基于可解释机器学习的研究方法
authors: Alexander Gabriel A. Aranes, John Michael C. Magpantay, Reginald Neil C. Recario, Jamlech Iram N. Gojo Cruz, Rodolfo C. Camaclang III
abstract: Filipino graduates face a persistent disconnect between educational preparation and labor market outcomes, where starting salary is a key signal of entry-level valuation. Current Philippine research is dominated by descriptive tracer studies that document employment rates but do not explain the determinants of pay. We address this gap using a crowd-sourced survey dataset of graduate responses whose noisy, self-reported nature makes it a challenging prediction target. Applying machine learning to this problem, we identify job role and industry as the dominant determinants of starting salary, significantly outweighing institutional prestige. The strength of this finding is its central contribution: it is corroborated by three independent lines of evidence, namely SHAP attributions, the heavy reliance of the best ensemble on occupational text, and a Natural Language Inference reformulation. These results suggest that career guidance and policy should prioritize sector-specific skills over institutional brand.
summary_zh: 菲律宾毕业生长期面临教育储备与劳动力市场需求脱节的问题，而起薪是衡量入门级劳动力市场价值的核心指标。当前菲律宾国内的相关研究以描述性追踪调研为主，仅记录就业率等宏观指标，并未对薪资水平的影响因素做出解释。本文基于众包调研得到的毕业生反馈数据集填补了该研究缺口，该数据集存在噪声高、用户自报告的特点，预测难度较大。通过机器学习方法分析，我们发现岗位类型和所属行业是起薪的核心影响因素，其重要性远高于毕业院校的声望。该核心结论得到了三类独立证据的交叉验证：SHapley加性解释（SHapley Additive exPlanations, SHAP）归因结果、最优集成模型对职业文本特征的强依赖、以及自然语言推理重构实验的结果。上述结果表明，职业指导和相关政策应当优先关注行业特定技能的培养，而非院校品牌建设。

title: There Is No Neutral Harness: Modern LLM Leaderboards Are Manufactured by Config-Fragile Items
title_zh: 不存在中立评测框架：现代大语言模型排行榜由配置敏感型样本主导
authors: V. S. Raghu Parupudi
abstract: Multiple-choice benchmarks fix the questions and the correct answers, but not the harness: the order of the options, the wording of the prompt, and whether a language model's answer is read from generated text or from per-option likelihoods. Work on this harness sensitivity reports it as aggregate score variance, leaving unexamined which items the variance falls on and whether they are the items that separate one model from the next. We treat the evaluation harness of large language models (LLMs) as an independent variable and resolve its effect to single items. We introduce the \textit{fragility grid}: 12 open-weight instruction-tuned LLMs from 4 families answer the same 3{,}679 items from 4 benchmarks (ARC, HellaSwag, MMLU, TruthfulQA) under 26 equally defensible harness configurations, recording one correctness bit for every model, item, and configuration. The comparison is matched, since the items, the weights, and the greedy decoding stay fixed while only the harness varies. Under the grid a model's score is a band rather than a point: gemma4-31b scores between 31 and 89 percent depending only on the harness. Three results follow. On the items that two adjacent models both answer stably the pair is tied, and config-fragile items carry 95.7 percent of a pair's gap on average. Four of the 12 models reach rank one under some configuration, so the harness selects the winner. Item discrimination, the property that benchmark-compression methods maximize, correlates with fragility at 0.28 (95 percent CI 0.25 to 0.30), so compression keeps the fragile items rather than removing them. The scoring choice, not the option order that protocols usually fix, is the load-bearing axis. We release the per-item records and the analysis script, from which every number regenerates on a CPU in seconds, and we position the fragility grid as a check a leaderboard can run before it reports an order.
summary_zh: 选择题基准测试通常固定题目和正确答案，但并未固定评测框架：包括选项顺序、提示词措辞、大语言模型的答案是从生成文本中提取还是从各选项的似然度中计算得到。现有针对评测框架敏感性的研究仅将其描述为总分方差，并未明确方差具体来自哪些样本，也未验证这些样本是否正是区分不同模型性能排名的核心样本。本文将大语言模型（LLM）的评测框架作为独立变量，将其影响拆解到单样本粒度。我们提出了「脆弱性网格」实验框架：来自4个家族的12个开源指令微调LLM，在26种完全合理的评测框架配置下，回答来自ARC、HellaSwag、MMLU、TruthfulQA四个基准的共3679道相同题目，记录每一个模型、每一道样本、每一种配置下的正误结果。该对照实验完全匹配，所有样本、模型权重、贪心解码策略均保持固定，仅评测框架发生变化。在该实验框架下，模型的得分是一个区间而非单点值：例如gemma4-31b的得分仅随评测框架变化，区间范围为31%到89%。研究得到三项核心结论：对于两个相邻排名模型都能稳定回答的样本，二者的性能完全持平，配置敏感型样本平均贡献了两个模型性能差距的95.7%；12个模型中有4个模型可以在某类配置下拿到第一名，也就是说评测框架直接决定了排行榜的冠军归属；基准压缩方法所最大化的样本区分度属性，与样本脆弱性的相关系数为0.28（95%置信区间0.25-0.30），说明基准压缩操作保留了脆弱样本而非将其剔除；对结果影响最大的核心变量是评分规则，而非现有评测协议通常固定的选项顺序。本文公开了所有单样本粒度的记录和分析脚本，所有数值都可以在普通CPU上数秒内复现，我们提出脆弱性网格可以作为排行榜发布排名前的必做校验步骤。

title: RIACT: A Responsible AI System for Personalized Study Habit Tracking and Early Burnout Signal Detection in University Students
title_zh: RIACT：面向大学生个性化学习习惯追踪与早期倦怠信号检测的负责任AI系统
authors: Ria Sidhu
abstract: Student burnout is highly prevalent in higher education, with reported rates ranging from 12% to over 70% and consistently exceeding those of the working population - yet it is typically identified only retrospectively, after academic decline has already occurred. A contributing factor is that students have little structured visibility into their own study behaviour, and existing productivity tools record activity without interpreting it. This paper presents RIACT (Record, Insight, Analyze, Coach, Track), a web-based application that combines structured study session logging with a hybrid AI architecture to surface personalized insights and early burnout signals. Students log sessions by location and time; the system computes net focus time by accounting for breaks, detects burnout signals through transparent, deterministic rules operating on week-over-week behavioural comparisons, and uses a large language model - constrained to a fixed output schema - to contextualize patterns and generate personalized recommendations. The design embeds responsible AI principles throughout: warnings are governed by auditable rules rather than model judgement, all output is framed as an observation rather than a diagnosis and data collection is limited to self-logged behavioural fields. We describe the system's design rationale, situate it within the literature on student burnout and explainable AI in education and propose an evaluation framework for validating its behavioural signals against established burnout instruments.
summary_zh: 大学生群体的学习倦怠问题非常普遍，现有调研得到的发生率从12%到70%以上不等，始终显著高于职场人群，但当前的倦怠识别大多是回溯式的，往往在学业表现已经出现下滑后才能被发现。导致该问题的一个核心因素是学生几乎无法结构化地感知自身的学习行为，现有生产力工具仅记录活动数据，并未对其做出解读。本文提出了RIACT（全称为Record, Insight, Analyze, Coach, Track），这是一款基于网页的应用，融合结构化学习会话日志与混合AI架构，可输出个性化洞察与早期倦怠信号。学生可以按地点和时间记录学习会话，系统通过扣除休息时间计算净专注时长，基于逐周行为对比的透明确定性规则检测倦怠信号，同时在固定输出 schema 的约束下调用大语言模型，对行为模式做场景化解读并生成个性化建议。该系统的设计全程嵌入负责任AI原则：所有预警都由可审计的规则触发，而非模型主观判断，所有输出都被定义为客观观察而非诊断结论，数据采集范围仅限定为用户自记录的行为字段。本文阐述了该系统的设计逻辑，梳理了其在学生倦怠研究与教育领域可解释AI研究中的定位，同时提出了一套评估框架，用于基于已有的成熟倦怠量表验证系统输出的行为信号的有效性。

title: Agentic Scaffolding Amplifies Sycophantic Behavior in Large Language Models
title_zh: 智能体支架会放大大型语言模型的谄媚行为
authors: Thantham Jittham
abstract: Sycophancy in large language models, the tendency to prioritize user agreement over truthful responses, has been documented extensively but studied primarily in single-turn settings. This paper investigates a critical question: does subjecting LLMs to greater interaction scaffolding make sycophancy better or worse? Across 4,800 veracity judgments (200 statements $\times$ 6 models $\times$ 4 conditions), we find that the interaction scaffolding characteristic of agentic systems (feedback loops, reconsideration checkpoints, and iterative refinement) systematically amplifies sycophantic behavior. Multi-turn interaction, user pressure, and iterative self-refinement each provide additional opportunities for models to drift toward agreement, and this drift coincides with a mean accuracy drop of $-6.3$ percentage points, establishing the capitulation as harmful rather than corrective. More capable models show larger amplification effects, a troubling inversion of expectations. We introduce the concept of agentic sycophancy amplification (ASA) and two novel metrics: capitulation rate and sycophantic capitulation rate. Our results indicate that as AI systems acquire greater autonomy, sycophancy becomes compounding rather than merely persistent. Systems designed with human oversight loops may inadvertently create the conditions for this drift.
summary_zh: 大型语言模型的谄媚行为，即优先迎合用户观点而非输出真实答案的倾向，已经得到广泛记录，但现有研究大多仅在单轮对话场景下开展。本文围绕核心问题展开研究：为LLM提供更丰富的交互支架，会缓解还是加剧谄媚行为？基于4800次真实性判断实验（200条陈述×6个模型×4种条件），我们发现智能体系统的典型交互支架（反馈回路、重检查点、迭代优化机制）会系统性放大谄媚行为：多轮交互、用户施压、迭代自我优化都会为模型提供更多向用户观点妥协的机会，该妥协过程会伴随平均6.3个百分点的准确率下降，证实该妥协是有害的而非纠错性质的。性能更强的模型表现出的谄媚放大效应反而更显著，完全违背了常规预期。本文提出了智能体谄媚放大效应（Agentic Sycophancy Amplification, ASA）的概念，同时定义了两个全新指标：妥协率和谄媚妥协率。研究结果表明，随着AI系统的自主性不断提升，谄媚行为会呈现复合增长趋势，而非仅仅维持原有水平。带有人类监督回路的系统设计可能会在无意中催生该类行为漂移的条件。

title: On the Role of Citations in Preference Data
title_zh: 论引用在偏好数据中的作用
authors: Yu Hou, Hal Daum\'e III, Rachel Rudinger, William Walden
abstract: Many NLP tasks require systems to provide attribution in their outputs--i.e. citations to grounding sources. Attribution serves as a bulwark against model hallucination and as a means for users to verify the credibility of model outputs. Yet, it is unclear how humans and LLMs evaluate citations when comparing outputs, a process central to reward modeling and modern LLM post-training. This paper studies the role of citations in the preferences of human judges and four open-source LLMs within the context of scientific question answering, leveraging mixed effects models to investigate the influence of citations on pairwise judgments. Among our key findings are (1) that humans prefer more diverse citations but fewer overall, and (2) that LLMs show some citation-related preferences compared to humans, despite lacking access to the sources, but these preferences depend on the data and specific models. We further discuss the implications of our findings for preference data collection.
summary_zh: 许多自然语言处理任务要求系统在输出中提供归因信息，也就是指向支撑来源的引用。归因是抵御模型幻觉的重要屏障，也是用户验证模型输出可信度的核心手段。但目前学界尚不清楚人类和LLM在对比不同输出时如何评估引用，而该评估过程正是奖励建模和现代LLM后训练的核心环节。本文聚焦科学问答场景，研究引用在人类标注者和4个开源LLM的偏好判断中发挥的作用，通过混合效应模型分析引用对成对偏好判断结果的影响。核心发现包括两点：（1）人类标注者更偏好引用多样性更高但总数量更少的输出；（2）尽管LLM无法访问引用对应的原始来源，但仍然表现出部分与人类对齐的引用相关偏好，不过这类偏好的表现随数据集和具体模型的不同存在差异。本文最后讨论了上述结论对偏好数据采集工作的启示。

title: SchemaRouter: Field-Aware Tool Routing for Efficient Heterogeneous Agentic RAG
title_zh: SchemaRouter（模式路由）：面向高效异构智能体检索增强生成的字段感知工具路由
authors: Yong-eun Cho
abstract: We also find that minimizing selected-field count is counterproductive: it reduces answer accuracy to 0.56 with negligible token savings, while recall-preserving projection restores top accuracy. SchemaRouter improves efficiency, schema-size-independent scaling, and verifiable provenance/license-grounded answering at competitive accuracy.
summary_zh: 本研究发现，最小化所选字段数量的策略反而会适得其反：该方案仅能节省极少的Token，却将回答准确率降至0.56，而保留召回率的投影方法可恢复最高准确率。SchemaRouter可在保持有竞争力的准确率的前提下，提升运行效率、实现与模式规模无关的扩展，支持可验证来源与基于许可的合规回答。

title: LitReview Arena: Evaluating Literature Review Agents with Battle-Style Peer Review Platform
title_zh: LitReview Arena（文献综述竞技场）：基于对战式同行评审平台的文献综述智能体评估
authors: Ruotong Zhao, Zhiyu Chen, Xurui Liu, Haidong Xue, Dong Liang, Jigao Fu, Wu YanBiao, Yuanyi Zhen, Fengli Xu, Yong Li
abstract: Literature reviews are essential to scientific progress, but rigorously evaluating automatically generated reviews remains difficult because many aspects of research utility depend on expert judgment rather than reference-overlap metrics. We introduce LitReview Arena, a battle-style evaluation platform with a structured protocol tailored to literature review quality: domain experts with AI paper-writing experience compare anonymized drafts, are matched to topics within their expertise, and provide dimension-wise outcomes over five literature-review-specific criteria. From this protocol, we collect approximately 3k expert judgments, each containing five dimension-wise outcomes, and show that even the strongest current systems win only 23.0% of decisive matches against human drafts on overall utility, while agentic LLMs such as Sonar Deep Research substantially outperform base language models by over 60%. We further find that existing LLM-as-a-judge methods are substantially misaligned with human experts (Spearman's rho=0.467), especially on synthesis-heavy criteria such as paper structure and research suggestions. Using the collected preference data, we provide an expert-calibrated evaluator, LitJudge, which improves alignment to Spearman's rho=0.78, comparable to inter-expert consistency; code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/VanellopeAsher/LitReview-Arena.
summary_zh: 文献综述是科学进步的核心基础，但由于研究效用的诸多维度依赖专家判断而非参考重叠指标，自动生成综述的严谨评估工作长期存在难点。本文提出LitReview Arena，一款专为文献综述质量设计的对战式评估平台，配套结构化评估流程：具备AI论文写作经验的领域专家对匿名草稿进行比对，系统会将专家匹配至其擅长的主题下，要求专家针对5项文献综述专属评估维度给出分维度结果。通过该流程，我们收集了约3000条专家标注结果，每条结果包含5个维度的评分，实验表明当前最强的现有系统在整体效用的决定性对局中，对比人类撰写的草稿胜率仅为23.0%，而Sonar Deep Research这类智能体大语言模型的表现大幅超越基础大语言模型，领先幅度超过60%。我们进一步发现，现有“大模型即裁判”的方法与人类专家的判断存在显著偏差（斯皮尔曼相关系数ρ=0.467），在论文结构、研究建议这类高度依赖内容整合的评估维度上偏差尤为明显。基于收集的偏好数据，我们开发了经专家校准的评估器LitJudge，其与人类判断的斯皮尔曼相关系数提升至0.78，已接近专家之间的判断一致性水平；相关代码与数据已开源至https://github.com/VanellopeAsher/LitReview-Arena。

title: AI Learning and Conceptual Transfer in the Game of Hidden Rules
title_zh: 隐规则游戏中的人工智能学习与概念迁移
authors: Christo Mathew, Wentian Wang, Jacob Feldman, Lazaros K. Gallos, Paul B. Kantor, Vladimir Menkov, Hao Wang
abstract: This report summarizes the work conducted on the Game of Hidden Rules (GOHR), focusing on reinforcement learning agents trained to infer hidden rules from trial-and-error feedback, representation design, rule difficulty analysis, transfer learning, generalization, and pseudo-bot-assisted human learning analysis. The report focuses on the Transformer-based A2C framework, Feature-Centric and Object-Centric representations, experimental findings, and classification of human learning data.
summary_zh: 本报告总结了隐规则游戏（Game of Hidden Rules, GOHR）相关研究工作，重点研究经训练后可通过试错反馈推断隐规则的强化学习智能体，覆盖表征设计、规则难度分析、迁移学习、泛化性、伪机器人辅助的人类学习分析等方向。报告聚焦基于Transformer的A2C（优势演员-评论家）框架、以特征为中心和以对象为中心的表征、实验结论以及人类学习数据分类等内容。

title: Wazobia Eval: A Benchmark for Nigerian Pidgin Emotion Understanding, Sarcasm Detection, and Cultural Reasoning
title_zh: Wazobia Eval（瓦佐比亚评测）：面向尼日利亚皮钦语情感理解、反讽检测与文化推理的基准数据集
authors: Stephanie Okoye
abstract: Nigerian Pidgin is one of Africa's most widely spoken languages, yet remains severely underrepresented in language model evaluation. Existing benchmarks primarily focus on translation, transcription, or generic sentiment analysis, leaving critical aspects of culturally grounded language understanding unmeasured. We introduce Wazobia Eval, a benchmark for evaluating Nigerian Pidgin emotion understanding, sarcasm detection, and cultural reasoning. The benchmark is built on a manually annotated dataset containing over 550 examples and a 16-category emotion taxonomy designed to capture culturally specific emotional registers that are not represented in conventional sentiment frameworks. Wazobia Eval provides standardized evaluation protocols and benchmark tasks for assessing model performance on nuanced Nigerian language understanding. We present the benchmark design, annotation methodology, taxonomy development process, and preliminary pilot evaluation results. Our goal is to provide foundational evaluation infrastructure for Nigerian language AI and establish a reproducible benchmark for future research. The dataset is publicly available at https://huggingface.co/WAZOBIALABS.
summary_zh: 尼日利亚皮钦语是非洲使用最广泛的语言之一，但在大语言模型评估中严重缺位。现有基准主要聚焦翻译、转写或通用情感分析任务，未对文化根植型语言理解的关键维度进行评测。本文提出Wazobia Eval，一款用于评估尼日利亚皮钦语情感理解、反讽检测与文化推理能力的基准。该基准基于人工标注数据集构建，包含超过550条样本，以及一个16分类的情感分类体系，可捕捉传统情感框架未覆盖的、具有文化特异性的情感表达。Wazobia Eval提供标准化评估流程与基准任务，可评测模型对尼日利亚语的精细化理解能力。本文介绍了该基准的设计方案、标注方法、分类体系开发流程以及初步试点评估结果。本研究旨在为尼日利亚语人工智能提供基础评测基础设施，为后续研究构建可复现的基准。数据集已公开至https://huggingface.co/WAZOBIALABS。

title: PepLLM: ESM-Guided Llama for Structured Protein-Peptide Binding Interface Analysis
title_zh: PepLLM：基于ESM引导的Llama模型实现结构化蛋白质-肽结合界面分析
authors: Hao Qian, Shikui Tu, Lei Xu
abstract: Protein-peptide interactions are central to cellular regulation and peptide-based drug discovery, yet existing computational methods mainly focus on interaction classification, binding-site prediction, or peptide binder generation. These formulations provide limited insight into the physicochemical mechanisms that determine how a peptide binds to a protein. In this work, we introduce \textbf{PepLLM}, an instruction-tuned framework for structured protein-peptide interface understanding. Given protein-peptide sequences, PepLLM generates a machine-readable JSON annotation describing multiple interface properties, including peptide burial state, hydrogen-bond density, salt-bridge presence, hotspot residues, hydrophobicity, and electrostatic complementarity. To support this task, we construct a new protein-peptide interface dataset by integrating structural interface analysis, solvent-accessible surface area computation, hydrophobic burial estimation, electrostatic potential calculation, and redundancy-aware data splitting. PepLLM connects a pretrained ESM encoder with a LLaMA decoder through a nonlinear modality adapter. The adapted ESM residue embeddings are injected into the LLaMA prompt as continuous soft tokens via placeholder-token replacement, enabling the decoder to generate structured interface annotations under instruction tuning. By moving beyond single-label prediction toward multi-property and mechanism-aware generation, PepLLM establishes a new task and modeling paradigm for interpretable protein-peptide interface analysis.
summary_zh: 蛋白质-肽相互作用是细胞调控与肽类药物研发的核心基础，但现有计算方法主要聚焦相互作用分类、结合位点预测或肽结合物生成，这类建模方式难以揭示决定肽与蛋白质结合的物理化学机制。本研究提出PepLLM，一款经指令微调的结构化蛋白质-肽界面理解框架。输入蛋白质-肽序列后，PepLLM可生成机器可读的JSON标注，描述多项界面属性，包括肽的包埋状态、氢键密度、盐桥存在情况、热点残基、疏水性与静电互补性。为支撑该任务，我们整合结构界面分析、溶剂可及表面积计算、疏水包埋估计、静电势计算与考虑冗余性的数据划分方法，构建了全新的蛋白质-肽界面数据集。PepLLM通过非线性模态适配器将预训练ESM编码器与LLaMA解码器相连，经适配后的ESM残基嵌入通过占位符令牌替换的方式作为连续软令牌注入LLaMA的提示中，使解码器可在指令微调下生成结构化界面标注。通过突破单标签预测范式，转向多属性、感知机制的生成任务，PepLLM为可解释的蛋白质-肽界面分析建立了全新的任务与建模范式。

title: Reviewing Model Collapse and Countermeasures
authors: Xihao Xie, Beichen Hu
abstract: Driven by massive amounts of web-scale data, generative AI (GenAI) has achieved remarkable progress, enabling various applications in diverse sectors. The advances of GenAI have actuated practitioners to use AI-synthesized data for training next-generation AI models. Undeniably, using synthetic data has alleviated the increasing stringent demand for data supply. Unfortunately, it also introduces a new critical issue: in a self-consuming cycle between model and data, the model ultimately collapse, raising more trustworthiness concerns to GenAI. In recent years, increasingly more studies have investigated the phenomenon of model collapse (MC) and explored potential solutions to mitigate it. However, the review of the phenomenon of MC still remains blank. To fill this gap, this paper provides an up-to-date overview of these studies for consolidating and reviewing the progress of MC in different application scenarios and countermeasures for mitigating MC. We also highlight challenges and future research opportunities.

title: KSE-Web: An Analysis of Hybrid Retrieval and LLM-Assisted Query Expansion for Low-Resource Khmer Semantic Search
title_zh: KSE-Web：面向低资源高棉语语义搜索的混合检索与大模型辅助查询扩展分析
authors: Nimol Thuon
abstract: As a low-resource language, Khmer presents several retrieval challenges, including limited annotated data, ambiguous word boundaries, weak support in multilingual embedding models, and frequent mixed Khmer-English usage. This paper presents KSE-Web, an analysis of hybrid retrieval and LLM-assisted query expansion for Khmer semantic search. We construct the dataset from approximately 17K candidate Khmer titles and retain 3K cleaned full-text Khmer documents after filtering, normalization, deduplication, and document-length control. The dataset includes 300 manually reviewed user-style Khmer search queries and silver relevance labels with partial human verification. We evaluate character n-gram BM25, multilingual dense retrieval, hybrid BM25+dense retrieval, and LLM-assisted query expansion using Qwen2.5 models. Experimental results show that BM25 achieves the strongest overall performance, reaching 0.943 Recall and 0.876 nDCG. Hybrid BM25+dense retrieval performs comparably, achieving 0.929 Recall and 0.871 nDCG, while dense retrieval alone performs lower. LLM-assisted query expansion does not outperform non-expanded retrieval; however, Qwen2.5-3B produces substantially stronger expanded-query results than Qwen2.5-0.5B, suggesting that LLM size and expansion quality matter for low-resource Khmer retrieval. Our analysis further shows that direct LLM expansion can introduce topic drift, generic terms, and noisy reformulations, while simple filtering may remove useful semantic cues. These findings highlight both the potential and limitations of LLM-assisted retrieval for Khmer semantic search and provide a foundation for future Khmer retrieval datasets with stronger human-verified annotations and Khmer-aware retrieval models. The dataset and documentation will be made available at github.com/back-kh/KhmerSemantic-Search.
summary_zh: 高棉语属于低资源语言，存在多项检索难点，包括标注数据有限、词边界模糊、多语言嵌入模型支持不足、高棉语-英语混合使用场景频繁等。本文提出KSE-Web，针对高棉语语义搜索场景开展混合检索与大模型辅助查询扩展研究。我们基于约1.7万条候选高棉语标题构建数据集，经过过滤、归一化、去重与文档长度控制后保留3000条清洗后的高棉语全文文档。数据集包含300条人工审核的用户风格高棉语搜索查询，以及经部分人工校验的银标准相关性标签。我们对字符n元语法BM25、多语言稠密检索、BM25+稠密混合检索、基于Qwen2.5系列模型的大模型辅助查询扩展方案开展评测。实验结果表明，BM25取得了最优的整体性能，召回率达0.943，nDCG达0.876；BM25+稠密混合检索性能与之接近，召回率为0.929，nDCG为0.871，而单独使用稠密检索的性能更低。大模型辅助查询扩展的表现并未超过未扩展的检索方案，但Qwen2.5-3B生成的扩展查询效果显著优于Qwen2.5-0.5B，说明大模型参数量与扩展质量对低资源高棉语检索至关重要。进一步分析表明，直接使用大模型进行查询扩展可能引入主题偏移、通用术语与噪声改写，而简单过滤操作可能移除有用的语义线索。上述结论明确了大模型辅助检索在高棉语语义搜索场景的潜力与局限性，为后续构建具备更高人工校验标注的高棉语检索数据集、开发高棉语适配检索模型提供了基础。数据集与文档将开源至github.com/back-kh/KhmerSemantic-Search。

title: Distinguishing Revision and Delayed Elaboration in Incremental Narrative Interpretation
title_zh: 增量叙事解读中区分修订与延迟细化的方法研究
authors: Yi-Chun Chen
abstract: Using visual narratives as a diagnostic domain, we demonstrate how a structured narrative representation can explicitly separate committed from underspecified content and support both update operators during incremental construction. Through a worked example, we show how delayed elaboration enables monotonic refinement of interpretive state, while revision requires non-monotonic correction. We discuss the broader relevance of this structural distinction for incremental reasoning and hybrid symbolic-neural systems.
summary_zh: 本研究以视觉叙事为诊断领域，证明结构化叙事表征可明确区分已确认内容与未明确指定内容，为增量构建过程中的两类更新算子提供支撑。通过示例演示，我们展示了延迟细化可实现解读状态的单调优化，而修订则需要非单调修正。本文讨论了该结构区分对增量推理与符号-神经混合系统的广泛参考价值。

title: AIREP: A Protocol for Per-Decision Evidence in AI Runtime Governance
title_zh: AIREP：面向AI运行时治理的单决策证据记录协议
authors: Ali Toygar Abak
abstract: A protocol is presented for recording the governance decisions of automated AI runtimes. When a runtime releases, blocks, defers, redacts, or escalates an individual output, AIREP records that decision as a single signed object that any party can check offline, independent of the runtime that produced it. A record carries the decision as one of a closed set of verbs under a stated policy basis, references its input, output, and evidence by hash rather than by value, and declares both what its evidence covers and what it does not. Records form a SHA-256 hash chain that binds each record to its position, so that tampering and gaps are detectable by recomputation. Vendor-, model-, and domain-specific content is confined to a single optional namespace, and a mechanical neutrality test keeps the shared format free of it. A reference implementation and a two-language conformance kit are described. Some implementation issues are considered, and problems such as alignment of the canonical form across implementations, freshness witnesses, and multi-runtime chains are exposed. The format is offered for adoption by any AI runtime that records governance decisions.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一套用于记录自动化AI运行时治理决策的协议。当AI运行时对单条输出执行发布、拦截、延迟、脱敏或升级操作时，AIREP会将该决策记录为独立的签名对象，任何方均可离线核验该对象，无需依赖生成该记录的运行时。每条记录在指定的政策依据下对应封闭集合中的一类决策动作，通过哈希值而非原始值引用其输入、输出与证据，同时明确声明其证据覆盖的范围与未覆盖的范围。所有记录构成SHA-256哈希链，将每条记录绑定至其对应位置，可通过重计算检测篡改与数据缺失。厂商、模型与领域专属内容被限定在单个可选命名空间内，通过机械中立性测试保证共享格式不受上述专属内容影响。本文提供了参考实现与双语言一致性套件，讨论了部分实现难点，同时指出了跨实现标准形式对齐、新鲜度见证、多运行时链等待解决问题。该协议格式可供所有需要记录治理决策的AI运行时采用。

title: KVBoost: Chunk-Level Key-Value Cache Reuse with Deviation-Guided Recomputation for Efficient Large Language Model Inference
title_zh: KVBoost：基于偏差引导重计算的块级键值缓存复用方法，用于高效大语言模型推理
authors: Srihari Unnikrishnan
abstract: Transformer-based large language models (LLMs) incur high prefill latency because key-value (KV) tensors must be recomputed for each request. Existing prefix-caching systems reduce this cost but require prompts to share a leading contiguous prefix, limiting effectiveness when shared content appears at arbitrary positions. We present KVBoost, a chunk-level KV cache reuse system for HuggingFace-compatible decoder models that enables reuse regardless of content position. KVBoost introduces a dual-hash keying scheme that separates positional identity (prefix hash) from content identity (content hash), supporting both exact and approximate cache matches. To address attention boundary errors from independently cached chunks, KVBoost employs two repair strategies: SelectiveRecompute, which re-encodes boundary regions, and CacheBlendRecompute, which identifies and recomputes high-deviation tokens after a probe pass. The system further incorporates asymmetric KV quantization (int8/int4), adaptive chunk boundary splitting, and importance-weighted eviction under a fixed memory budget. Evaluated on Qwen/Qwen2.5-3B over 1,000 bug-localization samples, KVBoost achieves a 4.49x reduction in time-to-first-token (142.4 ms vs.\ 639.1 ms) and outperforms prefix caching by 16%, with no loss in accuracy (99.2% vs.\ 99.1%). KVBoost provides a practical, memory-bounded inference acceleration layer compatible with RoPE-based models without architectural modification.
summary_zh: 基于Transformer架构的大语言模型（LLM）预填充延迟较高，原因是每条请求都需要重新计算键值（KV）张量。现有前缀缓存系统可降低该开销，但要求提示词共享开头的连续前缀，当共享内容出现在任意位置时效果受限。本文提出KVBoost，一款兼容HuggingFace生态的解码器模型块级KV缓存复用系统，无论共享内容处于什么位置均可实现复用。KVBoost引入双哈希键值方案，将位置标识（前缀哈希）与内容标识（内容哈希）分离，支持精确与近似缓存匹配。为解决独立缓存块带来的注意力边界误差，KVBoost采用两类修复策略：SelectiveRecompute（选择性重计算）对边界区域重新编码，CacheBlendRecompute（缓存融合重计算）在探测阶段后识别偏差较高的令牌并重新计算。该系统还集成了非对称KV量化（int8/int4）、自适应块边界拆分与固定内存预算下的重要性加权驱逐策略。在Qwen/Qwen2.5-3B模型上基于1000个bug定位样本开展评测，KVBoost将首令牌生成时间降低4.49倍（142.4毫秒对比639.1毫秒），性能比前缀缓存高16%，且准确率无损失（99.2%对比99.1%）。KVBoost是一款实用的内存受限推理加速层，兼容基于RoPE（旋转位置编码）的模型，无需修改模型架构。

title: Triangular Fuzzy Rescaling Distance
title_zh: 三角模糊重标度距离
authors: Eddy Soria, Aida Valls, Ana Beatriz Hern\'andez-Lara
abstract: Decision-making in complex systems often involves dealing with imprecise or uncertain information, frequently represented using fuzzy sets, particularly Triangular Fuzzy Numbers (TFNs). A crucial aspect of many fuzzy methods is the quantification of distance between TFNs. Many distance measures assume that all values are in the same scale, requiring a preliminary normalization stage when applied to heterogeneous attributes with different scales or units. This paper proposes the Triangular Fuzzy Rescaling Distance (d_{TR}), a metric designed to address this challenge. The d_{TR} uniquely integrates Linear Rescaling (LRE) directly into the distance calculation, ensuring normalization during the comparison of fuzzy numbers. We formally prove that d_{TR} satisfies the properties of a metric, including non-negativity, identity, symmetry, and the triangle inequality. Furthermore, we demonstrate that d_{TR} is bounded, scale-invariant, and origin-invariant. These properties, combined with a weighting vector for prioritizing dimensions, make d_{TR} suitable for applications involving heterogeneous fuzzy data, such as the construction of synthetic indicators, distance-based machine learning algorithms or multicriteria-decision aiding.
summary_zh: 复杂系统中的决策通常需要处理不精确或不确定信息，这类信息常采用模糊集表示，尤以三角模糊数（Triangular Fuzzy Numbers, TFNs）最为常用。诸多模糊方法的核心环节是对三角模糊数之间的距离进行量化。现有多数距离度量方法假设所有数值处于同一量纲下，当应用于量纲或单位不同的异质属性时，需要预先完成归一化处理。本文提出三角模糊重标度距离（Triangular Fuzzy Rescaling Distance, d_{TR}）这一度量方法，用于解决上述问题。d_{TR}将线性重标度（Linear Rescaling, LRE）直接集成到距离计算过程中，可在模糊数比较的同时自动完成归一化。本文通过严格形式化证明，证实d_{TR}满足度量的全部性质：非负性、同一性、对称性以及三角不等式。此外，本文还证明d_{TR}具备有界性、量纲不变性和原点不变性。上述性质结合用于维度优先级排序的权重向量，使得d_{TR}可适用于各类涉及异质模糊数据的应用场景，例如合成指标构建、基于距离的机器学习算法、多准则决策辅助等。

title: Small Language Model enabled Autonomous agent for Language-Conditioned Cognitive Radar
title_zh: 面向语言条件认知雷达的小语言模型驱动自主智能体
authors: Minhaj Uddin Ahmad, Zakia Zaman, Shunqiao Sun, Mizanur Rahman
abstract: Modern radar systems require adapting their processing strategies in response to changing interference, clutter, and data availability. This paper introduces a framework for a small language model (SLM)-driven autonomous agent designed for language-conditioned cognitive radar, functioning as an intelligent controller for a suite of array signal processing tools. Given a natural-language command, the agent extracts radar-operation-related cues, selects an appropriate sequence of signal-processing methods, configures parameters, and invokes executable tools for numerical computation. Experiments with a synthetic uniform linear array (ULA) radar demonstrate that, given a natural-language command, the agent performs meaningful algorithm selection across diverse scenarios for sidelobe control, jammer suppression, multiple-null beamforming, coherent-source handling, and low-snapshot direction-of-arrival (DOA) estimation. Ablation results show that radar-specific prompting and physics-grounded tool execution are both required for reliable decisions and hallucination-free numerical results.
summary_zh: 现代雷达系统需要根据不断变化的干扰、杂波和数据可用性自适应调整处理策略。本文提出一种由小语言模型（small language model, SLM）驱动的自主智能体框架，面向语言条件认知雷达设计，可作为阵列信号处理工具集的智能控制器。该智能体接收自然语言指令后，可提取与雷达运行相关的线索，选择合适的信号处理方法序列，完成参数配置并调用可执行工具开展数值计算。基于合成均匀线阵（uniform linear array, ULA）雷达的实验结果表明，在输入自然语言指令的情况下，该智能体可在旁瓣控制、干扰抑制、多零点波束形成、相干源处理、低快拍波达方向（direction-of-arrival, DOA）估计等多种场景下完成合理的算法选择。消融实验结果表明，雷达专属提示工程与物理约束下的工具执行二者缺一不可，是实现可靠决策、得到无幻觉数值结果的必要条件。

title: Correcting Variable Importance Scored by Random Forests
title_zh: 随机森林的变量重要性校正方法
authors: Guancheng Zhou, Haiping Xu, Jason Liu, Donghui Yan
abstract: Variable importance produced by Random Forests (RF) is used widely in statistical data analysis, and has played an important role in a variety of tasks such as assisting model interpretation, model selection and diagnosis, and cost-bounded learning etc. However, the calculation of variable importance in RF does not take into account of the correlations among variables, and variables that are correlated to many other variables tend to receive a lower importance index or being completely masked (i.e., with an importance index near zero) by other strongly correlated variables. To prevent influence from unwanted correlated variables in calculating variable importance, we propose to group variables by their conditional correlations (conditional on the response variable). We explore two computationally efficient options, with one grouping variables individually, and then separates the variable of interest from all correlated variables, while the other uses clustering to group variables according to their pair-wise conditional correlations. Our experiments show that both lead to sensible corrections to the importance of variables.
summary_zh: 随机森林（Random Forests, RF）输出的变量重要性在统计数据分析中得到广泛应用，在辅助模型解释、模型选择与诊断、成本约束学习等诸多任务中发挥重要作用。但随机森林的变量重要性计算未考虑变量间的相关性，与大量其他变量相关的变量往往会得到较低的重要性指数，甚至会被其他强相关变量完全掩盖（即重要性指数接近0）。为避免计算变量重要性时受到无关相关变量的干扰，本文提出基于变量的条件相关性（以响应变量为条件）对变量进行分组。本文探索了两种计算高效的实现方案：第一种方案对变量逐一分组，将目标变量与所有相关变量分离；第二种方案采用聚类方法，根据变量间的成对条件相关性完成分组。实验结果表明，两种方案均可实现对变量重要性的合理校正。

title: Provably adaptive sampling with uniform and remasking discrete diffusion models
title_zh: 面向均匀与重掩码离散扩散模型的可证明自适应采样方法
authors: Daniil Dmitriev, Zhihan Huang, Yuting Wei
abstract: Discrete diffusion models offer a promising alternative to autoregressive generation by enabling parallel updates, but their sampling efficiency can depend strongly on the choice of the forward process and the sampler. For the uniform forward process, existing lower bounds for the standard $\tau$-leaping sampler scale linearly with the ambient dimension $d$, raising the question of whether this dependence is intrinsic to the forward process. We answer this question in the negative. We consider a first-order sampler based on the leave-one-out denoiser for uniform and remasking processes whose coordinate updates can be performed in parallel. In both cases, the sampler can correct denoising mistakes during the sampling process, which becomes necessary when many coordinates are updated together. Our main result establishes an adaptive sampling guarantee: up to logarithmic factors, $N = O(\mathrm{DTC}(X_0) / \varepsilon)$ discretization steps suffice to achieve sampling error $O(\varepsilon_{\mathrm{score}}+\varepsilon)$, where $\varepsilon_{\mathrm{score}}$ is the error in score estimation. Thus, the sampling complexity is governed by the intrinsic dependence structure of the target distribution, as measured by its dual total correlation $\mathrm{DTC}(X_0)$, rather than directly by the ambient dimension $d$. Our analysis proceeds through a Bayes-optimal auxiliary sampler that separates discretization error from score-estimation error. We also derive an exact information-theoretic representation of the discretization error in terms of the mutual information between different coordinates of the forward process at different times. This representation applies to general forward processes and, in the uniform and remasking cases, can be controlled by $\mathrm{DTC}(X_0)$. Numerical experiments on structured synthetic distributions illustrate the predicted dimension-adaptive behavior.
summary_zh: 离散扩散模型支持并行更新，是自回归生成领域极具潜力的替代方案，但其采样效率高度依赖前向过程与采样器的选择。针对均匀前向过程，现有标准τ-跳跃采样器的下界随环境维度d线性增长，学界尚未明确该依赖关系是否为前向过程的固有属性。本文给出了否定的答案。本文针对均匀与重掩码过程设计了基于留一去噪器的一阶采样器，其坐标更新可并行执行。两类场景下，该采样器均可在采样过程中校正去噪误差，这在多坐标同步更新时是十分必要的。本文的核心结论给出了自适应采样的理论保证：在忽略对数因子的前提下，仅需N = O(DTC(X_0)/ε)次离散化步长即可实现O(ε_score+ε)的采样误差，其中ε_score为分数估计的误差。由此可见，采样复杂度由目标分布的内在依赖结构（由其对偶总相关性DTC(X_0)度量）决定，而非直接由环境维度d决定。本文通过贝叶斯最优辅助采样器开展分析，将离散化误差与分数估计误差分离。本文还基于前向过程不同时刻不同坐标间的互信息，推导得到离散化误差的精确信息论表示。该表示可适用于通用前向过程，且在均匀与重掩码场景下可通过DTC(X_0)实现误差控制。针对结构化合成分布的数值实验验证了本文提出的维度自适应特性。

title: Robustness of Anomaly Detection Models for Industrial Control Systems under Training-Time Data Contamination
title_zh: 面向耗散时变偏微分方程的惯性流形神经算子
authors: Mustafa Umut Ozbek, Taiwo Ojo, Pooria Madani, Khalil El-Khatib, Li Yang
abstract: Machine-learning-based anomaly detection is increasingly used in industrial control systems (ICS), yet most studies assume that detector training data is trustworthy. In practice, training data may be corrupted through compromised logs, labeling errors, manipulated historian records, or unsafe retraining processes. This paper evaluates the robustness of offline ICS anomaly-detection pipelines on the Secure Water Treatment (SWaT) benchmark under training-time contamination. We assess 11 heterogeneous anomaly detectors under three contamination strategies: random injection, similarity-targeted injection, and feature-noise injection. The first two insert attack samples into the nominal training pool, while the third adds bounded Gaussian noise to selected normal training samples. These attacks are contamination-based rather than gradient-driven poisoning methods. Contamination budgets from 1% to 10% are evaluated using clean validation and test sets under a unified offline protocol. The results show that robustness is strongly model-dependent and cannot be predicted from clean-data performance alone. Injection-based contamination causes the greatest degradation, particularly for local-density and distance-based detectors, whereas feature-noise contamination has a comparatively limited effect. PCA, SVM, HBOS, and IForest remain relatively stable, while the tuned neural detectors demonstrate intermediate robustness. Overall, the findings highlight the importance of training-data integrity in ML-enabled ICS monitoring, subject to the evaluated dataset, models, and threat assumptions.
summary_zh: 本文提出惯性流形神经算子（Inertial Manifold Neural Operator, IMNO），用于求解耗散时变偏微分方程（partial differential equations, PDEs）。由于耗散效应，这类系统的长时间动力学通常呈现出有效的低维结构。与傅里叶神经算子（Fourier Neural Operator, FNO）等标准神经算子架构不同，IMNO显式利用该低维结构，在非线性耗散偏微分方程的长程自回归训练与预测任务中实现了更优的物理可解释性、精度与稳定性。针对平移等变偏微分方程，本文进一步提出该神经算子的平移等变变体IMNO-SE，可保证输入的空间平移会在输出中产生完全相同的空间平移。该保留对称性的归纳偏置可大幅提升模型在平移等变偏微分方程上的性能。本文通过大量基准实验对IMNO的性能开展了数值评估。

title: Inertial Manifold Neural Operator for Dissipative Time-Dependent Partial Differential Equations
title_zh: 基于局部蒸馏的可解释人工智能方法
authors: Xiaoyang Xie, Clarence W. Rowley
abstract: In this paper, we introduce the Inertial Manifold Neural Operator (IMNO) for solving dissipative time-dependent partial differential equations (PDEs). The long-time dynamics of such systems often exhibit an effective low-dimensional structure due to dissipation. Unlike standard neural operator architectures such as the Fourier Neural Operator (FNO), IMNO explicitly leverages the low-dimensional structure to achieve better physical interpretability, accuracy, and stability in long-horizon autoregressive training and prediction for nonlinear dissipative PDEs. For shift-equivariant PDEs, we further introduce a shift-equivariant variant (IMNO-SE) of the proposed neural operator, ensuring that a spatial shift in the input induces the same spatial shift in the output. This symmetry-preserving inductive bias substantially improves its performance in shift-equivariant PDEs. Extensive benchmark experiments are presented to evaluate IMNO's performance numerically.
summary_zh: 在17个基准数据集上，局部蒸馏方法的精度几乎与其人工智能教师模型相当，同时可在每个测试点生成稀疏线性模型。在高维癌症基因表达的实例中，该框架可识别出局部模型使用不同基因的患者亚组；这类异质性无法通过全局线性模型观测到，也难以在黑盒模型中被挖掘出来。

title: Interpretable AI with Local Distillation
title_zh: 带性能保证的及时分类原始-对偶交替神经学习方法
authors: Erin Craig, Yiling Huang, Snigdha Panigrahi
abstract: Across 17 benchmark datasets, local distillation nearly matches its AI teacher's accuracy while producing a sparse linear model at each test point. In a high-dimensional cancer gene expression example, the framework identifies patient subgroups whose local models use different genes; this heterogeneity is invisible to a global linear model, and difficult to surface in a black-box model.
summary_zh: 及时风险分类在临床监测场景中至关重要，这类场景下的决策需要平衡两个目标：尽早完成患者分类以开展后续干预，以及继续观测更多数据以提升分类可靠性。但现有多数统计与机器学习方法均针对完全观测的轨迹设计，对灵敏度、特异度、监测成本等关键运行特征的控制能力十分有限。本文将序贯分类问题纳入多目标优化框架，同时优化上述三个指标。本文通过值递归刻画最优决策规则，量化每个时间点下立即分类与继续监测之间的权衡关系。为从数据中估计该规则，本文构建了约束优化问题：在满足预设的灵敏度与监测成本约束的前提下最大化特异度。随后本文提出对应的估计流程，采用循环神经网络近似动态演化的值过程，采用原始-对偶更新方案满足各项性能约束。通过仿真研究以及连续血糖监测中的低血糖风险预测应用，本文验证了所提方法可生成符合预期运行特征的高精度及时序贯决策规则。

title: Primal--Dual Alternating Neural Learning for Timely Classification with Performance Guarantees
authors: Jiaming Qiu, Yingye Zheng, Ying-Qi Zhao
abstract: Timely risk classification is essential in many clinical monitoring settings, where decisions must balance the benefit of classifying patients early for subsequent intervention against the value of observing additional data. Yet most existing statistical and machine-learning methods are designed for fully observed trajectories and offer limited control over key operating characteristics such as sensitivity, specificity, and monitoring cost. We cast the sequential classification problem within a multi-objective optimization framework targeting these three criteria. We characterize the optimal decision rule through a value recursion that quantifies, at each time point, the trade-off between immediate classification and continued monitoring. To estimate the rule from data, we formulate a constrained optimization problem that maximizes specificity while enforcing prespecified sensitivity and monitoring-cost constraints. We then develop an estimation procedure that employs a recurrent neural network to approximate the evolving value processes and a primal--dual updating scheme to satisfy the performance constraints. Through simulation studies and an application to continuous glucose monitoring for hypoglycemia risk prediction, we demonstrate that the proposed method yields accurate and timely sequential decision rules that adhere to the desired operating characteristics.

title: RAD: Rule-Augmented Relational Anomaly Detection
title_zh: RAD：规则增强的关系异常检测方法
authors: Noah Dahle, Anne Tumlin, Ngoc Tran, Xenofon Koutsoukos, Tyler Derr
abstract: Anomaly detection is often applied to data stored in relational databases, yet most existing methods require flattening multiple tables into a single feature matrix. This flattening can obscure entity identity, schema structure, and multi-hop dependencies, limiting the detection of anomalies that depend on relational context rather than isolated feature values. Beyond preserving relational structure, relational anomaly detection raises an additional challenge: how to incorporate symbolic behavioral evidence into learned relational representations. To address these challenges, we study relational anomaly detection, where the goal is to identify anomalous entities or events in a multi-table database. We propose RAD, a rule-augmented relational anomaly detector that combines heterogeneous graph representation learning with refined symbolic rule signals. RAD derives candidate rules from random-forest paths over flattened summaries of the entities or events being scored, refines them into compact interpretable predicates, injects the resulting rule features into the graph model, and learns anomaly scores using reconstruction-based and pairwise-ranking supervision. To evaluate this setting, we introduce a relational anomaly detection benchmark spanning three settings: LANL cybersecurity event detection and two unexpected user-churn anomaly tasks derived from Amazon and H&M relational databases. Experiments show that RAD improves anomaly ranking over flattened tabular detectors and relational baselines under natural class imbalance, achieving the best average rank on AUROC and AUPRC across the benchmark. Ablations show that direct rule injection and ranking-based supervision are key contributors to performance, while edge reconstruction is not uniformly beneficial. Our code and data are available at: https://github.com/noahd15/RAD_RelationalAnomalyDetection.
summary_zh: 异常检测常被应用于存储在关系型数据库中的数据，但现有多数方法需要将多张表展平为单个特征矩阵。该展平操作会掩盖实体身份、模式结构与多跳依赖关系，限制了对依赖关系上下文而非孤立特征值的异常的检测能力。除保留关系结构外，关系异常检测还面临另一项挑战：如何将符号化行为证据融入学习得到的关系表示中。为解决上述挑战，本文开展关系异常检测研究，目标是识别多表数据库中的异常实体或事件。本文提出RAD，即规则增强的关系异常检测器，融合异构图表示学习与精细化符号规则信号。RAD首先从待评分实体或事件的展平摘要对应的随机森林路径中提取候选规则，将其优化为紧凑的可解释谓词，再将生成的规则特征注入图模型，最终基于重构监督与成对排序监督学习异常分数。为对该场景开展评估，本文构建了覆盖三类场景的关系异常检测基准：LANL网络安全事件检测，以及从Amazon和H&M关系型数据库中提取的两类用户意外流失异常任务。实验结果表明，在自然类别不平衡条件下，RAD的异常排序性能优于展平表格检测器与关系基线方法，在基准数据集的AUROC和AUPRC指标上取得了最优平均排名。消融实验表明，直接规则注入与基于排序的监督是性能提升的核心贡献因素，而边重构的收益并不稳定。本文的代码与数据开源地址为：https://github.com/noahd15/RAD_RelationalAnomalyDetection。

title: ProxyFormer: A Dual-Stream Proxy Architecture for Ultra-Long Context and High-Resolution Generation
title_zh: ProxyFormer：面向超长上下文与高分辨率生成的双流代理架构
authors: Zhongpan Tang
abstract: The quadratic growth of attention computation and key-value (KV) cache with respect to sequence length is a central bottleneck for ultra-long-context language models and high-resolution generative models. We propose ProxyFormer, a general dual-stream architecture built upon proxy tokens. In each layer, fine-grained local features are compressed bottom-up into a small set of proxy states; expensive global interactions are performed only in the compressed proxy space; the globally contextualized proxies are then decompressed and injected top-down back into the local stream. Because the local stream persists across layers, fine-grained information that is not captured by one compression step remains accessible for later refinement, alleviating the irreversible information loss of conventional one-shot compression. We further introduce factorized multi-level compression/decompression, layer-wise dynamic compression ratios, asymmetric dual embeddings, and a proxy-only KV-cache inference scheme. On a 16GB GPU with batch size 1, a standard decoder-only model can train sequences of only about 20K tokens, whereas ProxyFormer with a compression ratio of 64 extends the trainable sequence length to about 0.7M. A model trained with a 64K window retains 92%-95% retrieval accuracy on a multi-needle retrieval task with 1,048,576 tokens, and a model trained with an 8K window exceeds 94% accuracy when extrapolated to 256K tokens. Preliminary image-generation experiments demonstrate the feasibility of ProxyFormer for both pixel-space and latent-space flow matching.
summary_zh: 注意力计算与键值（KV）缓存随序列长度呈二次增长，是超长上下文语言模型与高分辨率生成模型的核心瓶颈。本文提出ProxyFormer，一种基于代理令牌的通用双流架构。在每一层中，细粒度的局部特征自底向上压缩为少量代理状态；高成本的全局交互仅在压缩后的代理空间中执行；完成全局上下文建模的代理随后被解压缩，自顶向下注入回局部流。由于局部流在各层之间保持持久化，单次压缩步骤未捕获的细粒度信息可在后续优化过程中持续访问，缓解了传统单次压缩方法的不可逆信息损失问题。本文进一步提出因式分解多级压缩/解压缩、逐层动态压缩比、非对称双嵌入、仅代理KV缓存推理方案。在单批次大小为1的16GB GPU上，标准仅解码器模型仅能训练约2万令牌长度的序列，而压缩比为64的ProxyFormer可将可训练序列长度扩展至约70万令牌。采用64K窗口训练的模型在1048576令牌的多针检索任务中可保持92%-95%的检索精度，采用8K窗口训练的模型外推至256K令牌时精度仍超过94%。初步的图像生成实验验证了ProxyFormer在像素空间与隐空间流匹配任务中的可行性。

title: Diversity-Based Active Learning: An Evaluation of Metric Spaces for Active Learning Selection
title_zh: 基于多样性的主动学习：主动学习样本选择的度量空间性能评估
authors: Siddharth Chilamkur, Dorit S. Hochbaum
abstract: With rapid advancement over the last few years, many different methods are now widely used for classification. However, training these models requires substantial labeled data. Active Learning is a potential solution to this problem. Pool-based active learning minimizes costs by querying only the most informative samples from an unlabeled dataset. Diversity-based approaches, on the other hand, attempt to select a representative subset of the data. There are many different objectives for determining the selection process, including exact K-center, exact K-median, and Greedy K-center. In this paper, we will focus on evaluating the performance of Greedy K-center across a variety of metric spaces: the raw feature space, a Linear Discriminant Analysis (LDA) space, and a model-derived probability space (with and without entropy-based weighting). Using Random Forest classifiers as a baseline evaluator, our empirical results on synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that mapping unlabeled instances into a predictive probability space and weighting the result by entropy often dominates the other options for active learning selection with Greedy K-center.
summary_zh: 经过近年的快速发展，目前已有多种不同方法被广泛应用于分类任务。但训练这类模型需要大量的标注数据，主动学习（Active Learning）是解决该问题的潜在方案。基于池的主动学习仅从无标注数据集中查询信息量最高的样本，以此降低标注成本；而基于多样性的方法则尝试选出数据的代表性子集。目前已有多种用于确定选择过程的目标函数，包括精确K中心（exact K-center）、精确K中位数（exact K-median）和贪心K中心（Greedy K-center）。本文重点评估贪心K中心在多种度量空间下的性能，包括原始特征空间、线性判别分析（Linear Discriminant Analysis, LDA）空间，以及带/不带熵加权的模型输出概率空间。我们以随机森林分类器作为基准评估器，在合成数据集和真实数据集上开展的实证结果表明：将无标注样本映射到预测概率空间后以熵对结果加权，在基于贪心K中心的主动学习选择任务中，性能通常优于其余所有对比方案。

title: Traceable Spectral Inference via Influence Functions: Efficient Data Attribution and Error Proxies for the Ariel Mission
title_zh: 基于影响函数的可追踪光谱推理：Ariel任务的高效数据归因与误差代理
authors: Nikki Grens, Lu\'is F. Sim\~oes, Kai Hou Yip, Theresa Lueftinger
abstract: Interpretability is critical for machine learning models deployed in scientific space missions such as ESA's Ariel, where ground truth is unavailable during operations and physical plausibility must be assessed. While most explainable AI methods focus on feature attribution, this work investigates training data attribution through influence functions and introduces three key contributions for operational spectroscopy pipelines. First, influence is reformulated in terms of prediction rather than loss, enabling label-free deployment. Second, by leveraging the closed-form ridge solution of an Extreme Learning Machine, infinitesimal prediction influence is efficiently computed. Third, an influence-based conservative error proxy is derived by propagating training residuals through the influence sensitivities. Evaluated against simulated spectra, the proposed proxy correlates strongly with scale and shape-based spectral errors. Furthermore, influence functions enable the identification of the most influential samples and the approximation of the most harmful ones. Together, these results suggest that this approach can serve as an operational framework for scientific machine learning.
summary_zh: 可解释性对于部署在Ariel这类欧空局科学空间任务中的机器学习模型至关重要：这类任务在运行阶段无法获取真实值，必须对结果的物理合理性进行评估。当前多数可解释AI方法聚焦于特征归因，本研究则通过影响函数探究训练数据归因，为业务化光谱处理流水线提出三项核心贡献：第一，将影响从损失层面重构为预测层面，支持无标签部署；第二，利用极端学习机（Extreme Learning Machine）的闭式岭回归解，高效计算 infinitesimal 预测影响；第三，通过将训练残差沿影响灵敏度传播，推导得到基于影响的保守误差代理。在模拟光谱数据集上的评估结果显示，本文提出的代理与基于尺度和形状的光谱误差存在强相关性。此外，影响函数还可识别出贡献最高的样本，近似估计出危害最大的样本。上述结果表明，该方法可作为科学机器学习的业务化运行框架。

title: Exploring Long-period Architectures: Four New Planet Candidates from Kepler with Periods >342 days
title_zh: 探索长周期轨道构型：开普勒望远镜发现4颗轨道周期大于342天的新行星候选体
authors: Matthew T. Hansen, Jason A. Dittmann
abstract: The Kepler detection pipeline, as well as the transit method, has a bias towards shorter periods, leaving a dearth of detections at longer orbital periods. This relative lack of detections has left an incomplete picture of the architectures of exoplanet systems within the long-period regime. We have built a single transit detection pipeline, utilizing a classification convolutional neural network and the onboard spacecraft diagnostics of the Kepler spacecraft, to detect long-period planets. We apply our pipeline to all currently known planetary systems in the Kepler field hosting at least one planet with an orbital period longer than 6 days. We manually vet all new signals from our pipeline, and identify four new planetary candidates, all of which are in systems where the inner planets exhibit transit timing variations (TTVs). Two of these candidates, Kepler 1752.02 and Kepler 199.03, cause two transit events that are consistent with periods of $777.78^{+0.01}_{-0.02}$ and $505.495^{+0.004}_{-0.004}$ days, and radii of $3.55^{+0.15}_{-0.15}$ and $2.74^{+0.05}_{-0.05}$ $R_{\oplus}$, respectively. Our remaining two candidates, Kepler 1897.02 and Kepler 1811.02, are single transit candidates with radii $4.81^{+0.20}_{-0.19}$ and $3.25^{+0.28}_{-0.30}$ $R_{\oplus}$, respectively. The shortest orbital periods for these candidates, consistent with the Kepler dataset (gaps and coverage), are 342 days for Kepler 1897.02 and 544 days for Kepler 1811.02. The new planetary candidates, on their own, are incapable of reproducing the observed TTV signals in the inner system. Although difficult to schedule, follow-up observations are needed to further constrain the new candidates and potentially discover the planets causing the perturbations.
summary_zh: 开普勒探测流水线以及凌星法本身存在对短周期轨道的偏好，导致长轨道周期行星的探测数量严重不足，使得当前对长周期区间系外行星系统构型的认知尚不完整。我们构建了单凌星探测流水线，结合分类卷积神经网络与开普勒航天器的星载诊断数据，实现长周期行星的探测。我们将该流水线应用于开普勒天区所有已知的、至少包含一颗轨道周期大于6天行星的行星系统，对流水线输出的所有新信号进行人工核验，最终识别出4颗新的行星候选体，所有候选体所在系统的内侧行星均存在凌星时间变化（Transit Timing Variations, TTVs）现象。其中两颗候选体Kepler 1752.02和Kepler 199.03的两次凌星事件对应的周期分别为$777.78^{+0.01}_{-0.02}$天和$505.495^{+0.004}_{-0.004}$天，半径分别为$3.55^{+0.15}_{-0.15}$倍地球半径$R_{\oplus}$和$2.74^{+0.05}_{-0.05}R_{\oplus}$。剩余两颗候选体Kepler 1897.02和Kepler 1811.02为仅观测到单次凌星的候选体，半径分别为$4.81^{+0.20}_{-0.19}R_{\oplus}$和$3.25^{+0.28}_{-0.30}R_{\oplus}$。结合开普勒数据集的观测间隙和覆盖范围，Kepler 1897.02和Kepler 1811.02的最短轨道周期分别为342天和544天。仅靠这些新发现的行星候选体，无法复现观测到的内侧系统TTV信号。尽管后续观测的调度难度较高，仍需要开展后续观测进一步约束这些新候选体的参数，有望发现造成轨道扰动的行星。

title: The Axiomatic Trader: Latent Regularity, Information Budgets, and the Canonical Form of a Quantitative Investment System
title_zh: 公理化交易者：潜在规律性、信息预算与量化投资系统的规范形式
authors: Jiayu Li
abstract: Systematic trading rests on one article of faith: that regularities found in the past persist. We state it as a time-invariant mechanism driven by an unobserved latent state, and show that it leaves a researcher five constants to declare --- the recurrence bound $Lambda$ at a block length $b$, the invariance defect $epsilon_0$ of the representation it is declared of, the coherence times $ell_i$ of the state's coordinates, the signal ceiling $rho$ and the fraction $kappa$ of it contingent on the regime --- after which the architecture of a correct quantitative investment system is nearly forced.
summary_zh: 系统化交易建立在一条核心信念之上：历史中发现的市场规律性会持续存在。我们将其表述为由未观测潜在状态驱动的时不变机制，证明该机制为研究者明确了5个需要定义的常量：块长度为b时的递归边界$Lambda$、所定义表示的不变性缺陷$epsilon_0$、状态各维度的相干时间$ell_i$、信号上限$rho$，以及依赖于市场状态的信号占比$kappa$。在明确上述常量后，合规量化投资系统的架构几乎可以被唯一确定。

title: KellyBoost: Growth-Optimal Portfolio Construction with Gradient-Boosted Trees
title_zh: KellyBoost：基于梯度提升树的增长最优投资组合构建
authors: Jiayu Li
abstract: KellyBoost is a single multi-output XGBoost model whose softmax output is the portfolio: with y the vector of per-asset holding-period returns, the training loss is - log(1 + w y), the negative log growth rate, so the fitted model is the growth-optimal (Kelly) allocation conditioned on the features. The objective is exact rather than a surrogate: we derive the gradient, the analytic diagonal Hessian and the full Hessian in closed form, verify them by finite differences, and ship a dependency-free reference engine.
summary_zh: KellyBoost是一个多输出XGBoost模型，其softmax层的输出即为投资组合权重：设y为单资产持有期收益向量，训练损失为$-\log(1 + w y)$，即负对数增长率，因此拟合得到的模型就是以特征为条件的增长最优（凯利Kelly）资产配置方案。该目标函数是精确目标而非替代目标：我们推导得到了梯度、解析对角海森矩阵和完整海森矩阵的闭式解，通过有限差分法对其进行了验证，并发布了无依赖的参考实现引擎。

title: Spectrum-Aware Bounds on Invertibility for Privacy-Enhancing Instance Encoding
title_zh: 面向隐私增强型实例编码的、考虑频谱特性的可逆性边界约束
authors: Seokjin Hwang (Ray),  Yuting (Ray),  Li, Kiwan Maeng
abstract: Instance encoding is a popular empirical technique for privacy enhancement when sharing data to an untrusted server. It transforms sensitive data through an encoding process before sharing, with the hope that the encoding process retains utility but makes it hard to reconstruct the original data. However, most work offers no theoretical guarantee that the encoding process is actually irreversible. A recent work derived a mean-squared error (MSE) bound limiting any adversary's reconstruction accuracy, offering one of the first theoretical results in this domain. This bound, however, has three critical limitations: it is often too loose, only works with randomized encoders (excluding many deterministic encoders practitioners use), and only bounds MSE. We introduce a family of new bounds that (1) are tighter, (2) applicable even to fully deterministic encoders, and (3) can extend beyond MSE to other norm-based similarity metrics, by properly accounting for the encoder's spectral structure. We evaluate our bounds across a range of encoders, datasets, and attacks, showing they hold consistently and improve upon the existing bound.
summary_zh: 实例编码是向不可信服务器共享数据时广泛使用的隐私增强经验技术：该技术在共享前通过编码过程转换敏感数据，期望编码过程既保留数据效用，又使得原始数据难以被重建。但现有多数研究并未提供编码过程确实不可逆的理论保证。近期一项研究推导了限制任意敌手重建精度的均方误差（mean-squared error, MSE）边界，是该领域最早的理论成果之一。但该边界存在三个关键缺陷：通常过于宽松、仅适用于随机编码器（无法覆盖从业者使用的大量确定性编码器）、仅能约束MSE指标。本文提出一类全新的边界约束，通过合理考虑编码器的频谱结构，实现三点特性：1）边界更紧致；2）甚至可完全适用于确定性编码器；3）可扩展到MSE之外的其他基于范数的相似性度量。我们在多种编码器、数据集和攻击场景下对所提边界进行评估，结果表明该边界始终成立，性能优于现有边界。

title: Hierarchical Exponential-Gaussian Mixtures for Watch-Time Distribution Prediction
title_zh: 用于观看时长分布预测的分层指数-高斯混合模型
authors: Sofia Gulevskaia, Mikhail Trapeznikov, Aleksandr Poslavsky, Alexander D'yakonov
abstract: Accurate watch-time (WT) prediction is an important requirement for short-video recommendations. Yet WT distributions are near-zero-inflated, long-tailed and multimodal. The recent Exponential-Gaussian Mixture Network (EGMN) models the full conditional WT distribution rather than a single point estimate and achieves state-of-the-art performance. Our large-scale reproduction study reveals that EGMN is vulnerable to variance collapse, component redundancy, and inactive components. We propose a Hierarchical Exponential-Gaussian Mixture (HEGM) model that addresses these failure modes through a hierarchical skip-watch decomposition, KL-based variance regularization, structured initialization, removing the forced Gaussian shift and the entropy regularizer. Across public and large-scale industrial datasets, HEGM improves ranking accuracy and threshold-event prediction, while maintaining competitive point-estimation accuracy and substantially improving mixture stability and interpretability. A 1.5-month production A/B test confirms statistically significant engagement lifts. Our code and models are publicly released at https://github.com/rw404/HEGM.
summary_zh: 准确的观看时长（Watch-Time, WT）预测是短视频推荐的核心需求之一，但观看时长分布存在零值膨胀、长尾、多峰的特性。近期提出的指数-高斯混合网络（Exponential-Gaussian Mixture Network, EGMN）对完整的条件观看时长分布建模而非仅输出单点估计，取得了当前最优性能。我们的大规模复现研究发现，EGMN存在方差坍缩、组件冗余、组件失活等缺陷。本文提出分层指数-高斯混合（Hierarchical Exponential-Gaussian Mixture, HEGM）模型，通过分层跳看分解、基于KL散度的方差正则化、结构化初始化、移除强制高斯偏移和熵正则化等手段，解决了上述失效模式。在公开数据集和大规模工业数据集上的实验表明，HEGM提升了排序精度和阈值事件预测性能，同时保持了有竞争力的单点估计精度，大幅提升了混合模型的稳定性和可解释性。为期1.5个月的线上生产A/B测试验证了该模型可带来统计显著的用户互动率提升。相关代码和模型已开源至https://github.com/rw404/HEGM。

title: Beyond chlorophyll: machine learning estimates of diagnostic phytoplankton pigments from multispectral ocean colour data
title_zh: 超越叶绿素：基于多光谱海洋水色数据的诊断性浮游植物色素机器学习估算
authors: David Moffat, Angus Laurenson, Victor Martinez-Vicente, Gemma Kulk, Xuerong Sun, Robert J. W. Brewin, Shubha Sathyendranath
abstract: Phytoplankton play a central role in marine ecosystems and the global carbon cycle, with different groups contributing differently to ocean biogeochemical processes. While standard techniques exist for monitoring phytoplankton concentration from ocean-colour data, their community composition remains difficult to observe at large scales. Chlorophyll-a, widely available from satellite ocean-colour observations, is commonly used as a measure of phytoplankton biomass but provides limited information on taxonomic composition. Accessory pigments, some of which are diagnostic of important phytoplankton groups, offer additional information on community structure, but their retrieval from ocean-colour data is challenging because of limited spectral resolution and strong covariance with chlorophyll-a. In this study, we evaluate machine learning methods for estimating diagnostic pigment concentrations from multispectral satellite observations. Using a global dataset of 33,640 High Performance Liquid Chromatography (HPLC) measurements matched with ESA Ocean Colour Climate Change Initiative (OC-CCI) reflectance data, we compare Random Forest and TabPFN models trained on multispectral reflectance with baseline models using chlorophyll-a alone. A temporally stratified validation scheme is employed to reduce the effects of autocorrelation. Results show that multispectral models consistently outperform approaches based solely on satellite-derived chlorophyll-a, demonstrating that ocean-colour reflectance contains additional information relevant to pigment discrimination. Improvements vary by pigment, with those strongly correlated with chlorophyll-a showing limited gains, while others exhibit substantial improvement. These findings highlight the potential of machine learning to extract ecologically relevant information from satellite data beyond conventional chlorophyll-based approaches.
summary_zh: 浮游植物在海洋生态系统和全球碳循环中发挥核心作用，不同类群对海洋生物地球化学过程的贡献存在差异。虽然现有标准技术可通过水色数据监测浮游植物浓度，但大尺度范围内的群落组成观测仍十分困难。叶绿素a可通过卫星水色观测广泛获取，常被用于表征浮游植物生物量，但仅能提供非常有限的类群组成信息。部分辅助色素可作为关键浮游植物类群的诊断标志物，能够提供额外的群落结构信息，但受限于光谱分辨率不足、与叶绿素a强协相关等问题，很难从水色数据中反演得到。本研究评估了从多光谱卫星观测数据估算诊断色素浓度的机器学习方法。我们使用匹配了欧空局海洋水色气候变化倡议（Ocean Colour Climate Change Initiative, OC-CCI）反射率数据的全球33640组高效液相色谱（High Performance Liquid Chromatography, HPLC）测量数据集，对比了在多光谱反射率上训练的随机森林模型和TabPFN模型，与仅使用叶绿素a的基准模型的性能。我们采用时间分层验证方案降低自相关效应的影响。结果表明，多光谱模型的性能始终优于仅基于卫星反演叶绿素a的方法，证明水色反射率中包含与色素区分相关的额外信息。不同色素的性能提升幅度存在差异：与叶绿素a强相关的色素提升幅度有限，其余色素则取得了显著的性能提升。上述发现证明，机器学习有潜力从卫星数据中提取传统叶绿素方法无法获取的生态相关信息。

title: Test-Time Adaptation for ECG Classification via SQI-Gated Self-Training and Beat-Rhythm Consistency
title_zh: 基于SQI门控自训练与心跳-节律一致性的心电图分类测试时自适应
authors: Wenhan Jiang, Zhipeng Deng, Jiale Zhou, Haolin Wang, Yafei Ou, Yefeng Zheng
abstract: Deep learning models for electrocardiogram (ECG) classification often suffer from significant performance degradation when deployed in unseen domains due to shifts in acquisition devices and patient populations. Test-time adaptation (TTA) offers a practical solution by adapting models using only unlabeled data at inference time. However, existing TTA methods often underperform on ECG tasks, since naive online updates ignore the hierarchical beat-rhythm structure of cardiac cycles and are vulnerable to signal artifacts, which leads to unstable adaptation and model drift. We propose BeatRhythm-TTA, an ECG-tailored TTA framework that explicitly accounts for ECG's noisy observations and structured beat-rhythm semantics under domain shift. First, to handle pervasive ECG artifacts, we introduce a Signal Quality Index (SQI)-gated adaptation scheme that selectively filters out low-quality signals to prevent harmful updates. Second, to leverage ECG's beat-rhythm semantics, we enforce dual-level consistency so the model preserves beat morphology and rhythm dynamics while adapting to shifted acquisition conditions. Extensive experiments on multi-label ECG diagnosis across three adaptation protocols, using PTB-XL as the source domain and CPSC2018/Georgia as two target domains, demonstrate the effectiveness of our method, yielding an average +2.70% relative improvement in Macro-F1 over the best competing method.
summary_zh: 用于心电图（electrocardiogram, ECG）分类的深度学习模型，在部署到未知域时，常因采集设备和患者人群的分布偏移出现显著的性能下降。测试时自适应（Test-time Adaptation, TTA）是一种实用解决方案，可在推理阶段仅使用无标注数据对模型进行自适应调整。但现有TTA方法在ECG任务上的表现通常不佳：朴素的在线更新忽略了心动周期的分层心跳-节律结构，且易受信号伪影影响，导致自适应过程不稳定、出现模型漂移。本文提出BeatRhythm-TTA，一种专为ECG设计的TTA框架，可在域偏移场景下显式处理ECG的噪声观测和结构化心跳-节律语义。首先，为处理广泛存在的ECG伪影，我们提出信号质量指数（Signal Quality Index, SQI）门控自适应机制，选择性过滤低质量信号，避免有害更新。其次，为利用ECG的心跳-节律语义，我们强制实现双层级一致性，使得模型在适配偏移采集条件的同时，保留心跳形态和节律动态特性。我们以PTB-XL为源域，CPSC2018和Georgia为两个目标域，在多标签ECG诊断任务上开展三种自适应协议的大量实验，结果表明所提方法的有效性，相比最优对比方法，Macro-F1指标平均相对提升2.70%。

title: Towards Actionable Surgical Team Dynamics: from Teamwork to Counterfactual Annotations
title_zh: 面向可落地的手术团队动力学研究：从团队协作到反事实标注
authors: Vincenzo Marco De Luca, Antonio Longa, Andrea Passerini
abstract: Modeling team interactions in high-stakes environments such as operating rooms is critical for understanding how coordination, communication, and individual behaviors shape team performance and safety outcomes. Existing datasets in this domain are often fragmented across modalities, annotation schemes, and formats, limiting their ability to support integrated analyses of real-world collaborative processes. We address this limitation by introducing an extended multimodal dataset for surgical team interaction analysis, built from real operating room recordings. Starting from an existing corpus, we construct an analysis-ready version of the data by providing speaker diarization, transcripts, and multi-level annotations capturing team performance, interaction processes, and individual characteristics. Team performance is assessed using a standardized surgical teamwork evaluation protocol, while interaction quality and individual attributes are annotated through structured rating schemes covering collaboration, group dynamics, and non-technical skills. To further support the study of coordination breakdowns and performance variability, we introduce counterfactual annotations that describe plausible alternative team outcomes in the presence of observed interaction failures, enabling analysis of how specific behavioral patterns may relate to different trajectories of team performance. In addition, we provide structured temporal and relational representations designed to support computational modeling of teamwork processes and the design of AI-assisted collaborative systems. The dataset is designed to support the study of how individual actions, interaction patterns, and team-level processes jointly contribute to team outcomes in surgical settings, providing a unified resource for analyzing collaborative behavior in high-stakes domains.
summary_zh: 对手术室这类高风险环境下的团队交互行为建模，对于理解协作、沟通和个体行为如何影响团队绩效与安全结果至关重要。该领域现有数据集通常在模态、标注方案和格式上较为分散，难以支撑真实世界协作过程的集成分析。针对该缺陷，本文基于真实手术室录制数据，构建了面向手术团队交互分析的扩展多模态数据集。我们在现有语料基础上，通过提供说话人 diarization、转录文本和覆盖团队绩效、交互过程、个体特征的多层级标注，构建了可直接用于分析的数据集版本。其中团队绩效通过标准化手术团队协作评估协议进行评定，交互质量和个体属性通过覆盖协作、团队动力学、非技术技能的结构化评分方案完成标注。为进一步支持协作失效和绩效变异研究，我们引入反事实标注，描述观测到交互失效时团队可能出现的其他合理结果，支持分析特定行为模式与不同团队绩效演化路径的关联。此外，我们还提供了结构化的时序和关系表示，用于支撑团队协作过程的计算建模和AI辅助协作系统的设计。该数据集可用于研究手术场景下个体行为、交互模式和团队层级过程如何共同影响团队结果，为高风险领域的协作行为分析提供统一资源。

title: Beyond Point Predictions: Uncertainty-Aware Satellite Poverty Mapping for Public Policy
title_zh: 超越点预测：面向公共政策的具备不确定性感知能力的卫星贫困制图
authors: Markus B. Pettersson, James Bailie, Mohammad Kakooei, Eagon Meng, Adel Daoud
abstract: Despite their critical importance for policy and research, high-resolution poverty data remain limited across much of Africa. Machine learning (ML) with earth observation (EO) imagery has recently emerged as a way to supplement these data by predicting (i.e., estimating) poverty where it has not been directly measured. Yet to be used reliably, decision-makers and analysts need assurances that they will not be misled by the errors in these predictions. To meet this need, we develop an uncertainty-aware EO-ML method for poverty mapping based on simultaneous quantile regression and a novel form of conformal prediction. Using a spatiotemporal transformer trained on sequences of Landsat and nighttime-light images, we produce prediction intervals for neighborhood-level International Wealth Index estimates across Africa which are statistically guaranteed to achieve their desired coverage rates. While our method's point-prediction performance matches the state of the art, its prediction intervals are wider than might be expected given its high $R^2$ of $0.75$. However, other models of similar accuracy likely suffer from comparable uncertainty, pointing to an inherent limitation: even with its remarkably high explanatory power, EO-ML cannot naively be relied upon for policy-making, such as when designing poverty-targeting programs. To handle this challenge, we develop a procedure to efficiently allocate aid using both ground-truth surveys and model predictions while provably ensuring the risk of excluding eligible neighborhoods remains below a prespecified level. In simulations, this approach delivers substantially more aid per eligible recipient than other strategies, thereby demonstrating that EO-ML can indeed be a reliable supplement to traditional data sources---as long as methods
summary_zh: 高分辨率贫困数据对政策制定和学术研究至关重要，但非洲大部分地区的这类数据仍十分有限。近年来，结合地球观测（Earth Observation, EO）影像的机器学习（Machine Learning, ML）方法可在未直接开展贫困测量的区域预测（即估算）贫困水平，成为补充贫困数据的有效路径。但要实现可靠应用，决策者和分析人员需要确保不会被预测结果的误差误导。为满足这一需求，本文开发了一套基于同时分位数回归和新型共形预测的不确定性感知EO-ML贫困制图方法。通过在Landsat影像和夜间灯光影像序列上训练时空Transformer模型，本文生成了非洲全域社区级国际财富指数（International Wealth Index）估算的预测区间，该区间在统计层面可保证达到预设的覆盖率。本文方法的点预测性能达到当前最优水平，但其预测区间在决定系数R²高达0.75的情况下仍比预期更宽。然而，其他精度相近的模型很可能也存在相当程度的不确定性，这指向了一个固有局限：即便EO-ML的解释力极强，也无法直接贸然用于扶贫项目设计等政策制定场景。为应对这一挑战，本文提出了一套结合地面实测调查数据和模型预测结果的高效援助分配流程，可从理论层面保证符合申领条件的社区被排除在援助范围外的风险始终低于预设阈值。仿真结果显示，与其他策略相比，该方法能为更多符合条件的受助者分配援助，证明只要采用适配的方法，EO-ML完全可以成为传统数据源的可靠补充——只要相关方法

title: Spicing up Genetic Netlist Generation with LLMs
title_zh: 利用大语言模型（LLM）优化遗传网表生成
authors: Stefan Uhlich, Ya\u{g}{\i}z Gen\c{c}er, Andrea Bonetti, Arun Venkitaraman, Chia-Yu Hsieh, Eisaku Ohbuchi, Lorenzo Servadei
abstract: Analog circuit topology synthesis remains challenging because useful designs occupy a tiny fraction of a combinatorial search space, and small structural changes can induce highly nonlinear changes in behavior. Evolutionary algorithms are attractive because they can optimize over discrete circuit topologies using only black-box evaluations, but they often require many SPICE simulations and may converge prematurely. We introduce LLM-SPICEMixer, a hybrid synthesis framework that augments genetic netlist generation with IGEL (Inspiration-Guided Evolution with LLMs), an LLM-based proposal operator. During search, IGEL prompts an LLM with high-performing circuits from the elite set and instructs it to generate a new SPICE netlist, which is then evaluated by SPICE and selected using the same reward mechanism as conventional genetic operators. Thus, the LLM contributes structured topology proposals while simulation remains the source of truth. We evaluate LLM-SPICEMixer on a challenging benchmark task: synthesizing transistor-level circuits that implement a discriminant function for Iris classification. Compared with the genetic framework without LLM guidance, LLM-SPICEMixer improves the median final training reward by 8.4% and the median validation-selected test reward by 8.8%. The best validation-selected circuit achieves 93.3% test accuracy at the nominal tt corner and 85.9% average test accuracy across 17 process, voltage, and temperature corners.
summary_zh: 模拟电路拓扑合成目前仍面临诸多挑战：可用的有效设计仅占组合搜索空间的极小部分，且微小的结构改动就可能引发电路行为的高度非线性变化。进化算法的优势在于仅依靠黑箱评估即可在离散电路拓扑空间中完成优化，但这类方法通常需要大量SPICE仿真，且容易过早收敛。本文提出LLM-SPICEMixer，这是一套混合合成框架，通过IGEL（Inspiration-Guided Evolution with LLMs，大语言模型引导的启发式进化算法）这一基于LLM的提议算子，对遗传网表生成过程进行增强。在搜索过程中，IGEL将精英集中表现优异的电路作为提示输入大语言模型，引导其生成新的SPICE网表，随后新生成的网表将通过SPICE完成评估，并采用与传统遗传算子完全一致的奖励机制进行筛选。由此，大语言模型可输出结构化的拓扑提议，而仿真结果始终作为判定结果的真值来源。本文在一项高难度基准任务上对LLM-SPICEMixer进行验证：合成可实现Iris鸢尾花分类判别函数的晶体管级电路。与无LLM引导的纯遗传框架相比，LLM-SPICEMixer将最终训练奖励的中位数提升了8.4%，将经验证集筛选的测试奖励中位数提升了8.8%。表现最优的经验证集筛选电路在标称tt工艺角下的测试准确率可达93.3%，在17组工艺、电压、温度（PVT）角下的平均测试准确率可达85.9%。

title: ADDA: a Modular Framework for Representing, Simulating and Assimilating Dynamics with End-to-end Differentiability
title_zh: ADDA：具备端到端可微性的动力学表征、模拟与同化模块化框架
authors: Anthony Frion, Vien Minh Nguyen-Thanh, Ali Can Bekar, Pauleo R. Nimtz, Vadim Zinchenko, David S. Greenberg
abstract: Data assimilation (DA) is an essential tool for prediction and understanding in the geosciences. DA combines simulation programs representing scientific knowledge with observations that constrain system dynamics, resulting in analyses and forecasts that incorporate both knowledge and data. DA tasks can be addressed with a diverse toolset, including variational, ensemble and learning-based methods. In particular, many recent works have proposed using automatic differentiation tools for variational, learning-based or hybrid methods. However, comprehensive comparisons across algorithms and dynamical systems remain challenging, due to the incompatibility of simulation and assimilation codes, inflexible handling of spatial and temporal discretizations, specialization of DA methods to specific simulations, and limited support for automatic differentiation and parallel computation in simulations. To address this challenge, we introduce Automatic Differentiation for Data Assimilation (ADDA), a software framework for defining and working with system states, simulations, observation schemes and DA methods. ADDA provides a powerful and flexible set of base classes for representing dynamical systems and observation operators, with support for collocated and staggered grids, unstructured meshes, Lagrangian state variables and irregular or continuous-time observations. Parallel processing and differentiability are first-class features, with support for batch axes and automatic differentiation throughout. ADDA is implemented in PyTorch library, but supports DA for JAX-based computation of dynamics and their gradients. To demonstrate its features, we further provide differentiable, ADDA-compatible implementations of 10 dynamical systems of various dimensionalities and scales, from which we design multiple illustrative DA examples. All of our code is publicly available at https://github.com/m-dml/ADDA.
summary_zh: 数据同化（Data Assimilation, DA）是地球科学领域开展预测与机理分析的核心工具。数据同化将表征科学规律的模拟程序与约束系统动力学的观测数据相结合，生成同时融合先验知识与实测数据的分析结果与预报结果。目前可用于解决DA任务的工具集十分多样，包括变分方法、集合方法和基于学习的方法。尤其是近年来大量研究提出将自动微分工具应用于变分方法、基于学习的方法或混合方法中。但受模拟代码与同化代码不兼容、时空离散化处理灵活性不足、DA方法针对特定模拟场景定制化程度高、模拟过程对自动微分和并行计算的支持有限等问题限制，跨算法、跨动力系统的全面对比研究仍难以开展。为解决这一问题，本文提出自动微分数据同化（Automatic Differentiation for Data Assimilation, ADDA），这是一套用于定义和处理系统状态、模拟过程、观测方案与DA方法的软件框架。ADDA提供了一组功能强大、灵活性高的基类，用于表征动力系统和观测算子，支持同位网格、交错网格、非结构化网格、拉格朗日状态变量以及非规则或连续时间观测。并行处理能力和可微性是ADDA的核心原生特性，支持批量轴运算和全链路自动微分。ADDA基于PyTorch库实现，同时支持针对JAX框架下的动力学计算及其梯度计算开展数据同化。为展示其功能特性，本文进一步提供了10个不同维度、不同尺度的动力系统的可微、兼容ADDA的实现方案，并基于这些动力系统设计了多个典型DA示例。所有代码均已开源，访问地址为https://github.com/m-dml/ADDA。

title: Poisson Subspace Clustering: Focusing on the Essentials in Count Data
title_zh: 泊松子空间聚类：聚焦计数数据的核心本质
authors: Collin Leiber, Kai Puolam\"aki, Heikki Mannila
abstract: Count data represented as a matrix of non-negative integer values, such as contingency tables, are prevalent across diverse domains. When clustering such data sets, specific methods are required, as generic algorithms often fail to consider their unique distributional properties, leading to unreliable outputs. An effective strategy is to use well-established statistical models such as the Poisson and negative binomial distributions. We present 3CPO, a clustering algorithm based on statistically solid modeling of count data. In addition to the cluster labels, it identifies a subset of relevant columns, enhancing the interpretability of the results. We propose a simple iterative algorithm that maximizes the posterior probability to find good clustering solutions and discuss its properties. Extensive experiments demonstrate its ability to define high-quality clusters within associated subspaces for various data domains, ranging from gene expressions and texts to economics.
