Our findings suggest that 3CPO is a robust solution for clustering count data in a statistically sound and interpretable manner. Our code is available at https://github.com/collinleiber/3CPO.
summary_zh: 以非负整数值矩阵形式表示的计数数据（例如列联表）在各类领域中广泛存在。对这类数据集开展聚类时需要使用专门的方法，通用聚类算法通常未考虑计数数据独特的分布特性，往往会输出不可靠的结果。一种有效的解决思路是采用泊松分布、负二项分布等成熟的统计模型。本文提出3CPO算法，这是一套基于严谨计数数据统计建模的聚类算法。除聚类标签外，该算法还可识别出一组相关的特征列，有效提升聚类结果的可解释性。本文提出一种可最大化后验概率的简单迭代算法来获取优质聚类解，并对其特性进行了讨论。大量实验结果表明，该算法可在基因表达、文本、经济等多个领域的数据集对应的子空间中生成高质量聚类结果。研究结果证明，3CPO是一套统计严谨、可解释性强的鲁棒计数数据聚类方案。相关代码开源地址为https://github.com/collinleiber/3CPO。

title: A Multidimensional Data-Driven Hybrid Transformer Framework for Non-invasive Continuous Blood Pressure Prediction
title_zh: 面向无创连续血压预测的多维数据驱动混合Transformer框架
authors: Yuexin Ma, Jingqi Hou, Yuxuan Kang, Zhaoying Liu
abstract: Objective. To develop and evaluate a cuffless continuous blood pressure (BP) estimator using temporal physiological and demographic features. We propose a hybrid Transformer framework to estimate diastolic and systolic BP from ECG/PPG-derived feature sequences. Approach. Rather than raw waveforms, the framework models 10-step sequences of six physiological descriptors and two demographic covariates. A Multi-Source Temporal Encoder Module combines Transformer, Kolmogorov-Arnold Network, and XGBoost branches to capture complementary temporal, nonlinear, and tabular information. A Dynamic Conditional Fusion-Decoder applies differential multi-head attention, token-weighted aggregation, and gated residual correction. A robust composite objective jointly optimizes DBP and SBP. Main results. Using the MIMIC-III Waveform and Clinical Databases, the source pool comprised 28,486 waveform segments from 203 subjects, and feature generation retained 53,621 observations from 166 subjects. On 2,431 segment-level held-out test windows, mean error +/- standard deviation was 0.41 +/- 3.74 mmHg for diastolic BP and -1.60 +/- 5.95 mmHg for systolic BP, with 95% limits of agreement of [-6.93, 7.74] and [-13.25, 10.06] mmHg, respectively. The proportions within 10 mmHg were 98.48% and 94.36%. The framework achieved the lowest standard deviations and narrowest limits of agreement among the locally retrained baselines. Significance. The feature-sequence fusion framework improved agreement with reference BP and fell within numerical AAMI and BHS Grade A thresholds on this split. This retrospective analysis is not formal device validation; subject-disjoint and external evaluation remain necessary before clinical use.
summary_zh: 研究目的：开发并验证一套基于时序生理特征和人口统计学特征的无袖带连续血压估计器。本文提出一种混合Transformer框架，可从心电（ECG）/光电容积脉搏波（PPG）衍生的特征序列中估算舒张压和收缩压。研究方法：该框架不直接使用原始波形，而是对6类生理描述符和2类人口统计学协变量构成的10步序列进行建模。多源时序编码器模块融合Transformer、柯尔莫哥洛夫-阿诺德网络（Kolmogorov-Arnold Network）和XGBoost三个分支，提取互补的时序信息、非线性信息和表格信息。动态条件融合解码器采用差分多头注意力机制、令牌加权聚合和门控残差校正模块。通过鲁棒复合目标函数联合优化舒张压和收缩压的预测结果。主要结果：基于MIMIC-III波形与临床数据库，研究数据集包含来自203名受试者的28486段波形片段，特征生成阶段最终保留了来自166名受试者的53621条观测样本。在2431个片段级留出测试窗口上，舒张压的平均误差±标准差为0.41±3.74 mmHg，收缩压为-1.60±5.95 mmHg，二者的95%一致性界限分别为[-6.93, 7.74] mmHg和[-13.25, 10.06] mmHg。误差在10 mmHg以内的样本占比分别为98.48%和94.36%。与本地重新训练的基线模型相比，该框架实现了最低的预测标准差和最窄的一致性界限。研究意义：该特征序列融合框架提升了预测结果与参考血压的一致性，在本次划分的数据集上的表现满足美国医疗仪器促进协会（AAMI）和英国高血压学会（BHS）的A级阈值要求。本回顾性分析不属于正式的设备验证，在临床应用前仍需开展受试者完全不重叠的外部评估。

title: From Multimodal Observation to Interpretable Suggestions: Counterfactual Time-Expanded Relational Modeling of Surgical Teams
title_zh: 从多模态观测到可解释建议：外科手术团队的反事实时间扩展关系建模
authors: Vincenzo Marco De Luca, Antonio Longa, Giovanna Varni, Andrea Passerini
abstract: In surgery, patient safety is threatened not only by technical issues but also by poor teamwork. However, existing surgical AI-based solutions focus mainly on visual workflow and technical execution, neglecting the modeling of team interactions and missing opportunities to actively support clinicians in improving their teamwork skills. To address this gap, we propose a tempo-relational framework for modeling surgical team dynamics from multimodal observations. By leveraging Time-Expanded graphs, the approach captures both relational structure and temporal evolution, achieving strong expressivity while remaining robust in the low-data regime typical of surgical settings. Beyond prediction, such modeling enables the generation of efficient, interpretable, and actionable suggestions for clinicians. More specifically, we generate suggestions via a counterfactual procedure that identifies minimal yet structured changes in individual behaviors and interaction patterns associated with improvements in team performance. Experiments with simulated surgical procedures show that our approach improves predictive performance in diverse behavioral and interaction goals while offering meaningful insights into team dynamics. This work advances surgical AI beyond outcome-driven prediction towards a socially grounded, team-centric, and actionable paradigm to better understand and support the development of team skills in surgical settings.
summary_zh: 外科手术场景中，患者安全不仅受技术问题威胁，团队协作能力不足同样会带来风险。但现有外科人工智能解决方案大多聚焦于视觉工作流和技术操作执行层面，忽略了对团队交互行为的建模，错失了主动辅助临床工作者提升团队协作能力的机会。为填补这一研究空白，本文提出一套时序关系框架，可基于多模态观测数据对外科手术团队的动态行为进行建模。该方法利用时间扩展图同时捕捉团队的关系结构和时序演化特性，在外科场景典型的小数据条件下仍具备强表达能力和鲁棒性。除预测功能外，该建模方法还可生成高效、可解释、可落地的改进建议，为临床工作者提供指导。具体而言，本文通过反事实流程生成建议，识别出可提升团队绩效的个体行为和交互模式的最小结构化调整方案。在模拟外科手术流程上开展的实验结果表明，本文提出的方法可在不同行为和交互目标下提升预测性能，同时能够输出对团队动态行为有价值的洞见。本研究推动外科人工智能从结果导向的预测范式，转向以社会属性为基础、以团队为核心、可落地的新范式，助力理解并提升外科场景下的团队协作能力。

title: The Laws of Context Allocation: Causal Measurement and Closed-Loop Orchestration in Generative Search
title_zh: 上下文分配定律：生成式搜索中的因果测量与闭环编排
authors: Peiyang Liu, Xi Wang, Di Liang, Wei Ye
abstract: Finally, we unify these solutions into a deployable closed-loop submodular scheduler. Augmented by an attribution-steered contrastive decoder to override LLM attention inertia, our architecture systematically forces fresh evidence integration. By dominating classical open-loop baselines, we establish sequential, feedback-driven orchestration as the definitive paradigm for generative search. Our code, data, and causal measurement instruments are available at https://github.com/PeiYangLiu/ascp.
summary_zh: 最终，本文将所有解决方案整合为一套可部署的闭环子模调度器。该架构通过引入归因引导的对比解码器打破大语言模型的注意力惯性，可系统性地强制模型整合新的证据。该方法的性能全面超越传统开环基线模型，证明了基于序列、反馈驱动的编排是生成式搜索的确定性最优范式。相关代码、数据集和因果测量工具均已开源，访问地址为https://github.com/PeiYangLiu/ascp。

title: Which Histories Matter for Time Series Forecasting? Learning Predictive Relevance with Future Supervision
title_zh: 时间序列预测中哪些历史数据是重要的？基于未来监督的预测相关性学习
authors: Yong-Hoon Choi, Youngjin Cho
abstract: Historical retrieval for time-series prediction commonly treats past similarity as a proxy for usefulness. We ask a different question: which historical examples should be expected to matter for a query? We define predictive relevance as expected future utility conditioned on inference-time information, using realized futures only during training as privileged supervision. A normalized-pattern retriever first forms a coarse candidate set, and a lightweight residual multilayer perceptron (MLP) learns a listwise future-compatibility target while keeping inference-time scoring strictly past-only. Our method retains similarity-based candidate generation but reranks its candidates by a more predictive relevance criterion. Optimal relevance decomposes into candidate-level utility and query-specific compatibility, motivating Candidate-Prior and Shuffled-Future controls. Across six benchmarks, the reranker improves Pattern retrieval while revealing candidate-global, query-specific, and mixed relevance regimes. On all 12 confirmatory tasks, it improves Pattern and outperforms a matched-protocol Stationarity-Aware Retrieval-Augmented Time Series Forecasting (SARAF) retrieval rule. Architecture-matched ablations show that correct future supervision, rather than the MLP or added context alone, drives gains in query-specific regimes. Alternative-similarity experiments show that a strong last-value-anchored L2 rule remains superior in some domains, whereas future-supervised relevance is particularly strong where our diagnostics indicate query-specific relevance, especially on Solar. Candidate-pool diagnostics show that this contrast is not explained solely by coarse Pattern retrieval. Overall, historical relevance is structured and domain dependent rather than governed by a universally superior retrieval rule.
summary_zh: 现有时间序列预测的历史数据检索方法通常将历史样本相似度作为样本有用性的代理指标。本文提出了一个不同的研究问题：对于当前查询样本，哪些历史样本是真正对预测有价值的？本文将预测相关性定义为基于推理时刻信息的预期未来效用，仅在训练阶段使用已实现的未来数据作为特权监督信号。首先通过归一化模式检索器生成粗粒度候选集，随后通过轻量残差多层感知机（MLP）学习列表级的未来兼容性目标，同时保证推理阶段的打分过程完全仅使用历史数据。本文方法保留了基于相似度的候选生成流程，但采用更具预测性的相关性准则对候选样本进行重排序。最优相关性可分解为候选样本级效用和查询专属兼容性两部分，据此本文设计了候选先验对照实验和打乱未来对照实验。在6个基准数据集上的实验结果显示，重排序器可提升模式检索的性能，同时揭示了全局候选相关、查询专属相关和混合相关三类不同的相关性模式。在全部12项验证任务中，该方法的表现均优于模式检索方法，且性能超过遵循相同协议的平稳感知检索增强时间序列预测（Stationarity-Aware Retrieval-Augmented Time Series Forecasting, SARAF）检索规则。与架构匹配的消融实验结果表明，带来性能提升的核心因素是正确的未来监督信号，而非MLP本身或额外引入的上下文。不同相似度度量的对比实验显示，基于最后一个值锚定的L2规则在部分领域中仍具备优势，而未来监督的相关性方法在诊断结果显示存在查询专属相关性的场景下表现尤为突出，在Solar数据集上的性能优势最为明显。候选池诊断结果显示，两类方法的性能差异无法完全由粗粒度模式检索的效果解释。总体而言，历史数据的相关性具备结构化特征和领域依赖性，不存在普适性的最优检索规则。

title: Leveraging Remote Traffic Data for Local Air Pollutant Estimation: A Scenario-Based Machine Learning Study Across London Monitoring Sites
title_zh: 利用远程交通数据实现局地大气污染物估算：基于场景的伦敦监测站点机器学习研究
authors: Valeria Legaria-Santiago, Amadeo Arguelles, Magdalena Saldana-Perez, Jocelyn Richardson, Marcella Bona
abstract: Vehicular traffic is a major source of air pollution; however, the contribution of remotely acquired traffic information to local machine-learning (ML) air-pollution models remains insufficiently characterised. This study evaluates four interpretable tree-based ML models (Random Forest, Extra Trees, LightGBM, and XGBoost) under six predictor scenarios combining progressively larger predictor sets, ranging from remotely acquired traffic, meteorological, and temporal variables alone to the inclusion of measurements from one and four neighbouring monitoring stations, to estimate NO$_2$, PM$_{10}$, PM$_{2.5}$, and O$_3$ concentrations across several sites in London. ML model performance was compared with a ridge linear regression model as a baseline, with spatial interpolation methods and with a cross-site validation experiment. When modelling without data from neighbouring stations, the RMSE for NO$_2$ ranged from 9.73 to 11.66 $\mu$g/m$^3$ without traffic information, compared with 8.72 to 11.52 $\mu$g/m$^3$ when traffic information was included. Additionally, for NO$_2$, SHAP analyses indicate that traffic-related variables can contribute at levels comparable to pollutant measurements from neighbouring monitoring stations in traffic-dominated~environments.
summary_zh: 机动车交通是大气污染的主要来源之一，但远程获取的交通信息对局地机器学习大气污染估算模型的贡献尚未得到充分表征。本研究在6组预测因子场景下对4种可解释树基机器学习模型（随机森林Random Forest、极端树Extra Trees、轻量梯度提升机LightGBM、极端梯度提升XGBoost）的性能进行评估，6组场景的预测因子集逐步扩大，从仅包含远程获取的交通变量、气象变量和时间变量，逐步扩展到加入1个和4个邻近监测站点的实测数据，最终实现伦敦多个站点的二氧化氮（NO₂）、可吸入颗粒物（PM₁₀）、细颗粒物（PM₂.₅）和臭氧（O₃）浓度估算。本研究将机器学习模型的性能与岭线性回归基线模型、空间插值方法的结果进行对比，并开展跨站点验证实验。在不引入邻近站点数据的建模场景下，不加入交通信息时NO₂的均方根误差范围为9.73~11.66 μg/m³，加入交通信息后NO₂的均方根误差范围为8.72~11.52 μg/m³。此外，针对NO₂的SHAP可解释性分析结果显示，在交通主导的环境中，交通相关变量的贡献度可与邻近监测站点的污染物实测数据的贡献度相当。

title: SGHA: A Single-Loop Fully First-Order Algorithm for Nonconvex-Strongly-Convex Bilevel Optimization
title_zh: SGHA：面向非凸-强凸双层优化的单循环全一阶算法
authors: Zhihao Gu, Qilong Wu, Junchi Yang
abstract: In this work, we study the oracle complexity of finding an $\epsilon$-stationary point for nonconvex-strongly-convex (NC-SC) bilevel optimization using only first-order oracles. Existing methods achieving the best-known complexity guarantees typically rely on double-loop, penalty-based procedures. We propose a novel single-loop algorithm based on a constrained reformulation in which lower-level stationarity is imposed as a constraint. Specifically, we construct a regularized Lagrangian by introducing a quadratic regularizer and restricting the dual variable to a bounded domain, and then apply Smoothed Gradient Descent Ascent [Zhang et al., 2020], with Hessian-vector products approximated via finite differences of gradients. We refer to the resulting deterministic and stochastic algorithms as SGHA and Stoc-SGHA, respectively. In the deterministic setting, SGHA achieves an oracle complexity of $O(\bar{\kappa}_y^{5}\epsilon^{-2})$, where $\bar{\kappa}_y$ denotes the relevant condition number. In the stochastic setting, Stoc-SGHA achieves an oracle complexity of $O\left(\bar{\kappa}_y^{17}\epsilon^{-6}\rho^{-3}\right)$ with probability at least $1-\rho$ for any $\rho\in(0,1)$, and an oracle complexity of $O\left(\bar{\kappa}_y^{17}\epsilon^{-6}\right)$ in expectation under an additional bounded-iterate assumption. Moreover, under an additional stochastic smoothness assumption imposed only on the lower-level objective, the stochastic oracle complexity of Stoc-SGHA improves to $O\left(\bar{\kappa}_y^{11}\epsilon^{-4}\rho^{-2}\right)$ with high probability and $O\left(\bar{\kappa}_y^{11}\epsilon^{-4}\right)$ in expectation, matching the $\epsilon$-dependence of the lower bounds.
summary_zh: 本文研究仅使用一阶预言机求解非凸-强凸（NC-SC）双层优化问题的ε-驻点的预言机复杂度。现有可实现当前最优复杂度保证的方法通常依赖双循环、基于惩罚项的流程。本文提出一种基于约束重构的新型单循环算法，将下层问题的驻点条件作为约束引入优化问题。具体而言，本文通过引入二次正则项并将对偶变量限制在有界域内构建正则化拉格朗日函数，随后采用Smoothed Gradient Descent Ascent方法[Zhang et al., 2020]，通过梯度的有限差分近似海森向量积。本文将得到的确定性算法和随机算法分别命名为SGHA和Stoc-SGHA。在确定性场景下，SGHA的预言机复杂度为O(κ̄_y⁵ ε⁻²)，其中κ̄_y为相关条件数。在随机场景下，对于任意ρ∈(0,1)，Stoc-SGHA在至少1-ρ的概率下可实现O(κ̄_y¹⁷ ε⁻⁶ ρ⁻³)的预言机复杂度，在有界迭代的额外假设下可实现期望意义下O(κ̄_y¹⁷ ε⁻⁶)的预言机复杂度。此外，在仅针对下层目标施加随机平滑性的额外假设下，Stoc-SGHA的随机预言机复杂度可进一步提升到高概率下的O(κ̄_y¹¹ ε⁻⁴ ρ⁻²)和期望意义下的O(κ̄_y¹¹ ε⁻⁴)，其ε相关的复杂度阶数与理论下界完全匹配。

title: When More Modalities Hurt: Modality Dropout for Heavy-Duty Vehicle Engine Diagnostics
title_zh: 多模态产生负面影响时：面向重型车辆发动机诊断的Modality Dropout（模态丢弃）方法
authors: Adeel Zafar, Slawomir Nowaczyk, Hamid Sarmadi, Saeed Gholami Shahbandi
abstract: Heavy-duty vehicle diagnostics generate three disconnected data modalities: unstructured multi- lingual service complaints, high-dimensional sensor telemetry with over 80% missing values, and Diagnostic Trouble Codes (DTCs). We investigate whether fusing these modalities improves engine component classification on a proprietary dataset from a major truck manufacturer. Through 5-fold cross-validation across multiple model configurations spanning three model families on five engine component classes (885 samples, the full cross-database matched population for this manufacturer), we find that naive fusion provides modest gains over text alone (65.3%). However, modality dropout during training, which randomly disables entire modalities per batch, forces the network to exploit weaker inputs and achieves 68.8% accuracy on text+DTC fusion (weighted F1: 0.67), a 3.5-point improvement over text-only (65.3%, weighted F1: 0.64) and the best result across all methods including logistic regression and gradient-boosted trees. Per-class analysis shows that the dominant modality varies by fault type: text describes symptoms, DTCs encode structured fault signals, and sensors measure physical state. On intake/exhaust faults, sensors alone reach 93% where text achieves 80%. On fuel system faults, fusion with modality dropout nearly triples accuracy from 15% to 38% over text alone. To our knowledge, this is the first application of three-way modality fusion combining text, sensors, and fault codes in industrial vehicle diagnostics.
summary_zh: 重型车辆诊断场景会生成三类相互独立的数据模态：非结构化多语言服务投诉、缺失值占比超80%的高维传感器遥测数据，以及Diagnostic Trouble Codes（DTCs，诊断故障码）。本研究基于某主流卡车制造商的私有数据集，探究融合上述多模态数据是否能够提升发动机零部件分类任务的性能。研究在该制造商全跨库匹配的885个样本（覆盖5类发动机零部件）上开展了5折交叉验证，测试覆盖3个模型家族的多种模型配置，结果发现：相比仅使用文本数据的基线（准确率65.3%），朴素多模态融合仅能带来小幅性能提升；而训练阶段采用Modality Dropout（模态丢弃，即在每批次训练中随机禁用部分完整模态）的策略，能够迫使网络利用更弱的输入特征，在文本+DTC融合任务上达到68.8%的准确率（加权F1值为0.67），相比仅使用文本的基线（65.3%，加权F1值0.64）提升了3.5个百分点，性能超过包括逻辑回归、梯度提升树在内的所有对比方法。逐类别分析结果表明，不同故障类型对应的主导模态存在差异：文本用于描述故障症状，DTC编码结构化故障信号，传感器测量物理状态。针对进排气故障，仅使用传感器数据的分类准确率可达93%，而仅使用文本的准确率为80%；针对燃油系统故障，结合模态丢弃的融合方法准确率从仅用文本的15%提升至38%，性能提升近2倍。据我们所知，这是工业车辆诊断领域首次实现文本、传感器、故障码三类模态的三向融合应用。

title: Conformal Risk Minimization for Semi-Supervised Domain Adaptation via Optimal Transport
title_zh: 基于最优传输的半监督域自适应共形风险最小化
authors: Manos Giannopoulos, Yi Shen, Michael M. Zavlanos
abstract: In high-stakes healthcare applications, machine learning models are frequently trained on data from one patient population and deployed on another, creating a distribution shift that degrades both accuracy and reliability. Semi-Supervised Domain Adaptation (SSDA) addresses this by leveraging labeled data from some source domain to improve model performance on a target domain where labels are scarce. However, existing SSDA methods optimize primarily for point-prediction accuracy and offer no principled uncertainty quantification --- a prerequisite for clinical trust. Conformal Prediction (CP) can address this limitation by providing prediction sets with rigorous, distribution-free coverage guarantees. However, applying CP post-hoc to a pre-trained model can yield prohibitively large prediction sets, as SSDA pre-training methods do not account for the nonconformity score geometry that determines conformal set size. Conformal Risk Minimization (CRM) has been used to resolve this issue in the fully supervised setting by integrating the CP objective directly into model training, but it requires a large labeled dataset to compute nonconformity thresholds during training, precisely the data that is scarce in the SSDA regime. We propose an end-to-end framework that integrates CRM into the SSDA training objective, enabling effective CRM in the limited-labeled-target-data regime. The key idea is to utilize Optimal Transport (OT) to generate pseudolabels for unlabeled target instances, providing the additional training signal needed by CRM to operate using only a small labeled target set. This results in a model jointly optimized for domain invariance and conformal efficiency, producing prediction sets that are compact, coverage-valid, and support domain-specific constraints such as excluding mutually contradictory diagnoses in skin lesion classification.
summary_zh: 在高风险医疗场景中，机器学习模型通常基于某一患者群体的数据训练后部署到另一患者群体中，由此产生的分布偏移会同时降低模型的准确率与可靠性。Semi-Supervised Domain Adaptation（SSDA，半监督域自适应）方法利用源域的标注数据，提升模型在标签稀缺的目标域上的性能。但现有SSDA方法主要针对点预测准确率优化，无法提供符合理论规范的不确定性量化能力，而后者是临床场景建立信任的必要前提。Conformal Prediction（CP，共形预测）可生成满足严格无分布覆盖保证的预测集，能够解决上述缺陷。但将CP后处理应用于预训练模型时，往往会生成过大的预测集，原因是SSDA预训练过程没有考虑决定共形集大小的非一致性得分几何特性。Conformal Risk Minimization（CRM，共形风险最小化）通过将CP目标直接集成到模型训练过程中，在全监督场景下解决了该问题，但CRM需要大量标注数据在训练阶段计算非一致性阈值，而这类数据恰恰是SSDA场景下的稀缺资源。本文提出一种端到端框架，将CRM集成到SSDA训练目标中，实现了有限目标域标注数据场景下的高效CRM计算。该方法的核心思路是利用Optimal Transport（OT，最优传输）为未标注的目标域样本生成伪标签，为CRM提供所需的额外训练信号，仅需少量目标域标注集即可完成训练。最终得到的模型同时针对域不变性与共形效率优化，生成的预测集紧凑、满足覆盖有效性要求，且可支持领域特定约束，例如在皮肤病变分类任务中排除相互矛盾的诊断结果。

title: Activation-Weighted Seeded Residual Coding for Low-Bit LLM Weight Repair
title_zh: 用于低位大语言模型权重修复的Activation-Weighted Seeded Residual Coding（AWSRC，激活加权种子残差编码）
authors: Zehao Liu, Chuangchuang Fang, Yang Ren
abstract: Low-bit weight quantization saves storage but leaves errors that degrade language-model quality. We introduce Activation-Weighted Seeded Residual Coding (AWSRC), a compact repair codec for an existing quantization backbone. Given a reconstructed weight $W_0$, AWSRC encodes the residual $W-W_0$ using deterministic seed-generated bases. The sidecar stores seed selectors, low-bit coefficients, and scales rather than an explicit codebook. Activation statistics prioritize errors that affect layer outputs. On Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct, adding 0.162 scope-bits/weight to an INT4 RTN backbone closes 88.2%, 78.9%, and 71.3% of the matched PPL, KL, and accuracy gaps to BF16. Repairing a matched strong low-bit backbone also improves all measured quality metrics. With a matched 49.25 MB sidecar, about 0.8% of the BF16 model-weight payload, AWSRC gives the best perplexity and mean task accuracy among sparse, low-rank, and vector-quantized codecs.
summary_zh: 低位权重量化可节省存储空间，但会引入误差降低语言模型性能。本文提出Activation-Weighted Seeded Residual Coding（AWSRC，激活加权种子残差编码），一种可与现有量化骨干网络兼容的轻量修复编解码器。给定重建权重W₀，AWSRC使用确定性种子生成的基向量对残差W-W₀进行编码，其附属存储单元仅保存种子选择器、低位系数与缩放因子，无需存储显式码本。该方法利用激活统计信息优先处理对层输出影响较大的误差。在Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct模型上，为INT4 RTN量化骨干网络每权重额外添加0.162位范围比特，可分别将困惑度（PPL）、KL散度、准确率与BF16基线的差距弥补88.2%、78.9%、71.3%。对性能优异的低位量化骨干网络应用该修复方法，可全面提升所有测试的性能指标。当附属存储大小为49.25MB（仅占BF16模型权重总大小的0.8%）时，AWSRC在稀疏编码、低秩编码、向量量化编码等对比方案中取得了最优的困惑度与平均任务准确率。

title: Quantum Reservoir Computing with Physics-Informed Correction for Reduced-Order PDE Forecasting
title_zh: 面向偏微分方程降阶预测的物理信息校正量子储备计算
authors: Krishna Bhatia,  Harsh, Shalini Devendrababu
abstract: We study a hybrid proposal--correction architecture for reduced-order PDE forecasting in which a pure-state quantum reservoir computer (QRC) predicts latent coefficient dynamics and a PINN-based physics-informed corrector (PIC) refines local rollout windows. The method is evaluated on Burgers and Kuramoto--Sivashinsky (KS), with KS as the primary chaotic benchmark. On KS, QRC+PIC consistently improves over QRC alone in RMSE, NRMSE, and PDE residual, while Burgers highlights a regime in which simple baselines remain strong. These results suggest that QRC proposals with local physics-informed correction are a viable benchmark-dependent reduced-order forecasting strategy.
summary_zh: 本文提出一种混合预测-校正架构用于偏微分方程（PDE）降阶预测：由纯态量子储备计算机（Quantum Reservoir Computer, QRC）预测潜在系数动力学，基于物理信息神经网络（PINN）的Physics-Informed Corrector（PIC，物理信息校正器）对局部滚动预测窗口进行优化。该方法在Burgers方程与Kuramoto-Sivashinsky（KS）方程数据集上完成验证，其中KS方程作为核心混沌基准测试集。在KS数据集上，QRC+PIC方法的均方根误差（RMSE）、归一化均方根误差（NRMSE）与PDE残差指标均持续优于单独使用QRC的方案；而Burgers方程测试结果也验证了该架构在部分场景下性能可与经典基线方法持平。上述结果表明，结合局部物理信息校正的QRC架构是一类可行的、性能随基准数据集变化的PDE降阶预测方案。

title: One Inverse Step is a Convex Program: Bayes-Limit Calibration of Diffusion Inversion
title_zh: 单逆步等价于凸规划：扩散反演的贝叶斯极限校准
authors: Gordei Verbii
abstract: One implicit DDIM inversion step is the cheapest probe of whether a pretrained diffusion model encodes local manifold geometry. It is the stationarity condition of an explicit potential, $x-G(x)=\nabla\Psi_t(x)$, strongly convex at the Bayes limit with modulus exactly $e^{-h_t}$ for the step's log-SNR gap $h_t$ $-$ for every data law, schedule and point, with no manifold, reach or unimodality hypothesis. Three consequences must be kept apart. (i) The solution is unique at the Bayes limit; a second one requires the trained score to violate the posterior-covariance bound by $1/(1-e^{-h_t})$, a hypothesis-free certificate of model error; the same bound makes contraction a schedule constant, $\rho_g^{\star}=1-e^{-h_t}<0.326$ throughout the standard DDPM schedule. (ii) The solver can still fail: Picard iteration is unit-step gradient descent on $\Psi_t$, unstable wherever $\lambda_{\max}(\nabla^2\Psi_t)>2$, so oscillation certifies nothing; damping below $2/\lambda_{\max}$ cures it. (iii) The geometry lives in the convergence domain: on the scale-free depth $w=r\kappa_{\max}$ the oscillation shell sits at $w=\tfrac12$, schedule-free, and the divergence shell at $w=1/(1+\rho_g^{\star})$, with a measured finite-noise correction in $\|\mathrm{II}\|^2$. Exact scores reproduce both to within $0.54\%$ on three classes; no trained score we probe shows a shell $-$ a derived limitation, not a null result: the Fermi window conflicts with the model's own training support by $3.6$-$5.6\times$, and the trained Hessian-Lipschitz constant is $2$-$12\%$ of the curvature the law reads, $0$ on a ReLU net. Finally the unconditional ceiling $\sigma_t\lambda_{\max}(\mathrm{sym}\,J)\le1$, from $\mathrm{Cov}(x_0\mid x_t)\succeq0$ alone, holds for the exact score to $3\times10^{-7}$ but is violated in all DDPM CIFAR-10/CelebA-HQ-256 settings, by $1.26$-$4.66\times$.
summary_zh: 单步隐式DDIM反演是检验预训练扩散模型是否编码局部流形几何特征的最低成本探测方式。它是显式势函数x-G(x)=∇Ψₜ(x)的平稳条件，在贝叶斯极限下该势函数为强凸函数，对于步长的对数信噪比间隙hₜ，其凸性模恰好为e^(-hₜ)，该结论对任意数据分布、调度方案与样本点均成立，无需对流形、可达性或单峰性做额外假设。该性质可推导出三类独立结论：（1）贝叶斯极限下解唯一；若存在第二个解，则说明训练得到的得分函数违反后验协方差边界1/(1-e^(-hₜ))，这是一种无假设的模型误差证明；该边界还可保证收缩性为调度常量，在标准DDPM调度全程满足ρ_g^⋆=1-e^(-hₜ)<0.326。（2）求解器仍可能失效：皮卡迭代是Ψₜ上的单位步长梯度下降，当∇²Ψₜ的最大特征值大于2时迭代不稳定，此时振荡现象不具备任何证明效力，将步长阻尼至2/λ_max以下即可解决该问题。（3）几何特征存在于收敛域内：在无标度深度w=rκ_max尺度下，振荡壳位于w=1/2处且与调度无关，发散壳位于w=1/(1+ρ_g^⋆)处，可通过||II||²度量有限噪声校正量。在三类测试集上，精确得分可将两类壳的误差控制在0.54%以内；而我们测试的所有训练得到的得分函数均不存在该类壳，这是一种可推导的局限性而非零结果：费米窗口与模型自身训练支撑的冲突程度达3.6-5.6倍，训练得到的Hessian-Lipschitz常数仅为数据分布对应曲率的2%-12%，在ReLU网络上该值为0。最终，仅由Cov(x₀|xₜ)⪰0可推导出无条件上界σₜλ_max(sym J)≤1，该上界对精确得分的偏差小于3e-7，但在所有DDPM CIFAR-10/CelebA-HQ-256设置中均被违反，超出上界的幅度为1.26-4.66倍。

title: Partial-Moment PINNs for Caldeira--Leggett Parameter Learning in Quantum Brownian Motion
title_zh: 面向量子布朗运动Caldeira-Leggett参数学习的偏矩物理信息神经网络
authors: Krishna Bhatia
abstract: We study parameter recovery in the Caldeira--Leggett (quantum Brownian) oscillator from partial moment traces. Our model is a moment-level PINN that predicts the five first/second moments and enforces the linear CL/HPZ ODEs by automatic differentiation. Physical structure is imposed through a PSD (Cholesky) covariance head, high-temperature CL assumptions with $D_{xp}\approx0$, and fluctuation--dissipation ties between $D_{pp}$ and $\gamma$. On synthetic CL data with channels ${\mu_x,\sigma_{xx},\sigma_{xp}}$, the constrained variant recovers $(\omega,\gamma)$ accurately, stabilizes $D_{pp}$, and achieves low rollout error compared to finite differences and Kalman--EM (expectation--maximization) with exact Van Loan discretization. Fisher-style checks confirm that diffusion needs at least one variance observable, and sparse $\sigma_{pp}$ ``anchors'' restore conditioning. We also show that the same PINN can learn time-varying HPZ coefficients.
summary_zh: 本文研究如何从偏矩轨迹中恢复Caldeira-Leggett（量子布朗）振子的参数。所提出的模型是一个矩级物理信息神经网络（PINN），可预测前五阶一阶矩与二阶矩，并通过自动微分强制满足线性CL/HPZ常微分方程约束。模型通过半正定（Cholesky分解）协方差输出头、满足D_xp≈0的高温CL假设、以及D_pp与γ之间的涨落耗散关系引入物理结构约束。在包含{μ_x,σ_xx,σ_xp}通道的合成CL数据集上，加入约束的模型可精准恢复参数(ω,γ)，稳定D_pp的取值，相比采用精确Van Loan离散化的有限差分法与Kalman-EM（期望最大化）方法，实现了更低的滚动预测误差。Fisher风格检验证实，扩散过程至少需要一个方差观测变量，稀疏的σ_pp观测值可起到「锚点」作用，改善问题的条件数。本文还证明，该PINN架构可用于学习时变HPZ系数。

title: When a neural surrogate cannot accelerate a solver: runtime share, closed-loop drift, and the economics of uncertainty gating in a stiff coupled simulation
title_zh: 神经代理无法加速求解器的场景：运行时占比、闭环漂移与刚性耦合仿真中不确定性门控的经济性分析
authors: L. Th\"ummler, T. Kuroda
abstract: We further separate stability from fidelity: a never-crashing gated run accumulates a linear -19.9% density bias over 6000 steps. The error is a directed, ballistically accumulating bias, not the variance-driven divergence the autoregressive literature targets.
summary_zh: 本文进一步将稳定性与保真度两个概念解耦：永不崩溃的门控仿真在6000步后会累积-19.9%的线性密度偏差。该误差是定向的、呈弹道式累积的偏差，并非自回归研究领域通常关注的方差驱动发散问题。

title: Graph Representation Learning of Lightweight IoT Ciphers
title_zh: 轻量级物联网密码的图表示学习
authors: Jonathan Cook, Sabih ur Rehman, M. Arif Khan
abstract: SIMON and SIMECK belong to a family of Lightweight Cryptographic Algorithms (LCAs) based on the Feistel block cipher, designed for Internet of Things (IoT) devices. As with all Feistel ciphers, they are susceptible to differential cryptanalysis, necessitating rigorous resilience evaluations. While state-of-the-art techniques leverage heuristics and sampling to improve efficiency, little work has applied Machine Learning (ML) guided Graph Representation Learning (GRL) to efficiently identify and visualise high-probability differential clusters. We address this gap by introducing an efficient feature engineering strategy that extracts four differential attributes from a partial Difference Distribution Table (pDDT), revealing structural information concealed in raw differential data. Utilising the enriched features, we construct and compare three ML-guided directed graphs for SIMON$32$ and SIMECK$32$ using K-Nearest Neighbour (KNN), Decision Trees (DT), and Random Forests (RF). To the best of our knowledge, our framework produces the first graph-based visualisation of the differential clustering effect, in which high-probability single-bit differentials form geometrically close clusters in the learned embedding. All three models achieve a precision of $1.0$ in identifying high-probability differentials, confirming zero false positives. KNN achieves the strongest cluster separation, the highest F1 score and the lowest graph construction time of approximately $2.3$ seconds, while DT and RF produce optimal paths with near-perfect regression. The results are consistent across both LCAs, demonstrating the applicability of the framework to other AND-rotation LCA families.
summary_zh: SIMON与SIMECK属于基于Feistel分组密码的轻量级密码算法（Lightweight Cryptographic Algorithms, LCAs）家族，专为物联网（IoT）设备设计。与所有Feistel密码一致，二者易受差分密码分析攻击，因此需要开展严格的鲁棒性评估。现有前沿技术采用启发式方法与采样策略提升评估效率，但鲜有研究将机器学习引导的图表示学习（Graph Representation Learning, GRL）用于高效识别并可视化高概率差分簇。针对该研究空白，本文提出一种高效的特征工程策略，从局部差分分布表（partial Difference Distribution Table, pDDT）中提取4类差分属性，挖掘原始差分数据中隐藏的结构信息。基于增强后的特征，分别采用K近邻（KNN）、决策树（DT）、随机森林（RF）为SIMON32与SIMECK32构建三类机器学习引导的有向图并开展对比。据我们所知，本框架首次实现了差分簇效应的图可视化：高概率单比特差分在学习得到的嵌入空间中形成几何上邻近的簇。三类模型识别高概率差分的精确率均达到1.0，不存在误报。其中KNN模型的簇分离度最高、F1得分最优，图构建时间最短（约2.3秒）；DT与RF模型可生成回归性能近乎完美的最优路径。上述结果在两类轻量级密码上均保持一致，证明该框架可推广至其他基于「与运算-循环移位」结构的轻量级密码家族。

title: Reservoir of Importance: Learning Semi-Structured Sparsity with Differentiable Subset Sampling
title_zh: 重要性储备：基于可微子集采样的半结构化稀疏性学习
authors: Ha Dinh, Xuan Duy Ta, Khoat Than, Khac-Hoai Nam Bui
abstract: Semi-structured $N$:$M$ sparsity has emerged as a practical direction for accelerating large language models (LLMs). However, existing learnable-mask approaches incur substantial parameter and memory overhead, limiting their scalability to large models and aggressive sparsity regimes. In this work, we revisit semi-structured pruning from a perspective that reconciles efficiency with scalability. We propose Reservoir of Importance (RoI), a lightweight semi-structured pruning framework that learns sparsity masks through differentiable subset sampling. Unlike prior methods that model full categorical distributions over all feasible $N$:$M$ patterns, RoI introduces a compact-logit parameterization for sparsity mask learning and performs sampling without replacement to select masks, thereby reducing trainable parameters from combinatorial complexity to $\mathcal{O}({M})$. As a result, RoI requires 1.5-8.75$\times$ fewer learnable parameters and significantly lower memory cost, while remaining fully aligned with hardware-friendly sparsity patterns. Extensive evaluations across multiple scales of the Qwen2.5 LLM family (0.5-7B parameters) demonstrate that RoI achieves competitive performance with strong memory efficiency, stability, and scalability to more aggressive $N$:$M$ sparsity patterns, offering a practical path toward efficient LLM deployment.
summary_zh: 半结构化N:M稀疏性是加速大语言模型（LLM）推理的实用技术方向。但现有可学习掩码方法会产生大量额外参数与内存开销，限制其在大模型与高稀疏度场景下的可扩展性。本文从兼顾效率与可扩展性的角度重新审视半结构化剪枝任务，提出Reservoir of Importance（RoI，重要性储备），一种轻量级半结构化剪枝框架，可通过可微子集采样学习稀疏掩码。与以往对所有可行N:M模式建模完整类别分布的方法不同，RoI为稀疏掩码学习引入紧凑对数参数化，执行无放回采样选择掩码，将可训练参数从组合复杂度降至O(M)。因此RoI的可训练参数数量比现有方法少1.5-8.75倍，内存开销显著降低，同时生成的稀疏模式完全适配硬件加速要求。在参数规模0.5B到7B的多尺度Qwen2.5大语言模型系列上开展的大量实验表明，RoI在保持性能竞争力的同时具备优异的内存效率、稳定性，可扩展至更高稀疏度的N:M模式，为大语言模型高效部署提供了可行路径。

title: ST$^2$U: Stateful Test-Time Unlearning via Restricted Knowledge Boundary Control
title_zh: ST²U：基于受限知识边界控制的有状态测试时遗忘方法
authors: Xunlei Chen, Qinghui Gong, Ruini Xue, Yaodong Hu, Tian Lan, Wenhong Tian
abstract: Controlling restricted knowledge in large language models is essential for model alignment and safe deployment. Test-time unlearning avoids costly retraining and parameter updates by intervening only during inference. However, existing activation-editing methods apply isolated pointwise corrections, overlooking how autoregressive generation continually reconstructs hidden states from the prompt, cache, and generated prefix. Consequently, later states may return to restricted knowledge regions after a locally successful correction, causing restricted knowledge re-entry. In this work, we propose Stateful Test-Time Unlearning via restricted knowledge boundary control (ST$^2$U), which formulates test-time unlearning as trajectory-wide boundary control. ST$^2$U first models restricted knowledge boundaries in low-dimensional invertible coordinates while leaving orthogonal non-target components unchanged. During inference, ST$^2$U monitors risk along the trajectory, applies minimal boundary corrections with contextual anchoring, and propagates historical correction states across tokens to mitigate knowledge re-entry. This trajectory-wide control enables more persistent forgetting while preserving non-target capabilities and limiting inference overhead. Across three benchmarks and three model families, ST$^2$U delivers the strongest overall balance, combining best or second-best retention with competitive forgetting and substantially less restricted-knowledge re-entry than test-time baselines (13.76%-19.84% versus 46.50%-59.10%).
summary_zh: 管控大语言模型中的受限知识是模型对齐与安全部署的核心要求。测试时遗忘技术无需代价高昂的重训练与参数更新，仅在推理阶段介入即可实现知识移除。但现有激活编辑方法采用孤立的逐点校正策略，忽略了自回归生成过程会根据提示词、缓存与已生成前缀持续重构隐藏状态，导致局部校正成功后的后续状态可能重新回到受限知识区域，引发受限知识重入问题。本文提出Stateful Test-Time Unlearning via Restricted Knowledge Boundary Control（ST²U，基于受限知识边界控制的有状态测试时遗忘）方法，将测试时遗忘建模为全轨迹边界控制问题。ST²U首先在低维可逆坐标空间中对受限知识边界建模，同时保持正交的非目标分量不变。推理阶段，ST²U沿生成轨迹监控风险，在上下文锚定的前提下施加最小程度的边界校正，跨token传播历史校正状态以缓解知识重入问题。该全轨迹控制策略可在保留非目标能力、控制推理开销的同时实现更持久的遗忘效果。在三个基准数据集与三类模型家族上的测试结果表明，ST²U实现了最优的综合性能平衡，在遗忘性能具备竞争力的前提下，非目标能力保留性能位列第一或第二，其受限知识重入率仅为13.76%-19.84%，远低于现有测试时基线方法的46.50%-59.10%。

title: Neural Boltzmann Equations
title_zh: 神经玻尔兹曼方程
authors: Jonas Spinner, Jack Shergold
abstract: The dynamics of particles in the early universe are described by Boltzmann equations, which involve high-dimensional phase-space integrals. Classical approaches use quadrature integration and evolve the system on a fixed momentum grid, which scales poorly to complicated systems and parameter scans, severely limiting the complexity of processes that can be studied. We introduce Neural Boltzmann Equations (NBEs), which combine three coupled concepts to overcome these limitations. First, particle properties are encoded in physics-inspired neural distribution functions, with parameters that can be predicted using neural networks, enabling efficient parameter scans. Second, phase-space integrals are evaluated with Monte Carlo, using importance sampling tools from collider physics. Third, we use the natural gradient method to evolve the system. After demonstrating the individual benefits of NBEs, we use the framework to perform a precision calculation of the effective number of relativistic neutrino degrees of freedom in the early universe.
summary_zh: 早期宇宙中的粒子动力学由玻尔兹曼方程描述，这类方程涉及高维相空间积分。传统方法采用正交积分在固定动量网格上演化系统，其扩展性难以适配复杂系统与参数扫描场景，严重限制了可研究过程的复杂度。本文提出神经玻尔兹曼方程（Neural Boltzmann Equations, NBEs），融合三个耦合概念以克服上述局限：第一，将粒子属性编码为物理启发的神经分布函数，其参数可通过神经网络预测，实现高效参数扫描；第二，采用对撞物理中的重要性采样工具，通过蒙特卡洛方法计算相空间积分；第三，使用自然梯度方法演化系统。在验证NBEs的各项独立优势后，本文利用该框架对早期宇宙中相对论中微子自由度的有效数量开展了高精度计算。

title: Channel-Token Attention for Reliable Dynamic Spectrum Access under Bursty Primary-User Traffic
title_zh: 面向突发主用户流量下可靠动态频谱接入的信道令牌注意力机制
authors: Krishna Acharya, Dinanath Padhya, Utsab Dahal, Ashish Kandel, Binod Sapkota
abstract: Dynamic spectrum access must coordinate secondary users under bursty primary-user activity while preserving packet reliability and delay. We present TACAN, a centralized policy that represents each channel as a token containing occupancy history and automatic-modulation-classification entropy; a context token supplies queue class, delay and user identity. A Transformer encoder is warm-started from an occupancy-greedy policy and refined with proximal policy optimization. The frozen policies were trained to maintain a channel assignment in every slot, including when queues were empty. We therefore replay them on held-out trajectories and distinguish standby assignment success from packet-present access and packet delivery. In a 20-channel network with 60 primary devices and 4 secondary users, TACAN achieves 92.53% +/- 0.47 packet-present access success, compared with 89.94% for Greedy and 83.53% for PPO+MLP. Its paired gain over Greedy is 2.59 points (parametric 95% CI 1.89-3.29), with wins in all five seeds; the exact two-sided sign-test value is 0.0625. The gain rises from 0.57 points at normal primary-user load to 7.67 points at extreme load. TACAN also reduces mean delivery delay from 1.208 to 1.123 slots and the conditional user-reliability gap from 9.69 to 3.15 points. Delivered packets per SU-slot remain arrival-limited (30.12% versus 30.11%), so no packet-throughput gain is claimed.
summary_zh: 动态频谱接入需要在突发的主用户活动场景下协调次用户，同时保障分组可靠性与时延性能。本文提出TACAN这一集中式策略，将每个信道表示为包含占用历史与自动调制分类熵的令牌，同时用一个上下文令牌提供队列类别、时延与用户身份信息。Transformer编码器从占用贪心策略出发进行热启动，再通过近端策略优化完成微调。训练得到的冻结策略可在每个时隙（包括队列为空时）维持信道分配，因此本文在留出轨迹上对其进行重放，将待机分配成功率与存在分组时的接入成功率、分组投递率区分开。在包含60个主设备与4个次用户的20信道网络中，TACAN的存在分组场景接入成功率达92.53%±0.47%，优于贪心策略的89.94%与PPO+多层感知机（PPO+MLP）的83.53%。其相对贪心策略的性能增益为2.59个百分点（参数化95%置信区间1.89~3.29），在全部5个随机种子下均取得更优表现，精确双侧符号检验值为0.0625。该增益在主用户正常负载下为0.57个百分点，在极端负载下可提升至7.67个百分点。TACAN还将平均投递时延从1.208个时隙降至1.123个时隙，将条件用户可靠性差距从9.69个百分点缩小至3.15个百分点。每个次用户时隙的投递分组数仍受到达率限制（30.12%对比30.11%），因此本文未宣称其在分组吞吐量上存在增益。

title: Hierarchy-Aware Semantic Losses for Knowledge Graph Link Prediction
title_zh: 面向知识图谱链接预测的层级感知语义损失
authors: Filip Kronstr\"om, Ross D. King
abstract: These results are consistent with ontology-derived class hierarchies providing complementary information to graph structure, and suggest that encouraging hierarchical consistency through semantic losses is an effective and comparatively parameter-efficient mechanism for improving knowledge graph link prediction.
summary_zh: 上述结果与由本体导出的类别层级可为图结构提供互补信息的结论一致，表明通过语义损失引导层级一致性是提升知识图谱链接预测性能的一种兼具有效性与参数高效性的机制。

title: Do Time-Series Foundation Models Pay Off for Industrial Monitoring? A Cost-Aware Empirical Study
title_zh: 时间序列基础模型在工业监测场景中是否物有所值？一项考虑成本的实证研究
authors: Guan-Hua Wen, Kuan-Yu Chen
abstract: Industrial monitoring models must detect operationally relevant deviations while satisfying target-specific data, calibration, and resource constraints. Time-series foundation models (TSFMs) promise reusable representations and zero-shot forecasts, yet evidence for their deployment value remains mixed when task definitions are heterogeneous and lightweight baselines are competitive. This work presents a protocol-aware empirical assessment across three settings: a C-MAPSS degradation-risk proxy, normal-only training for anomalous-sound detection on MIMII, and BDG2 forecasting-residual diagnostics with synthetic target perturbations. We assess classical one-class methods, compact neural autoencoders, residual forecasters, MOMENT-small, Chronos-T5, and TimesFM 2.5 in terms of anomaly-ranking performance, risk-horizon sensitivity, residual forecasting and perturbation sensitivity, and local implementation cost. Across 100 C-MAPSS engines evaluated out of fold, TCN-AE reaches fold-weighted AUROC/AUPRC 0.9570/0.8960, compared with 0.7310/0.3080 for MOMENT reconstruction; paired engine-cluster bootstrap confidence intervals exclude zero for both differences. Across five matched MIMII pump evaluations, OCSVM also exceeds MOMENT reconstruction in AUROC and AUPRC. On a fixed 12-meter BDG2 panel, TimesFM 2.5 has the lowest aligned forecast error and the highest synthetic AUROC point estimate, although synthetic AUPRC is similar across TSFM and fitted residual models. Same-device measurements show that MOMENT incurs higher latency, peak allocated VRAM, and serialized state-dictionary size than TCN-AE. Under the evaluated frozen and zero-shot settings, TSFMs are task-dependent deployment options rather than default replacements for fitted lightweight models.
summary_zh: 工业监测模型需要检测与运行相关的偏差，同时满足面向特定任务的数据、校准与资源约束。时间序列基础模型（Time-Series Foundation Models, TSFMs）具备可复用表示与零样本预测的优势，但在任务定义异构、轻量基线模型性能极具竞争力的场景下，其部署价值的相关证据仍存在分歧。本文在三类场景下开展了符合评估规范的实证研究：C-MAPSS退化风险代理任务、基于MIMII数据集的仅正常样本训练异常声音检测任务、带合成目标扰动的BDG2预测残差诊断任务。本文从异常排序性能、风险视界灵敏度、残差预测与扰动灵敏度、本地部署成本几个维度对经典单类方法、紧凑神经自编码器、残差预测器、MOMENT-small、Chronos-T5与TimesFM 2.5开展评估。在100台采用折外评估的C-MAPSS引擎上，TCN-AE的折加权AUROC/AUPRC达0.9570/0.8960，相比之下MOMENT重构方法的结果为0.7310/0.3080，两种差异对应的配对引擎集群自举置信区间均不包含0。在5组匹配的MIMII泵评估任务中，OCSVM的AUROC与AUPRC同样超过MOMENT重构方法。在固定12米的BDG2面板上，TimesFM 2.5的对齐预测误差最低，合成场景AUROC点估计值最高，不过TSFM与拟合残差模型的合成场景AUPRC结果相近。同设备测量结果显示，与TCN-AE相比，MOMENT的时延、峰值分配显存与序列化状态字典大小均更高。在本文评估的冻结与零样本设置下，TSFM是依赖任务特性的部署选项，无法直接替代经过拟合的轻量模型。

title: Stochastic gradient descent with initial regularization
title_zh: 带初始正则化的随机梯度下降
authors: Nabil Kahal\'e
abstract: We analyze a variant of stochastic gradient descent with initial regularization (SGDIR) and derive dimension-free upper bounds on its expected excess risk for the squared loss. In the noiseless case, we obtain new bounds for both averaged and non-averaged SGDIR under moment, source, and capacity assumptions. For a particular value of the source parameter, these bounds are of order $m^{-2}\log^{2}m$, where the number of training samples is of order $m$. For another value of the source parameter, we obtain, for any $\epsilon>0$, bounds of order $m^{-3+\epsilon}$, provided that the capacity parameter exceeds $\epsilon^{-1}$. We also establish a lower bound that matches our upper bounds in certain regimes up to a polylogarithmic factor. In the noisy case, we provide an instance-based comparison between SGDIR and ridge regression. Under general assumptions and a mild lower bound on the regularization parameter, we show that the expected excess risk of SGDIR is no larger than that of ridge regression, up to a polylogarithmic factor. Numerical experiments on synthetic and real data are consistent with our theoretical findings.
summary_zh: 本文分析了带初始正则化的随机梯度下降（stochastic gradient descent with initial regularization, SGDIR）变体，针对平方损失推导得到其期望超额风险的无维度上界。在无噪声场景下，本文在矩假设、源假设与容量假设下分别得到了平均SGDIR与非平均SGDIR的新上界。当源参数取特定值时，该上界的阶为$m^{-2}\log^{2}m$，其中训练样本数的阶为$m$。当源参数取另一值时，若容量参数大于$\epsilon^{-1}$，则对任意$\epsilon>0$，可得到阶为$m^{-3+\epsilon}$的上界。本文还建立了一个下界，该下界在部分场景下与我们得到的上界仅相差一个多对数因子。在有噪声场景下，本文对SGDIR与岭回归开展了基于实例的对比。在通用假设与正则化参数的温和下界条件下，本文证明SGDIR的期望超额风险相比岭回归仅相差一个多对数因子，性能不弱于后者。在合成数据与真实数据上开展的数值实验结果与理论结论一致。

title: A Momentum-Based Variance-Reduced Algorithm for Federated Multiobjective Optimization
title_zh: 面向联邦多目标优化的动量驱动方差缩减算法
authors: Yong Zhao, Chunlin You, Minh N. Dao, Zai-Yun Peng
abstract: Federated learning has traditionally been formulated as a single-objective optimization problem, primarily focused on maximizing model utility. In real-world applications, however, machine learning models often need to optimize multiple and potentially conflicting objectives simultaneously. This motivates federated multiobjective optimization (FMOO), which provides a natural framework for jointly handling multiple task-specific objectives in federated learning. In this paper, we propose a momentum-based variance-reduced algorithm for federated multiobjective optimization. The method incorporates a momentum-driven gradient estimator into the local updates to reduce the variance of stochastic updates, leading to an improved convergence rate. We establish theoretical guarantees showing that the expected Pareto stationarity measure of a randomly selected output iterate decays at a rate of $\mathcal{O}(T^{-2/3})$, improving upon the $\mathcal{O}(T^{-1/2})$ rates established for existing methods such as FSMGDA and FedCMOO. Numerical experiments on federated multiobjective optimization benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness and competitive performance of the proposed algorithm.
summary_zh: 联邦学习传统上被建模为单目标优化问题，核心目标是最大化模型效用。但在实际应用中，机器学习模型往往需要同时优化多个可能相互冲突的目标，这催生了联邦多目标优化（Federated Multiobjective Optimization, FMOO），为联合处理联邦学习中多个任务特定目标提供了天然框架。本文提出一种面向联邦多目标优化的动量驱动方差缩减算法，该方法将动量引导的梯度估计器引入本地更新过程，降低随机更新的方差，进而提升收敛速率。本文给出了理论保证，证明随机选取的输出迭代的期望帕累托平稳性度量以$\mathcal{O}(T^{-2/3})$的速率衰减，优于现有FSMGDA、FedCMOO等方法的$\mathcal{O}(T^{-1/2})$速率。在联邦多目标优化基准任务上的数值实验验证了所提算法的有效性与竞争性能。

title: A Commutator Framework for Selective Spectral Alignment in Deep Neural Networks
title_zh: 深度神经网络中选择性谱对齐的交换子框架
authors: Kaj Nystr\"om
abstract: Analytic examples and numerical experiments exhibit factorization of spectral and activation geometry, transient growth, and cancellation among nonzero sources. In tested finite-time regimes, cancellation dominated by a negative transport-imbalance interaction persists across depths, widths, and two regression benchmarks. Spectral alignment therefore appears as a layer- and scale-dependent compatibility phenomenon governed by transport, interaction, cancellation, and possible damping, rather than a universal consequence of training.
summary_zh: 分析示例与数值实验展示了谱与激活几何的分解、瞬态增长以及非零源之间的抵消效应。在测试的有限时间区间内，由负向传输不平衡交互主导的抵消效应在不同深度、宽度与两个回归基准任务下均持续存在。因此，谱对齐表现为一种由传输、交互、抵消与潜在阻尼共同主导的、依赖层与尺度的兼容现象，而非训练带来的普适性结果。

title: Thinking at the Right Size: Amortized Distillation Across Post-Trained LLMs
title_zh: 以合适规模思考：跨后训练大语言模型的摊销蒸馏
authors: Yan Zhou, Sara Kangaslahti, Jonathan Geuter, Nihal V. Nayak, Marco Fumero, Francesco Locatello, David Alvarez-Melis
abstract: Practical deployment of large language models (LLMs) requires families of post-trained variants---instruction-tuned, reasoning-tuned, and chat-style models---each at multiple sizes to meet diverse latency and memory budgets. Producing each (variant, size) pair independently is prohibitive, so model families typically span only a handful of coarse-grained sizes per post-trained variant. Boomerang distillation (Kangaslahti et al., 2026) reduces this cost along the size axis for base models. Through model size interpolation, it constructs models of intermediate sizes from a single teacher-student pair without additional training. However, it still treats each post-trained variant as a separate object of optimization. We introduce ADAPT---Amortized Distillation Across Post-Trained LLMs---a framework for amortizing distillation across both axes of a model family: size and post-training variant, producing $L \times K$ models for $L$ interpolated sizes across $K$ post-trained variants with a single distillation run. ADAPT combines two components. First, a two-phase distillation procedure constructs post-trained students through pre-training alignment and supervised fine-tuning distillation, enabling smooth size--performance interpolation on generation and reasoning tasks. Second, weight-delta initialization approximates this construction across post-trained variants by transferring the distillation-induced weight change from the base model to students initialized from different post-trained variants. The resulting continuum of interpolated models also enables adaptive model-size selection at inference time, improving the compute--accuracy trade-off for long-form reasoning tasks.
summary_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）的实际部署需要一系列后训练变体——包括指令微调、推理微调与对话式模型，每种变体都具备多个尺寸以适配不同的时延与内存预算。独立生成每一个（变体，尺寸）对的成本高到难以承受，因此现有模型家族通常仅为每个后训练变体提供少数几个粗粒度尺寸。Boomerang蒸馏（Kangaslahti et al., 2026）降低了基础模型在尺寸维度上的蒸馏成本，该方法通过模型尺寸插值，仅利用一对师生模型即可构建出中间尺寸的模型，无需额外训练。但该方法仍将每个后训练变体视为独立的优化对象。本文提出ADAPT——跨后训练大语言模型的摊销蒸馏（Amortized Distillation Across Post-Trained LLMs），这一框架可在模型家族的两个维度（尺寸与后训练变体）上实现蒸馏摊销：仅需一次蒸馏运行，即可生成覆盖K个后训练变体的L个插值尺寸对应的共L×K个模型。ADAPT包含两个核心组件：第一，两阶段蒸馏流程，通过预训练对齐与监督微调蒸馏构建后训练学生模型，在生成与推理任务上实现平滑的尺寸-性能插值；第二，权重增量初始化，通过将蒸馏引发的权重变化从基础模型迁移到从不同后训练变体初始化的学生模型，近似实现跨后训练变体的模型构建。最终得到的连续插值模型集还支持推理时的自适应模型尺寸选择，可提升长程推理任务的计算量-精度权衡表现。

title: RIBOSPAN: A Long-Context RNA Foundation Model for Versatile RNA Modeling
title_zh: RIBOSPAN：面向通用RNA建模的长上下文RNA基础模型
authors: Ziyuan Wang, Bohao Tang, Fei Zhang, Shuo Han, Pengfei Liu
abstract: Full-length RNAs, particularly messenger RNAs, often exceed the context lengths used to pretrain existing RNA foundation models, limiting complete-transcript modeling at single-nucleotide resolution. We present RIBOSPAN, a 1.61-billion-parameter bidirectional RNA foundation model natively pretrained with context lengths up to 10,240 nt. RIBOSPAN combines dense bidirectional self-attention, single-nucleotide tokenization, and attention-isolated sequence packing to enable high-resolution modeling of complete long RNAs. We evaluate the model through nucleotide reconstruction, a controlled long-context representation benchmark, and frozen RNA-type representation analysis. Native 10K pretraining preserves strong reconstruction at 10,240 tokens, while continued pretraining with 40% masking improves recovery under heavy corruption while preserving representation quality. The long-context benchmark further shows that native 10K models maintain strong contextual responsiveness and context-specific representation separation while keeping perturbation-induced representation changes highly localized. Inference-time YaRN scaling recovers much of the contextual organization lost by direct extrapolation of short-context models, but induces substantially greater distal representation diffusion. Frozen-representation evaluations further demonstrate state-of-the-art RNA representation quality, with RIBOSPAN achieving the strongest overall performance across diverse RNA types and retaining a clear advantage on long RNAs. Building on the same backbone, we develop a multidimensionally conditioned discrete-diffusion framework for full-length mRNA generation and redesign, including synonymous-codon diffusion for protein-preserving CDS optimization. Together, RIBOSPAN establishes a powerful long-context foundation for transferable RNA representation learning and full-transcript mRNA design.
summary_zh: 全长RNA，尤其是信使RNA的长度通常超过现有RNA基础模型的预训练上下文长度，限制了单核苷酸分辨率下的完整转录本建模。本文提出RIBOSPAN，这是一个参数量达16.1亿的双向RNA基础模型，原生预训练的上下文长度最高可达10240 nt。RIBOSPAN融合了密集双向自注意力、单核苷酸分词与注意力隔离序列打包技术，实现了对完整长RNA的高分辨率建模。本文通过核苷酸重建任务、受控长上下文表示基准与冻结RNA类型表示分析对该模型开展评估。原生10K预训练设置下，模型在10240个token长度下仍保持优异的重建性能，而采用40%掩码的持续预训练可提升高损坏场景下的恢复能力，同时保留表示质量。长上下文基准测试进一步表明，原生10K模型可保持优异的上下文响应能力与上下文特定表示分离能力，同时将扰动引发的表示变化高度局部化。推理时采用YaRN缩放可恢复直接外推短上下文模型所损失的大部分上下文组织信息，但会引发显著更高的远端表示扩散。冻结表示评估进一步证明RIBOSPAN具备当前最优的RNA表示质量，在多种RNA类型上取得了整体最优性能，且在长RNA任务上保持明显优势。基于相同骨干网络，本文开发了面向全长mRNA生成与重设计的多维度条件离散扩散框架，包括用于保留蛋白质序列的同义密码子扩散以优化编码区序列（CDS）。综上，RIBOSPAN为可迁移RNA表示学习与全长转录本mRNA设计提供了强大的长上下文基础。

title: Mirror descent algorithms with logarithmic barriers
title_zh: 采用对数障碍的镜像下降算法
authors: Alberto De Marchi, Yura Malitsky, Adrien B. Taylor
abstract: This work derives convergence guarantees for mirror descent and proximal mirror descent algorithms when a logarithmic barrier is used as a distance-generating function. Standard approaches cannot be applied when the solution lies on the boundary, where the Bregman divergence blows up. We show that, in a specific setting, both methods enjoy an $O(\log k / k)$ rate, which is also tight. In addition, our contributions include: (i) a new technique for handling the blow-up; (ii) a resolution of a gap in the theory of relative smoothness; and (iii) a comparison of the proposed approach with interior-point methods.
summary_zh: 本文推导了将对数障碍作为距离生成函数时，镜像下降与近端镜像下降算法的收敛性保证。当解位于边界上时，Bregman散度会趋于无穷大，此时标准方法无法适用。本文证明，在特定设置下，两种算法均可达到$O(\log k / k)$的收敛速率，且该速率是紧的。此外，本文的贡献还包括：（1）提出了一种处理散度趋于无穷大问题的新技术；（2）填补了相对平滑性理论中的一处空白；（3）将所提方法与内点法进行了对比。

title: DIME: Query-Efficient Framework for Membership Inference on Diffusion Models
title_zh: DIME（去噪器理想成员误差）：面向扩散模型的查询高效成员推理框架
authors: Tue Do, Daniel Alabi
abstract: Membership inference attacks expose whether individual records were used to train a model, yet existing attacks on diffusion models are largely heuristic and can require substantial query budgets. We introduce DIME (Denoiser Ideal Membership Error), a theoretically grounded and query-efficient framework for membership inference on diffusion models. Our starting point is an exact characterization of the optimal diffusion denoiser for a finite training set, which reveals that membership leakage is governed by the denoiser's implicit reconstruction error. This error decomposes into two complementary signals: a bias term, capturing reconstruction accuracy, and a previously unexplored local crowding term, capturing the geometry of nearby training examples. Both admit efficient estimators using only model queries, yielding a practical attack with as few as two queries. Across CIFAR-10/100, STL10-U, CelebA, and ImageNet, DIME consistently outperforms prior attacks at comparable or substantially lower query cost, improving TPR at 1% FPR by up to $3\times$; remarkably, its two-query variant can outperform existing 30-query baselines. Finally, we suggest, discuss, and evaluate specific defenses to counteract such powerful membership tests.
summary_zh: 成员推理攻击可判断个体记录是否被用于模型训练，但现有针对扩散模型的攻击大多基于启发式设计，往往需要消耗大量查询预算。本文提出DIME（Denoiser Ideal Membership Error，去噪器理想成员误差），一个具备理论支撑、查询效率极高的扩散模型成员推理框架。研究起点是针对有限训练集的最优扩散去噪器的精确表征，该表征显示成员信息泄露由去噪器的隐式重构误差决定。该误差可分解为两个互补信号：一是偏差项，用于表征重构精度；二是此前未被探索的局部拥挤项，用于表征邻近训练样本的几何特征。两类信号都可通过仅调用模型查询的高效估计器得到，最终实现仅需两次查询的实用攻击。在CIFAR-10/100、STL10-U、CelebA和ImageNet数据集上，DIME在相当甚至远更低的查询成本下，性能始终优于现有攻击方法，在1%假阳性率（FPR）下的真阳性率（TPR）最高可提升3倍；值得注意的是，其仅需两次查询的变体性能即可超过现有需要30次查询的基线方法。最后本文提出、讨论并评估了可抵御这类强成员推理测试的针对性防御方案。

title: SAGE: Stability-Aware Graph-Based Ensemble Feature Selection for Explainable Postpartum Depression Risk Prediction
title_zh: SAGE：面向可解释产后抑郁风险预测的稳定性感知图基集成特征选择方法
authors: Md. Rokon Islam Emon, Syed Shariar Alam Shuvo, Shahriar Siddique Ayon, Abdullah Al Mamun, Ahnaf Atef Choudhury
abstract: Postpartum depression (PPD) poses a major burden on maternal and child health, especially in low- and middle-income countries where prevalence exceeds 19%. Despite advancements in machine learning for PPD prediction, current approaches are limited by opaque global explanations that lack clinical usefulness at the patient level, unstable feature selection, and poor generalization under class imbalance. We propose SAGE, a Stability-Aware Graph-Based Ensemble feature selection system that incorporates both local explainable AI and a genetically optimized artificial neural network (GA-ANN). Using a primary cohort of 766 postpartum women, SAGE combines information-theoretic relevance, PCA-based structure, and graph-based interactions with bootstrap stability weighting to identify robust and non-redundant predictors. The GA-ANN architecture, optimized using a genetic algorithm and enhanced with GAN based oversampling, achieved strong performance with 87.96% accuracy, 86.32% F1 score, and 0.88 AUC using only 16 features, outperforming baseline and other feature selection methods. Psychological and socioeconomic factors such as EPDS score, PHQ-9 score, feelings about motherhood, and abuse history are the main predictors, while demographic factors have less influence. The LIME-based explanations allow instance-based insight into selected features from the graph, enabling personalized risk assessment. The findings make SAGE a scalable, interpretable, and clinical tool for early identification of PPD in health-care limited resources.
summary_zh: 产后抑郁（PPD）严重威胁母婴健康，在患病率超过19%的中低收入国家问题尤为突出。尽管机器学习在产后抑郁预测领域已取得一定进展，但现有方法存在全局解释透明度不足、临床患者层面实用性差、特征选择不稳定、类别不平衡场景下泛化能力弱等局限。本文提出SAGE，一个稳定性感知的图基集成特征选择系统，融合了局部可解释人工智能技术与遗传优化人工神经网络（GA-ANN）。基于766名产后女性的初始队列数据，SAGE结合信息论相关性、基于主成分分析（PCA）的结构特征、基于图的交互信息与自举稳定性权重，可识别出鲁棒且无冗余的预测因子。通过遗传算法优化、结合生成对抗网络（GAN）过采样增强的GA-ANN架构，仅使用16个特征就实现了87.96%的准确率、86.32%的F1值与0.88的AUC，性能优于基线方法与其他特征选择方法。爱丁堡产后抑郁量表（EPDS）得分、患者健康问卷9项（PHQ-9）得分、母性认同感、虐待史等心理与社会经济因素是主要预测因子，人口统计学因素的影响相对更低。基于局部可解释模型-不相关方法（LIME）的解释可提供基于实例的图特征洞察，支持个性化风险评估。研究结果表明SAGE是可扩展、可解释、适用于医疗资源受限场景的产后抑郁早期识别临床工具。

title: CatchBench: When Can an Agent Failure Be Caught?
title_zh: CatchBench：智能体故障何时可被检测？
authors: Yue Zhao
abstract: The release scores 72 entrants, from rule scanners and structural models to eleven LLM judges across nine model families (GPT, Claude, Gemini, Gemma, Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Mistral, Nova), over 1187 declared configurations and 1162 recorded runs. Most of the arena does not order: 47 of 118 pre-declared contrasts separate, and the rest are published unresolved rather than ranked. The two sharpest results cut against our own data. One rule ignores every name and permission; it flags each capability declared after the first. On one of six configuration sources it reaches a perfect F1, so a score there measures how the corpus was built rather than how well a method reasons. Our admissibility bar then rejected one injected substrate and withheld evidential status from the other. A benchmark number is therefore not interpretable until the process behind its labels is published and tested for the shortcut it may leave. We report both, and regenerate every ordering from released predictions with no model call.
summary_zh: 本次基准测试共纳入72个参赛方案，覆盖规则扫描器、结构模型，以及来自9个模型家族（GPT、Claude、Gemini、Gemma、Llama、Qwen、DeepSeek、Mistral、Nova）的11个大语言模型（LLM）评审器，涉及1187种声明配置与1162次记录运行结果。绝大多数测试场景不存在明确排序：118个预先声明的对比组中仅47组可区分优劣，其余结果均未得到明确结论、无法完成排序。两个最明确的结果反而与我们的初始预期相悖：其一，某条完全忽略名称与权限的规则，可标记首个声明之后的所有能力项，在6个配置源中的某一个上F1值达到100%，说明该场景下的评分反映的是语料库的构建方式，而非方法的推理能力。我们设置的可采纳性标准随后否决了一个注入的基准子数据集，同时认定另一个子数据集不具备证据效力。因此，只有公开基准标签背后的生成流程、并验证其可能存在的捷径漏洞后，基准测试的数值结果才具备可解释性。本文同时报告了上述两部分内容，且所有排序结果均可基于公开预测结果重新生成，无需调用任何模型接口。

title: Change Detection in Probability Flow ODE: Online Testing in Diffusion Latent Spaces
title_zh: 概率流常微分方程（ODE）中的变化检测：扩散潜空间中的在线测试
authors: Artem Kraevskiy, Artem Prokhorov
abstract: The method detects arbitrary distributional shifts, including covariance rotations and higher-order structural breaks, without parametric assumptions on either regime.
summary_zh: 该方法可检测任意分布偏移，包括协方差旋转与高阶结构突变，且无需对任意阶段的分布做参数假设。

title: Contrastive Representation-Guided Genetic Minority Oversampling for Imbalanced Time-Series Classification
title_zh: 面向不平衡时间序列分类的对比表征引导遗传少数类过采样方法
authors: Wenbin Pei, Yunrong Hao, Zhen Liu, Guan Wang, Bing Xue, Yiu-Ming Cheung, Qiang Zhang
abstract: Real-world time-series classification tasks often exhibit class imbalance, which can be extremely severe in some applications. To avoid training biased classifiers on imbalanced data, sampling is one of the most popular data pre-processing techniques because of its classifier-agnostic nature. However, due to the complex temporal dependencies in original time-series data and the scarcity of minority-class samples, existing sampling methods, including interpolation-based oversampling methods and deep learning-based generative models, usually suffer from limited generalization and poor diversity when generating new time-series samples. This paper proposes a Frequency-domain representation-guided Multi-tree Genetic Programming-based oversampling approach (FreMGP) to imbalanced time-series classification, where each individual represents a set of synthetic samples for the minority class. A frequency-domain class-discriminative representation module based on contrastive learning is also developed, guiding the evolutionary search toward high-quality synthetic time-series samples. Experiments on imbalanced time-series datasets demonstrate that FreMGP outperforms existing oversampling methods and consistently improves the performance of different classifiers, including both general machine learning and deep learning models.
summary_zh: 现实场景中的时间序列分类任务往往存在类别不平衡问题，部分场景下不平衡程度极高。为避免在不平衡数据上训练得到有偏分类器，采样技术因具备分类器无关的特性，成为最主流的数据预处理方案之一。但由于原始时间序列数据存在复杂时间依赖关系、少数类样本稀缺，现有采样方法（包括基于插值的过采样方法与基于深度学习的生成模型）生成新时间序列样本时普遍存在泛化能力有限、样本多样性差的问题。本文提出FreMGP（频域表征引导多树遗传编程过采样方法）用于不平衡时间序列分类，该方法中的每个个体对应少数类的一组合成样本。本文还开发了基于对比学习的频域类别区分表征模块，引导进化搜索生成高质量的合成时间序列样本。在不平衡时间序列数据集上的实验表明，FreMGP性能优于现有过采样方法，可稳定提升包括传统机器学习模型与深度学习模型在内的不同分类器的性能。

title: ReCoG: Reciprocal Co-Evolution for Multimodal Graph Learning
title_zh: ReCoG：面向多模态图学习的互惠协同演化框架
authors: Rui Xue, Tianfu Wu
abstract: Multimodal graph learning requires jointly training over graph structure and heterogeneous node attributes, yet existing methods largely decouple these processes: prior multimodal graph neural networks (GNNs) focus on aligning modalities in a shared embedding space while operating on fixed or weakly adapted graph structures, and graph structure learning approaches infer topology from unimodal node representations without accounting for multimodal interactions. This separation fundamentally limits the ability of GNNs to capture semantically meaningful relationships in multimodal settings, where observed edges are often noisy, incomplete, or misaligned with underlying semantics. We propose ReCoG (Reciprocal Co-Evolution for Multimodal Graph Learning), a new learning paradigm that tightly couples graph structure learning and multimodal representation learning through end-to-end reciprocal interaction. Concretely, ReCoG integrates (i) a multimodal graph refiner that infers and corrects edges using cross-modal semantic evidence, and (ii) a coupled cross-modal message passing mechanism that performs joint intra- and inter-modality propagation over the refined graph. This unified design yields greater expressiveness than decoupled or two-stage formulations and allows dynamic interaction between topology and representation learning. Across diverse benchmarks for node classification and link prediction, ReCoG consistently outperforms strong multimodal graph structure learning baselines, including graph foundation models. Our results demonstrate that reciprocal co-evolution of structure and semantics is important for effective multimodal graph learning, challenging the prevailing separation between topology and representation learning.
summary_zh: 多模态图学习需要同时对图结构与异质节点属性进行联合训练，但现有方法大多将两个过程解耦：此前的多模态图神经网络（GNN）聚焦于在固定或弱适配的图结构上运行、在共享嵌入空间中对齐不同模态，而图结构学习方法仅从单模态节点表征推断拓扑，未考虑多模态交互。这种分离从根本上限制了图神经网络在多模态场景下捕捉语义关联的能力，而多模态场景下观测到的边往往存在噪声、不完整或与底层语义不对齐的问题。本文提出ReCoG（Reciprocal Co-Evolution for Multimodal Graph Learning，多模态图学习互惠协同演化框架）这一全新学习范式，通过端到端的互惠交互将图结构学习与多模态表征学习紧密耦合。具体而言，ReCoG集成两个模块：（1）多模态图优化器，基于跨模态语义证据推断并修正边；（2）耦合跨模态消息传递机制，在优化后的图上执行模态内与模态间的联合传播。该统一设计相比解耦或两阶段方案具备更强的表达能力，可实现拓扑学习与表征学习的动态交互。在节点分类与链路预测的多类基准测试上，ReCoG性能始终优于包括图基础模型在内的主流多模态图结构学习基线。研究结果表明，结构与语义的互惠协同演化对实现高效多模态图学习至关重要，挑战了当前拓扑学习与表征学习相互分离的主流思路。

title: Learning to Control Coupled-Dynamics Environments with Joint Markov Decision Processes
title_zh: 基于联合马尔可夫决策过程（JMDP）的耦合动力学环境控制学习
authors: Ege C. Kaya, Aliasghar Pourghani, Mahsa Ghasemi, Vijay Gupta, Abolfazl Hashemi
abstract: Coupled-dynamics environments expose the one-step outcomes that would follow from several possible counterfactual actions under a common realization of exogenous randomness. The ordinary Markov decision process formalism allows one to reason about the marginal law of each action but discards dependence across these counterfactual outcomes. The Joint Markov decision process (JMDP) formalism preserves that dependence. Prior work established the formalism and solved the fixed-policy joint moment evaluation problem in JMDPs. This paper develops optimal-control methods. We define a nonparametric distributional Bellman optimality operator for JMDPs, and prove that when the induced marginal MDP has a unique optimal policy, its iterates converge in Wasserstein distance to the optimal joint return law. For the first two moments, we establish convergence under a weaker condition that permits several mean-optimal actions as long as their tie resolutions share a second-moment fixed point. We also derive sampled targets for neural approximation.
summary_zh: 耦合动力学环境可展示在外生随机性的同一实现下，多个可能的反事实动作对应的单步结果。传统马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）形式化方法仅能单独推导每个动作的边缘分布，丢弃了不同反事实结果之间的依赖关系。联合马尔可夫决策过程（JMDP）形式化方法可保留这类依赖关系。此前的研究已建立该形式化体系，解决了JMDP中的固定策略联合矩评估问题。本文进一步开发了最优控制方法：定义了JMDP的非参数分布贝尔曼最优算子，证明当诱导的边缘MDP存在唯一最优策略时，算子迭代结果在瓦瑟斯坦距离下收敛到最优联合回报分布。针对前两阶矩，本文在更宽松的条件下证明了收敛性：只要多个均值最优动作的平局决策共享二阶矩不动点，收敛即可成立。本文还推导了适用于神经网络近似的采样目标。

title: LpWM: A Case for Sparse Representations in World Models
title_zh: LpWM：世界模型中稀疏表征的应用价值验证
authors: Yilun Kuang, Yash Dagade, Quentin Le Lidec, Lucas Maes, Randall Balestriero, Yann LeCun
abstract: Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) learn latent dynamics for planning and avoid representation collapse by matching features to maximum-entropy distributions such as isotropic Gaussians, yielding dense representations. However, it is unclear whether dense representations are the most favorable geometry for modeling dynamics. In this work, we ask whether a different geometry, sparse representations, can make action-conditioned latent dynamics easier to model, and what dynamical structure emerges from such representations. We first show that nonlinear Lipschitz dynamics can be approximated arbitrarily well by action-conditioned linear dynamics in a sufficiently high-dimensional one-hot latent space, with rollout error vanishing as the dimension grows. This motivates distributed sparse representations as a practical relaxation of one-hot sparsity. We introduce LpWorldModel (LpWM), a JEPA model regularized with Rectified Distribution Matching Regularization (RDMReg) to match encoder features to a Rectified Generalized Gaussian distribution, yielding non-negative sparse codes. Empirically, sparsity lowers the predictor complexity required for successful planning: on PushT, sparse LpWM outperforms dense LeWM by up to 57% in planning success at intermediate predictor capacities. This advantage also extends beyond Gaussian distribution matching, with LpWM outperforming dense VICReg representations across multiple predictor families. We further find that the learned sparse representations are mode-factored, with support encoding discrete dynamical regimes and feature magnitudes capturing continuous within-regime state. Together, these results suggest that sparse representations can reduce the predictor complexity required for control while revealing interpretable structure.
summary_zh: 联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）学习用于规划的潜动力学，通过将特征与各向同性高斯等最大熵分布匹配避免表征坍缩，最终生成稠密表征。但目前尚不清楚稠密表征是否是动力学建模的最优几何结构。本文探究稀疏表征这一不同几何结构是否能降低动作条件潜动力学的建模难度，以及这类表征会催生何种动力学结构。首先证明，在足够高维的独热潜空间中，非线性利普希茨动力学可通过动作条件线性动力学任意精度近似，且推演误差随维度增长趋近于零。该结论启发本文采用分布式稀疏表征作为独热稀疏性的实用松弛方案。本文提出LpWM（Lp世界模型），这是一个采用校正分布匹配正则化（RDMReg）的JEPA模型，可将编码器特征与校正广义高斯分布匹配，生成非负稀疏编码。实验表明，稀疏性可降低成功规划所需的预测器复杂度：在PushT任务上，稀疏LpWM在中等预测器容量下的规划成功率比稠密LeWM最高高出57%。该优势不局限于高斯分布匹配场景，在多个预测器家族上，LpWM性能均优于稠密VICReg表征。进一步研究发现，学习得到的稀疏表征具备模式分解特性：支撑集编码离散动力学模式，特征幅值捕捉模式内的连续状态。上述结果表明，稀疏表征可降低控制任务所需的预测器复杂度，同时输出可解释的结构。

title: MOSH-WM: Mask-Grounded Soft-Hamiltonian Dynamics for Object-Centric World Models
title_zh: MOSH-WM：面向以对象为中心的世界模型的掩码基软哈密顿动力学
authors: Zhekai Wang, Haoxiang Huang, Xiang Liu, Zhikang Chen, Yueqing Sun, Qi Gu, Shiji Zhou, Miao Liu, Sen Cui
abstract: Object-centric world models forecast future videos by evolving a set of entity slots, but the variables receiving dynamics supervision are often unconstrained visual features. We introduce \method{}, a mask-grounded soft-Hamiltonian world model that makes its position-like state explicitly depend on slot-owned image support. A frozen video-slot encoder produces slots and masks; spatial moments of mask-owned support form a canonical state $Q$, temporal differences form $P$, and a learned energy supplies a soft directional bias to a bounded learned increment. Decoder-relevant appearance and identity are stored separately in a causal visual context. A gated composer and bounded residual then combine this context with the propagated phase state to reconstruct decoder-compatible slots. On OBJ3D, given six observed frames and evaluated over the following 30 frames, \method{} reduces LPIPS by 25.0\% and spatial MSE by 33.7\% relative to the strongest object-centric baseline. On CLEVRER, given six observed frames and evaluated over the following ten frames, the corresponding reductions are 14.5\% and 18.7\%. Horizon-resolved visual and object-state measurements show that the complete model accumulates error more slowly throughout the 30-frame closed-loop rollout. Project page:https://github.com/moshwm-anon/-moshwm-anon.github.io.
summary_zh: 以对象为中心的世界模型通过演化一组实体槽预测未来视频，但接收动力学监督的变量往往是无约束的视觉特征。本文提出MOSH-WM，一个掩码基软哈密顿世界模型，其类位置状态显式依赖于槽所属的图像支撑集。由冻结的视频-槽编码器生成槽与掩码，掩码支撑集的空间矩构成标准状态Q，时间差构成P，学习得到的能量为有界的学习增量提供软方向偏置。解码器相关的外观与身份信息被单独存储在因果视觉上下文中，门控组合器与有界残差模块随后将该上下文与传播后的相状态结合，重构出与解码器兼容的槽。在OBJ3D数据集上，给定6帧观测结果、对后续30帧进行评估时，MOSH-WM相比最优的以对象为中心基线方法，学习感知图像块相似性（LPIPS）降低25.0%，空间均方误差（MSE）降低33.7%。在CLEVRER数据集上，给定6帧观测结果、对后续10帧进行评估时，两类误差分别降低14.5%与18.7%。不同预测步长的视觉与对象状态测量结果表明，完整模型在30帧闭环推演过程中的误差累积速度更慢。项目主页：https://github.com/moshwm-anon/-moshwm-anon.github.io。

title: Generative Neural Networks for Sinkhorn Distributionally Robust Hypothesis Testing
title_zh: 面向Sinkhorn分布鲁棒假设检验的生成神经网络
authors: Fenglin Zhang, Teyan Liu, Jie Wang
abstract: This paper studies the Sinkhorn distributionally robust hypothesis testing (SDRHT) problem, seeking a robust detector against least-favorable distributions in Sinkhorn discrepancy-based ambiguity sets centered at the empirical distributions. Existing approaches solve this problem by solving large-scale conic programs, which are not scalable. To overcome this, we propose a generative framework that learns least-favorable distributions and supports efficient training and end-to-end sampling. For the Sinkhorn discrepancy-based ambiguity sets, we first derive an equivalent conditional-KL-divergence representation with respect to kernel-smoothed reference distributions. This property allows us to prove strong duality for both constrained and unconstrained minimax SDRHT formulations. Based on the closed-form optimal detector and Brenier's theorem, we reformulate the max-min dual formulation as a maximization problem over convex potentials whose gradients characterize invertible transport maps between kernel-smoothed distributions and their least-favorable counterparts. We efficiently approximate these potentials using Hyper Input Convex Neural Networks (HyCNNs) equipped with stochastic gradient estimators and prove the representation power of HyCNNs and the distributional universality of their induced transport maps. Numerical results show that the proposed method achieves superior accuracy and robustness across different sample sizes and dimensions, while avoiding the scalability limitations of classical SDRHT methods.
summary_zh: 本文研究Sinkhorn分布鲁棒假设检验（SDRHT）问题，目标是在以经验分布为中心、基于Sinkhorn散度定义的歧义集内，构建针对最不利分布的鲁棒检测器。现有方法通过求解大规模锥规划解决该问题，可扩展性差。为克服该局限，本文提出一个生成式框架，可学习最不利分布，支持高效训练与端到端采样。针对基于Sinkhorn散度的歧义集，本文首先推导了其关于核平滑参考分布的等价条件KL散度表征，基于该性质证明了约束与无约束极小极大SDRHT公式的强对偶性。基于闭式最优检测器与Brenier定理，本文将极大极小对偶公式重构为凸势函数上的最大化问题，势函数的梯度可表征核平滑分布与其最不利版本之间的可逆传输映射。本文采用配备随机梯度估计器的超输入凸神经网络（HyCNN）高效近似这些势函数，证明了HyCNN的表征能力与其诱导传输映射的分布普适性。数值实验结果表明，所提方法在不同样本量与维度下均实现了更优的准确率与鲁棒性，同时规避了传统SDRHT方法的可扩展性缺陷。

title: Spiking Neural Networks for Continuous Control: Neuromorphic Reinforcement Learning in Conventional Computing
title_zh: 面向连续控制的脉冲神经网络：传统计算环境下的神经形态强化学习
authors: Jessica Hunter, Md Maruf Hossain Shuvo, Krishna Roy
abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms have made strides over the past decade applying them to a wide range of problems and control tasks. However, the deployment of RL on neuromorphic hardware for continuous control tasks remains under-validated. Namely it is unclear whether replacing a conventional actor network with a spiking neural network (SNN) affects the performance of an agent before any hardware-specific benefits manifest. We provide a systematic validation of a minimal, neuromorphically viable spiking actor variant of Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) on conventional hardware, establishing a baseline for future neuromorphic RL research. In this paper, we propose the Spiking Actor Network Soft Actor Critic (SANSAC) to address the use of RL frameworks in continuous environments, designed as a framework that can be implemented on neuromorphic hardware. We compare a traditional Soft Actor Critic (SAC) network to SANSAC in a traditional computer. We demonstrate the near equivalent performance of SANSAC and SAC, while addressing the impact of hidden dimensions. Our results demonstrate the viability of SNN based algorithms in complex continuous environments, as well as competitive performance to traditional neural networks in traditional computers, providing a basis to continue exploring the use of SNNs in continuous RL frameworks.
summary_zh: 过去十年间，强化学习（RL）算法在各类问题与控制任务中取得了长足进展。然而面向连续控制任务的强化学习在神经形态硬件上的部署仍缺乏充分验证：目前尚不清楚在硬件专属优势显现之前，用脉冲神经网络（SNN）替换传统演员网络是否会影响智能体的性能。本文在传统硬件环境下对神经形态可实现的极简脉冲演员变体Soft Actor-Critic（SAC，软演员-评论家算法）开展系统性验证，为后续神经形态强化学习研究建立基准。本文提出Spiking Actor Network Soft Actor Critic（SANSAC，脉冲演员网络软演员-评论家算法），解决连续环境下强化学习框架的落地问题，该框架可直接在神经形态硬件上实现。我们在传统计算机上将传统SAC网络与SANSAC进行对比，结果表明SANSAC与SAC的性能几乎相当，同时明确了隐藏层维度的影响。研究结果证明了基于SNN的算法在复杂连续环境中的可行性，其在传统计算机上的性能可与传统神经网络相竞争，为后续探索SNN在连续强化学习框架中的应用提供了基础。

title: HAWKEYE: Seeing One Layer Deeper -- A Cohesion-Aware Structural Channel for Temporal Link Prediction
title_zh: HAWKEYE：更深一层感知——面向时序链路预测的内聚感知结构通道
authors: Jiacheng Ding, Xiaofei Zhang
abstract: State-of-the-art temporal-link-prediction (TLP) models are, in essence, multi-channel information aggregators: they combine an interaction-history channel, a time-encoding channel, and a structure channel. The first two have been refined relentlessly; the structure channel remains a crude afterthought -- DyGFormer encodes it as a 1--2-bit neighbour-cooccurrence count. We begin with a measurement: on sparse temporal graphs the classical 1-hop common-neighbour signal is near-random (discriminative AUC $\approx 0.50$), because two nodes almost never share a direct neighbour; the genuinely discriminative signal lies one hop deeper -- the 2-hop cohesive bridge, whose discAUC reaches 0.73--0.98, on both bipartite and non-bipartite graphs. Motivated by this, we propose HAWKEYE, a cohesion-aware structural channel that incrementally maintains the classical k-family of cohesiveness indicators (degree $\to$ k-core $\to$ k-truss) and forms 2-hop cohesive-bridge features. HAWKEYE is a drop-in replacement for a temporal-graph model's native structure channel, with no change to the backbone. Swapping HAWKEYE into DyGFormer improves test AP/MRR over the cooccurrence channel by +0.6 to +10.8 points across six multi-seed-validated datasets (uci, enron, USLegis, CanParl, reddit, mooc). On the bipartite recommendation benchmark tgbl-subreddit, a 3-seed single-pass struct-only ablation shows HAWKEYE nearly doubling the baseline test MRR (0.103$\pm$0.003 $\to$ 0.204$\pm$0.005, +10.1 points across all three seeds); the streaming pipeline scales to the 67M-edge tgbl-flight in five minutes per pass. We further characterise when it helps: the gain tracks a graph's training-free 2-hop discAUC and vanishes on degenerate or saturated graphs -- a predictable boundary. All code, data, and figure-generation scripts are released.
summary_zh: 当前最优的时序链路预测（TLP）模型本质上是多通道信息聚合器：其组合了交互历史通道、时间编码通道与结构通道。前两类通道已经得到持续优化，而结构通道仍处于非常粗糙的初级阶段：DyGFormer仅将其编码为1-2位的邻居共现计数。本文首先开展了一项度量实验：在稀疏时序图上，经典的1跳共同邻居信号接近随机状态，判别性AUC约为0.50，原因是两个节点几乎不会共享直接邻居；真正具备判别性的信号位于更深一层的2跳内聚桥，在二分图与非二分图上其判别AUC可达0.73-0.98。受此启发，本文提出HAWKEYE，一种内聚感知结构通道，可增量维护经典的k系列内聚指标（度→k核→k桁架）并生成2跳内聚桥特征。HAWKEYE可直接替换时序图模型原生的结构通道，无需修改模型主干。将HAWKEYE替换DyGFormer的共现通道后，在6个经过多种子验证的数据集（uci、enron、USLegis、CanParl、reddit、mooc）上，测试集AP/MRR指标提升了0.6至10.8个点。在二分图推荐基准tgbl-subreddit上，3种子单通道仅结构信息的消融实验显示，HAWKEYE可将基线测试MRR几乎翻倍（从0.103±0.003提升至0.204±0.005，3种子平均提升10.1个点）；其流式流水线可扩展至包含6700万条边的tgbl-flight数据集，单次遍历仅需5分钟。本文进一步明确了该方法的适用场景：性能增益与图的无需训练2跳判别AUC正相关，在退化图或饱和图上增益消失，边界可预测。所有代码、数据与绘图脚本均已开源。

title: EGAMA-RC: Risk-Calibrated Evidence-Gated Adaptive Malware Analysis for Robust and Interpretable Memory-Forensic Triage
title_zh: EGAMA-RC：面向鲁棒可解释内存取证分诊的风险校准证据门控自适应恶意软件分析
authors: Isaac Kofi Nti
abstract: Machine-learning malware detectors often achieve high clean-data accuracy, but operational triage also requires evidence about uncertainty, novelty, robustness, interpretability, latency, and review cost. This paper presents EGAMA-RC, a risk-calibrated evidence-gated framework for memory-forensic malware triage. Building on SHAP-guided feature refinement, EGAMA-RC combines dataset-specific refinement, model-pool evaluation, adversarial and open-family testing, novelty scoring, explanation-conditioned evidence, and runtime-aware routing. Low-risk samples are accepted automatically, while uncertain, high-risk, or potentially novel cases are routed to review, escalation, or novelty-aware handling. Across three malware datasets and a frozen multi-seed protocol, the selected hybrid gate accepts 93.12% of pooled samples with 99.86% accepted accuracy and a 0.136% false-accept rate. Novelty calibration reduces over-restrictive review behavior while preserving a low unsafe-accept profile. XGBoost provides lightweight fast-path inference with p50/p95 latency of 0.0054/0.0059 ms per sample. The results show that dependable malware analysis requires risk-calibrated routing, novelty awareness, and controlled analyst review, not classification accuracy alone.
summary_zh: 机器学习恶意软件检测器通常在干净数据集上可实现很高的准确率，但实际运营中的分诊场景还需要考虑不确定性、新颖性、鲁棒性、可解释性、延迟与人工审核成本等要素。本文提出EGAMA-RC，一种面向内存取证恶意软件分诊的风险校准证据门控框架。该框架基于SHAP引导的特征优化，融合了数据集专属优化、模型池评估、对抗与未知家族测试、新颖性评分、解释条件证据与运行时感知路由功能。低风险样本可自动通过，而不确定、高风险或潜在的新型样本将被路由至人工审核、升级处理或新颖性专属处理流程。在3个恶意软件数据集与固定多种子实验协议下，本文选用的混合门控机制可自动接受93.12%的池内样本，接受样本准确率达99.86%，误接受率仅为0.136%。新颖性校准功能在维持低不安全接受率的同时，减少了过度严格的审核行为。XGBoost为其提供轻量快速推理能力，单样本p50/p95延迟仅为0.0054/0.0059毫秒。实验结果表明，可靠的恶意软件分析不仅依赖分类准确率，还需要风险校准路由、新颖性感知与可控的分析师审核机制。

title: Maximum-distance nonnegative matrix factorization for unmixing highly mixed grain-size distribution data: A generalization of AnalySize
title_zh: 用于高混合度粒度分布数据解混的最大距离非负矩阵分解：AnalySize方法的泛化
authors: Qianqian Qi, Zhongming Chen, Peter G. M. van der Heijden
abstract: Nonnegative matrix factorization (NMF) decomposes a nonnegative matrix into the product of two nonnegative matrices. This property makes NMF well suited for unmixing grain-size distribution data, which are inherently nonnegative and have row sums equal to one. Previous studies have shown that AnalySize, an NMF-based method, performs well on poorly mixed grain-size distribution data but struggles when the data is highly mixed, where no observed samples are close to the true end members. To overcome this limitation, we introduce a maximum-distance NMF that encourages the estimated end members to be as distinct as possible and develop a hierarchical alternating least squares algorithm for optimization. The proposed formulation can be regarded as a generalization of AnalySize, where AnalySize minimizes the distance among end members while the proposed method maximizes it. Experimental results demonstrate that the method effectively decomposes highly mixed grain-size distribution data.
summary_zh: 非负矩阵分解（NMF）可将非负矩阵分解为两个非负矩阵的乘积，该特性使得NMF非常适合用于粒度分布数据的解混，这类数据天然满足非负特性且行和为1。已有研究表明，基于NMF的AnalySize方法在低混合度粒度分布数据上表现优异，但在高混合度数据场景下性能不佳，这类场景中没有观测样本接近真实端元。为克服该局限，本文引入最大距离NMF，该方法可引导估计得到的端元尽可能互不相同，同时开发了分层交替最小二乘算法用于优化。本文提出的模型可视为AnalySize的泛化版本：AnalySize最小化端元之间的距离，而本文方法最大化端元之间的距离。实验结果表明，该方法可有效分解高混合度的粒度分布数据。

title: Lightweight Multi-scale Hierarchical Anomaly Detection and Localization for Geospatial Big Data Applications at the Edge
title_zh: 面向边缘端地理空间大数据应用的轻量级多尺度分层异常检测与定位
authors: Thomas Benton Townsend, Joshua Bean, Benjamin K Tkach, Narcisa Gabriela Pricope, Dimitrios Michael Manias
abstract: As an increasing number of critical applications, including environmental, emergency, meteorological, and agricultural, rely on real-time anomaly detection in geospatial data streams, challenges related to the storage, processing, and communication of this data arise. Traditionally, large volumes of data have been sent to centralized processing locations for insight extraction. Given the big data context of these applications, this approach becomes increasingly infeasible as data volume and velocity continue to increase. This paper proposes a lightweight edge-oriented approach for anomaly detection and localization for geospatial data streams. By leveraging the H3 discrete global grid system and a multi-scale drill-down logic, the proposed approach significantly reduces computational overhead, achieving a 99.7\% reduction in evaluations compared to traditional flat-scan methods. Furthermore, by filtering out noise-induced flickering anomalies at lower resolutions, spatially-persistent anomalous signals can be efficiently identified. The results demonstrate that the proposed framework effectively distills massive geospatial data into actionable insights.
