summary_zh: 越来越多的关键应用（包括环境、应急、气象与农业领域）依赖地理空间数据流的实时异常检测，这给数据的存储、处理与通信带来了诸多挑战。传统方案会将海量数据传输至中心化处理节点提取信息，但在这类应用的大数据场景下，随着数据体量与生成速度持续增长，该方案的可行性越来越低。本文提出一种面向边缘端的轻量级地理空间数据流异常检测与定位方法，通过利用H3离散全球网格系统与多尺度下钻逻辑，大幅降低计算开销，与传统全量扫描方法相比，评估量减少99.7%。此外，该方法通过在低分辨率下过滤噪声引发的闪烁异常，可高效识别空间上持续存在的异常信号。实验结果表明，该框架可将海量地理空间数据有效提炼为可落地的决策信息。

title: Advanced LLM-Enhanced Intent-Based 5G Network Management using Dynamic Semantic Routes
title_zh: 基于动态语义路由的大语言模型增强型高级意图驱动5G网络管理
authors: Thomas Benton Townsend, Dimitrios Michael Manias
abstract: As the use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Large Language Models (LLMs) is becoming common in everyday applications, their ability to interpret natural language has increased significantly. An emerging application of AI is integration with network management and orchestration practices. An instance of this integration is LLM-enhanced intent-based networking, where network operators will control a network using natural language. This work presents the use of dynamic routes with a semantic router to identify an intent from a network operator's prompt and extract necessary details for intent fulfillment in intent-based 5G+ core networks. Furthermore, the performance of static route selection is assessed by evaluating multiple encoders and dynamic route detail extraction accuracy against a series of realistic operator prompts. The presented results show that static and dynamic routes are successful in detail extraction and schema formatting.
summary_zh: 随着人工智能（AI）与大语言模型（LLM）在日常应用中普及，其自然语言理解能力得到了显著提升。AI的新兴应用方向之一是与网络管理和编排流程深度融合，LLM增强型意图驱动网络就是这类融合的典型场景：网络运营商可使用自然语言直接控制网络。本文提出将动态路由与语义路由器结合，从网络运营商的提示词中识别意图，提取意图执行所需的全部必要信息，支撑意图驱动的5G+核心网络运行。此外，本文通过评估多个编码器的性能，以及动态路由的细节提取准确率在一系列真实运营商提示词上的表现，对静态路由选择的性能进行了全面评估。实验结果表明，静态与动态路由均可高效完成细节提取与模式格式化任务。

title: NeuroPrefetcher: Storage-Aware Sparse LLM Inference via Delta Prefetching
title_zh: NeuroPrefetcher：基于增量预取的存储感知稀疏大语言模型推理
authors: Nobel Dhar, Md Romyull Islam, Xuechen Zhang, Gongjin Sun, Sahidul Islam, Bobin Deng, Kun Suo
abstract: Deploying large language models on edge devices is increasingly limited by a widening gap between model size and available memory. Existing approaches such as quantization, smaller models, and offloading can raise the effective memory limit, but they still assume that the model can be compressed or partitioned to fit within some budget. We target the harder model-exceeds-memory setting, in which the model remains larger than resident memory throughout execution and storage becomes an active source of weights on the critical path. We observe that MLP activity during autoregressive decoding has strong temporal locality: approximately 82-85% of active neurons persist from one token to the next. This means that most sparse weights needed for the current token are already resident, and only the newly needed rows must be fetched from storage. We present NeuroPrefetcher, a storage-backed LLM inference system that exploits this property through predictive delta prefetching. After layer 0, a single GPU-resident predictor, occupying 2.86% of base model parameters, predicts sparse activity for all downstream MLP layers in one forward pass. The runtime compares these predictions against resident GPU buffers and issues application-scheduled NVMe reads only for incoming delta rows, replacing reactive operating-system demand paging with explicit, model-aware weight movement. On real unified-memory edge hardware, NeuroPrefetcher achieves 7.9-12.0x speedup over llama.cpp across constrained memory budgets.
summary_zh: 边缘设备上部署大语言模型正受到模型体量与可用内存之间持续扩大的鸿沟的严重限制。现有方案（如量化、更小模型、内存卸载）可提升有效内存上限，但这类方案均假设模型可被压缩或分区以适配某一内存预算。本文针对更具挑战性的模型超内存场景开展研究：该场景下模型在整个执行过程中始终大于常驻内存，存储成为关键路径上权重的核心来源。本文观察到自回归解码过程中MLP层的激活具备极强的时间局部性：约82-85%的激活神经元会从当前token保留至下一个token。这意味着当前token所需的大部分稀疏权重已经常驻内存，仅需要从存储中拉取新出现的权重行。本文提出NeuroPrefetcher，一种基于存储的大语言模型推理系统，利用上述特性实现预测式增量预取。在第0层之后，仅占基础模型参数2.86%的单GPU常驻预测器可通过一次前向传播预测所有下游MLP层的稀疏激活状态。运行时将这些预测结果与GPU常驻缓冲区对比，仅针对新增的增量行发起应用层调度的NVMe读取，用显式的模型感知权重移动替换操作系统的被动请求分页机制。在真实的统一内存边缘硬件上，在各类受限内存预算下，NeuroPrefetcher相比llama.cpp可实现7.9-12.0倍的加速比。

title: Q-Learning with Stable Infinite-Dimensional Linear Function Approximation
title_zh: 采用稳定无限维线性函数近似的Q学习
authors: Shengbo Wang
abstract: Q-learning with linear function approximation can be unstable because an arbitrary approximation architecture need not preserve the Bellman contraction. We develop a stable infinite-dimensional linear function approximation framework for Q-learning from a single Markovian behavior-policy trajectory. The learning variable is a coefficient field $\theta\in C(\mathbb L)$ on a compact latent metric space $(\mathbb L,\rho)$. The framework uses a reconstruction operator that maps $\theta$ to a continuous Q-function and a compression operator that maps Bellman updates back to latent coordinates. Nonexpansiveness of both operators induces a contractive latent Bellman map on $C(\mathbb L)$, with a unique fixed point $\theta^*$ whose reconstruction approximates the optimal Q-function up to representation error. We propose two stochastic approximation (SA) algorithms and establish their sup-norm convergence bounds with a leading term of order $\widetilde O(n^{-1/2})$. The infinite-dimensional formulation provides a powerful abstraction for identifying the structures that govern statistical difficulty. Smoothness of the compression map in $\rho$ is inherited by $\theta^*$ and the SA iterates, allowing uniform estimation errors to be controlled through covering numbers of $(\mathbb L,\rho)$ rather than the dimension of $C(\mathbb L)$. Remarkably, the SA algorithms we propose are agnostic to the choice of $\rho$, and thus can automatically adapt to both the smoothness and the geometry. We further illustrate the framework through Q-measure-learning with linear density approximation and output-layer neural weight training under a frozen pretrained network.
summary_zh: 采用线性函数近似的Q学习可能出现不稳定问题，原因是任意近似架构不一定能保留贝尔曼收缩特性。本文针对单马尔可夫行为策略轨迹下的Q学习，开发了一套稳定的无限维线性函数近似框架。学习变量为定义在紧致隐度量空间(ℒ,ρ)上的系数场θ∈C(ℒ)。该框架使用可将θ映射为连续Q函数的重构算子，以及可将贝尔曼更新映射回隐坐标的压缩算子。两类算子的非扩张特性可在C(ℒ)上诱导出收缩型隐贝尔曼映射，其存在唯一不动点θ*，对最优Q函数的重构近似误差不超过表示误差。本文提出两类随机近似（SA）算法，推导得到其上确界范数收敛边界，主导项阶为Õ(n^(-1/2))。该无限维形式提供了强大的抽象能力，可识别决定统计难度的核心结构。压缩映射在ρ上的平滑性可被θ*与SA迭代继承，使得统一估计误差可通过(ℒ,ρ)的覆盖数控制，而非依赖C(ℒ)的维度。值得注意的是，本文提出的SA算法无需感知ρ的选择，因此可自动适配平滑性与几何结构。本文进一步通过线性密度近似下的Q测度学习、冻结预训练网络下的输出层神经权重训练两个场景，验证了该框架的有效性。

title: Learning Generalizable Behaviors for Terminal Agents
title_zh: 面向终端智能体的可泛化行为学习
authors: Yihang Yao, Bo Pang, Xuan Phi Nguyen, Ding Zhao, Shafiq Joty, Semih Yavuz
abstract: Terminal agents are a compelling application of large language models (LLMs), with the potential to integrate deeply into users' daily workflows. Reinforcement learning (RL) is a key technique for improving their capabilities, making scalable training environments a central challenge. Since public real-user interaction data are scarce, synthetic environments provide a practical alternative, but often suffer from domain gaps and limited fidelity, leading to poor generalization. Existing work mainly scales the quantity and diversity of synthetic environments, while reward-signal quality and the mechanisms governing generalization remain under-explored. We study how RL improves terminal agents and propose the Agentic Compositional Generalization hypothesis: rather than teaching new domain-specific skills from scratch, RL primarily shapes high-level decision-making behaviors that compose and route low-level skills acquired during pre-training and supervised fine-tuning (SFT). This account is consistent with our empirical results and suggests that verifier quality, which determines which behaviors are reinforced, is more important than simply increasing environment quantity or diversity. Motivated by this insight, we propose River, a simple training recipe that improves reward quality by filtering low-quality environments and augmenting outcome rewards with process-level behavior regularization. Using this recipe, our RL-trained agent achieves the best performance among evaluated open-source RL-trained 8B models across four terminal-agent benchmarks. River also generalizes across model families, scales, agent harnesses, and RL objectives. Using fewer than 30% of the TMax training environments, River improves RL gains by 106% and 30% on average for models ranging from 2B to 27B on Terminal-Bench-Lite and Terminal-Bench-v2.1, respectively.
summary_zh: 终端智能体是大语言模型（LLM）极具前景的落地应用方向，可深度融入用户日常工作流。强化学习（RL）是提升终端智能体能力的核心技术，因此可扩展训练环境成为核心挑战。由于公开的真实用户交互数据十分稀缺，合成环境成为实用替代方案，但这类方案普遍存在领域 gap 与保真度不足的问题，最终导致泛化性能差。现有工作主要聚焦于扩大合成环境的数量与多样性，而奖励信号质量与泛化背后的作用机制仍缺乏深入探索。本文研究强化学习如何提升终端智能体性能，提出智能体组合泛化假设：强化学习并非从零开始教授全新的领域专属技能，而是主要塑造高层决策行为，对预训练与监督微调（SFT）阶段习得的底层技能进行组合与路由。该假设与本文的实验结果一致，同时表明决定强化学习行为导向的验证器质量，比单纯提升环境数量或多样性更为重要。受该结论启发，本文提出River，一种简单的训练策略，通过过滤低质量环境、用过程级行为正则化增强结果奖励，提升奖励质量。采用该策略后，经强化学习训练的智能体在4个终端智能体基准上的性能在所有参评开源8B强化学习模型中排名第一。River同时具备跨模型系列、跨模型规模、跨智能体框架、跨强化学习目标的泛化能力。仅使用不到30%的TMax训练环境，在2B至27B的模型规模范围内，River在Terminal-Bench-Lite与Terminal-Bench-v2.1上分别将强化学习收益平均提升106%与30%。

title: KMGen: A Skill-based Approach for Synthetic Individual Patient Data Generation
title_zh: KMGen：基于技能的合成化个体患者数据生成方法
authors: Jalen Jiang, Chufan Gao, Ethan Rasmussen, Stephen Z. Xie, Jimeng Sun
abstract: Individual patient data (IPD) from clinical trials is the substrate for survival modeling, meta-analysis, and safety research, yet IPD is rarely released. Prior work has addressed only half of this gap: reconstructing Kaplan-Meier (KM) curves from published plots -- typically requiring manual digitization or human-in-the-loop correction -- while offering no mechanism for generating the adverse-event (AE) streams that constitute the other half of a patient record. We introduce KMGen, the first end-to-end framework that (i) fully automates KM curve extraction at accuracy competitive with human-guided tools, and (ii) generates synthetic per-patient AE trajectories from public trial registry records. The extraction stage is a fully automated agentic pipeline -- an agent generates code to extract each step in the KM curve -- achieving a mean Integrated Absolute Error (IAE) of 0.0151 on a 32-plot benchmark spanning clean, edge-case, and adversarial conditions. The IPD generation stage decouples patient archetype extraction from statistical sampling: an LLM distills the trial record into arm-specific statistics, adverse events, patient demographics, and risk multipliers. A mechanistic sampler generates patient events via clinical archetypes, bootstrap rank-correlation coupling to the empirical KM curve (preserving the marginal survival distribution exactly), and cycle-based AE scheduling with an induction/maintenance split. Across three held-out oncology trials spanning an order of magnitude in cohort size and 30 independent regenerations per trial, KMGen achieves mean integrated KM absolute difference $\Delta_{\text{KM}}\,{\leq}\,0.051$, sex/ECOG JSD ${\leq}\,0.013$ on 5 of 6 demographic slots, and recovers ${\geq}\,71\%$ of the top-15 AEs by exact MedDRA term under a single fixed parameter set. The pipeline is released as open source at https://github.com/chufangao/kmgen.
summary_zh: 临床试验的个体患者数据（IPD）是生存建模、元分析与安全性研究的基础，但这类数据极少公开。现有工作仅解决了该问题的一半：从已发表的图中重建Kaplan-Meier（KM，卡普兰-迈耶）曲线，这类方案通常需要手动数字化或人工介入校正，无法生成构成患者记录另一半内容的不良事件（AE）序列。本文提出KMGen，首个端到端框架，可实现两大核心功能：（1）全自动提取KM曲线，精度可与人工引导工具相媲美；（2）从公开的临床试验注册记录生成合成的逐患者不良事件轨迹。其提取阶段是完全自动化的智能体流水线：智能体生成代码提取KM曲线的每一个步骤，在覆盖干净场景、边界场景与对抗场景的32张图基准上，平均积分绝对误差（IAE）仅为0.0151。其IPD生成阶段将患者原型提取与统计采样解耦：大语言模型将临床试验记录提炼为分组专属统计信息、不良事件、患者人口统计学特征与风险乘数。机制采样器通过临床原型生成患者事件，通过与经验KM曲线的bootstrap秩相关耦合，完全保留边际生存分布，同时采用基于周期的诱导/维持拆分机制调度不良事件。在3个独立的 held-out 肿瘤临床试验（队列规模相差一个数量级，每个试验独立生成30次）上，KMGen的平均KM积分绝对差Δ_KM≤0.051，6个人口统计学特征中有5个的性别/ECOG分布JSD≤0.013，在单组固定参数下可还原至少71%的按精确MedDRA术语排序的前15个不良事件。该流水线已开源，项目地址为https://github.com/chufangao/kmgen。

title: What AstroPT knows about galaxies, and what that can teach us about LLMs
title_zh: AstroPT（天文预训练Transformer）对星系的认知及其对大语言模型研究的启示
authors: UniverseTBD,  :, Kshitij Duraphe, Aman Kumar, Michael J. Smith, Shashwat Sourav
abstract: Interpretability research increasingly asks when concepts emerge during training and whether linear probes recover real structure, but in language models these claims are hard to validate because language offers little ground-truth ordering of concepts or relationships among them. We propose the use of astronomical ground truth through AstroPT, a transformer trained on millions of galaxy images, as a calibration testbed. AstroPT is an LLM-like model trained within a domain where the difficulty ordering of concepts and the relations among them are known in advance. Probing frozen representations across checkpoints, layers, model sizes, and objective choices, we find that galaxy properties emerge in a fixed order that tracks their known difficulty---quantities written almost directly into the pixels (band magnitude) become decodable early in training and shallow in the network, while multiband/spectra based and inferred quantities (such as redshift and specific star formation rate) emerge later and deeper. This order is invariant to our tested training objectives, and scales in magnitude but not in sequence with capacity. Our linear probe directions further recover the known physical structure among galaxy properties. Our findings suggest that astronomy offers a controlled sandbox for calibrating mechanistic interpretability methods we otherwise apply to LLMs blind.
summary_zh: 可解释性研究越来越关注训练过程中概念何时涌现、以及线性探针能否还原真实结构，但在语言模型领域这类结论很难得到验证，因为语言几乎不存在概念或概念间关系的真实排序。本文提出使用天文领域真实数据作为校准测试平台，核心是AstroPT——一种在数百万张星系图像上训练的Transformer类模型，其所属领域的概念难度排序与概念间关系均为预先已知。该类大语言模型相似模型可作为校准测试基准。通过在不同检查点、网络层、模型规模和训练目标选择下探测冻结表征，研究发现星系属性按照其已知的难度以固定顺序涌现：几乎直接编码在像素中的物理量（如波段星等）在训练早期、网络浅层即可被解码，而基于多波段/光谱推导得到的物理量（如红移、比恒星形成率）则在训练后期、网络更深层才会涌现。该涌现顺序不受测试的训练目标影响，且仅在量级上随模型容量缩放，序列顺序保持不变。研究中的线性探针方向还可还原星系属性之间已知的物理结构。上述结果表明，天文学领域可作为受控沙盒环境，用于校准原本在大语言模型上盲用的机制可解释性方法。

title: Mitigating Explanation Leakage in Financial Fraud Detection Systems
title_zh: 金融欺诈检测系统中的解释泄露缓解方法
authors: Muhammad Waleed Gul, Elaheh Homayounvala
abstract: Financial fraud detection relies heavily on centralized machine learning models. This creates serious data privacy risks. Federated Learning (FL) decentralizes data processing, but financial regulations still require models to be transparent. This means using Explainable AI (XAI) tools such as TreeSHAP. Recent cybersecurity research shows a problem with this approach. Sharing high-fidelity SHAP explanations exposes the federated network to Membership Inference Attacks (MIAs). This dissertation proposes and evaluates DP-FedSHAP. It is a new architecture that applies client-level differential privacy only to post-hoc TreeSHAP vectors. It is compared against a Weight-Level DP baseline, which perturbs the trained model directly instead. Using the highly imbalanced IEEE-CIS Fraud Detection dataset, this study measures the trade-off between explanation fidelity, privacy preservation, and the model's Area Under the Precision-Recall Curve (AUPRC).
summary_zh: 金融欺诈检测高度依赖集中式机器学习模型，这会带来严重的数据隐私风险。联邦学习（Federated Learning, FL）可实现数据去中心化处理，但金融监管要求模型具备可解释性，因此通常需要使用TreeSHAP（树型沙普可解释方法）等可解释人工智能（Explainable AI, XAI）工具。近期网络安全研究表明，该方案存在缺陷：共享高保真度的SHAP解释会使联邦网络面临成员推理攻击（Membership Inference Attacks, MIAs）的威胁。本文提出并评估了DP-FedSHAP这一新型架构，该架构仅对事后生成的TreeSHAP向量施加客户端级差分隐私，与直接扰动训练模型的权重级差分隐私基线方法形成对比。研究使用高度不平衡的IEEE-CIS欺诈检测数据集，测量了解释保真度、隐私保护水平与模型精确率-召回率曲线下面积（Area Under the Precision-Recall Curve, AUPRC）三者之间的权衡关系。

title: Adversarial Agents on Topology Optimization: Understanding the Fragility and Robustness of Deep Learning-based and Physics-Based Design Models under Adversarial Perturbation
title_zh: 拓扑优化领域的对抗智能体：理解基于深度学习与物理的设计模型在对抗扰动下的脆弱性与鲁棒性
authors: Hoang Anh Nguyen, Yuan Hong, Hongyi Xu
abstract: Topology optimization, using both physic-based approaches and deep learning surrogates, serves as a cornerstone for generative design agents in cyber-manufacturing systems. While deep learning surrogates have gained widespread adoption due to their speed in online design generation, this work demonstrates their vulnerability under input perturbations. In this work, we present a mechanics-grounded reliability evaluation framework that formulates an adversarial agent targeting the generative design models. We investigate a strictly non-intrusive threat model where bounded perturbations are introduced exclusively to the initial-density channel, while physical boundary conditions, compliance-gradient channels, network architectures, and solver routines remain intact. Evaluating surrogate models across U-Net, convolutional, and generative architectures with varying physics-gradient conditioning depths demonstrates that bounded initialization noise can cause catastrophic mechanical failure, increasing compliance by multiple orders of magnitude through severed load paths and disconnected supports. Furthermore, we discover that incorporating richer physics-gradient conditioning in the deep learning surrogates does not guarantee monotonic robustness across surrogate families. Finally, physics-in-the-loop recovery demonstrates that initializing the classical SIMP optimizer with perturbed topologies mitigates design performance degradation, having a high probability of restoring compliance to near-baseline levels across tested instances. These findings demonstrate that learned surrogates should serve as physics-verified initializers instead of replacing physics-based solvers entirely in a resilient cyber-manufacturing system. Moreover, the proposed adversarial agent provides a foundation for future training generative design agents robust against noise and targeted perturbations.
summary_zh: 结合物理驱动方法与深度学习代理模型的拓扑优化是网络制造系统中生成式设计智能体的核心基础。尽管深度学习代理模型因在线设计生成速度快而得到广泛应用，本研究证明其在输入扰动下存在脆弱性。本文提出了一种基于力学的可靠性评估框架，构建了针对生成式设计模型的对抗智能体。研究采用完全非侵入式威胁模型：仅对初始密度通道施加有界扰动，物理边界条件、柔度梯度通道、网络架构与求解器流程均保持不变。通过对不同物理梯度条件深度的U-Net、卷积、生成架构类代理模型进行评估，结果表明有界的初始化噪声可通过切断载荷路径、断开支撑结构引发灾难性力学失效，使柔度提升数个数量级。此外研究发现，在深度学习代理模型中引入更丰富的物理梯度条件并不能保证整个代理模型族的鲁棒性单调提升。最后，物理在环恢复实验表明，使用扰动后的拓扑初始化经典SIMP（固体各向同性材料惩罚法）优化器可缓解设计性能下降，在绝大多数测试案例中可将柔度恢复至接近基线的水平。上述结果表明，在弹性网络制造系统中，学习得到的代理模型应作为经过物理验证的初始化工具，而非完全替代物理驱动求解器。此外，本文提出的对抗智能体为后续训练可抵御噪声与定向扰动的鲁棒生成式设计智能体提供了基础。

title: Scale-invariant Optimal Sampling for Rare-events Data with Sparse Models
title_zh: 面向稀疏模型的稀有事件数据尺度不变最优采样方法
authors: Jing Wang, HaiYing Wang, Qiang Zhang, Hao Helen Zhang
abstract: Subsampling is effective in tackling computational challenges for massive data with rare events. Overly aggressive subsampling may adversely affect estimation efficiency, and optimal subsampling is essential to mitigate the information loss. However, existing optimal subsampling probabilities depend on data scales, and some scaling transformations may result in inefficient subsamples. This problem is more significant when there are inactive features, because their influence on the subsampling probabilities can be arbitrarily magnified by inappropriate scaling transformations. We tackle this challenge and introduce a scale-invariant optimal subsampling function in the context of sparse models, where inactive features are commonly assumed. Instead of focusing on estimating model parameters, we define an optimal subsampling function to minimize the prediction error, using adaptive lasso to outline the estimation procedure and study its theoretical guarantee. We first introduce the adaptive lasso estimator for rare-events data and establish its oracle properties, thereby validating the use of subsampling. Then we derive a scale-invariant optimal subsampling function that minimizes the prediction error of the inverse probability weighted (IPW) adaptive lasso. Finally, we present an estimator based on the maximum sampled conditional likelihood (MSCL) to further improve the estimation efficiency. We conduct numerical experiments using both simulated and real-world data sets to demonstrate the performance of the proposed methods.
summary_zh: 子采样可有效解决含稀有事件的海量数据带来的计算挑战，但过度激进的子采样会损害估计效率，最优子采样是降低信息损失的核心手段。然而现有最优子采样概率依赖于数据尺度，部分尺度变换可能导致子采样结果效率低下。当存在无效特征时该问题会更加突出，因为不合适的尺度变换可将无效特征对子采样概率的影响任意放大。本文针对该挑战，在通常假设存在无效特征的稀疏模型场景下提出了尺度不变的最优子采样函数。研究不聚焦于模型参数估计，而是定义了可最小化预测误差的最优子采样函数，采用自适应套索（adaptive lasso）设计估计流程并证明了其理论保证：首先针对稀有事件数据引入自适应套索估计器，证明其满足 oracle 性质，验证了子采样方法的合理性；随后推导得到可最小化逆概率加权（Inverse Probability Weighted, IPW）自适应套索预测误差的尺度不变最优子采样函数；最后提出基于最大采样条件似然（Maximum Sampled Conditional Likelihood, MSCL）的估计器，进一步提升估计效率。研究通过模拟数据与真实数据集开展数值实验，验证了所提方法的性能优势。

title: Sparse Additive Off-Policy Evaluation for Reinforcement Learning with Potentially Limited Number of Trajectories
title_zh: 面向非表格任务的表格基础模型
authors: Tuoyi Zhao, Chengchun Shi, Zhengling Qi, Lan Wang
abstract: We develop a new framework for flexible, nonlinear, and interpretable off-policy evaluation for infinite-horizon reinforcement learning. To handle large state spaces and support transparent decision-making, we model the Q-function using a nonlinear function class with a sparse additive structure. We derive high-probability finite-sample error bounds for estimating the value function of a target policy and show that the bounds depend only logarithmically on the ambient dimension $d$, thereby alleviating the curse of dimensionality. In contrast to most existing theory for off-policy evaluation, which typically assumes access to many trajectories, our analysis guarantees accurate value estimation when either the number of trajectories or the time horizon is sufficiently large. In addition, we propose a group-sparsity-based feature screening procedure that identifies, with high probability, a reduced feature set containing all relevant covariates. Numerical experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach.
summary_zh: 表格基础模型（Tabular foundation models, TFMs）是近期面向表格数据机器学习领域涌现的极具前景的范式，具备无需针对特定任务训练即可跨数据集泛化的能力。由于大量机器学习数据集都可表示为表格形式，由此引出一个问题：表格基础模型的能力是否可延伸至传统意义上的非表格任务？本文使用TabPFN v3针对三类非表格分类任务开展验证：MNIST手写数字识别、法德语文本语言识别、Tiny ImageNet图像分类。所有任务中原始数据均被表示为表格的行，分类任务被转化为缺失标签预测问题。研究在不进行额外训练或微调的前提下，评估了性能随提供给预训练模型的上下文样本数量的变化规律。尽管模型无法显式获取数据自带的空间或序列结构，TabPFN v3在部分场景下的分类精度可与专门针对对应任务设计的模型或方法相媲美。

title: Tabular foundation models for non-tabular tasks
authors: Goran Nakerst, John Brennan, Wouter Beugeling, Masudul Haque
abstract: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) have recently emerged as a promising paradigm for machine learning on tabular data, offering the ability to generalize across datasets without task-specific training. Since many machine learning datasets can be represented as tables, this raises the question: does TFM capability extend beyond tasks traditionally regarded as tabular? We address this question by using TabPFN v3 on three non-tabular classification problems: handwritten digit recognition on MNIST, language identification of French and German words, and image classification on Tiny ImageNet. In each case, the original data are represented as rows of a table and classification is formulated as prediction of a missing label. We evaluate performance as a function of the number of context samples provided to the pretrained model, with no additional training or fine-tuning. Despite having no explicit access to the spatial or sequential structure characterizing the data, TabPFN v3 in some cases achieves accuracies comparable with that of models or methods geared specifically toward the corresponding tasks.

title: GCA: Global Centroid Alignment in Federated Learning
title_zh: GCA：联邦学习中的全局质心对齐方法
authors: Jong-Ik Park, Harry Jiang, Logan Blakely, Georgios Fragkos, Shamina Hossain-McKenzie, Carlee Joe-Wong
abstract: Autoencoder (AE)-based federated learning (FL) is attractive for anomaly detection when clients have limited local data. However, conventional FL exchanges AE parameters or gradients, incurring substantial communication overhead and potentially exposing input training data information, since AEs are explicitly optimized to reconstruct their inputs. We introduce \emph{Global Centroid Alignment (GCA)}, a latent-code-mediated FL protocol that coordinates clients without transmitting AE parameters or gradients. In each round, (1) clients first train their local AEs using a \emph{reconstruction} update and upload a small subset of encoder latent codes to the FL server. (2) The server pools these codes, fits a clustering model, and broadcasts only \emph{global latent centroids and their support counts}. (3) Each client then updates its encoder by aligning its local latent codes with the \emph{nearest} centroid using \emph{inverse-count} weighting to emphasize globally underrepresented patterns. Steps (1)--(3) repeat over communication rounds. Because GCA exchanges only sampled latent codes and centroid statistics, its communication cost depends on latent dimensionality and the numbers of uploaded codes and returned centroids rather than on AE model size. Across five tabular and two vision benchmarks, GCA yields higher reconstruction error under a server-side client data extraction attack in all 21 comparisons and clearly lower cosine similarity in 20 of 21 comparisons with FedAvg, FedProx, and FedNova, showing its ability to protect training data. It even improves test accuracy over FedAvg by up to $5.76\%$. GCA achieves extraction defense comparable to DP-FedAvg, remains effective when DP-FedAvg does not reduce target resemblance, and lowers per-round communication by up to $99.15\%$.
summary_zh: 基于自编码器（Autoencoder, AE）的联邦学习（Federated Learning, FL）在客户端本地数据有限的场景下非常适用于异常检测任务。但传统联邦学习方案交换自编码器的参数或梯度，会产生极高的通信开销，且由于自编码器的优化目标是重构输入，该过程可能泄露输入训练数据的信息。本文提出全局质心对齐（Global Centroid Alignment, GCA）——一种以隐编码为中介的联邦学习协议，无需传输自编码器参数或梯度即可完成客户端协同。每一轮流程如下：1）客户端首先通过重构更新训练本地自编码器，向联邦学习服务器上传一小部分编码器隐编码；2）服务器汇总所有隐编码，拟合聚类模型，仅向客户端广播全局隐质心及其支持计数；3）每个客户端使用逆计数加权策略，将本地隐编码与最近的全局质心对齐，重点突出全局代表性不足的模式。上述三步在通信轮次中循环执行。由于GCA仅交换采样隐编码与质心统计量，其通信开销取决于隐空间维度、上传编码数量与返回质心数量，与自编码器模型规模无关。在5个表格数据集与2个视觉数据集基准测试中，与FedAvg、FedProx、FedNova等基线方法相比，GCA在全部21组对比中面对服务器端客户端数据提取攻击时的重构误差更高，其中20组对比的余弦相似度显著更低，证明其具备优秀的训练数据保护能力；同时GCA的测试精度相比FedAvg最高可提升5.76%，其提取防御能力与DP-FedAvg相当，在DP-FedAvg无法降低目标相似度的场景下仍可正常工作，单轮通信量最高可降低99.15%。

title: Two-level domain-decomposition AdaGrad method for scalable training of graph neural networks
title_zh: 面向图神经网络可扩展训练的双层区域分解AdaGrad方法
authors: Laurynas Varnas, Julien Herrmann, Alexander Heinlein, Serge Gratton, Alena Kopani\v{c}\'akov\'a
abstract: Graph neural networks (GNNs) have emerged as a powerful framework for learning from graph-structured data. However, their efficient training remains challenging, particularly in distributed computing environments. This challenge arises from the use of message passing, which couples all graph nodes, leading to expensive optimization steps, high memory requirements, and substantial communication overhead. To alleviate these limitations, we propose a novel domain-decomposition (DD) variant of AG2m, an AdaGrad method enhanced with second-order curvature information and momentum, denoted by DD-AG2m. The proposed DD-AG2m alternates between AG2m optimization on the original (global) graph and AG2m optimization on the partitioned graphs. To incorporate global information at reduced cost, we further introduce a two-level variant (2DD-AG2m) that performs global optimization steps on a coarse graph obtained by randomly subsampling nodes within each subdomain. Numerical experiments spanning graph classification, node-level regression, and spatiotemporal forecasting tasks demonstrate that the proposed DD methods reduce the computational cost required to achieve the same predictive performance by a factor of 4-8. Moreover, for the fixed computational cost, they improve the predictive performance of GNNs by up to 22% compared with the baseline AG2m.
summary_zh: 图神经网络（Graph Neural Networks, GNNs）是面向图结构数据学习的强大框架，但其高效训练在分布式计算环境下仍面临诸多挑战：图神经网络采用的消息传递机制将所有图节点耦合在一起，导致优化步成本高、内存需求大、通信开销高。为缓解上述局限，本文提出了AG2m（融合二阶曲率信息与动量的增强型AdaGrad自适应梯度算法）的新型区域分解（Domain-Decomposition, DD）变体，命名为DD-AG2m。该方法交替在原始全局图与划分得到的子图上执行AG2m优化。为以更低成本引入全局信息，本文进一步提出双层变体2DD-AG2m：在每个子域内随机采样节点得到粗粒度图，在粗粒度图上执行全局优化步。覆盖图分类、节点级回归、时空预测任务的数值实验表明，所提区域分解方法达到相同预测性能所需的计算成本可降低4~8倍；在固定计算成本下，其图神经网络预测性能相比基线AG2m方法最高可提升22%。

title: Neighbor-embedded Graph Neural Network-based Crowd Delivery Traffic Management in Smart City
title_zh: 基于邻域嵌入图神经网络的智慧城市众包配送交通管理方法
authors: Kishu Gupta, Deepika Saxena, Ashutosh Kumar Singh, Chung-Nan Lee
abstract: The significant upsurge in vehicle traffic presents a considerable challenge in the pursuit of smart mobilization and transportation (SMT) worldwide. Current approaches primarily focus on vehicular traffic management through congestion prediction but fall short in addressing essential objectives such as traffic reduction and appropriate vehicle selection to alleviate congestion in smart cities ($SmCt$). To address these concerns, this work introduces a novel \textit{Neighbor-Embedded Graph Neural Network-based Crowd Delivery Traffic Management} (NeCDM) Model, comprising two key components: the Traffic Congestion Prediction Unit (TCPu) and the Traffic Observation and Management Unit (TOMu). The TCPu utilizes Graph Neural Network (GNN) optimization to accurately predict traffic flow levels at various delivery stations within $SmCt$ ecosystems. Additionally, the TOMu facilitates the intelligent selection of the most suitable delivery vehicles for fulfilling crowd delivery requests ($CDR$). This work emphasizes the potential of crowd delivery as a feasible solution for achieving SMT goals while adhering to smart city parameters ($\mathcal{SCP}$s), such as reduced carbon emissions, shorter travel times, and minimized travel distances. The proposed model achieves notable improvements in computational efficiency, including reductions of up to 4.03\% in L1 loss ($\pounds$), 16.66\% in L2 loss ($\pounds_{rmse}$), and 7.64\% in computation time.
summary_zh: 全球机动车交通量的大幅增长给智慧城市的智能移动与交通（Smart Mobilization and Transportation, SMT）目标带来了巨大挑战。现有方法主要通过拥堵预测实现机动车交通管理，未能充分实现交通流量削减、合理选择配送车辆以缓解智慧城市拥堵等核心目标。针对上述问题，本文提出新型邻域嵌入图神经网络众包配送交通管理（NeCDM）模型，该模型包含两个核心组件：交通拥堵预测单元（Traffic Congestion Prediction Unit, TCPu）与交通观测管理单元（Traffic Observation and Management Unit, TOMu）。TCPu通过优化图神经网络（GNN），可精准预测智慧城市生态系统中各配送站点的交通流量水平；TOMu可智能选择最适配的配送车辆完成众包配送请求。本研究验证了众包配送作为可行方案的潜力，可在满足智慧城市参数（如降低碳排放、缩短出行时长、压缩出行距离）的前提下实现智能移动与交通目标。所提模型的计算效率得到显著提升：L1损失最高降低4.03%，L2均方根损失最高降低16.66%，计算耗时最高降低7.64%。

title: Model-Consistent Byzantine-Resilient Decentralized Federated Learning for Collaborative Missions
title_zh: 面向协同任务的模型一致拜占庭容错去中心化联邦学习
authors: Yue Li, Sudip Bhujel, Cameron Lira, Ning Wang, Yang Xiao
abstract: This paper introduces DFL-C, a novel Byzantine-resilient DFL architecture that enables decentralized nodes to perform collaborative training with global model consistency. At its core, DFL-C integrates an asynchronous common subset (ACS) consensus protocol into the DFL workflow to ensure all nodes aggregate a uniform set of model updates to establish global model consistency, despite individual Byzantine equivocation. DFL-C further implements a dual-domain trust scoring mechanism to provide resilience against data-domain Byzantine manipulations including model poisoning attacks. This mechanism complements the consensus protocol, significantly reducing the latter's runtime. Our experimental results demonstrate that DFL-C maintains model accuracy while achieving global model consistency under Byzantine behaviors with moderate consensus overhead. Notably, when compared with the state-of-the-art DFL solution BALANCE (Fang et al.) that does not provide model consistency, DFL-C achieves better model accuracy against untargeted model poisoning attacks and comparable resilience against backdoor attacks, with the advantage widened under non-IID scenarios.
summary_zh: 本文提出DFL-C这一新型拜占庭容错去中心化联邦学习架构，可让去中心化节点在保证全局模型一致性的前提下完成协同训练。该架构的核心是将异步公共子集（Asynchronous Common Subset, ACS）共识协议集成到去中心化联邦学习工作流中，确保所有节点聚合统一的模型更新集合，即便存在单个拜占庭节点发送矛盾信息的情况也能维持全局模型一致性。DFL-C进一步实现了双域信任评分机制，可抵御包括模型投毒攻击在内的数据域拜占庭篡改行为。该机制是共识协议的补充，可大幅降低共识协议的运行耗时。实验结果表明，在存在拜占庭行为的场景下，DFL-C仅引入适中的共识开销，即可在维持模型精度的同时保证全局模型一致性。值得注意的是，与不具备模型一致性保证的当前最优去中心化联邦学习方案BALANCE相比，DFL-C在非目标模型投毒攻击下的模型精度更高，面对后门攻击的鲁棒性与之相当，且该优势在非独立同分布场景下会进一步扩大。

title: Stress Testing Unlearning Algorithms
title_zh: 机器遗忘算法的压力测试
authors: Noam Diamant, Ethan Fetaya, Neta Glazer
abstract: Recently, machine unlearning, the removal of specific training data influence from a model, has gained increasing attention. In large language models (LLMs), unlearning is particularly challenging due to the ambiguity of inputs and outputs. Con- sequently, rigorous evaluation is critical for assessing both safety and utility, and for driving progress in unlearning meth- ods. We identify two key shortcomings in existing unlearning benchmarks: (1) they do not actively test whether unlearned information can still be forcibly extracted, and (2) they fail to evaluate performance preservation on boundary questions, be- nign queries that are semantically close to the unlearned con- tent. Here we introduce WMDP++, an extension of WMDP that addresses these gaps by incorporating targeted extrac- tion of unlearned information and systematic evaluation on boundary questions. WMDP++ provides a more stringent and informative benchmark for evaluating unlearning in LLMs.
summary_zh: 近年来，机器遗忘（即从模型中移除特定训练数据的影响）受到越来越多的关注。在大语言模型（LLMs）场景下，由于输入输出的语义模糊性，遗忘任务的实现尤为困难。因此，严谨的评估工作对于同时保障模型安全性与可用性、推动遗忘方法的迭代进步至关重要。本研究发现现有遗忘基准存在两大核心缺陷：（1）未主动测试已被模型遗忘的信息是否仍可被强制提取；（2）未评估模型在边界问题上的性能保留能力，边界问题指与已遗忘内容语义高度接近的良性查询。本文提出WMDP++基准，即现有WMDP基准的扩展版本，通过新增对已遗忘信息的定向提取任务、以及针对边界问题的系统性评估模块，填补了上述空白。WMDP++为大语言模型的遗忘效果评估提供了更严格、信息维度更丰富的测试基准。

title: From Detrimental to Beneficial: Dynamic Influence-based Valuation and Editing
title_zh: 从有害到有益：基于动态影响的数据估值与编辑框架
authors: Adrian Nyakairu, Hongfu Liu
abstract: Data valuation is a cornerstone of data-centric learning, where prior efforts primarily focus on designing algorithms to classify training samples as either beneficial or detrimental for the learning task. However, leveraging these valuation estimates for subsequent data intervention remains underexplored; conventional approaches typically discard or downweight harmful samples, thereby underutilizing available data resources. In this paper, we present Dynamic Influence-based Valuation and Editing (DIVE), a novel and efficient framework that dynamically estimates sample values at the batch level and transforms detrimental data into beneficial contributions. Rather than altering the raw data, DIVE operates at the optimization level by strategically reversing the gradient directions of harmful samples during training, ensuring seamless integration with standard learning procedures with minimal overhead. Extensive empirical evaluations demonstrate that DIVE consistently improves classification performance, maximizes data efficiency, stabilizes optimization, and effectively generalizes to large language model fine-tuning.
summary_zh: 数据估值是数据驱动学习领域的核心基础，现有相关研究主要聚焦于设计算法将训练样本划分为对学习任务有益或有害的类别，但如何将这些估值结果用于后续的数据干预流程仍缺乏探索：传统方案通常直接丢弃有害样本或降低其权重，导致现有数据资源无法得到充分利用。本文提出动态影响估值与编辑框架（Dynamic Influence-based Valuation and Editing, DIVE），这一全新高效框架可在批次层级动态估计样本价值，将原本有害的数据转化为正向贡献。DIVE不修改原始数据，而是在优化层级对训练过程中有害样本的梯度方向进行策略性反转，可在几乎不增加额外开销的前提下无缝适配标准学习流程。大量实证评估结果表明，DIVE可稳定提升分类任务性能、最大化数据利用效率、优化过程稳定性，且可有效迁移至大语言模型微调场景。

title: Interpretable statistical feature engineering for early disruption prediction in the short pulse ADITYA tokamak
title_zh: 用于短脉冲ADITYA托卡马克早期破裂预测的可解释统计特征工程
authors: Jyoti Agarwal, Kavit Patel, Bhaskar Chaudhury, Abhishek Sharma, Shrichand Jakhar, Manika Sharma
abstract: Reliable early disruption prediction is critical for the safe operation and real-time control of tokamaks. However, machine learning based prediction frameworks have predominantly targeted medium and long pulse devices, with comparatively limited attention given to short pulse tokamaks where available warning time is inherently constrained. In this work, an interpretable machine learning framework is developed for feature engineering and early prediction of disruptions in the ADITYA using the initial plasma evolution information, prior to the activation of the negative converter of the ohmic transformer power supply. Statistical descriptors comprising the mean, variance, skewness, kurtosis and wavelet energy entropy are extracted from routinely available plasma diagnostics over different operation time windows. Decision tree based feature selection is employed to identify physically meaningful disruption precursors and to reduce feature dimensionality. These selected features are used to train a random forest classifier. The proposed framework achieves stable predictive performance across different analysis windows, with a maximum ROC-AUC of 0.87 for 0-35 ms and 0-40 ms windows. Comparable and in some cases improved, performance is obtained using the reduced feature set, demonstrating that the selected statistical descriptors retain the essential information required for disruption prediction. The proposed methodology provides an interpretable and computationally efficient framework for real time disruption prediction in short pulse tokamaks and establishes that carefully engineered statistical descriptors can effectively replace raw time series inputs for early disruption prediction, thereby offering a practical pathway toward real time plasma control in short pulse tokamaks similar to ADITYA and ADITYA-U.
summary_zh: 可靠的早期破裂预测是托卡马克装置安全运行与实时控制的核心支撑。但现有基于机器学习的预测框架大多面向中长脉冲托卡马克装置，针对短脉冲托卡马克的相关研究相对匮乏，而短脉冲装置的可用预警时间存在天然约束。本研究开发了一套可解释机器学习框架，利用欧姆变压器负变流器启动前的初始等离子体演化信息，实现ADITYA短脉冲托卡马克的特征工程与破裂早期预测。研究从不同运行时间窗口的常规等离子体诊断数据中提取均值、方差、偏度、峰度、小波能量熵等统计描述符，采用基于决策树的特征选择方法筛选具备物理意义的破裂前兆特征并降低特征维度，使用筛选后的特征训练随机森林分类器。所提出的框架在不同分析窗口下均能保持稳定预测性能，在0-35ms和0-40ms窗口下的最高ROC-AUC值可达0.87。使用降维后的特征集可获得相当甚至部分场景下更优的预测效果，证明筛选出的统计描述符保留了破裂预测所需的全部核心信息。该方法为短脉冲托卡马克的实时破裂预测提供了可解释、低计算开销的实现路径，验证了经过精心设计的统计描述符可有效替代原始时间序列输入实现早期破裂预测，为ADITYA及ADITYA-U等同类型短脉冲托卡马克的实时等离子体控制提供了可行方案。

title: From Symmetry to Invariance: Learning Galois Equivalent Representations in Finite Fields
title_zh: 从对称性到不变性：学习有限域上的伽罗瓦等价表示
authors: Zheng Zhang, Na Zhang
abstract: Neural networks can learn algebraic operations from finite examples, but it remains unclear whether this ability transfers across mathematically equivalent representations of the same operation. We study this question through multiplication in finite fields under changes of basis. The Galois action organizes basis representations into orbits, and bases in the same orbit induce the same coordinate multiplication map. This structure allows us to separate learning multiplication from transferring it to basis representations that are not used for training. We examine several ways of providing or recovering the relevant orbit structure, including invariant labels, basis matrices, orbit recognition, and algebraic decomposition. Our main approach trains a model to predict the Galois action between basis representations. Repeated applications of the learned transformation are then used to construct a canonical representative for each orbit, which supports multiplication on held-out bases through exact canonical matching. This provides a concrete mechanism for converting a learned algebraic symmetry into an invariant representation that can be used for transfer.
summary_zh: 神经网络可从有限样本中学习代数运算，但目前学界尚不清楚该能力是否可在同一运算的数学等价表示之间迁移。本研究以有限域上不同基下的乘法运算为研究对象探讨该问题：伽罗瓦作用可将不同基的表示组织为轨道，同一轨道内的基会诱导出相同的坐标乘法映射。该结构特性可将乘法运算的学习过程与向未训练基表示的迁移过程解耦。本研究探索了多种生成或还原轨道结构的方案，包括不变标签、基矩阵、轨道识别、代数分解等。核心方法是训练模型预测不同基表示之间的伽罗瓦作用，通过反复调用学习得到的变换为每个轨道生成一个标准代表元，通过精确的标准匹配实现未见过的基上的乘法运算，为将学习到的代数对称性转化为可迁移的不变表示提供了具体实现机制。

title: GTA-RAG: Graph-Trajectory-Augmented Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Turn Retrieval-Augmented Reasoning
title_zh: GTA-RAG：面向多轮检索增强推理的图轨迹增强强化学习框架
authors: Jun Chen, Yongchao Liu, Pengyu Qiu, Jiajun Zheng, Juelu Zhang, Yujie Zeng, Qin Zhang, Ziyue Qiao, Xiao Luo
abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) enables LLMs to access external knowledge for answering knowledge-intensive questions. For complex multi-hop questions, multi-turn retrieval-augmented reasoning extends RAG into an iterative process that repeatedly searches for and integrates evidence across documents. However, existing reinforcement-learning (RL) approaches for agentic RAG are typically optimized with final-answer rewards, which provide sparse supervision and overlook whether the model actually retrieves the required evidence chain. We present \textsc{GTA-RAG}, a graph-trajectory-augmented RL framework for multi-turn retrieval-augmented reasoning. From an entity--document graph, we sample connected document paths, synthesize multi-hop QA trajectories, and validate them with the deployed retriever to obtain executable trajectory-level supervision. We then optimize the retrieval policy with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) and a trajectory-guided reward that encourages both accurate answers and acquisition of target evidence documents, followed by answer-reward training on natural QA instances. Experiments on three multi-hop and two simple QA benchmarks show that \method{} consistently outperforms RL-based RAG baselines with both Qwen2.5-3B and Qwen2.5-7B backbones, while substantially improving evidence-chain coverage. Our code is available at https://github.com/cjcj46262/GTA-RAG.
summary_zh: 检索增强生成（Retrieval-augmented generation, RAG）技术可让大语言模型访问外部知识以回答知识密集型问题。针对复杂多跳问题，多轮检索增强推理将RAG扩展为迭代流程，跨文档反复搜索并整合证据信息。但现有面向智能体RAG的强化学习方案通常仅使用最终答案奖励进行优化，监督信号稀疏，且无法判断模型是否实际检索到了所需的证据链。本文提出GTA-RAG（Graph-Trajectory-Augmented Reinforcement Learning，图轨迹增强强化学习框架）用于多轮检索增强推理任务：首先从实体-文档图中采样连通的文档路径，合成多跳问答轨迹，通过部署的检索器验证得到可执行的轨迹级监督信号；随后使用组相对策略优化（Group Relative Policy Optimization, GRPO）和轨迹引导奖励优化检索策略，该奖励同时鼓励输出准确答案和获取目标证据文档，最后在自然问答样本上使用答案奖励完成训练。在3个多跳问答基准和2个简单问答基准上的实验结果表明，以Qwen2.5-3B和Qwen2.5-7B为骨干模型时，GTA-RAG的性能始终优于现有基于强化学习的RAG基线方案，且证据链覆盖率得到显著提升。相关代码已开源至https://github.com/cjcj46262/GTA-RAG。

title: Arbitrage-Aware Multi-Step Forecasting of Implied Volatility Surfaces: Modelling Surface Trajectories Using Latent Diffusion
title_zh: 具备套利感知能力的隐含波动率曲面多步预测：基于隐扩散模型的曲面轨迹建模
authors: Dominik Manuel Buchegger, Lukas Gonon
abstract: Implied volatility surfaces summarise the option market and are central to many financial applications. Forecasting their future evolution requires modelling two-dimensional geometry, temporal dependence, and predictive uncertainty while preserving economic admissibility. We propose a conditional latent diffusion framework for generating joint 30-step trajectories of implied volatility surfaces and underlying returns. An arbitrage-aware autoencoder learns a low-dimensional surface representation, while the diffusion model captures the conditional joint evolution. Evaluated on SPX surfaces, the framework generates realistic probabilistic multi-step scenarios while also outperforming the persistence benchmark in point forecasting.
summary_zh: 隐含波动率曲面是期权市场信息的汇总，是众多金融应用的核心基础。预测其未来演化需要同时对二维几何特征、时间依赖关系和预测不确定性建模，且需保证结果满足经济合理性约束。本文提出一种条件隐扩散框架，可生成隐含波动率曲面与对应标的收益率的联合30步演化轨迹。其中具备套利感知能力的自编码器学习波动率曲面的低维表示，扩散模型则捕捉二者的条件联合演化规律。在标普500（SPX）波动率曲面数据集上的评估结果显示，该框架可生成符合真实场景的概率多步预测结果，且点预测性能优于持续性基准模型。

title: Quantum-Inspired Hybrid Neural Networks for Neural Decoding: A Controlled Ablation Study of Learnable Quantum Sidecar Integration
title_zh: 面向神经解码的量子混合神经网络：可学习量子侧模块集成的受控消融研究
authors: Diana Legziel Levy, Menachem Finkelstein, Peter Chin, Eilon Vaadia, Sarel Cohen
abstract: We study parameterized quantum circuits (PQCs) integrated as residual sidecar modules within a ResNet-50 backbone for 31-class neural population decoding---imagined handwriting classification from multi-neuron spike rasters. Under strictly controlled conditions (fixed data splits, seeds, and optimizer), we compare four model variants: baseline, quantum sidecar with frozen input projection, quantum sidecar with backbone-gradient-trained projection, and a measurement-guided variant that aligns angle encodings with circuit measurement outcomes. The backbone-gradient variant improves accuracy in 3/4 seeds (+0.19% mean, 95% CI [-1.10%, +1.48%]) and consistently reduces Linear CKA similarity to baseline features ($\Delta=-0.025$, 4/4 seeds), indicating genuine structural reorganization of representations. A nine-variant ablation identifies simple shallow architectures as the most effective and reproducible configuration. Measurement-guided training consistently improves representation geometry without reducing accuracy. All results use noiseless statevector simulation on 4 qubits, a regime chosen to reflect the practical constraints of current near-term superconducting hardware; no quantum computational advantage over classical methods is claimed.
summary_zh: 本研究将参数化量子电路（Parameterized Quantum Circuits, PQCs）作为残差侧模块集成到ResNet-50骨干网络中，实现31类神经群体解码任务，即从多神经元脉冲光栅数据中分类想象手写字符。在严格控制变量（固定数据划分、随机种子、优化器）的条件下，对比了四类模型变体：基线模型、输入投影层冻结的量子侧模块模型、骨干网络梯度更新投影层的量子侧模块模型、以及将角度编码与电路测量结果对齐的测量引导变体模型。骨干网络梯度更新投影层的变体在3/4的随机种子设置下准确率均有提升（平均提升0.19%，95%置信区间[-1.10%, +1.48%]），且与基线特征的线性中心核对齐（Linear CKA）相似度持续降低（Δ=-0.025，4/4种子设置下均成立），证明该方案实现了特征表示的真实结构重构。包含9种变体的消融实验结果表明，简单的浅层架构是效果最优、可复现性最强的配置。测量引导训练可在不降低准确率的前提下持续优化表示的几何结构。所有实验均基于4量子比特的无噪声态矢量仿真完成，该设置匹配当前近期超导量子硬件的实际约束，本研究未宣称所提方法具备超越经典方法的量子计算优势。

title: The Variance of Thought: Policy Variance, Critical Forks, and Local Credit Assignment
title_zh: 思维方差：策略方差、关键分叉点与局部信用分配
authors: Yingru Li
abstract: Long-horizon language-model tasks --- multi-step reasoning and tool-using agents alike --- are limited by credit assignment. We analyze it through the policy variance $\sigma_\pi^2(s)=\operatorname{Var}_{a\sim\pi}[Q_{\pi}(s,a)]$, which in a deterministic MDP is the sole source of return variance and is injected in discrete pulses at states we call critical forks. Three results follow. (i) Policy variance is a discovery budget: observing an action of advantage $c$ requires $\Omega(c^2/\sigma_\pi^2(s))$ draws, a bound that is exact on the canonical two-point fork. (ii) Policy variance is bounded by the policy's Gini dispersion, $\sigma_\pi^2(s)\le 1-\|\pi(\cdot|s)\|_2^2$, a rollout-free necessary condition for criticality computable from logits alone. (iii) The remaining horizon sets the estimation cost: at a fork whose downstream success probability is $P$, the Monte Carlo advantage estimate has signal-to-noise ratio of order $\sqrt{P}$, so its sample cost scales as $1/P$ --- a cost that branched sampling shares. Bootstrapping removes it by converting a product of survival probabilities into a sum, provided the value representation is multiplicatively accurate, which argues for log-value parameterization.
summary_zh: 长程语言模型任务（包括多步推理和工具调用智能体）的性能均受限于信用分配机制。本文通过策略方差$\sigma_\pi^2(s)=\operatorname{Var}_{a\sim\pi}[Q_{\pi}(s,a)]$对信用分配问题展开分析，在确定性马尔可夫决策过程中，策略方差是回报方差的唯一来源，且仅会在我们定义为关键分叉点的状态处以离散脉冲的形式注入。本文得到三项核心结论：（1）策略方差是发现预算：观测到优势值为$c$的动作需要至少$\Omega(c^2/\sigma_\pi^2(s))$次采样，该下界在标准两点分叉点场景下是紧的；（2）策略方差受限于策略的基尼离散度，满足$\sigma_\pi^2(s)\le 1-\|\pi(\cdot|s)\|_2^2$，这一无需采样 rollout 的临界性必要条件可直接从对数概率计算得到；（3）剩余决策步长决定估计成本：在下游成功概率为$P$的分叉点处，蒙特卡洛优势估计的信噪比与$\sqrt{P}$正相关，因此其采样成本与$1/P$成正比，分支采样方法也存在相同的成本特性。自举法可通过将生存概率的乘积转化为求和消除该成本，前提是值函数表示满足乘法精度要求，这一结论也为对数值参数化方案提供了理论支撑。

title: MASH-Bench: Diagnosing Cross-Source Failure in Mass-Shooting Risk Classification
title_zh: MASH-Bench：大规模枪击风险分类的跨源故障诊断基准
authors: Neha Sharma, Ritesh Sharma
abstract: Public mass-shooting databases differ substantially in coverage, feature availability, and reporting practices, creating challenges for machine-learning models that must generalize across data sources. We introduce MASH-Bench, a harmonized benchmark of 6,968 incidents from four U.S. databases: Kaggle, Mother Jones, Stanford MSA, and the Gun Violence Archive (GVA). We evaluate cross-source risk classification using leave-one-dataset-out (LODO) evaluation. Random Forest, XGBoost, and LightGBM achieve VeryHigh-risk recall of 0.68-0.89 on the curated sources but generalize poorly to GVA, where mean recall drops to 0.20 and precision to 0.0004. To investigate the source of this degradation, we conduct a controlled feature-masking ablation that removes the five features unavailable in GVA from the curated sources. The resulting recall collapse to zero provides evidence that feature completeness is a major contributor to the observed cross-source failure. We further evaluate three domain-adaptation approaches: DANN, CORAL, and importance weighting. DANN improves VeryHigh-risk recall on GVA by 0.282 (95% CI [0.11, 0.47], p = 0.003), although precision remains low, whereas CORAL and importance weighting yield zero recall. Oracle prior-shift recalibration likewise fails to recover VeryHigh-risk predictions, indicating that label-side correction alone is insufficient under the observed feature deficiencies. A per-group audit further identifies substantial disparities associated with media-attributed mental-health labels. Overall, these results indicate that, in MASH-Bench, cross-source generalization is constrained more by feature completeness and label prevalence than by classifier choice. The benchmark provides a controlled setting for diagnosing these effects in cross-source risk classification.
summary_zh: 公开的大规模枪击事件数据库在覆盖范围、可用特征、上报规则上存在显著差异，给需要跨数据源泛化的机器学习模型带来了巨大挑战。本文提出MASH-Bench基准，整合了来自美国4个数据库（Kaggle、Mother Jones、斯坦福MSA、枪支暴力档案GVA）的共6968起事件的标准化数据。本研究采用留一数据集（leave-one-dataset-out, LODO）评估方案测试跨源风险分类性能，结果显示随机森林、XGBoost、LightGBM在经过整理的数据源上的极高风险类别召回率可达0.68-0.89，但在GVA数据集上泛化性能极差，平均召回率降至0.20，精确率降至0.0004。为探究性能退化的根源，本研究开展了受控特征掩码消融实验：从整理后的数据源中移除GVA数据集不包含的5个特征，结果模型召回率直接降至0，证明特征完整性不足是跨源故障的核心诱因。本研究进一步评估了三类域适应方法：DANN、CORAL和重要性加权，其中DANN可将GVA数据集上的极高风险召回率提升0.282（95%置信区间[0.11, 0.47]，p=0.003），但精确率仍处于极低水平，CORAL和重要性加权方法的召回率直接降至0。基于先验偏移的校准方案同样无法恢复极高风险类别的预测能力，证明仅在标签侧做校正无法弥补特征缺失带来的缺陷。分组审计结果进一步发现，与媒体标注的心理健康标签相关的预测结果存在显著的不公平性。整体结果表明，在MASH-Bench场景下，跨源泛化性能的约束主要来自特征完整性和标签覆盖率，而非分类器的选择。该基准为跨源风险分类场景下的相关影响因素诊断提供了受控测试环境。

title: KPI-Conditioned Generative Design of Automotive Hood Inner Panels: A Two-Stage Retrieval-Generation Pipeline with Surrogate-Based Performance Estimation
title_zh: 面向汽车引擎盖内板的KPI条件生成式设计：融合代理性能估计的两阶段检索-生成流水线
authors: Sudeep Chavare
abstract: An inner hood panel must meet a deflection target, stay below a stress limit, and hit a mass target. Machine-learned surrogates have made the forward direction, geometry to performance, fast and routine. The inverse direction, producing geometry from a stated requirement, remains largely unaddressed for industrial parts whose design space is organized into discrete topology families rather than a continuous parameterization. This work presents a two-stage pipeline for that inverse problem. A reachability stage determines which topology families can satisfy a given requirement vector. A conditional variational autoencoder then generates point-cloud geometry within a selected family, and a neural-operator surrogate estimates the performance of each candidate. The pipeline is built entirely from public data and freely available compute, and is deployed as an interactive tool. The pipeline works, with qualifications that are reported as primary findings rather than caveats. The surrogate is accurate in aggregate, but its error is comparable to the performance differences it is asked to discriminate, which bounds what can be claimed for any individual generated design. That ratio of surrogate error to within-class signal is argued to be the quantity that determines whether a pipeline of this kind can work at all.
summary_zh: 汽车引擎盖内板需要同时满足挠度指标、应力上限约束和质量指标。基于机器学习的代理模型已经可以快速实现从几何结构到性能指标的正向预测，但对于设计空间被划分为离散拓扑族而非连续参数化的工业零部件而言，从需求描述生成对应几何结构的逆向设计问题仍未得到充分解决。本文提出一套两阶段流水线用于解决该逆向设计问题：首先通过可达性阶段判断哪些拓扑族可以满足给定的需求向量，随后使用条件变分自编码器在选定的拓扑族内生成点云几何结构，最后通过神经算子代理模型估计每个候选设计的性能。该流水线完全基于公开数据和免费算力搭建，已部署为交互式设计工具。实验验证了流水线的有效性，同时也明确了其适用边界：代理模型在整体层面精度达标，但单样本预测误差与待区分的不同设计间性能差异处于同一量级，这一特性限制了单一生成设计结果的可靠性。研究指出，代理模型误差与类内信号的比值是决定该类生成流水线能否有效工作的核心参数。

title: Geometric Structures on Graphs: a Holonomy-Based Discretization of Curvature
title_zh: 图上的几何结构：基于和乐性的曲率离散化方法
authors: Hao Li, Yuhan Peng, Junwen Dong
abstract: We propose a holonomy-based framework for discretizing curvature on graphs equipped with local symmetric positive-definite metrics. Each vertex carries a fibre metric \(g_i\), and each directed edge carries a reversible metric-compatible transport \(F_{ij}\). The ordered product around an oriented triangular loop \(\mathcal C\) gives a holonomy \(H_{\mathcal C}\), whose normalized logarithm \(\Omega_{\mathcal C}=-s_{\mathcal C}^{-1}\operatorname{Log}(H_{\mathcal C})\) is used as a finite-loop curvature observation. Thus the construction discretizes the geometric principle that infinitesimal holonomy is controlled by curvature, rather than treating holonomy as a heuristic feature. Since \(\Omega_{\mathcal C}\) lies in the \(g_i\)-orthogonal Lie algebra, it is not itself a velocity of an SPD metric. We therefore introduce two aggregation mechanisms: a commutator with a symmetric response matrix, producing symmetric Ricci-type metric responses, and an incidence-aware covariant divergence of curvature-induced edge fluxes, reflecting the relation between trace and covariant divergence. The resulting responses are locally orthogonal-gauge equivariant and can drive exponential updates that preserve positive definiteness. We also give a reversible metric-compatible parametrization of edge transports, allowing orthogonal edge factors, loop scales, weights, and response matrices to be learned while respecting the graph geometry. Known-geometry calibrations on the unit sphere test the holonomy--curvature relation, curvature preservation under nontrivial local metric representations, and the empirical recovery of edge transports from local observations.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种基于和乐性（holonomy）的框架，用于在配备局部对称正定度量的图上对曲率进行离散化。每个顶点对应一个纤维度量\(g_i\)，每条有向边对应一个可逆的、与度量兼容的传输算子\(F_{ij}\)。沿定向三角环\(\mathcal C\)的有序乘积可得到和乐量\(H_{\mathcal C}\)，其归一化对数形式\(\Omega_{\mathcal C}=-s_{\mathcal C}^{-1}\operatorname{Log}(H_{\mathcal C})\)被用作有限环曲率观测值。该构造将无穷小和乐性受曲率控制的几何原理进行离散化，而非将和乐性作为启发式特征处理。由于\(\Omega_{\mathcal C}\)位于\(g_i\)正交李代数内，其本身并非对称正定（SPD）度量的速度，因此本文引入两种聚合机制：第一种是与对称响应矩阵的对易子，可生成对称的类Ricci度量响应；第二种是曲率诱导边通量的关联感知协变散度，可反映迹与协变散度之间的关系。最终得到的响应具备局部正交规范等变性，可驱动保持正定性的指数更新。本文还提出了边传输算子的可逆度量兼容参数化方法，可在尊重图几何特性的前提下学习正交边因子、环尺度、权重与响应矩阵。基于单位球面的已知几何校准实验验证了和乐-曲率关系、非平凡局部度量表示下的曲率保持能力，以及从局部观测值经验恢复边传输算子的效果。

title: Dual-Scale State-Space Modeling with Speaker-Wise Dynamic CRF for Speech Emotion Recognition in Conversation
title_zh: 面向对话语音情感识别的双尺度状态空间建模与说话人专属动态CRF架构
authors: Guan-Hua Wen, Kuan-Yu Chen, Hou-Chiang Tseng
abstract: Conversational speech emotion recognition must reconcile acoustic evidence across temporal scales with two interaction processes: cross-speaker contextual influence and within-speaker emotion evolution. We propose DSSM-CRF, an audio-only architecture that explicitly separates these processes. Bidirectional state-space models encode fused self-supervised speech representations at frame and dialogue scales, so each utterance representation captures local prosody and context from all speakers. The decoder then orders each speaker's utterances into an independent dynamic conditional random field chain. Consecutive utterances in a speaker's chain form a transition pair whose score combines a corpus-level transition matrix with a residual predicted from the two contextualized utterances. An auxiliary objective supervises whether each pair changes emotion but does not participate in Viterbi inference. Thus, interlocutor turns affect contextual emotion scores without being treated as transitions in another speaker's emotion trajectory. DSSM-CRF achieves 75.81% UA and 74.90% WA on IEMOCAP, and 54.72% WA and 49.31% WF1 on MELD. Matched controls demonstrate complementary gains from speaker-wise factorization and CRF modeling.
summary_zh: 对话语音情感识别需要协调跨时间尺度的声学证据，同时兼顾两类交互过程：跨说话人上下文影响与说话人自身的情感演化。本文提出DSSM-CRF，一种仅使用音频输入的架构，可显式分离上述两类过程。双向状态空间模型在帧尺度与对话尺度下对融合的自监督语音表征进行编码，使每条话语表征同时捕捉局部韵律特征与所有说话人的上下文信息。解码器随后将每个说话人的话语序列整理为独立的动态条件随机场（CRF）链，同一说话人链中的连续话语构成转移对，其得分由语料级转移矩阵与从两个上下文话语预测得到的残差项组合而成。辅助目标用于监督每对相邻话语的情感是否发生变化，但不参与维特比（Viterbi）推理。该设计使得对话者的轮次仅能影响上下文情感得分，不会被当作另一说话人情感轨迹中的转移项处理。DSSM-CRF在IEMOCAP数据集上达到75.81%的非加权准确率（UA）与74.90%的加权准确率（WA），在MELD数据集上达到54.72%的加权准确率与49.31%的加权F1值（WF1）。对照实验证明，说话人因子分解与CRF建模可带来互补的性能增益。

title: Precision-Aware Variable Bit Processing Elements for Hardware-Efficient Systolic Array Designs
title_zh: 面向硬件高效脉动阵列设计的精度感知可变位宽处理单元
authors: Dantu Nandini Devi, Madhav Rao
abstract: Systolic arrays (SAs) have emerged as prominent hardware accelerators for matrix operations in deep learning, while floating point number formats enable precision control across computational domains. This research investigates approximate computing techniques for floating point (FP) multipliers in Weight Stationary Systolic Arrays, focusing on IEEE 754 (FP32), TensorFloat-32 (TF32), and Brain Floating point (BF16) formats. By integrating partial product matrix (PPM) column truncation with positive and negative compressors in the FP multiplier architecture, we optimize the trade-off between computational efficiency and accuracy. NSGA-II optimization algorithm was employed to explore the vast design space for evolving FP multiplier designs, towards achieving substantial hardware improvements while maintaining acceptable output quality. Substantial hardware benefits were observed in the FP multiplier designs across various applications, while preserving output quality. The FP approximated Processing Elements designed in the SA was found to offer comparable CNN accuracy for models trained on MNIST, F-MNIST, and CIFAR-10 dataset. The FP approximated SA designs that fall in the top 10 CNN performance offered substantial hardware gains in the range of 66% to 92% footprint savings, 60% to 93% of power benefits with 21% to 54% improvement in the delay when compared with the corresponding exact implementations mentioned in the literature for running the model trained on CIFAR-10 dataset. The TF32 and BF16 approximated SA designs also achieved substantial gains while maintaining comparable CNN accuracy. Our findings confirm that targeted approximation in FP multiplier design significantly improves the efficiency of hardware accelerators for error-tolerant applications, establishing an effective approach to hardware resource optimization in contemporary computing architectures.
summary_zh: 脉动阵列（Systolic Arrays, SAs）已成为深度学习中矩阵运算的主流硬件加速器，而浮点数格式可实现跨计算域的精度控制。本文针对权值驻留型脉动阵列中的浮点（FP）乘法器展开近似计算技术研究，覆盖IEEE 754（FP32）、TensorFloat-32（TF32）与脑浮点（BF16）三种格式。通过在浮点乘法器架构中集成部分积矩阵（Partial Product Matrix, PPM）列截断与正负压缩器，本文优化了计算效率与精度之间的权衡关系。研究采用带精英策略的非支配排序遗传算法（NSGA-II）探索广阔的设计空间，迭代演化浮点乘法器设计，在保持可接受输出质量的前提下实现硬件性能的大幅提升。所设计的浮点近似处理单元在脉动阵列中运行MNIST、F-MNIST与CIFAR-10数据集训练的模型时，可达到与精确实现相当的CNN精度。在CNN性能排名前10的浮点近似脉动阵列设计中，与文献中对应的精确实现相比，运行CIFAR-10训练模型时可实现66%~92%的面积节省、60%~93%的功耗收益，延迟提升幅度达21%~54%。TF32与BF16近似脉动阵列设计同样在保持相当CNN精度的前提下获得了显著的硬件性能提升。研究结果表明，浮点乘法器设计中的定向近似可大幅提升面向容错应用的硬件加速器效率，为当代计算架构中的硬件资源优化提供了有效路径。

title: Dataset Complexity Shapes Finite-Distance Loss Geometry in Neural Networks
title_zh: 数据集复杂度塑造神经网络有限距离下的损失几何结构
authors: Jaeyong Bae, Hawoong Jeong
abstract: Finite datasets can share the same size and low-order statistics while differing strongly in structural complexity. We connect this dataset complexity to loss-landscape geometry by pairing local label mixing across neighborhood scales with local entropy around trained neural-network solutions. Adapted from the Franz--Parisi construction in spin-glass theory, local entropy measures the effective volume of low-loss, solution-like parameter configurations at each distance from a reference. We estimate it in finite networks using adaptive sequential Monte Carlo. In a controlled synthetic sweep, greater dataset complexity produces a larger decrease in local entropy near the reference. Farther away, its radial derivative becomes weak and nearly common across conditions. Dataset complexity therefore changes where the effective solution volume contracts, rather than making it decrease uniformly faster. Experiments on real image data show the same qualitative trend, with label randomization further amplifying the effect. These results show that dataset structure shapes how low-loss neighborhoods are organized across finite distances from trained solutions.
summary_zh: 有限数据集可具备相同的规模与低阶统计特性，但结构复杂度差异极大。本文通过将跨邻域尺度的局部标签混合与训练后神经网络解附近的局部熵相结合，建立了数据集复杂度与损失景观几何特性之间的关联。研究改编自自旋玻璃理论中的Franz--Parisi构造，用局部熵衡量距离参考点不同位置处低损失、类解参数构型的有效体积，并采用自适应序贯蒙特卡洛方法在有限网络中对其进行估计。在受控合成遍历实验中，数据集复杂度越高，参考点附近的局部熵下降幅度越大；距离参考点更远的区域，局部熵的径向导数会变弱，且在不同复杂度条件下几乎趋于一致。因此数据集复杂度改变的是有效解体积发生收缩的位置，而非使其均匀地以更快速度下降。真实图像数据上的实验呈现出相同的定性趋势，标签随机化会进一步放大该效应。上述结果表明，数据集结构决定了低损失邻域相对于训练后解的跨有限距离组织方式。

title: Tracing the Unlabeled Storm: Cross-Variable Transfer in a Lagrangian Atmospheric JEPA Framework
title_zh: 从单尺度得分场恢复加权切几何
authors: K M Anirudh, S Sandeep, Hariprasad Kodamana
abstract: Deep atmospheric convection governs South Asian monsoon variability, yet attempting to learn its latent world model directly from zero-inflated, heavy-tailed precipitation yields suboptimal predictive representations. Continuous atmospheric proxies, such as outgoing longwave radiation (OLR), express this convective organization far more coherently. We address this mismatch with \emph{cross-variable proxy learning}: M-JEPA, a multiscale Monsoon Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture, is pretrained on five continuous proxy fields over Lagrangian patches tracking moving convective systems---without rainfall supervision at any point. The resulting frozen representation is transferred to daily precipitation forecasts through a shared decoder trunk featuring parallel probabilistic and deterministic branches. Because rainfall is strictly unobserved during pretraining, downstream skill directly measures the predictive information captured in the latent rollout. A frozen-backbone probing framework with two controls (an identical architecture trained on rainfall alone, and a randomly initialized backbone) attributes the transfer specifically to proxy pretraining: direct rainfall training exhibits $36\%$ higher CRPS error ($7.52$ vs.\ $5.54$\,mm/day). Against the 51-member operational ECMWF ensemble, the transferred model attains a statistically resolved CRPS advantage ($6.81$ vs.\ $6.89$\,mm/day) and higher Brier skill ($+0.05$ vs.\ $-0.04$) using $15.4$M parameters on a single consumer GPU, concentrated at heavy-rain thresholds and fine spatial scales, while the ensemble retains an advantage in neighborhood skill and deterministic references on point metrics. The result provides a competitive monsoon precipitation forecast grounded in intraseasonal dynamics and a diagnostic framework for evaluating transferred atmospheric representations.
summary_zh: 在光滑数据流形附近，单个切空间即可概括局部几何特性。而在分支点处，对应的一阶对象是切方向上的测度，其归一化质量记录了所选数据测度下各分支的局部占比。本文研究当分支中心与齐次度\(d\)均未知时，单噪声水平下的得分场是否可确定该加权切几何。在该切测度模型中，\(d\)即为局部测度维度。齐次切测度的高斯平滑满足Ornstein--Uhlenbeck特征函数方程，其弱形式可将得分值（无需得分导数）转化为求解中心与齐次度的线性系统，具备显式秩条件与扰动边界。完成校准后，单位球面上的切向得分即为标量高斯-锥变换的球面对数梯度，通过积分可恢复该变换（至多差一个缩放系数），且其所有球谐乘子均为正。因此任意一个精确的球壳即可在任意环境维度\(D\geq2\)下识别归一化角测度。对于至多包含\(K\)条正射线的场景，最高到2K-1阶的矩可构造性恢复任意维度下的射线数量、方向与权重。任意固定观测方案至少需要KD-1个标量切向分量。在二维平面场景下，K阶矩既是充分条件也是必要条件，本文给出了定量的有限查询验证方法。对于具备正\(C^{0,\beta}\)密度的有限平面\(C^{1,\beta}\)分支，本文证明有限噪声得分到其切模型的收敛阶为\(O(\sigma^\beta)\)。在受控实验中，5万步训练可降低四种几何场景下的验证集归一化得分误差，但会提升角矩误差，可区分普通得分拟合与几何恢复两类任务。

title: Recovering Weighted Tangent Geometry from a Single-Scale Score Field
authors: Ziqi Zhao, Qingjian Ni
abstract: Near a smooth data manifold, one tangent space summarizes local geometry. At a branch point, the corresponding first-order object is instead a measure over tangent directions, whose normalized masses record the local share of each branch under the chosen data measure. We ask whether a score field at one noise level determines this weighted tangent geometry when the branch center and homogeneity degree $d$ are unknown. In this tangent-measure model, $d$ is the local measure dimension. Gaussian smoothing of a homogeneous tangent measure satisfies an Ornstein--Uhlenbeck eigenfunction equation. Its weak form turns score values---without score derivatives---into a linear system for the center and homogeneity degree, with an explicit rank condition and perturbation bound. After this calibration, the tangential score on one sphere is the spherical log-gradient of a scalar Gaussian--cone transform. Integration recovers that transform up to scale, and all its spherical-harmonic multipliers are positive. Thus one exact shell identifies the normalized angular measure in every ambient dimension $D\geq2$. For at most $K$ positive rays, moments through degree $2K-1$ constructively recover count, directions, and weights in arbitrary dimension. Any fixed observation scheme needs at least $KD-1$ scalar tangential components. In the plane, degree $K$ is both sufficient and necessary, and we give quantitative finite-query certificates. For finite planar $C^{1,\beta}$ branches with positive $C^{0,\beta}$ densities, we prove $O(\sigma^\beta)$ convergence from the finite-noise score to its tangent model. In controlled experiments, 50k-step training lowers validation normalized-score error across four geometries yet raises angular-moment error, separating ordinary score fit from geometry recovery.

title: Gaussian process learning with flow map refinement for parameter estimation in dynamical systems
title_zh: 超越稠密Adam状态：面向内存高效优化器的自适应对数空间量化
authors: Yue Hao, Dongwei Ye
abstract: Parameter estimation is a central task in data-driven learning of dynamical systems. It aims to recover the underlying physical parameters from observed time-series data, thereby providing interpretable insights into the physical mechanisms governing the system. Gradient/derivative matching methods based on Gaussian process provide an efficient way to perform parameter estimation. Those methods avoid repeated numerical integration and enforce local derivative consistency. However, such local matching may result in global inconsistency with the governing flow map, particularly under scarce and noisy observations. To address this limitation, we propose a framework based on Gaussian process learning with flow map refinement (GPL-FMR), a two-stage parameter estimation framework. The first stage is based on Gaussian process learning algorithm and the posterior obtained from which is transferred as an informative prior to the second stage based on flow-map refinement. The second stage further improves the parameter estimation via optimisation based on global dynamical constraints. We demonstrate and analyse its performance on multiple numerical examples, including the Van der Pol oscillator, the Lotka-Volterra model, and the Lorenz-63 system. The results show that the proposed framework consistently improves parameter estimation accuracy, particularly under scarce and noisy observations.
summary_zh: 本文基于总计214.7 GPU小时的96次运行，评估了AdamW、Adafactor、CAME与APOLLO四种优化器的实现路径。在2万步的TinyLlama-1.1B基准测试中，采用AL8二阶矩与8位均匀动量的AdamW可达到72.90的困惑度，优于FP32基线的72.48与8位动态量化基线的73.54，同时优化器状态存储占用从8392.7 MiB降至2119.2 MiB。CAME的非负状态需要更高精度：采用AL16精度时困惑度为86.16，与FP32的86.68相当，而全AL8精度下困惑度升至90.19。在10万步的GPT-2实验中，拓扑感知参数保护可将量化Adafactor的后期损失差距从+0.1185降至+0.0159。上述结果验证了状态感知与拓扑感知优化器量化方案的有效性。所有端到端对比实验均使用单一训练种子，结果为实测经验值。

title: Beyond Dense Adam States: Adaptive Log-Space Quantization for Memory-Efficient Optimizers
authors: Yan Wang
abstract: Across 96 runs totaling 214.7 GPU-hours, we evaluate AdamW, Adafactor, CAME, and APOLLO paths. On a 20K-step TinyLlama-1.1B benchmark, AdamW with AL8 second moments and 8-bit uniform momentum reaches 72.90 perplexity, versus 72.48 for FP32 and 73.54 for an 8-bit dynamic-quantization baseline, while reducing measured optimizer-state storage from 8392.7 to 2119.2 MiB. CAME requires higher precision for its non-negative states: AL16 reaches 86.16 perplexity versus 86.68 for FP32, while all-AL8 reaches 90.19. In a 100K-step GPT-2 experiment, topology-aware parameter protection reduces the late-loss gap of quantized Adafactor from +0.1185 to +0.0159. These results support state- and topology-aware optimizer quantization. End-to-end comparisons use a single training seed and are reported as empirical measurements.

title: StocBench: A Benchmark for Generative Modeling of Stochastic Dynamics
title_zh: StocBench：面向随机动力学生成建模的基准测试集
authors: Sebastian Pfister, Benjamin Holzschuh, Nils Thuerey
abstract: We benchmark transport-based generative models as well as distillation-based few-step methods for the probabilistic forecasting of stochastic fluid flows, with a particular focus on performance under limited inference budgets. All methods are evaluated on a two-dimensional Kolmogorov flow with stochastic forcing. We measure one-step distributional accuracy against large simulated reference ensembles and assess whether the invariant measure is preserved during autoregressive rollouts via the enstrophy spectrum. On the stochastic task, flow matching achieves the most accurate one-step conditional distribution at high inference budgets, while the second-order exponential integrator DPM-2 is strongest at very low NFE. Few-step distillation methods are competitive with the multi-step methods and preserve the enstrophy spectrum particularly well. A deterministic control task, in which the forcing over the prediction interval is observed, separates aleatoric from epistemic uncertainty. Model performance does not translate between the two settings: the distilled models are competitive on the stochastic task but least accurate on the control task. While stochastic diffusion samplers such as DDPM better preserve the enstrophy spectrum during rollouts in the stochastic setting, deterministic samplers such as DDIM and DPM-2 show better spectral preservation in the deterministic setting.
summary_zh: 本文针对随机流体流动的概率预测任务，对基于传输的生成模型与基于蒸馏的少步方法进行基准测试，重点评估有限推理预算下的性能表现。所有方法均在带随机强迫的二维柯尔莫哥洛夫流（Kolmogorov flow）数据集上开展评测。本文对照大规模模拟参考系综测量一步分布精度，通过涡量谱评估自回归滚动过程中不变测度的保持能力。在随机任务场景下，高推理预算时流匹配方法可实现最精确的一步条件分布，而极低函数评估步数（NFE）下二阶指数积分器DPM-2表现最优。少步蒸馏方法的性能与多步方法相当，且对涡量谱的保持效果尤为出色。本文设置了确定性对照任务，即预测区间内的强迫项可被观测，用于区分随机不确定性与认知不确定性。模型性能在两类场景下不具备迁移性：蒸馏模型在随机任务上表现优异，但在对照任务上精度最低。随机扩散采样器如DDPM在随机场景的滚动过程中对涡量谱的保持效果更好，而确定性采样器如DDIM与DPM-2在确定性场景下的谱保持性能更优。

title: The spatial anatomy of urban wildfire vulnerability: a spatially validated GeoAI framework reveals the roles of building density and vegetation moisture in structure loss during the 2025 Palisades Fire
title_zh: 城市野火脆弱性的空间解剖：空间验证的GeoAI框架揭示2025年帕利塞兹火灾中建筑密度与植被湿度对建筑损毁的作用
authors: Parastoo Farajpoor, Mohammadreza Narimani
abstract: Urban wildfire resilience depends on interactions among built form, vegetation condition, and extreme fire weather, yet city-scale risk models often overlook whether predictive skill transfers across neighborhoods. We developed a spatially validated GeoAI workflow for the January 2025 Palisades Fire, linking 12,081 CAL FIRE damage inspections to pre-fire Sentinel-2 vegetation indices, Landsat surface temperature, LANDFIRE fuels, terrain, and OpenStreetMap buildings and roads. Among 9,883 inspected residential structures, 5,566 were destroyed. Random cross-validation yielded ROC-AUC 0.92 for the integrated XGBoost model, but 1 km spatial block validation reduced performance to 0.75; logistic regression performed similarly and was better calibrated. Building count within 100 m was the strongest predictor, with destruction odds increasing 4.12-fold per standard deviation. Vegetation moisture and greenness showed opposing conditional associations: NDMI at 100-300 m was protective (OR 0.52), whereas NDVI at 30-100 m was positively associated with destruction after accounting for moisture (OR 1.74). Predictive information was concentrated at the 100-300 m neighborhood scale. A separate post-fire track mapped burn severity and vegetation recovery without leakage. The results support neighborhood-scale susceptibility screening, moisture-aware vegetation management, and spatial block validation as a minimum standard for single-event urban wildfire modeling.
summary_zh: 城市野火韧性取决于建成环境形态、植被状态与极端火灾天气之间的相互作用，但现有城市尺度风险模型往往忽略预测能力是否可跨邻域迁移。本文针对2025年1月帕利塞兹火灾开发了经过空间验证的GeoAI工作流，将12081条加州林业与消防局（CAL FIRE）损毁检查记录与火灾前Sentinel-2植被指数、Landsat地表温度、LANDFIRE可燃物数据、地形数据以及OpenStreetMap建筑与道路数据相关联。在9883栋接受检查的住宅建筑中，共有5566栋完全损毁。随机交叉验证下集成XGBoost模型的ROC-AUC可达0.92，但1km空间块验证下性能降至0.75；逻辑回归表现相当且校准效果更优。100m范围内的建筑数量是最强预测因子，每提升一个标准差，建筑损毁概率提升4.12倍。植被湿度与绿度呈现相反的条件关联：100-300m范围内的归一化差异湿度指数（NDMI）具备防护作用（优势比OR=0.52），而控制湿度变量后30-100m范围内的归一化植被指数（NDVI）与建筑损毁呈正相关（OR=1.74）。预测信息集中在100-300m的邻域尺度。独立的灾后轨迹图在无数据泄露的前提下绘制了燃烧烈度与植被恢复情况。研究结果可为邻域尺度易损性筛查、湿度感知型植被管理提供支撑，同时证明空间块验证应作为单事件城市野火建模的最低标准。

title: DAW: Dynamics-Aware Weighting for Deep Learning Forecasts of Chaotic Systems
title_zh: DAW：面向混沌系统深度学习预测的动力学感知加权方法
authors: Zhou Fang, Gianmarco Mengaldo
abstract: Deep learning surrogates for forecasting chaotic dynamical systems suffer from catastrophic error accumulation over long-term autoregressive rollouts. This behavior is partly tied to the underlying systems: chaotic spatiotemporal systems, such as the Kuramoto-Sivashinsky (KS) equation, visit phase space unevenly - dominated by recurrent, low-dimensional quiescent states (e.g., near-laminar flows) and punctuated by rare, dynamically complex topological transitions (e.g., wave-merging events). Under a sample-wise uniform objective, standard neural surrogates allocate their finite capacity to the statistically numerous quiescent states, under-representing the transient regimes that trigger disproportionate, localized errors. Existing imbalanced-regression methods reweight samples by target-space density. However, statistical target-space rarity need not coincide with the intrinsic dynamical rarity - the recurrence geometry of the attractor that is the source of the imbalance. To address this, we introduce Dynamics-Aware Weighting (DAW), a data-centric objective reweighting framework. Using the local dimension $d$ from dynamical systems theory as an a priori measure of a state's active degrees of freedom, DAW reshapes the loss landscape to allocate representational capacity toward the sparse, high-$d$ regimes where forecast errors are systematically large. On the chaotic KS equation, DAW consistently outperforms uniform training, purely statistical density weighting, and its randomly permuted ablation, reducing long-term autoregressive error relative to all baselines. Event-level analysis shows that DAW achieves this by suppressing the localized error amplifications incurred during sharp jumps in $d$, which accompany complex physical processes such as wave-merging in the KS system.
summary_zh: 用于预测混沌动力系统的深度学习代理模型在长期自回归滚动预测过程中会遭遇灾难性误差累积问题。该现象与底层系统特性直接相关：以库拉莫托夫-西瓦辛斯基（Kuramoto-Sivashinsky, KS）方程为代表的混沌时空系统在相空间中的访问分布并不均匀，其运动轨迹以循环出现的低维静止状态（如近层流流动）为主，仅会被罕见的、动力学层面复杂的拓扑转变事件（如波合并事件）打断。在逐样本均匀优化目标下，标准神经代理模型会将有限的表征能力分配给统计占比更高的静止状态，对会引发不成比例局部误差的瞬态 regime 表征不足。现有不平衡回归方法会根据目标空间密度对样本重新加权，但统计层面的目标空间稀缺性并不等同于内在动力学稀缺性——后者是作为不平衡来源的吸引子循环几何特性。为解决该问题，本文提出动力学感知加权（Dynamics-Aware Weighting, DAW）这一以数据为中心的目标重加权框架。该框架利用动力系统理论中的局部维度d作为状态活跃自由度的先验度量，重塑损失景观，将表征能力分配给预测误差系统性偏大的高维稀疏 regime。在混沌KS方程上的实验表明，DAW的表现始终优于均匀训练、纯统计密度加权以及随机置换消融实验的结果，相比所有基线方法均降低了长期自回归预测误差。事件层面分析显示，DAW实现性能提升的机制是抑制d值急剧跳变过程中产生的局部误差放大，这类跳变通常伴随KS系统中的波合并等复杂物理过程。

title: Toward a First-Principles Update Geometry for the Language-Model Head
title_zh: 面向语言模型头部的第一性原理更新几何研究
authors: Aditya Somasundaram
abstract: We study the language-model head and softmax as a single module, deriving an update geometry from their composition rather than from the weight matrix in isolation. Under Hilbert's projective distance, the maximum change caused by an update $S$ over $\left|\left|{h}\right|\right|_2\le H$ is $H\max_{i<j}\left|\left|{s_i-s_j}\right|\right|_2$, which is $H$ times the Euclidean diameter of its token rows. Motivated by Muon's singular-value conditioning, we propose maximizing the smallest row separation while constraining this diameter, producing an approximate-equidistance problem when $V\gg d$.
summary_zh: 本文将语言模型头部与softmax作为单一模块开展研究，从二者的组合特性而非孤立的权重矩阵出发推导更新几何。在希尔伯特投影距离下，更新算子S在约束||h||₂≤H时引发的最大变化为H·max_{i<j}||s_i-s_j||₂，即H乘以其token行的欧氏直径。受Muon算法的奇异值条件化思路启发，本文提出在约束上述直径的前提下最大化最小行间距，当V≫d时可生成近似等距问题。

title: Sharp Barron Regularity Results for Coulombic Many-Electron Wave Functions
title_zh: 库仑多电子波函数的尖锐Barron正则性结果
authors: Pingbing Ming, Hao Yu
abstract: We also determine the exact endpoint growth. Writing $\varepsilon=2-s$, we prove that, for either $u=\phi$ or $u=\phi_3$, there is a computable constant $M$ independent of $\varepsilon$ such that \[ \left\|u\right\|_{\mathcal{B}^{2-\varepsilon}}\leq\frac{M}{\varepsilon^2}\left\|u\right\|_{\mathcal{B}^1}. \] For the unperturbed two-electron atom we prove, with a constant independent of $\varepsilon$, \[ \left|\left\|\phi_3\right\|_{\mathcal{B}^{2-\varepsilon}}-\frac{32\pi Z\lvert\phi_3(0,0)\rvert}{\varepsilon^2}\right|\leq\frac{C}{\varepsilon}. \] Hence the quadratic rate in the upper bound is sharp whenever $\lvert\phi_3(0,0)\rvert\neq0$, as is the case for the ground state.
summary_zh: 本文确定了精确的端点增长特性。令ε=2-s，我们证明对于u=φ或u=φ₃，均存在与ε无关的可计算常数M，满足不等式||u||_{ℬ^{2-ε}} ≤ M/ε² · ||u||_{ℬ¹}。对于无扰动双电子原子，我们证明存在与ε无关的常数C，满足||φ₃||_{ℬ^{2-ε}} - 32πZ|φ₃(0,0)|/ε² 的绝对值 ≤ C/ε。因此当|φ₃(0,0)|≠0时（基态即满足该条件），上述上界中的二次速率是尖锐的。

title: MRMAD: A Multi-Round Multi-Audio Benchmark for Evaluating Acoustic Degradation Perception in Large Audio-Language Models
title_zh: MRMAD：用于评估大音频语言模型声学退化感知能力的多轮多音频基准集
authors: Yize Li, Ningyuan Yang, Sile Yin, Sindhuja Thogarrati, Sung-En Chang, Andrew C. Singer, Xue Lin, Chuan-Che Huang, Shuo Zhang
abstract: Large audio-language models (LALMs) have shown promising progress in understanding speech, music, and general sound events, yet their ability to reason about how audio signals are degraded remains underexplored. Existing benchmarks primarily evaluate semantic understanding, event recognition, or high-level audio reasoning, leaving a basic question unanswered: Do LALMs understand the differences in audio quality? We introduce MRMAD, a Multi-Round Multi-Audio Degradation benchmark for evaluating audio degradation perception and understanding in LALMs. MRMAD spans speech, music, and sound, and frames evaluation as multi-turn dialogues over multiple audio inputs, requiring models to identify degradation types, compare severity, and perceive corruption changes across turns. Unlike current single-turn audio-language benchmarks, MRMAD evaluates whether LALMs can maintain consistent degradation hypotheses with new evidence and explain low-level acoustic phenomena in natural language. Through a systematic evaluation of 18 representative LALMs from non-thinking to reasoning and Omni models, we find that current models often recognize coarse content while failing to diagnose, compare, or reason about degradations reliably. MRMAD reveals an important yet overlooked aspect of audio-language understanding and provides a diagnostic foundation for building future LALMs that are robust to real-world acoustic conditions.
summary_zh: 大音频语言模型（Large Audio-Language Models, LALMs）在语音、音乐和通用声音事件理解方面已取得可观进展，但这类模型推理音频信号退化机制的能力仍未得到充分探索。现有基准主要评估语义理解、事件识别或高层音频推理能力，尚未回答一个基础问题：大音频语言模型能否理解音频质量的差异？本文提出MRMAD，即多轮多音频退化基准集，用于评估大音频语言模型对音频退化的感知与理解能力。MRMAD覆盖语音、音乐和普通声音三类音频，将评估任务构建为基于多音频输入的多轮对话，要求模型识别退化类型、比较退化严重程度、跨轮次感知失真变化。与现有单轮音频语言基准不同，MRMAD重点评估大音频语言模型能否在获得新证据时保持一致的退化假设，并用自然语言解释低层声学现象。通过对18款代表性大音频语言模型（覆盖非推理类、推理类及全模态模型）的系统性评估，我们发现当前模型通常可以识别粗略的音频内容，但无法可靠地诊断、比较或推理音频退化问题。MRMAD揭示了音频语言理解领域一个重要却长期被忽视的维度，为后续构建适配真实世界声学条件的鲁棒大音频语言模型提供了诊断基础。

title: A Query-Time Framework for Transient 2D Pore-Scale Flow Prediction and Generative Design
title_zh: 面向瞬态二维孔隙尺度流动预测与生成式设计的查询时刻框架
authors: Yiming Wang, Jiale Zhu, Zhichen Ye, Yandong Lv, Shiqi Wang, Jinlong Liu, Yucheng Fan
abstract: Pore-scale flow governs transport and permeability behaviour in porous media engineering applications, yet repeated lattice Boltzmann method (LBM) simulation across many geometries and design queries remains costly for repeated deployment. This study formulates transient pore-scale flow prediction as a geometry-conditioned query-time operator and introduces QSGS-Transient-7606, a benchmark of 7,606 two-dimensional porous structures each paired with 30 logarithmically sampled LBM states.
