All metrics are computed exactly on all pairwise distances, independently of any method's internals, and every number is reproducible offline: the closed-source method's output coordinates (not its algorithm) are committed to the artifact.
summary_zh: 降维（Dimensionality-Reduction, DR）方法的性能通常通过各点的k近邻在二维嵌入中的留存情况进行评估，典型指标包括recall@k、可信度、连续性。本文指出这类指标是有偏的距离保真度度量：其逐点可变半径和硬包含阈值会偏向近邻图类方法（t-SNE、UMAP），同时惩罚保留绝对距离的方法。本文提出采用固定半径距离带谢泼德rho值评估降维保真度：该指标是高维与二维成对距离之间的斯皮尔曼相关系数，被限定在累积距离带中，可分别报告局部结构和全局结构的保真度，且所有点都采用相同的绝对半径进行评估。在具备已知真实几何特征（非均匀密度、稠密簇、闭环过渡、子空间外离群点、不平衡双种群数据）、噪声水平符合实际场景（信噪比SNR=1，维度D=768，样本量N=1000）的合成数据集上，本文对8种降维方法（PCA、Isomap、t-SNE、UMAP、PyMDE、PCC、DREAMS、闭源方法toorPIA）完成基准测试，得到如下结论：（1）全局谢泼德rho值较高的同时，簇内尺度可能发生高达93倍的压缩，该现象无法被基于排序的指标检测到，但可通过基于数值的过度压缩指标明确识别；（2）recall@k指标与固定半径带指标的结果存在系统性偏差，偏差方向与理论预测的偏置方向一致；（3）引入成员约束的谢泼德rho值可以解决多对统计量无法处理的单点和少数种群相关问题，即使是近期提出的局部-全局混合方法DREAMS也会在这类问题上出现无提示的失效。本文补充的样本外（addplot）测试可评估从未见过的异常点是否落在正常区域之外，以及其方向是否能识别异常来源。所有指标均可基于全部成对距离精确计算，独立于各降维方法的内部实现，所有结果均可离线复现：闭源方法的输出坐标（而非其算法）已随项目工件一同开源。

title: Width-Independent Compressibility of Deep Neural Networks
authors: Hong-Yi Wang, Mingze Wang, Liu Ziyin
abstract: It has long been known that well-trained neural networks can be compressed very strongly without affecting their performance, an important phenomenon that remains poorly understood. We prove a uniform compressibility theorem for deep multilayer perceptrons with analytic activations. For a deep, wide fixed teacher network, there exists a narrow (same depth) network that approximately represents the same function as the original. The reachable compressed width is strikingly independent of the original width, but is $O((\log(1/\varepsilon))^{d_{in}})$, where $\varepsilon$ is the error budget and $d_{in}$ is the effective input dimension. Our construction involves a novel derivative-matching technique which is aware of the low-dimensional input, and a layer-wise reweighting that preserves the input-output mapping.

title: First-Principles Atomistic Structure and Dynamics of Polyethylene During High-Pressure Radical Polymerization via Machine Learning Force Fields
title_zh: 基于机器学习力场的高压自由基聚合过程中聚乙烯的第一性原理原子结构与动力学研究
authors: Bharatha K. Gunawardana, Teresa Shah, Bicha Azizova, Deepa Ranabhat, Yizhi Song, Akshath Shastri, Srinjoy Ghose, Thomas E. Gartner III, Hsin-Yu Ko
abstract: Polyethylene (PE) is one of the most commonly used synthetic polymers. While the synthesis and processing protocols for PE are well established, precise experimental assignment of microscopic structures at atomistic resolution (i.e., the position of each atom) remains largely limited to highly crystalline systems. This gap is often addressed via computer simulations using empirical interatomic potentials, which use approximate but efficient descriptions of interatomic interactions to reach the length and time scales needed to describe macromolecules. These empirical potentials typically perform well for bulk and/or collective properties but face challenges with chemical realism for complex systems, e.g., during reactive processes. In this work, we address this challenge by combining the computational efficiency of a deep potential (DP) machine-learning force field and the chemical realism of first-principles van der Waals (vdW) corrected hybrid density functional theory (DFT) enabled by a SeA high-throughput framework. Using this approach, we study the structure and dynamics of PE oligomers and polymers in an ethylene solvent under common high-pressure (supercritical) radical polymerization conditions. We found that the local solvation environment of radical-containing PE oligomers converges for chain lengths greater than (n~6), suggesting extensibility of our oligomer-trained MLFF to significantly longer polymers. We then confirmed the extensibility of these models to long PE chains by characterizing the molecular weight scaling of single-chain structure and dynamics, which showed classic good solvent behavior. Our PE MLFF retained a consistent level of fidelity and stability across a wide range of thermodynamic state points and chain lengths, at full atomistic resolution, therefore paving the way towards first-principles-based polymer structure and property prediction.
summary_zh: 聚乙烯（PE）是应用最广泛的合成聚合物之一。尽管聚乙烯的合成与加工工艺已经十分成熟，但在原子分辨率下对微观结构（即每个原子的位置）进行精确的实验表征，目前仍仅能在高结晶度体系中实现。该研究缺口通常通过基于经验原子间势的计算机模拟填补，这类势函数采用近似但高效的原子间相互作用描述，可支撑描述大分子所需的长度和时间尺度模拟。这类经验势通常在体属性和集体属性预测上表现良好，但在复杂体系（例如反应过程）的化学真实性层面存在明显缺陷。本研究结合深度势（Deep Potential, DP）机器学习力场的计算效率，和经第一性原理范德华（vdW）校正的杂化密度泛函理论（Density Functional Theory, DFT）的化学真实性，整套计算流程基于SeA高通量框架实现。基于该方法，本文研究了常见高压（超临界）自由基聚合条件下，乙烯溶剂中聚乙烯低聚物和聚合物的结构与动力学特性。研究发现，当含自由基的聚乙烯低聚物链长大于n~6时，其局部溶剂化环境会趋于收敛，说明基于低聚物训练的机器学习力场可拓展到长链聚乙烯体系。本文进一步通过表征单链结构与动力学的分子量缩放规律，验证了该模型对长聚乙烯链的拓展性，结果显示长链聚乙烯呈现典型的良溶剂行为。本文开发的聚乙烯机器学习力场可在全原子分辨率下，在宽热力学状态点范围和宽链长范围内保持一致的保真度和稳定性，为基于第一性原理的聚合物结构与性能预测铺平了道路。

title: Adaptive Multilevel Twisted Sequential Monte Carlo for Rare Events Estimation in Language Models
title_zh: 面向大语言模型稀有事件估计的自适应多层扭曲序贯蒙特卡洛方法
authors: Zixuan Liu, Fangzheng Wu, Brian Summa, Zizhan Zheng
abstract: Rare unsafe behaviors in large language models can remain practically significant even when their probability is extremely small, particularly at deployment scales involving millions or billions of interactions. Twisted Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) provides a principled framework for rare-event probability estimation by learning twist functions that guide generation toward a target event. However, the standard twist learning framework relies on positive samples from the rare-event target distribution, which may be nearly absent before an informative twist has been learned, resulting in unreliable rare-event estimation. We propose Adaptive Multilevel Twisted SMC, which learns the rare-event twist through a sequence of progressively rarer intermediate events. At each level, the learned twist provides more informative positive examples for learning the next twist, ultimately leading to a more accurate final twist for the target rare event. Experiments across diverse tasks and model scales show that the proposed method produces more accurate rare-event probability estimates. By enabling more reliable discovery of hard-to-observe unsafe behaviors, our method provides a practical tool for strengthening the evaluation and safety alignment of deployed language models.
summary_zh: 大语言模型中罕见的不安全行为即使发生概率极低，在涉及数百万乃至数十亿次交互的部署规模下仍具有极高的实际风险。扭曲序贯蒙特卡洛（Twisted Sequential Monte Carlo, SMC）是一类严谨的稀有事件概率估计框架，通过学习扭曲函数引导生成过程向目标事件靠拢。但标准的扭曲学习框架依赖来自稀有事件目标分布的正样本，在尚未学习到有效扭曲函数之前这类正样本几乎不存在，最终导致稀有事件估计结果不可靠。本文提出自适应多层扭曲序贯蒙特卡洛方法，通过一系列稀有度逐步提升的中间事件学习稀有事件对应的扭曲函数。在每一层级，学习得到的扭曲函数可为下一层扭曲函数的学习提供更具信息量的正样本，最终得到针对目标稀有事件的更精确的最终扭曲函数。在多类任务和不同模型规模下的实验结果表明，所提方法可以得到更准确的稀有事件概率估计结果。该方法可支撑更可靠的难观测不安全行为发现，为提升已部署大语言模型的评估质量和安全对齐水平提供实用工具。

title: Guidance for Prior Change via Density Ratio Estimation
title_zh: 基于密度比估计的先验变化引导方法
authors: Yichen Zang, Song Liu, Jiun-Yi Lin
abstract: Simulation-Based Inference (SBI) serves as a vital framework for parameter inference in scientific fields where simulators involve intractable likelihoods, yet while amortized generative models offer rapid posterior estimation, they are often restricted by the specific priors used during training, thereby limiting their flexibility as prior knowledge evolves. To address this prior dependency, PriorGuide was introduced as an inference-time guidance method, but due to its intractable formulation, it relies on Gaussian approximations of the reverse transition kernel and Gaussian mixture model fitting for the prior ratio, both of which introduce systematic bias. Motivated by these limitations, we propose an unbiased test-time guidance framework that leverages Density Ratio Estimation (DRE) to learn a score guidance term, effectively decoupling the inference process from the prior training. Moreover, our framework remains agnostic to the specific density ratio estimators, making it a general and flexible framework for handling prior changes. Experimental results across multiple tasks demonstrate that our method matches or outperforms PriorGuide on C2ST and MMD in most tasks while maintaining robustness even under limited overlap between the training and target priors. Furthermore, we apply our method to Bayesian updating for parameter inference from planetary light-curve data, where it also demonstrates strong effectiveness and robustness. Code is available at https://github.com/a-chenchen/dre-based-prior-guidance .
summary_zh: 基于模拟的推断（Simulation-Based Inference, SBI）是科学领域中针对似然函数难以直接求解的模拟器开展参数推断的核心框架。尽管摊销生成模型可实现快速后验估计，但这类模型通常受限于训练阶段使用的特定先验分布，当先验知识发生变化时模型的灵活性会大幅下降。为解决这种先验依赖问题，此前有研究提出PriorGuide作为推断阶段的引导方法，但由于其公式难以直接求解，该方法依赖反向转移核的高斯近似和针对先验比的高斯混合模型拟合，两种操作都会引入系统性偏差。针对上述局限性，本文提出一种无偏的测试阶段引导框架，该框架利用密度比估计（Density Ratio Estimation, DRE）学习分数引导项，有效将推断过程与训练阶段的先验分布解耦。此外本文提出的框架不绑定特定的密度比估计器，是一套通用灵活的先验变化处理框架。多任务上的实验结果表明，在绝大多数任务中，所提方法的C2ST和MMD指标表现与PriorGuide持平甚至更优，即使训练先验与目标先验的重叠度很低，该方法仍能保持鲁棒性。本文进一步将该方法应用于行星光变曲线数据的贝叶斯更新参数推断任务，同样展现出优异的有效性和鲁棒性。代码开源地址为https://github.com/a-chenchen/dre-based-prior-guidance。

title: Posterior Information Dynamics of Diffusion Models for Linear Inverse Problems
title_zh: 面向线性逆问题的扩散模型后验信息动力学研究
authors: Xiangming Meng
abstract: Diffusion models are widely used as priors for linear inverse problems, yet endpoint quality does not reveal when measurement information enters reverse denoising or how it is allocated across signal directions. We study this process through the smoothed likelihood force, the difference between exact posterior and prior scores at each noise level. For a fixed measurement, its expected squared norm gives both posterior--prior relative-entropy dissipation and reverse-path relative-entropy growth. Averaging over measurements yields an information--minimum mean-square error (I-MMSE) identity linking information gain to denoising-error reduction. Under finite second moments, the force energy and its ratio to prior-score energy decay quadratically in the noising kernel's signal coefficient at high noise. Solvable models show that conditioning removes class separation already explained by the measurement, reduces a uniform index entropy over \(n\) empirical samples from \(\log n\) to \(H(I\mid r)\), and makes assimilation depend on operator--prior alignment even for identical singular values. Experiments in models with tractable posteriors evaluate these predictions. In a separate illustration with a frozen FFHQ model, masks sharing the same spectrum yield different prior-normalized null-space trajectory statistics.
summary_zh: 扩散模型被广泛用作线性逆问题的先验分布，但仅靠最终输出的质量无法反映测量信息是在反向去噪过程的哪个阶段进入模型，也无法反映信息在不同信号方向上的分配机制。本文通过平滑似然力（即各噪声水平下精确后验分数与先验分数的差值）对该过程展开研究。对于固定测量，平滑似然力的期望平方范数同时对应后验-先验相对熵耗散量和反向路径的相对熵增长量。对测量取平均后可得到信息-最小均方误差（I-MMSE）恒等式，该恒等式将信息增益与去噪误差的降低关联起来。在二阶矩有限的条件下，高噪声区域中力的能量及其与先验分数能量的比值，会随加噪核的信号系数呈二次方衰减。可解析求解的模型实验表明，条件化操作会移除测量已经解释过的类别分离信息，将n个经验样本上的均匀索引熵从log n降低为H(I|r)，即使奇异值完全相同，信息同化过程也会依赖算子与先验的对齐程度。本文在可求解后验的模型上开展实验，对上述预测进行了验证。在使用冻结FFHQ模型的另一组实验中，频谱完全相同的掩码会产生不同的、经先验归一化的零空间轨迹统计量。

title: Benchmarking Composable Compression Techniques in Mixture-of-Experts LLMs
title_zh: 混合专家大语言模型的可组合压缩技术基准评测
authors: Afsara Benazir, Chen Chen, Rongxiao Qu, Jiabo Huang, Jingtao Li, Lingjuan Lyu
abstract: MoEXBench introduces an eight-module evaluation suite that jointly measures composable-compression quality, workload and architecture robustness, pruning/quantization/KV cache sensitivity, and deployment efficiency on commodity hardware. Our results reveal non-trivial interactions among compression methods: composable compression cannot be predicted from standalone techniques, compression rate alone does not reliably predict quality loss or runtime gain, expert pruning is the dominant degradation source, and average quality can hide workload and architecture-specific failures. By releasing normalized module scores, compressed artifacts, and reproducible scripts, MoEXBench enables practical accuracy-memory-latency comparison across MoE families and hardware backends.
summary_zh: 本文提出MoEXBench，一套包含8个模块的评测套件，可在商用硬件上联合度量可组合压缩质量、工作负载与架构鲁棒性、剪枝/量化/KV缓存敏感度以及部署效率。研究结果揭示了压缩方法间存在非平凡的交互效应：可组合压缩的效果无法通过独立压缩技术的表现预测，仅靠压缩率无法可靠预测质量损失或运行时增益，专家剪枝是模型性能下降的主要来源，而平均质量指标会掩盖特定工作负载与特定架构下的失效问题。通过发布标准化模块得分、压缩后模型产物与可复现脚本，MoEXBench支持跨混合专家模型家族、跨硬件后端的精度-内存-延迟实用化对比。

title: MusPyExpress: Extending MusPy with Enhanced Expression Text Support
title_zh: MusPyExpress：扩展MusPy以支持增强型表达文本
authors: Phillip Long, Hao-Wen Dong, Julian McAuley, Zachary Novack
abstract: Current work in modeling symbolic music primarily relies on representations extracted from MIDI-like data. While such formats allow for modeling symbolic music as sequences of notes, they omit the large space of symbolic annotations common in western sheet music broadly known as expression text, such as tempo or dynamics, which specify time- and velocity-dependent controls on the musical composition and performance. To alleviate this gap, we present MusPyExpress, an extension to the popular symbolic music processing library MusPy that enables the extraction of expression text along with symbolic music for downstream modeling. Utilizing this extension, we parse the PDMX dataset to illustrate the wealth of expression text available in MusicXML datasets. Additionally, we introduce multiple generative tasks, including joint expression-note generation, expression-conditioned music generation, and expression tagging, that take advantage of this additional notational information.
summary_zh: 当前符号音乐建模工作主要依赖从类MIDI数据中提取的表征，这类格式可将符号音乐建模为音符序列，但遗漏了西方乐谱中广泛存在的一大类符号标注——即表达文本（expression text），例如速度、力度等用于指定音乐创作与表演中时间、速度相关控制的标注信息。为填补这一空白，本文提出MusPyExpress，它是主流符号音乐处理库MusPy的扩展，支持在提取符号音乐的同时提取表达文本，供下游建模使用。利用该扩展，本文解析了PDMX数据集，展示了MusicXML数据集中蕴含的丰富表达文本信息。此外，本文还提出了多类生成任务，包括表达-音符联合生成、表达条件化音乐生成、表达标注，充分利用这类额外的记谱信息。

title: Variational Structure at the Edge of Stability
title_zh: 稳定性边缘处的变分结构
authors: Eric Regis
abstract: When discrete-time optimizers operate at the edge of stability, they exhibit near-two-periodic behavior. These oscillatory dynamics are reminiscent of conservative systems, such as the dynamics generated by symplectic integrators. However, a precise formulation of the connection between discrete-time optimizers at the edge of stability and discrete mechanics remains underexplored. Recently, Litman introduced the "edge coupling": a functional on consecutive gradient descent iterates whose critical points encode the fixed points and two-point orbits of the gradient descent dynamics. Here we extend the edge coupling to heavy-ball and Nesterov momentum. We show that its critical points characterize the fixed points and two-point orbits, with its Hessian characterizing their stability. We also show that the edge coupling can be identified with the symmetric Verlet action, formalizing the connection between the edge of stability and discrete mechanics.
summary_zh: 当离散时间优化器运行在稳定性边缘（edge of stability）时，会表现出近似二周期行为，这类振荡动力学与辛积分器生成的保守系统动力学十分相似。但目前学界尚未充分探索运行在稳定性边缘的离散时间优化器与离散力学之间的精确关联形式。近期Litman提出了「边缘耦合」概念：定义在连续梯度下降迭代值上的泛函，其临界点可编码梯度下降动力学的不动点与两点轨道。本文将边缘耦合扩展到重球法与Nesterov动量场景下，证明其临界点可刻画不动点与两点轨道，其海森矩阵可刻画对应点的稳定性。本文还证明边缘耦合可与对称Verlet作用量等价，正式建立了稳定性边缘与离散力学之间的关联。

title: GeoQ: Geometry-Aware Conditional Quantile Error Estimation for Scientific Surrogate Models
title_zh: GeoQ：面向科学代理模型的几何感知条件分位数误差估计
authors: Khoa Nguyen, Daniel Serino, Aviral Prakash, Marc Klasky
abstract: Neural-network surrogate models are increasingly used to accelerate scientific simulations, but their deployment in extrapolative and autoregressive settings requires input-dependent estimates of prediction error. In this work, we introduce GeoQ (Geometry-Aware Conditional Quantile Error Estimation), a non-intrusive calibration framework for estimating surrogate error at individual query points. GeoQ represents the error at a query point as an anchor-averaged calibration error plus a learned nonnegative correction. This correction is modeled as an upper conditional quantile of the anchor-relative error increment, using geometry-based features that encode representation-space displacement and local support density. A cross-fitting procedure generates approximately out-of-sample calibration tuples, while a feature-space k-nearest-neighbor support score identifies regions \textcolor{black}{where the learned error model is supported by calibration data}. We evaluate GeoQ on scalar regression, chaotic dynamics, medium-range weather forecasting, and Richtmyer-Meshkov instability prediction. The results demonstrate that geometry-aware conditional quantile modeling provides a practical and non-intrusive approach for validity-aware error estimation in scientific surrogate models.
summary_zh: 神经网络代理模型被越来越多地用于加速科学仿真，但在外推、自回归场景下部署这类模型需要依赖输入的预测误差估计。本文提出GeoQ（Geometry-Aware Conditional Quantile Error Estimation，几何感知条件分位数误差估计），一种非侵入式校准框架，用于估计单个查询点处的代理模型误差。GeoQ将查询点处的误差表示为锚点平均校准误差与可学习非负修正项之和，该修正项基于编码表征空间位移与局部支持密度的几何特征，建模为锚点相对误差增量的上条件分位数。本文采用交叉拟合流程生成近似的样本外校准元组，同时通过特征空间k近邻支持分数识别校准数据可支撑的误差模型适用区域。本文在标量回归、混沌动力学、中期天气预报、瑞奇迈尔-梅什科夫不稳定性预测任务上对GeoQ进行评估，结果表明几何感知条件分位数建模可为科学代理模型提供实用的非侵入式误差估计方案，实现感知有效性的误差估计。

title: Piecewise Linear Equivariant Maps for Compact Groups
title_zh: ChequeMark：面向非营业时间企业存款欺诈检测的集成机器学习框架
authors: Valeriano Aiello
abstract: Motivated by equivariant neural networks, we study piecewise linear equivariant maps between finite-dimensional real representations of compact groups. We show that all genuinely non-linear piecewise linear behaviour is confined to the subspaces on which the identity component of the group acts trivially, while equivariance forces linearity on the corresponding orthogonal complements. As a consequence, we obtain a compact-group analogue of the finite-group existence criterion of Gibson--Tubbenhauer--Williamson for non-zero equivariant piecewise linear maps between irreducible representations, with the identity component giving rise to a rigidity phenomenon absent from the finite-group case.
summary_zh: 支票欺诈是非营业时间企业存款业务的重大风险：金融机构通常在1个工作日内释放资金，但支票清算流程需要数天时间，该时间差为金融机构带来了欺诈暴露窗口。现有缓解方案依赖静态的存款级校验，无法捕捉客户历史行为与不断演化的欺诈模式。为解决该问题，本文提出多视图集成机器学习框架，融合三类模型：用于识别已知欺诈模式的极端梯度提升（XGBoost）、用于无标签异常检测的孤立森林、用于提取交易活动关联模式的图采样与聚合（GraphSAGE），最终将三类模型的输出合并为单客户级风险得分。在稳定分布场景下，该框架性能与XGBoost相当；在定向分布偏移场景下，该框架表现最优（F1值83.77%，假阳性率0.69%），优于XGBoost（F1值82.77%，假阳性率0.72%）。结果表明该框架在保留基于行为、异常、关联证据的可解释性的同时，提升了对分布偏移的鲁棒性。

title: Large-Scale Evaluation of Advanced Imputation Methods for Missing Values in Smart Meter Data
title_zh: 面向智能电表数据缺失值的先进插补方法大规模评估
authors: Daniela Stojcheska, Marija Markovska, Dimitar Taskovski, Branislav Gerazov, Boris Nikolov
abstract: Accurate and reliable collection of electricity consumption data through Advanced Metering Infrastructure (AMI) is of great importance for the operation of smart grids, especially for the detection of non-technical losses (NTL). However, real-world datasets frequently suffer from missing values due to communication failures. This paper presents an empirical evaluation of three advanced algorithms for large-scale data imputation: the Optimally Weighted Average (OWA) method, Low-Rank Matrix Completion via SoftImpute, and a Shape-Modeling Autoencoder. Existing studies on missing value imputation in electricity consumption data often lack validation on larger datasets. Therefore, the goal of this paper is to validate the selected algorithms on a large-scale real-world electricity consumption dataset from North Macedonia that includes 17,428 commercial smart meters over two years. The robustness of each algorithm is evaluated by simulating continuous gaps in the data ranging from 1 to 168 hours. The results indicate that OWA provides the lowest overall reconstruction error across the evaluated gap sizes and strong stability in worst-case scenarios for gaps of up to one week. In contrast, the autoencoder exhibits higher variance, while SoftImpute has stable but inferior accuracy. These findings suggest that imputation methods should be selected based on the characteristics of load curve data and highlight the potential for hybrid algorithmic architectures in future grid management systems.
summary_zh: 通过高级计量基础设施（AMI）准确可靠采集用电数据对智能电网运行至关重要，尤其在非技术损耗（NTL）检测场景下作用突出。但真实场景数据集常因通信故障出现缺失值。本文针对三类先进大规模数据插补算法开展实证评估：最优加权平均（OWA）法、基于SoftImpute的低秩矩阵补全、形状建模自编码器。现有用电数据缺失值插补研究大多缺乏在大规模数据集上的验证，因此本文基于北马其顿包含17428台商用智能电表两年数据的大规模真实用电数据集，对所选算法进行验证。通过模拟时长1到168小时的连续数据缺失间隙，评估各算法的鲁棒性。结果表明，在所有评估的缺失间隙长度下，OWA的整体重建误差最低，且在最长一周的缺失间隙最坏场景下稳定性优异；自编码器的结果方差更高，而SoftImpute的表现稳定但精度更低。研究结论表明插补方法的选择需要结合负荷曲线数据的特征，也验证了未来电网管理系统采用混合算法架构的潜力。

title: ChequeMark: An Ensemble Machine Learning Framework for After-Hours Business Deposit Fraud Detection
authors: Ann Youduo Xu, Emily Yu, Justin Leski, William Lam
abstract: Cheque fraud is a material risk in after-hours business deposit operations because funds may be released within one business day, while cheque clearing takes several days. This timing gap creates a fraud exposure window for financial institutions. Prior mitigation relies on static, deposit-level checks and therefore miss historical client behavior and evolving patterns. To address this gap, we propose a multi-view ensemble ML framework that combines: Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost) for known fraud patterns, Isolation Forest for label-free anomaly detection, and Graph Sample and Aggregate (GraphSAGE) for relational patterns associated with transaction activities. We then combine the three outputs into a single client-level risk score. Under stable conditions, performance is comparable to XGBoost; under a targeted distribution shift, our framework performs best (F1: 83.77%, FPR: 0.69%) versus XGBoost (F1: 82.77%, FPR: 0.72%). These results indicate improved robustness to distribution shift while preserving interpretability through plain-language explanations grounded in behavioural, anomaly, and relational evidence.

title: Rethinking Communication Metrics: How Should We Measure Meaning?
title_zh: 重新思考通信指标：我们应当如何度量语义？
authors: Niloofar Tavakolian, Hakimeh Purmehdi, Jungyeon Baek
abstract: Semantic communication shifts the objective of communication systems from accurate symbol reconstruction toward meaning preservation, task accomplishment, and efficient information exchange. However, its evaluation remains fragmented across telecommunications, natural language processing, computer vision, and machine learning, and no single metric can characterize semantic quality across modalities, tasks, and channel conditions. This article surveys key performance indicators (KPIs) for text- and image-based semantic communication systems from a unified, evaluation-centered perspective. Unlike prior surveys primarily organized around architectures, applications, or transmission strategies, this work focuses on how semantic success should be defined and measured. Existing KPIs are classified according to communication goal, source modality, receiver output, reference availability, evaluation level, and channel or resource constraints. The survey reviews reconstruction-based, task-oriented, reference-free, representation-level, perceptual, and channel-aware metrics, and presents a cross-modality comparison of their roles, strengths, and limitations. It further analyzes how unresolved semantic-KPI challenges affect monitoring, quality assurance, resource optimization, fault diagnosis, and standardization. Key open problems include the absence of universal semantic success criteria and standardized semantic ground truth, semantic drift, limited reference-free evaluation, weak integration of machine-learning metrics with communication constraints, and the lack of relation-level and multimodal KPIs. Finally, future research directions are outlined toward standardized, interpretable, adaptive, task-aware, and communication-aware evaluation frameworks.
summary_zh: 语义通信将通信系统的目标从精确符号重建转向语义保留、任务完成与高效信息交换，但当前语义通信的评测工作分散在电信、自然语言处理、计算机视觉、机器学习多个领域，尚无单一指标可以跨模态、跨任务、跨信道条件表征语义质量。本文从统一的以评测为核心的视角，综述面向文本、图像的语义通信系统关键性能指标（KPI）。不同于现有以架构、应用、传输策略为核心的综述，本文聚焦于如何定义与度量语义成功，按照通信目标、源模态、接收端输出、参考数据可得性、评测层级、信道/资源约束对现有KPI进行分类，综述了基于重建的指标、面向任务的指标、无参考指标、表征级指标、感知指标、信道感知指标，跨模态对比了各类指标的作用、优势与局限性。本文进一步分析了当前语义KPI领域尚未解决的挑战对系统监控、质量保障、资源优化、故障诊断、标准化工作的影响，指出当前的核心开放问题包括缺乏通用语义成功准则与标准化语义真值、语义漂移问题、无参考评测能力不足、机器学习指标与通信约束的融合度低、缺乏关系级与多模态KPI，最后展望了面向标准化、可解释、自适应、任务感知、通信感知的评测框架的未来研究方向。

title: FrugalSOT - Frugal Search Over the Models
title_zh: FrugalSOT：面向模型的节俭搜索
authors: Pradheep P, Yuvanesh S, Harish KB, Keerthan Saai Reddy S, Joshva Devadas T, Naveenkumar J, Hemalatha K
abstract: In on-device NLP tasks, limited resources of embedded hardware, such as the Raspberry Pi 5, require efficient inference strategies. This paper introduces FrugalSOT (Frugal Search Over The Models), a resource-aware model selection architecture for on-device NLP inference. FrugalSOT estimates each request's complexity by extracting features such as prompt length, named entity density, and syntactic complexity. The request is first made to the least complex model that is likely to pass a relevance threshold. If the output of that model falls short of the threshold, the request is made to a more complex model. It is important to note that the relevance threshold undergoes continuous updates in the background. using past validation outcomes in an adaptation process using a low-pass filtering mechanism, thus imparting adaptation to changing input patterns. Experimental results achieved on a Raspberry Pi 5 show that FrugalSOT reduces average inference time and overall computational resource use to a significant extent compared to a single-model baseline approach, without compromising output relevance to the same extent as the most sophisticated model. These results confirm that adaptive model selection can enable efficient, high-quality natural language processing inference on limited devices.
summary_zh: 在端侧自然语言处理任务中，树莓派5等嵌入式硬件的资源受限，要求采用高效推理策略。本文提出FrugalSOT（Frugal Search Over The Models，模型节俭搜索），一种面向端侧NLP推理的资源感知模型选择架构。FrugalSOT通过提取提示长度、命名实体密度、句法复杂度等特征估计每个请求的复杂度，首先将请求发送给最轻量化、输出大概率满足相关性阈值的模型；若该模型的输出未达到阈值，则将请求转发给更复杂的模型。值得注意的是，相关性阈值会在后台基于历史验证结果，通过低通滤波机制持续更新，实现对输入模式变化的自适应。在树莓派5上开展的实验结果表明，与单模型基线方案相比，FrugalSOT可在不损失输出相关性（与最复杂模型的输出相关性相当）的前提下，大幅降低平均推理时间与整体计算资源占用，验证了自适应模型选择可在资源受限设备上实现高效高质量的自然语言处理推理。

title: Subzero matrix completion for sparse data analysis: large-scale learning of latent low-rank structure
title_zh: 用于稀疏数据分析的Subzero矩阵补全：潜在低秩结构的大规模学习
authors: Lawrence K. Saul, Ningyuan Huang, Dennis Bollweg, Jeff Soules, Diana C. Halikias
abstract: We investigate when a sparse nonnegative matrix can be recovered from a real-valued matrix of much lower rank by zeroing out its negative elements. The potential for such decompositions suggests a mathematical connection between sparsity and rank; we analyze a number of sparse matrices with this latent low-rank structure and use them to illustrate the geometric origins of this connection. Previous algorithms have discovered these decompositions via an alternating minimization over the factors of a low-rank matrix, but to do so, they have also needed to compute and store another matrix, neither sparse nor low-rank, that is the size of their product. We develop a stochastic, alternating least-squares algorithm that operates on smaller blocks of this dense matrix and scales as a result to much larger problems. We also show how to further accelerate this algorithm with sparse optimizations and customized CUDA kernels. As one example, we use the algorithm to analyze the sparse matrix of synaptic weights for the recently published $\textit{Drosphilia}$ connectome. The nonzero elements of this matrix, with 139,255 rows and columns, record the number of synapses between cells in the nervous system of a female fruit fly. Despite a slowly decaying spectrum of singular values, this matrix exhibits a latent low-rank structure that is predictive of cell categories across multiple levels of specificity.
summary_zh: 本文研究在何种条件下，可通过将实值低秩矩阵的负元素置零，恢复得到稀疏非负矩阵。这类分解的存在性揭示了稀疏性与秩之间的数学关联，本文分析了多类具备该潜在低秩结构的稀疏矩阵，阐释了该关联的几何起源。现有算法通过对低秩矩阵的因子进行交替最小化求解这类分解，但需要额外存储和计算一个与因子乘积尺寸相同的非稀疏非低秩矩阵，扩展性受限。本文提出一种随机交替最小二乘算法，仅在该稠密矩阵的子块上运算，可扩展到规模大得多的问题场景，同时通过稀疏优化与定制CUDA内核进一步加速算法。作为示例，本文使用该算法分析了近期公开的果蝇连接组的突触权重稀疏矩阵，该矩阵的行列数均为139255，非零元素记录了雌性果蝇神经系统中细胞之间的突触数量。尽管该矩阵的奇异值谱衰减缓慢，但其具备的潜在低秩结构可跨多个特异性层级预测细胞类别。

title: Separating Voice from Age in COPD Screening
title_zh: 慢性阻塞性肺疾病（COPD）筛查中语音特征与年龄因素的分离研究
authors: George P. Kafentzis, Nikoletta Arvaniti
abstract: Voice has been proposed as a low-cost screening signal for chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD). COPD is strongly age-associated and voice changes with age, thus such results admit a trivial alternative explanation. We re-evaluate a public sustained-phonation corpus ($1246$ recordings, $68$ participants) under a strictly participant-level protocol. We therefore evaluate on repeatedly drawn age-matched cohorts and report the discrimination achieved by the confounders themselves on those same cohorts. Where raw (unmodelled) age ($0.510$ $[0.469, 0.551]$) and raw gender ($0.479$) are both measured at chance, acoustic models excluding age retain ROC-AUC $0.717$ $[0.552, 0.859]$ and average precision $0.747$ $[0.581, 0.892]$ against a one-to-one baseline of $0.5$, whereas models containing age fall to $0.531$--$0.679$. The separation is reproduced by two further learners with fixed hyperparameters. Two findings have broader methodological implications: models trained with age transfer less effectively to an age-balanced target cohort than otherwise identical models trained without age, and fourteen classical voice-quality and perturbation measures achieve comparable discrimination to a $55$-dimensional combined representation. We conclude that a non-age acoustic signal is present, that confounding by recording conditions cannot be excluded from the released features, and that the evaluation protocol in standard use cannot distinguish these possibilities.
summary_zh: 语音已被提出作为慢性阻塞性肺疾病（Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease, COPD）的低成本筛查信号。由于COPD与年龄高度相关，且语音特征会随年龄变化，因此现有相关研究结果存在一个显而易见的替代性解释：筛查效果可能仅由年龄混淆因素驱动。本研究在严格的受试者级评估协议下重新验证了一个公开的持续发声语料库（包含1246条录音，共68名受试者）。研究通过多次抽取年龄匹配的队列开展评估，并报告混淆因素本身在相同队列上实现的区分度。实验结果显示，原始（未建模的）年龄的区分度为0.510 [0.469, 0.551]，原始性别的区分度为0.479，二者均处于随机猜测水平；排除年龄特征的声学模型的受试者工作特征曲线下面积（ROC-AUC）可达0.717 [0.552, 0.859]，平均精度为0.747 [0.581, 0.892]，显著优于0.5的一对一基线水平，而纳入年龄特征的模型性能仅为0.531~0.679。该分离效应在另外两个固定超参数的学习器上也得到了复现。两项研究结论具备更广泛的方法学意义：与未纳入年龄特征的同配置模型相比，使用年龄特征训练的模型向年龄平衡目标队列的迁移效果更差；14种经典语音质量与扰动指标可实现与55维组合表征相当的区分度。本研究证实存在不依赖年龄的声学信号，但无法排除发布特征中存在录音条件混淆的可能性，同时指出当前通用的评估协议无法区分这两种可能性。

title: Random Hazard Forests
title_zh: 随机风险森林（Random Hazard Forests, RHF）
authors: Hemant Ishwaran, Eileen M. Hsich, Udaya B. Kogalur, Donald K. K. Lee
abstract: Clinical data sources such as electronic health records and wearable sensors record patient status repeatedly over follow-up, often at irregular times and on different schedules for different measurements. These data create opportunities for continuously updated, individualized risk prediction. Existing approaches, however, often simplify the temporal structure before modeling it. We introduce Random Hazard Forests (RHF), a survival tree ensemble that learns how a patient's hazard changes in continuous time as new measurements become available. RHF formulates the estimation problem directly through a nonparametric hazard likelihood for predictable covariate processes. An efficient working model guides tree construction, after which flexible time-varying hazards are estimated for each terminal node. Given any predictable covariate path, each tree follows the path through its terminal nodes over time and assembles the corresponding node-level hazards into a trajectory. Averaging these trajectories across trees yields the RHF pathwise hazard estimate. Because routing at each time uses only the covariate state available immediately beforehand, RHF accommodates internal longitudinal covariates without lookahead. Simulations and an intensive care application show that RHF accurately estimates changing risk under irregular and asynchronous covariate updates.
summary_zh: 电子健康记录、可穿戴传感器等临床数据源会在随访过程中反复记录患者状态，不同测量项的采集时间往往不规则、采集周期也不统一。这类数据为实现持续更新的个体化风险预测提供了机遇，但现有方法通常会先简化时间结构再开展建模。本文提出随机风险森林（Random Hazard Forests, RHF），这是一种生存树集成模型，可在新测量数据可用时学习患者的风险率在连续时间内的变化规律。RHF直接针对可预测协变量过程构建非参数风险似然估计问题，通过高效的工作模型引导树结构构建，之后为每个终端节点估计灵活的时变风险率。对于任意可预测的协变量路径，每棵树都会随时间将路径映射到对应的终端节点，将节点级风险率组合为风险轨迹，对所有树的轨迹取平均即可得到RHF的路径级风险估计。由于每个时间点的路由过程仅使用该时间点之前已有的协变量状态，RHF可在不引入前瞻偏差的前提下适配内部纵向协变量。仿真实验与重症监护场景的应用结果表明，RHF可在协变量更新不规则、不同步的条件下精准估计动态变化的风险。

title: Reaching the Tail: Calibration Diversity Drives Conformal Coverage under Data Scarcity
title_zh: 触及尾部：数据稀缺场景下校准集多样性驱动共形覆盖率
authors: Donald Aadithiyan
abstract: Multi-horizon rare-event forecasting is hard under long macroeconomic series' data constraints: labeled events are scarce, and standard uncertainty quantification assumes an exchangeability that autocorrelation violates. A controlled ablation shows an apparent rare-event threshold for Adaptive Conformal Inference instead reflects calibration-set size. Across 200 random calibration sets, support width of the nonconformity-score distribution explains up to 85% of coverage variance versus 2% for rare-event count; the same, not the same magnitude, replicates across synthetic conditions and five countries (five-country Spearman $\rho$ 0.45-0.66 vs. 0.02-0.23). A diversity-maximizing selector built on this is the only strategy tested that improves long-horizon coverage (67.8% to 81.4% at six months); Mondrian, shift-robust, and extreme-value alternatives fail to close it. Mondrian even worsens coverage under oracle labels. A compact proposition explains why: coverage deficit reflects how closely the calibration set's upper quantile reaches the test distribution's. Diversity is necessary, not sufficient. Demonstrated on a two-stage U.S. recession-forecasting framework with RegressorChain, whether six-month coverage reaches 90% under honest scoring remains open, a question this paper quantifies rather than resolves.
summary_zh: 在长时序宏观经济序列的数据约束下，多视界稀有事件预测难度极大：带标注的稀有事件样本稀缺，且标准不确定性量化方法假设数据满足可交换性，而自相关性会违反该假设。受控消融实验表明，自适应共形推断（Adaptive Conformal Inference）中观测到的表观稀有事件阈值效应，实际上反映的是校准集大小的影响。在200个随机生成的校准集上，非一致性得分分布的支撑宽度最多可解释85%的覆盖率方差，而稀有事件数量仅能解释2%；该规律（而非相同的数值幅度）在合成数据场景与五个国家的真实数据中均得到复现（五国的斯皮尔曼ρ值为0.45~0.66，对应稀有事件数量的ρ值仅为0.02~0.23）。基于该规律构建的多样性最大化选择器是所有测试策略中唯一能提升长视界覆盖率的方法，可将6个月预测的覆盖率从67.8%提升至81.4%；而Mondrian共形推断、抗分布偏移共形推断、极值共形推断等替代方法均无法缩小覆盖率缺口，其中Mondrian方法在使用真值标签的场景下甚至会降低覆盖率。本文通过一个简洁的命题解释了背后的机制：覆盖率缺口反映了校准集的上分位数与测试分布上分位数的接近程度，多样性是实现高覆盖率的必要非充分条件。本研究在基于RegressorChain的两阶段美国衰退预测框架上开展验证，在诚实评分规则下6个月预测覆盖率能否达到90%仍是待解决的开放问题，本文对该问题进行了量化而非给出最终结论。

title: Predicting Early Functional Decline from Longitudinal Laboratory and Vital Sign Trajectories: A Large-Scale Study Using the All of Us Research Program
title_zh: 基于纵向实验室与生命体征轨迹预测早期功能衰退：一项使用全民研究计划（All of Us Research Program）的大规模研究
authors: Rashmita Kudamala, Aravind V. Kuruvikkattil, Lalitha Pranathi Pulavarthy, Saptarshi Purkayastha
abstract: Functional decline in older adults is typically recognized only after falls or observable gait impairment, closing the window for prevention. We investigated whether temporal trajectories of routine biomarkers, already recorded but rarely analyzed longitudinally, can identify patients in the pre-clinical phase of mobility decline. Using the All of Us Research Program (N = 297,861; 11.1% cases), we derived trajectory features (slope, variability, delta, mean) for twelve biomarkers over a three-year pre-index window. LightGBM models incorporating trajectories significantly outperformed static laboratory summaries (AUROC 0.797 vs. 0.755; DeLong p < 0.001; AUPRC 0.380 vs. 0.304). A 1:1 age- and sex-matched analysis confirmed an independent trajectory signal (AUROC 0.727 vs. demographics-only 0.680). A horizon analysis demonstrated sustained prediction 3-12 months before decline onset (AUROC 0.768-0.740). Because the model uses only measurements already ordered in routine care, it supports passive, zero-burden EHR integration for early detection of pre-clinical functional decline.
summary_zh: 老年人群的功能衰退通常仅在跌倒或出现明显步态障碍后才会被发现，此时已错过干预窗口。本研究探究常规生物标志物的时序轨迹（已被临床记录但极少被纵向分析）是否可识别处于移动能力衰退临床前阶段的患者。本研究使用全民研究计划（All of Us Research Program）的数据集（共297861名受试者，其中11.1%为功能衰退病例），在索引事件前的三年窗口内提取12项生物标志物的轨迹特征（斜率、变异性、变化量、均值）。融合轨迹特征的LightGBM模型性能显著优于仅使用实验室静态汇总特征的模型：受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）为0.797 vs 0.755，DeLong检验p<0.001，平均精度（AUPRC）为0.380 vs 0.304。1:1年龄与性别匹配分析证实轨迹特征携带独立于人口统计学因素的信号（AUROC 0.727 vs 仅人口统计学特征的0.680）。视界分析表明，该模型可在功能衰退发作前3~12个月实现稳定预测，AUROC保持在0.768~0.740区间。由于该模型仅使用常规诊疗中已开具的检测项，可实现零负担的电子健康记录（EHR）被动集成，用于临床前功能衰退的早期检测。

title: Neural Network Field Theory at Finite Width
title_zh: 有限宽度下的神经网络场论
authors: Christian Ferko, Aaron Mutchler
abstract: Under mild assumptions, any quantum mechanical (QM) model or quantum field theory (QFT) admits a representation in terms of an ensemble of neural networks with countably many random parameters. We investigate the features of NN-QM and NN-FT models with finitely many parameters, such as a feedforward network of width $N < \infty$. We find that, generically, such models must violate one of the properties of conventional Euclidean QFTs, such as reflection positivity or cluster decomposition. We present several complementary ways of understanding which features can and cannot be preserved at finite $N$, both in QM and in QFT.
summary_zh: 在温和假设下，任意量子力学（Quantum Mechanics, QM）模型或量子场论（Quantum Field Theory, QFT）都可表示为包含可数个随机参数的神经网络集成形式。本文研究参数数量有限的神经网络-量子力学（NN-QM）与神经网络-场论（NN-FT）模型的特性，例如宽度N<∞的前馈网络。研究发现，这类模型通常必然会违反传统欧几里得量子场论的某一项特性，例如反射正定性或团簇分解性。本文提出多种互补方法，阐释在有限宽度N下，量子力学与量子场论场景中哪些特性可以保留、哪些特性无法保留。

title: Reading the Room: Implicit Confusion Encoding in Recurrent World Model States
title_zh: 感知环境：循环世界模型状态中的隐式混淆编码
authors: Donald Aadithiyan
abstract: World models built on the RSSM architecture, such as DreamerV3, keep a recurrent hidden state $h_t$ trained only to reduce prediction error. We show this state also tracks its own confusion, hiding in plain sight: nearly orthogonal to $h_t$'s directions of greatest variance, invisible to any variance-based method. It is functionally distinct from ensemble disagreement, which flags new inputs, and reconstruction error, which flags bad predictions right now. On a test holding prediction error fixed while confusion varies, a linear probe on $h_t$ finds the signal (AUROC 0.72, 5 runs), while an ensemble baseline scores below chance. A discounted count of recent high-error steps explains 80% of the probe's output ($R^2=0.80$). We confirm the signal is causally used, not merely present, by editing $h_t$ directly and watching behaviour change, including a check using real values from other trajectories instead of synthetic edits. Its geometry and closed form generalize across three control tasks; the decisive dissociation test itself holds cleanly on only one, and its practical use, deciding when to check reality instead of trusting imagination, generalizes to only two of the three tasks.
summary_zh: 基于RSSM架构构建的世界模型（例如DreamerV3）会维护一个循环隐状态h_t，该状态的训练目标仅为最小化预测误差。本研究发现该隐状态还会追踪模型自身的混淆程度，该信息几乎与h_t的最大方差方向正交，所有基于方差的方法都无法检测到该信号。该信号在功能上与标记新输入的集成分歧、标记当前预测错误的重构误差均存在明显差异。在固定预测误差、仅改变混淆程度的测试场景下，对h_t训练的线性探针可检测到该信号（AUROC为0.72，5次重复实验），而集成基线模型的性能低于随机猜测水平。近期高误差步的折扣计数可解释探针输出80%的方差（R²=0.80）。本研究通过直接编辑h_t并观测行为变化（包括使用其他轨迹的真实值而非合成值开展对照实验），证实该混淆信号不仅存在，还会被模型因果性地使用。该信号的几何特性与闭式表达在三个控制任务中具备泛化性，但关键的解离测试仅在其中一个任务中完全成立，其实际用途（即判断何时应当校验现实而非信任模型的想象）仅能泛化到三个任务中的两个。

title: Sorting from Counterexamples
title_zh: 基于反例的排序
authors: Noga Alon, Shay Moran, Shlomo Moran
abstract: \Theta(n\log n + nk). \] Thus, while the noiseless complexity matches the classical complexity of sorting, each untruthful counterexample incurs an additional cost of order $n$. The upper bound is based on a geometric representation of permutations and Gr\"unbaum's theorem, while the lower bound combines sorting arguments with a Condorcet-type construction. We also study the case where the target ranking has a low-dimensional geometric representation: each item is represented by a point in $\mathbb{R}^d$, and the ranking is obtained by projecting the points onto an unknown direction. For these classes we give an upper bound of $O(d^2\log n+dk)$ and a lower bound of $\Omega(d\log n+dk)$, leaving a factor of $d$ gap in the noiseless term.
summary_zh: 本研究证明该场景下的计算复杂度为Θ(n log n + nk)：即无噪声场景下的复杂度与经典排序的复杂度一致，而每个错误反例会引入量级为n的额外开销。上界推导基于排列的几何表示与Grünbaum定理，下界推导则结合排序相关论证与孔多塞（Condorcet）式构造。本研究还探究了目标排序具备低维几何表示的场景：每个待排序项对应R^d空间中的一个点，排序结果由点向某个未知方向投影得到。针对这类排序问题，本文给出O(d² log n + dk)的复杂度上界与Ω(d log n + dk)的复杂度下界，无噪声项仍存在因子d的差距。

title: Loss-Parameterized Fisher Width Along Learning Trajectories
title_zh: 学习轨迹上以损失为参数的费希尔宽度
authors: Vu Khac Ky
abstract: \frac{\sqrt6}{\pi}\mathbb E[\chi_{d-1}]. \] Controlled full-Fisher experiments support the matched-loss branch and the population predictions. In a nonlinear MLP with a diagonal model-Fisher approximation, GD and SGD remain close at matched loss, whereas Adam follows a substantially displaced branch; the fixed probes tested retain highly similar temporal shapes. These results support a branchwise, rather than universal, loss parametrization of Fisher width.
summary_zh: 本研究推导得到理论结果为√6/π 乘以d-1自由度卡方分布的期望。受控全费希尔实验验证了匹配损失分支与总体层面的预测结论。在采用对角模型-费希尔近似的非线性多层感知机（MLP）中，梯度下降（GD）与随机梯度下降（SGD）在匹配损失条件下的轨迹始终接近，而Adam优化器的轨迹则处于明显偏离的分支；测试的固定探针的时序形状均高度相似。上述结果支持费希尔宽度采用分支式的损失参数化方式，而非全局统一的损失参数化方式。

title: Tensor Seeks Layout: Formalizing Layout Selection for ML Compilers
title_zh: 张量布局探索：面向机器学习编译器的布局选择形式化方法
authors: Clemens Eisenhofer, Yuwen Jia, Daniel Kroening, Sergey Pupyrev
abstract: The formulation unifies several existing layout optimization strategies, including XLA's layout assignment, partition dimension selection in systolic array compilers, and layout planning in mobile GPU optimizers. We implement the formalization in a production compiler for an AI accelerator and measure the execution time of the compiled models under greedy heuristics, the compiler's rule-based strategy, and an optimal solver. Simple heuristics degrade execution time by up to $5\times$ on some workloads. Where the compiler's cost model is accurate, the solver matches or beats the rule-based strategy. On workloads with complex data movement it falls behind, and since the solver minimizes the stated objective exactly, that gap isolates cost-model error from search quality, showing where compiler effort actually pays off.
summary_zh: 本文提出的形式化框架统一了多种现有布局优化策略，包括XLA的布局分配、脉动阵列编译器中的分区维度选择、移动GPU优化器中的布局规划。本研究将该形式化方法在面向AI加速器的生产级编译器中实现，分别在贪心启发式策略、编译器原有基于规则的策略、最优求解器三种模式下测量编译后模型的执行时间。实验结果显示，简单启发式策略在部分工作负载下会使执行时间最高提升5倍；当编译器的成本模型准确时，最优求解器的性能可达到甚至超过基于规则的策略；但在数据移动模式复杂的工作负载下，最优求解器的性能反而落后。由于最优求解器可精确最小化设定的目标函数，该性能差距可将成本模型误差与搜索质量误差分离开，明确编译器优化工作的实际收益点。

title: Sparse Separable Factor Analysis in the Complex Domain with an Application to Local Field Potential Data
title_zh: 复域稀疏可分因子分析及其在局部场电位数据中的应用
authors: Ian Hultman, Kirtikanth Kalapatapu, Yassine Filali, Rainbo Hultman, Sanvesh Srivastava
abstract: Complex-valued arrays arise in signal processing, where scientific interpretation depends on retaining amplitude and phase information. Existing covariance estimation methods either ignore the multiway organization of such data or rely on real-domain embeddings that do not directly exploit their complex structure. We develop sparse separable factor analysis (SSFA), a latent factor model for complex-valued arrays with a separable covariance structure across modes. Each mode-specific covariance matrix is modeled through a low-rank Hermitian factor structure and a diagonal residual covariance matrix. To obtain interpretable estimates, we impose elementwise lasso penalties on the complex loading matrices and estimate the SSFA parameters using a mode-wise parameter-expanded expectation-maximization procedure. The resulting loading updates admit closed-form complex soft-thresholding solutions, which shrink the modulus of each loading while preserving its phase. A separate balancing step resolves the scale nonidentifiability of the separable covariance structure. Simulation studies show that SSFA improves covariance estimation relative to vectorization-based methods, including complex principal component analysis. We apply SSFA to local field potential recordings from mice, where we compare separability structures induced by different groupings of brain region, frequency, and time and perform model-based imputation of recordings missing because of electrode misplacement.
summary_zh: 复值数组广泛存在于信号处理领域，这类数据的科学解释依赖于同时保留幅度与相位信息。现有协方差估计方法要么忽略这类数据的多维度结构，要么依赖实域嵌入，无法直接利用其复域特性。本文提出稀疏可分因子分析（Sparse Separable Factor Analysis, SSFA），这是一种面向复值数组的潜因子模型，可在不同模态上构建可分的协方差结构。每个模态对应的协方差矩阵通过低秩厄米特因子结构与对角残差协方差矩阵建模。为得到可解释的估计结果，本文对复载荷矩阵施加元素级套索（lasso）惩罚，采用模态级参数扩展期望最大化流程估计SSFA的参数。最终得到的载荷更新存在闭式复软阈值解，可在保留每个载荷相位的同时收缩其模值。额外的平衡步骤可解决可分协方差结构的尺度不可识别问题。仿真实验表明，与基于向量化的方法（包括复主成分分析）相比，SSFA可提升协方差估计精度。本研究将SSFA应用于小鼠的局部场电位记录数据，对比了由脑区、频率、时间的不同分组方式诱导的可分性结构，并针对电极放置错位导致的缺失记录开展了基于模型的插补。

title: Beyond Sparse Weights: When Is Attention Compressible?
title_zh: 超越稀疏权重：注意力何时具备可压缩性？
authors: Chiwun Yang, Xiaoyu Li
abstract: KV-cache compression is often justified by attention maps with a few large weights. This is incomplete: large weights may not contain most of the mass, omitted values can cancel, and preserving the attention output may not preserve the task. We separate these questions. Global score gaps -- not threshold counts -- determine how many tokens are needed to retain a target mass. For a realized row, the weighted sum of omitted values is the exact missing statistic. A controlled retrieval--aggregation model explains when truncation helps and when it hurts. These results motivate CertKV, a training-free compressor that reserves one tail-summary slot per head and allocates the rest by value dispersion. Under matched budgets, CertKV is top-two in seven of nine LongBench-v2 settings, remains in the leading compressed tier on 128K RULER, and realizes a ten-fold cache budget in a packed Llama prototype. Compressibility depends on the mass, values, future queries, and task -- not on a sparse-looking map alone.
summary_zh: KV缓存（KV-cache）压缩通常以注意力图存在少量大权重作为合理性依据，这一认知并不完备：大权重未必包含绝大多数的质量，被省略的值可能相互抵消，且保留注意力输出也未必能保留下游任务性能。本文对上述问题进行了区分研究：决定保留目标质量所需token数量的是全局分数差，而非阈值计数。对于已实现的注意力行，被省略值的加权和就是精确的缺失统计量。一个受控的检索-聚合模型可解释截断操作何时有益、何时有害。基于上述研究结果，本文提出CertKV（无训练压缩器），该方法为每个注意力头预留1个尾部摘要槽位，其余槽位按值的离散度分配。在相同缓存预算下，CertKV在LongBench-v2的9项设置中有7项位列前二，在128K RULER基准测试中处于领先的压缩方法梯队，且在打包后的Llama原型中可实现10倍的缓存预算提升。注意力的可压缩性取决于质量、取值、未来查询和任务，而非仅由看似稀疏的注意力图决定。

title: Federated Continual Learning as a Distributed Drift-Plus-Penalty Control Problem
title_zh: 联邦持续学习作为分布式漂移加惩罚控制问题
authors: Nazreen Shah, Naveen Kumar Reddy Somireddy, Zubair Shaban, Ranjitha Prasad, B. N. Bharath
abstract: Federated Continual Learning (FCL) is fundamental to real-world distributed learning systems, requiring models to adapt to sequential, non-IID data across clients while mitigating catastrophic forgetting and client drift. Existing approaches formulate continual learning (CL) as a sequence of per-task optimization problems, applied locally at each client and coupled through aggregation, using heuristic mechanisms such as replay, regularization, or projection-based constraints. However, forgetting in FCL is inherently a long-term, distributed phenomenon, arising from the interaction of temporal task evolution and cross-client heterogeneity, which is not explicitly regulated. In this work, we cast FCL as a stochastic control problem and propose Federated Queue-regulated Continual Learning (FedQCL), a framework based on Lyapunov drift-plus-penalty (DPP) optimization. FedQCL introduces virtual queues to track the accumulation of forgetting across tasks and clients, enabling explicit control of the stability-plasticity trade-off. By optimizing a DPP objective, the method jointly improves current-task performance while the queue-based formulation provides an interpretable and tunable mechanism to balance adaptation and retention through a single parameter, without requiring gradient projection or additional communication overhead. Empirical evaluations on standard benchmarks, including Split-CIFAR-10, Split-CIFAR-100, and Split-TinyImageNet, demonstrate that FedQCL outperforms state-of-the-art baselines with respect to accuracy while significantly reducing forgetting under heterogeneous data distributions.
summary_zh: 联邦持续学习（Federated Continual Learning, FCL）是现实世界分布式学习系统的核心技术，要求模型适配跨客户端的序列非独立同分布（non-IID）数据，同时缓解灾难性遗忘和客户端漂移问题。现有方法将持续学习（Continual Learning, CL）建模为一系列单任务优化问题，在每个客户端本地执行后通过聚合耦合，采用回放、正则化或基于投影的约束等启发式机制。但联邦持续学习中的遗忘本质上是一种长期分布式现象，由时序任务演化和跨客户端异质性的交互作用产生，现有方法并未对其进行显式调控。本工作将FCL转化为随机控制问题，提出FedQCL（基于李雅普诺夫漂移加惩罚（Lyapunov drift-plus-penalty, DPP）优化的联邦队列调控持续学习框架）。FedQCL引入虚拟队列跟踪跨任务、跨客户端的遗忘累积，可显式控制稳定性-可塑性权衡。通过优化DPP目标，该方法可同时提升当前任务性能，且基于队列的公式提供了可解释、可调节的机制，仅通过单个参数即可平衡适配能力与记忆保留能力，无需梯度投影也不会产生额外通信开销。在Split-CIFAR-10、Split-CIFAR-100、Split-TinyImageNet等标准基准上的实验评估表明，FedQCL在异质数据分布下的准确率优于当前最优基线，同时可显著降低遗忘程度。

title: Multimodal Injury Risk and Performance Prediction in Tennis Using Weighted Ensemble Learning
title_zh: 基于加权集成学习的网球多模态运动损伤风险与运动表现预测
authors: Weihao Qu, Dongyang Wang, Ling Zheng, Francisco E. Alvarez, Shobharani Polasa, Jiacun Wang
abstract: Machine learning has had a positive impact on the sports industry, with one of its most promising applications being the prediction of athlete performance and injury risk. Recent advances have employed state-of-the-art models to improve prediction accuracy, yet progress remains limited by data availability and the reliance on subjective observations or expert assessments. To address these limitations, researchers in sports such as soccer, basketball, and wrestling have begun integrating heterogeneous data sources, such as wearable device readings, with traditional subjective assessments. However, similar multimodal approaches remain underexplored in tennis. In this work, we propose a multimodal weighted ensemble learning framework, Predictive Athlete Readiness for Tennis (PART), to monitor athlete wellness and estimate near-term injury risk in tennis players. PART processes a wide range of inputs, including physiological metrics, training and match data, sleep information from wearable devices, self-reported questionnaires, vertical jump assessments, and motion analysis from match-play videos. From these modalities, specialized machine learning and deep learning models independently extract four athlete-specific characteristics: overall wellness, injury risk, physical capability, and playing style. To overcome the complexity of combining these diverse modalities, PART employs a supervised weighted ensemble integration strategy, assigning adaptive weights to each predictive model based on its reliability. Evaluation of multimodal data collected from nine collegiate tennis players demonstrates that PART achieves strong performance in monitoring athlete wellness and estimating near-term injury susceptibility. Beyond collegiate athletes, the framework also shows promise for recreational tennis players, offering personalized insights to mitigate injury risk and optimize performance.
summary_zh: 机器学习已对体育产业产生积极影响，其中最具前景的应用方向之一就是运动员运动表现与损伤风险预测。现有研究已采用当前最优模型提升预测准确率，但该方向的进展仍受限于数据可得性，以及对主观观测或专家评估的依赖。为解决上述局限，足球、篮球、摔跤等项目的研究人员已开始整合可穿戴设备读数等异质数据源与传统主观评估方法，但网球领域的同类多模态方法仍有待深入探索。本工作提出面向网球的多模态加权集成学习框架PART（Predictive Athlete Readiness for Tennis，网球运动员状态预测框架），用于监测网球运动员的健康状态并预估其短期损伤风险。PART可处理多类输入数据，包括生理指标、训练与比赛数据、可穿戴设备采集的睡眠信息、自我报告问卷、纵跳评估数据以及比赛视频的运动分析结果。基于这些多模态数据，专用机器学习和深度学习模型可独立提取四类运动员特征：整体健康状态、损伤风险、体能水平和比赛风格。为解决多模态融合的复杂度问题，PART采用有监督加权集成融合策略，根据各预测模型的可靠性为其分配自适应权重。基于9名大学网球运动员采集的多模态数据开展的评估实验表明，PART在运动员健康状态监测和短期损伤易感性预估任务中表现优异。除大学运动员外，该框架对业余网球运动员也具备应用潜力，可提供个性化参考建议以降低损伤风险、优化运动表现。

title: What Neural Network Field Theory Can and Cannot Realise on a Computer
title_zh: 神经网络场论在计算机上可实现与不可实现的边界
authors: Thomas R. Harvey
abstract: One aim of neural network field theory is to put a quantum or effective field theory on a computer, with the network ensemble itself as the theory. We ask how far that aim can be pushed for a function class regular enough to be computed with. Our main result is a no-go theorem with assumptions that hold for standard network architectures. We use it to separate four versions of neural network field theory, according to whether the defining object is the finite width ensemble or its infinite width limit, and whether the target we want to compute is a quantum or an effective field theory. Neither finite width interpretation is straightforwardly consistent. For finite width ensembles with finite variance at each point, the QFT interpretation fails reflection positivity, while the EFT interpretation establishes no scale separation by which the positivity violation can be placed outside its domain of validity. Of the two limit versions, one can be simulated in full and the other only in part, as only its smeared correlators are computable with a controlled error. As such, at the level of a controlled numerical computation, the QFT and EFT versions cannot be distinguished. One dimension escapes the obstruction, yet reflection positivity is shown to still fail there at every finite width for the cosine network. Two escapes from the theorem remain, giving up either finite variance at a point or exact rotation invariance, and we discuss both of these possibilities.
summary_zh: 神经网络场论的目标之一是将量子场论或有效场论在计算机上实现，其中网络系综本身即为该场论。本文针对足够规则、可计算的函数类，探究该目标可实现的上限。本文的核心结论是一个适用于标准网络架构的不可行定理。基于该定理，我们根据定义对象是有限宽度系综还是其无限宽度极限、目标计算对象是量子场论还是有效场论，将神经网络场论划分为四类。两类有限宽度的解释都无法直接自洽：对于每一点处方差有限的有限宽度系综，其量子场论解释无法满足反射正定性，而其有效场论解释不存在可将正定性违背置于其有效域之外的尺度分离。两类极限版本中，一类可完全模拟，另一类仅能部分模拟，仅其平滑关联函数可在可控误差下完成计算。因此，在可控数值计算层面，量子场论版本和有效场论版本无法被区分。存在一个维度可规避该阻碍，但研究表明对于余弦网络，在任意有限宽度下反射正定性仍然不成立。该定理仍存在两个可突破的方向：放弃单点有限方差假设，或放弃严格旋转不变性，本文对这两种可能性均展开了讨论。

title: ChemDIRT: A Diversified Instruction, Representation, and Task Benchmark for Robust Chemistry-LLM Evaluation
title_zh: ChemDIRT：面向鲁棒化学大语言模型评估的多样化指令、表征与任务基准
authors: Eric Inae, Tim Gunn, Chris Bond, Meng Jiang
abstract: The rapid advancement of large language models (LLMs) has led to increasing interest in their application to scientific domains such as chemistry. However, existing chemistry benchmarks often provide only a narrow view of model capability, focusing on limited task sets while overlooking robustness to variations in problem formulation and chemical representation. As a result, reported performance may overestimate a model's true ability to reason consistently across realistic settings. To address this challenge, we introduce ChemDIRT (Diversified Instruction, Representation, and Task Benchmark), a comprehensive evaluation framework designed to assess the robustness of chemical reasoning in LLMs. ChemDIRT systematically measures model performance across variations in instructions and molecular representations while spanning eight categories of chemistry tasks. By evaluating both accuracy and consistency under these controlled perturbations, ChemDIRT provides a more reliable assessment of model reasoning capabilities than conventional single-format benchmarks. We benchmark a diverse set of open- and closed-source LLMs, revealing substantial prompt sensitivity, representation dependence, and uneven performance across task families.
summary_zh: 大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）的快速发展推动了其在化学等科学领域的应用研究。但现有化学基准通常仅能反映模型能力的局部维度，聚焦于有限的任务集，忽略了模型对问题表述变化和化学表征变化的鲁棒性。这导致现有研究报告的性能可能高估了模型在真实场景下保持一致推理的实际能力。为解决该问题，本文提出ChemDIRT（Diversified Instruction, Representation, and Task Benchmark，多样化指令、表征与任务基准），这一综合评估框架用于评估大语言模型化学推理的鲁棒性。ChemDIRT覆盖8大类化学任务，可系统测量模型在指令变化和分子表征变化下的性能表现。通过在上述可控扰动下同时评估准确率和一致性，ChemDIRT相比传统单格式基准可提供更可靠的模型推理能力评估结果。本文对一系列开源和闭源大语言模型开展基准测试，发现现有模型普遍存在显著的提示敏感性、表征依赖性，且在不同任务类别上的性能表现不均衡。

title: BeTaL-GBI: Admission-Aware Benchmark Tuning and Full-Stack Verification of Geometric Belief Interfaces
title_zh: BeTaL-GBI：具备准入感知的几何信念接口基准调优与全栈验证
authors: Alvin Spivey, Yu Huang
abstract: Third, GBI-DCSE v3 maps 99 claims to machine-readable evidence: 95 of 96 testable claims pass, with 148 standalone checks executed without failure. The harness exercises signed ledgers, PBFT quorums, and enclave forgery across 62 configurations. Under synthetic conditions, GBI-DCSE is a selective, policy-versioned, self-auditing test and routing substrate.
summary_zh: 第三，GBI-DCSE v3可将99项声明映射为机器可读证据：96项可测试声明中有95项通过验证，148项独立检查全部执行成功。该测试框架在62种配置下完成了签名账本、PBFT（实用拜占庭容错）法定人数和飞地伪造的测试。在合成场景下，GBI-DCSE是具备选择性、策略版本化、自审计能力的测试与路由底层系统。

title: The geometry of AI validation: Exact certification limits for iid best-of-N search
title_zh: AI验证的几何：独立同分布N选优搜索的精确认证边界
authors: Ricardo Fitas
abstract: AI systems increasingly generate alternatives, inspect evidence, and deploy a selected output. Validation is therefore target-relative: evidence certifies deployment only in directions resolved by the interventions that produced it. We represent validation and deployment rules as kernels over a reliability surface. Their span geometry separates replication, which reduces sampling noise, from new intervention directions, which reduce structural blindness. We make this principle exact for iid best-of-$N$ search. Under scalar ranking, randomized ties, maximum selection, bounded binary truth, and a stable rank-truth relation, knowing best-of-$n$ reliability through $n=m$ leaves exact ambiguity width $B_{m,N}=1+2\sum_{r=1}^{m}(-1)^r\cos^{2N}{r\pi/[2(m+1)]}$. Explicit bounded worlds attain the entire interval, and the complete prefix is information-maximal among reliability-mean audits confined to $n\le m$. The governing scale is $m^2/N$: when $m$ is proportional to $\sqrt{N}$, ambiguity remains about 0.83, while width $\varepsilon$ requires $m$ of order $\sqrt{N\log(1/\varepsilon)}$. Monotonicity gives an exact uniform-approximation frontier; a Lipschitz bound gives an exact capped-tail dual and order-sharp $L/m^2$ ambiguity. These results yield a two-gate audit rule: establish structural coverage, then add independent tasks for precision. Retrospective studies of mathematical reasoning and code selection construct compatible deployment values with wide separation and show that a score-tail audit rule frozen on 82 discovery tasks substantially reduces held-out error. Beyond iid search, the geometry applies only to known or independently estimated kernels; the empirical analyses are illustrative rather than prospective interventions.
summary_zh: 当前AI系统越来越多地生成多个备选方案、核验证据并部署选定的输出。因此验证是目标相对的：证据仅能在生成该证据的干预所覆盖的方向上，对部署行为进行认证。本文将验证和部署规则表示为可靠性曲面上的核函数。其张成空间的几何特性可将降低采样噪声的复制操作，与降低结构盲区的新干预方向区分开。本文针对独立同分布的N选优搜索，将该原理严格化。在标量排序、随机平局、最大值选择、有界二元真值、稳定排序-真值关系的设定下，当已知n=m时的N选优可靠性，可得到精确的歧义宽度B_{m,N}=1+2∑_{r=1}^{m}(-1)^r cos^{2N}{rπ/[2(m+1)]}。显式有界世界可覆盖整个区间，且该完整前缀是n≤m的可靠性均值审计中信息最大的形式。核心控制尺度为m²/N：当m与√N成正比时，歧义值约为0.83；若要将歧义宽度控制为ε，则m的量级需达到√(N log(1/ε))。单调性可推导出精确的一致近似边界；Lipschitz界可推导出精确的截尾对偶形式，以及阶数严格为L/m²的歧义值。基于上述结果，本文提出双门审计规则：先建立结构覆盖度，再添加独立任务以提升精度。针对数学推理和代码选择的回溯研究构建了具备广泛分离度的兼容部署值，结果表明基于82项发现任务固定的分数尾部审计规则可大幅降低留出集误差。除独立同分布搜索外，该几何框架仅适用于已知核函数或可独立估计核函数的场景，本文的实证分析仅作示例用途，不代表前瞻性干预方案。

title: Retrieval Needs Multivectors: An Exponential Separation
title_zh: 检索需要多向量：指数级分离下界
authors: Mihir Agarwal, Viraj Agrawal, Sabyasachi Basu, Ankit Garg, Kirankumar Shiragur
abstract: Motivated by our theoretical construction, we introduce ANDOR, a new retrieval benchmark that naturally instantiates these hard examples. We show that state-of-the-art single-vector embedding models perform poorly on ANDOR in the zero-shot setting and exhibit only marginal improvements after fine-tuning, highlighting the inherent difficulty of the benchmark compared to prior work. In contrast, multi-vector models consistently outperform their single-vector counterparts and improve substantially with fine-tuning, closely aligning with our theoretical predictions.
summary_zh: 受理论推导结论的启发，本文提出ANDOR这一全新检索基准，可自然生成上述难例样本。实验表明，当前最优的单向量嵌入模型在零样本设置下的ANDOR基准上表现不佳，经过微调后性能提升也十分有限，凸显了该基准相比现有工作的固有难度。与之相比，多向量模型的性能始终优于单向量模型，且经过微调后性能可大幅提升，与本文的理论预测高度吻合。

title: Congruence Decomposition with Neural Block Solvers for Large-Scale PCI Assignment
title_zh: 面向大规模物理小区标识分配的结合神经块求解器的同余分解方法
authors: Yeqing Qiu, Chengpiao Huang, Ye Xue, Akang Wang, Fan Xu, Zhipeng Jiang, Dong Zhang, Ruoyu Sun, Qingjiang Shi, Zhi-Quan Luo
abstract: Physical Cell Identity (PCI) assignment is essential for interference management in dense 5G networks. As cellular networks scale, PCI reuse becomes unavoidable, which may cause collisions, confusions, and multiple forms of modular interference. Jointly mitigating these effects gives rise to a large-scale, multi-objective combinatorial optimization problem that is difficult to solve efficiently at practical network scales. In this work, we propose a congruence decomposition framework with neural block solvers for large-scale PCI assignment. The proposed decomposition exploits the arithmetic structure of PCI values to decouple multiple modular interference objectives into a collection of blockwise Min-$k$-Partition subproblems, followed by a graph coloring procedure to resolve PCI conflicts. For the resulting NP-hard Min-$k$-Partition subproblems, we develop neural block solvers by parameterizing their relaxed quadratic formulations with graph neural networks, enabling efficient optimization at large scales. Discrete assignments are recovered through conditional expectation rounding with theoretical guarantees. Experiments on synthetic cellular graphs and real-world 5G networks show that the proposed method consistently outperforms existing modular-interference-aware baselines in modular interference reduction, conflict elimination, and computational efficiency.
summary_zh: 物理小区标识（Physical Cell Identity, PCI）分配是高密度5G网络干扰管理的核心环节。随着蜂窝网络规模扩张，PCI复用不可避免，可能引发冲突、混淆以及多种形式的模干扰。同时缓解上述问题会产生一个大规模多目标组合优化问题，在实际网络规模下难以高效求解。本工作提出面向大规模PCI分配的结合神经块求解器的同余分解框架。该方法利用PCI值的算术结构，将多个模干扰目标解耦为一系列分块Min-k-Partition子问题，随后通过图着色流程解决PCI冲突。针对得到的NP难Min-k-Partition子问题，本文通过图神经网络对其松弛后的二次公式进行参数化，开发了神经块求解器，可实现大规模下的高效优化。通过带理论保证的条件期望舍入操作恢复离散分配结果。在合成蜂窝图和真实5G网络上开展的实验表明，所提方法在模干扰降低、冲突消除和计算效率方面始终优于现有考虑模干扰的基线方法。

title: A Data-Driven Approach to State Construction in Markov Models
title_zh: 马尔可夫模型中状态构建的数据驱动方法
authors: Linde Van Gestel, Marie-Anne Guerry, Evy Rombaut
abstract: A Markov chain is a widely used stochastic process modelling random events over time. These models are built on subsets of the entire dataset, referred to as states, which are considered to be homogeneous regarding transition probabilities. However, the creation of these states is often disregarded or based on prior assumption, potentially violating the homogeneity requirement and thus decreasing the validity and predictive power of the model. In order to fill this gap, this paper combines supervised feature selection with unsupervised learning techniques for data-driven state construction. Density-based clustering, spectral clustering, and Kohonen self-organizing maps are examined for their ability to identify latent groups without prior assumptions. The contribution of this study is twofold. First, the paper presents a methodological framework for state construction incorporating suitable unsupervised learning techniques, with appropriate measures both for classification performance and Markov model accuracy. Secondly, the framework is tested on an application, resulting in a comparative analysis showing that spectral clustering and Kohonen self-organizing maps are best at capturing inherent structure. These results serve as a cornerstone in providing theoretical and methodological guidance for improving state definition in applied Markov modelling.
summary_zh: 马尔可夫链是广泛用于对时序随机事件建模的随机过程。这类模型基于整个数据集的子集（即状态）构建，假设所有状态在转移概率层面具备同质性。但现有研究往往忽略状态构建环节，或基于先验假设完成状态构建，可能违背同质性要求，进而降低模型的有效性和预测能力。为填补这一研究空白，本文将有监督特征选择与无监督学习技术相结合，实现数据驱动的状态构建。本文考察了基于密度的聚类、谱聚类和Kohonen自组织映射在无先验假设前提下识别潜在分组的能力。本研究的贡献分为两方面：首先，本文提出了一套状态构建方法框架，整合了适用的无监督学习技术，同时配套了针对分类性能和马尔可夫模型准确率的评估指标；其次，本文在实际应用场景下对该框架进行测试，对比分析结果表明，谱聚类和Kohonen自组织映射最擅长捕捉数据的内在结构。上述研究结果可为提升应用类马尔可夫建模中的状态定义质量提供理论和方法层面的指导。

title: Magnitude Homology Is the Associated Graded of the Length Filtration
title_zh: 量级同调是长度滤过的相伴分次
authors: Luciano Melodia
abstract: Magnitude homology is graded by length and knows nothing of persistence. Its persistent refinement knows nothing of where its bars begin and end. We show that the two are one construction: filtering the length nerve by sublevel sets of the length yields the persistence module, and the associated graded of that filtration is the magnitude complex. A long exact sequence exchanges them, and each side gains what it lacked. Magnitude homology locates the critical values of the barcode, so a graded computation lists the lengths at which an endpoint can occur, and the barcode acquires a stability estimate of $(n+1)\delta$ in degree $n$ under a perturbation of size $\delta$, while a computed perturbation moves a barcode by more than $\delta$, so the factor cannot be dropped. We apply this to quantitative equational theories, whose free algebras are metric spaces built from syntax: an inclusion of theories induces a morphism of the presenting monads and a comparison of barcodes with an explicit bound, so the invariant measures axiomatic strength. Four examples are computed, one in every degree.
summary_zh: 量级同调（Magnitude Homology）以长度为分次维度，不涉及持久性相关信息；其持久性改进版本则完全不关注条形码的起止位置。本文证明二者本质上属于同一构造：通过长度的次水平集对长度神经进行滤过可得到持久性模，而该滤过的相伴分次即为量级复形。二者可通过一条长正合序列实现转换，各自补足了对方缺失的特性。量级同调可定位条形码的临界值，因此通过分次计算即可枚举端点可能出现的所有长度；当存在大小为δ的扰动时，n次维度下的条形码可获得(n+1)δ的稳定性估计，而现有计算扰动会使条形码偏移量超过δ，因此该系数无法被省略。本文将该结论应用于定量等式理论，这类理论的自由代数是由语法构建的度量空间：理论间的包含关系可诱导呈现单子的态射，以及带显式边界的条形码对比，因此该不变量可用于度量公理强度。本文共计算了4个示例，每个分次维度各1个。

title: Explainable Adaptive Zero Trust Framework for AWS with Adversarial Robustness Evaluation
title_zh: 面向AWS（亚马逊云科技）的可解释自适应零信任框架及对抗鲁棒性评估
authors: Om Singh, Yagyaraj Pandey, Nandini Pathak
abstract: Experiments on an 8,500-record synthetic CloudTrail dataset show that Isolation Forest achieves 94.4% precision, 91.2% recall, and an F1 score of 0.928. Across the four adversarial scenarios, the mean detection rate is 91.0%, with behavioral mimicry being the most difficult at 83.9%. SHAP analysis identifies IP reputation, login-time deviation, and API call velocity as the three dominant features. A structured NIST SP 800-207 self-assessment gives EAZTF a mean compliance score of 93%, compared with 38% for a traditional perimeter baseline. Mean time to detect decreases from hours to under one minute. Because the evaluation uses synthetic data, these results should be interpreted as indicative rather than validated production performance.
summary_zh: 基于包含8500条记录的合成CloudTrail（云追踪）数据集开展的实验显示，孤立森林（Isolation Forest）算法的精确率可达94.4%、召回率达91.2%，F1值为0.928。在四类对抗场景下，平均检测率为91.0%，其中行为模仿场景的检测难度最高，检测率仅为83.9%。SHAP（SHapley加性解释）分析识别出IP信誉、登录时间偏差、API调用速率为三大主导特征。基于NIST SP 800-207标准开展的结构化自评估显示，EAZTF框架的平均合规得分为93%，而传统边界基线方案的合规得分仅为38%。平均检测耗时从小时级降低至1分钟以内。由于本次评估使用的是合成数据，相关结果仅可作为参考性结论，不能等同于经过验证的生产环境性能。

title: Class-Conditioned Gaussian Mixture Modeling for Imbalanced Time Series Quantification
title_zh: 面向不平衡时间序列量化的类条件高斯混合建模
authors: Md Shahriar Kabir, Mayesha Maliha R. Mithila, Anne H. H. Ngu, Myl\`ene C. Q. Farias, Byron Gao
abstract: Quantification, estimating class prevalences in bags of unlabeled instances is vital in domains where aggregate statistics are more important than individual instance labels, such as biosignal monitoring, fall detection, and activity recognition. We investigate this issue in the challenging setting of imbalanced time series data and develop CC-GMNet-TS, a class-conditioned Gaussian mixture quantifier that combines a Transformer-based feature extractor with per-class latent mixtures. Unlike previous mixture-based quantifiers, which use a single Gaussian mixture shared by all classes, CC-GMNet-TS assigns each class its own compact mixture in a bounded latent space and scores segment embeddings against these class-specific components to create bag-level representations that emphasize rare but informative patterns. Bags are constructed from labeled pools using the Artificial Prevalence Protocol (APP) and prior shift bag sampling (PShift) to cover a wide range of class prevalence scenarios, and the model is trained end-to-end with a quantification-oriented loss. Experiments on three benchmarks: EMG Data for Gestures, SmartFallMM, and UCI-HAR show that CC-GMNet-TS achieves lower error across the three benchmarks compared to traditional aggregators and recent deep quantifiers, while ablations confirm the contributions of both the Transformer backbone and class-conditioned mixtures during PShift.
summary_zh: 量化任务即估计无标签实例包中的类占比，在聚合统计量比单个实例标签更重要的领域（如生物信号监测、跌倒检测、活动识别）中至关重要。本文针对极具挑战性的不平衡时间序列数据场景开展研究，提出CC-GMNet-TS（类条件高斯混合量化网络-时间序列），该类条件高斯混合量化器将基于Transformer的特征提取器与每类专属的潜在混合模型相结合。不同于以往所有类共享单个高斯混合的混合类量化器，CC-GMNet-TS在有界潜在空间中为每个类分配独立的紧凑混合结构，通过将片段嵌入与这些类专属组件进行打分，生成可突出稀有高价值模式的包级表示。研究通过人工流行度协议（APP）和先验偏移包采样（PShift）从标注池中构建包，覆盖大范围的类占比场景，同时采用面向量化任务的损失函数对模型进行端到端训练。在手势肌电数据集、SmartFallMM智能跌倒多模态数据集、UCI-HAR人类活动识别数据集三个基准上开展的实验表明，与传统聚合器和近期提出的深度量化器相比，CC-GMNet-TS在三个基准上的误差均更低，消融实验也验证了Transformer骨干网络和类条件混合结构在PShift场景下的贡献。

title: Gauss--Hermite Quadrature for Gaussian-Mixture Entropy with an Action-Space Hermite Surrogate
title_zh: 结合动作空间Hermite代理的高斯混合熵高斯-厄米特求积法
authors: Jae Wan Shim
abstract: For repeated optimization over continuous actions, we also propose a Hermite polynomial surrogate in action space. In a radar pointing benchmark, its second-order form achieves substantially lower surrogate error and optimizer regret than a second-order Taylor surrogate based on local derivatives at the nominal action, while both methods use nine direct objective evaluations per replanning step. The Hermite surrogate also improves pointing performance in the tested benchmark.
summary_zh: 针对连续动作下的重复优化场景，本文还提出了动作空间内的Hermite多项式代理模型。在雷达指向基准测试中，该二阶形式的代理模型相比基于标称动作局部导数的二阶泰勒代理模型，代理误差和优化器遗憾显著更低，且两种方法在每步重规划过程中均仅需9次直接目标函数评估。测试基准结果显示，Hermite代理模型还可进一步提升指向性能。

title: Spectral partitioning for $k$-block averaging kernels of finite Markov chains
title_zh: 有限马尔可夫链k块平均核的谱划分方法
authors: Michael C. H. Choi, Youjia Wang
abstract: We develop spectral algorithms for selecting state-space partitions that define averaging kernels for finite, ergodic and reversible Markov chains. For a partition $\mathcal O$, the Gibbs kernel $G_{\mathcal O}$ resamples within the current block from the stationary conditional distribution; when this update is tractable, composing or mixing it with a baseline kernel $P$ can accelerate convergence. We select $\mathcal O$ by rounding the bottom nonconstant eigenfunctions of $P^2$, or the algebraically smallest eigenfunctions of $P$ for additive mixtures, using weighted $k$-means. For $F(\mathcal O)=\|G_{\mathcal O}P-\Pi\|_{F,\pi}^2$, we derive exact trace and normalized-cut representations and show that $F$ equals the Pearson $\chi^2$-mutual information between the initial block label and the state after one transition, giving this matrix objective a natural probabilistic interpretation. In the two-block case, a threshold sweep exactly solves the associated one-dimensional weighted two-means rounding problem. For general $k \geq 2$, weighted $k$-means rounds the bottom $(k-1)$-dimensional embedding, after which candidates are rescored by $F$; the rounding distortion is a distance between subspaces that yields spectral approximation bounds. We extend the framework to additive mixtures, finite-horizon objectives, and discounted infinite-horizon objectives. In contrast to classical normalized spectral clustering, which uses top nonconstant modes to find low-flow persistent clusters, our method uses bottom modes to favor large normalized cross-block flow and rapid loss of block-label information. Experiments on a controlled-spectrum graph, a mean-field Ising model, and Bayesian variable selection show notable per-iteration improvements in convergence and statistical estimation.
summary_zh: 本文针对有限、遍历且可逆的马尔可夫链，开发了用于定义平均核的状态空间划分选择谱算法。对于划分𝒪，吉布斯核G_𝒪会在当前块内根据平稳条件分布进行重采样；当该更新可高效计算时，将其与基线核P进行组合或混合可加速收敛。本文通过对P的底部非恒定特征函数（针对加性混合场景则为P的代数最小特征函数）执行加权k均值聚类的舍入操作，选择得到划分𝒪。针对目标函数F(𝒪)=||G_𝒪P-Π||_{F,π}^2，本文推导了其精确迹表示和归一化割表示，证明F等于初始块标签与单次转移后状态之间的皮尔逊χ²互信息，为该矩阵目标赋予了自然的概率解释。在两块场景下，通过阈值扫描即可精确求解对应的一维加权双均值舍入问题。对于任意k≥2的通用场景，采用加权k均值对底部(k-1)维嵌入进行舍入，之后通过F对候选划分重新打分；舍入失真为子空间之间的距离，可据此推导谱近似边界。本文还将该框架扩展至加性混合、有限时域目标和折扣无限时域目标场景。与采用顶部非恒定模式寻找低流量持久簇的经典归一化谱聚类不同，本文方法采用底部模式，优先选择归一化跨块流量大、块标签信息快速丢失的划分。在可控谱图、平均场伊辛模型、贝叶斯变量选择三个场景下开展的实验显示，该方法在收敛速度和统计估计性能上的单步提升效果显著。

title: DNA Methylation Profiling in Melanoma: From Lesion Classification to Therapeutic Stratification
title_zh: 黑色素瘤DNA甲基化图谱研究：从病变分类到治疗分层
authors: Jana T. Winterstein, Lukas Heinlein, G\"unter Raddatz, Carina Nogueira Garcia, Sarah Haggenm\"uller, Christoph Wies, Lucas Schneider, Annemarie Hoffsommer, Tim J. Zeuner, Friedegund Meier, Sarah Hobelsberger, Frank F. Gellrich, Mildred Sergon, Axel Hauschild, Lucie Heinzerling, Justin G. Schlager, Kamran Ghoreschi, Max Schlaak, Franz J. Hilke, Carola Berking, Markus V. Heppt, Michael Erdmann, Sebastian Haferkamp, Konstantin Drexler, Dirk Schadendorf, Wiebke Sondermann, Matthias Goebeler, Bastian Schilling, Daniel B. Lipka, Stefan Fr\"ohling, Felix Sahm, Jakob N. Kather, Yuri Tolkach, Jochen S. Utikal, Benjamin Izar, Yevgeniy R. Semenov, Titus J. Brinker
abstract: DNA methylation provides a stable record of cellular identity, capturing epigenetic programs that distinguish specialized cell states despite a shared genome. Because malignant transformation and tumour progression are accompanied by extensive epigenetic remodeling, we hypothesized that the methylome of melanocytic lesions contains biologically and clinically relevant information for both diagnosis and disease progression. In a cohort of 1,001 tissue samples prospectively collected across eight German university hospitals profiled using Illumina Infinium MethylationEPIC arrays, we compared machine-learning models based on selected Cytosine phosphate Guanine (CpG) methylation sites with models incorporating biology-guided features, including epigenetic age acceleration, cell type composition and copy-number variation burden. In an external test set, the best diagnostic classifier was CpG-based and distinguished melanocytic nevi, noninvasive melanoma and invasive melanoma with a macro-averaged area under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.919 (95% CI: 0.878 to 0.952). Notably, across CpGs most strongly hyper- and hypomethylated between NV and IM, NIM showed an intermediate methylation profile, providing a molecular correlate of its diagnostic complexity. The best model for clinically relevant treatment group prediction, with AJCC stages grouped according to guideline-based management recommendations, relied on biology-guided features and achieved a macro-averaged mean absolute error of 0.627 (95% CI: 0.477 to 0.808). Together, these findings demonstrate that methylation-based models can capture both diagnostic identity and clinically relevant disease stratification, supporting DNA methylation as a promising biomarker for further validation and potential clinical translation.
summary_zh: DNA甲基化可提供稳定的细胞身份记录，捕获在共享基因组背景下区分特化细胞状态的表观遗传程序。由于恶性转化和肿瘤进展过程伴随大规模表观遗传重塑，本研究假设黑色素细胞病变的甲基组包含对诊断和疾病进展均有价值的生物学与临床信息。本研究对德国8所大学医院前瞻性收集的1001份组织样本队列，采用Illumina Infinium MethylationEPIC甲基化芯片进行图谱分析，对比了基于选定CpG（胞嘧啶-磷酸-鸟嘌呤）甲基化位点的机器学习模型，与整合表观遗传年龄加速、细胞类型组成、拷贝数变异负荷等生物学引导特征的模型性能。在外部测试集上，性能最优的诊断分类器为基于CpG的模型，可区分黑色素细胞痣、非侵入性黑色素瘤和侵入性黑色素瘤，宏平均受试者工作特征曲线下面积达0.919（95%置信区间：0.878~0.952）。值得注意的是，在黑色素痣和侵入性黑色素瘤之间差异最显著的高甲基化和低甲基化CpG位点上，非侵入性黑色素瘤呈现中间甲基化图谱，为其诊断复杂性提供了分子层面的对应解释。针对临床相关治疗组预测任务的最优模型基于生物学引导特征构建，将美国癌症联合委员会（AJCC）分期按指南推荐的管理方案分组后，该模型的宏平均绝对误差达0.627（95%置信区间：0.477~0.808）。上述结果共同证明，基于甲基化的模型可同时捕获诊断身份信息和临床相关的疾病分层信息，说明DNA甲基化是极具潜力的生物标志物，值得进一步验证并推动临床转化。

title: Federated Ensemble Forecasting Under Supply-Chain Market Volatility
title_zh: 供应链市场波动下的联邦集成预测方法
authors: Shunmukha Sagar Puppala
abstract: Supply chain forecasting systems increasingly operate under market shocks, non-identically distributed regional demand, and limited willingness to centralize commercial data. This work proposes Federated Ensemble Forecasting with Negative-Correlation Learning (FEF NCL), a distributed method that trains specialized forecasting experts across client nodes while discouraging redundant model errors. The framework combines temporal feature encoders, client level drift scoring, reliability-weighted aggregation, and an explain ability layer that exposes the market and supplier variables most responsible for each forecast. A single synthetic dataset is used to evaluate the design. It contains 124,800 weekly SKU region observations from ten regional client nodes, 60 product families, 40 suppliers, five commodity groups, and a 2021-2024 volatility profile with explicit price-shock regimes. Because the dataset is synthetic, the reported results should be interpreted as controlled evidence of internal consistency rather than real-world validation. Across the synthetic test split, FEF NCL reduces weighted mean absolute percentage error from 13.9% for the best federated baseline to 12.4%, improves delay-risk macro-F1 from 0.755 to 0.801, and lowers the high volatility quintile error by 2.1 percentage points relative to SCAFFOLD. The analysis suggests that negative-correlation specialization is useful when clients face different supplier, freight, and commodity conditions, although deployment would require stronger privacy analysis, live drift monitoring, and operational calibration. Index Terms federated learning, ensemble learning, negative correlation learning, supply chain forecasting, market volatility, data drift, demand planning, risk governance
summary_zh: 当前供应链预测系统越来越多地在市场冲击、区域需求非同分布、商业数据集中化意愿有限的场景下运行。本文提出FEF NCL（带负相关学习的联邦集成预测方法），该分布式方法可在各客户端节点训练专用预测专家模型，同时抑制冗余模型误差。该框架整合了时序特征编码器、客户端级漂移打分、可靠性加权聚合，以及可暴露对各次预测贡献最大的市场和供应商变量的可解释性层。本研究采用单份合成数据集开展性能评估，该数据集包含来自10个区域客户端节点的124800条周度最小存货单位（SKU）-区域观测记录，覆盖60个产品品类、40个供应商、5个大宗商品组，以及2021-2024年包含明确价格冲击区间的波动剖面。由于该数据集为合成数据，报告结果仅可作为内部一致性的受控证据，不等同于真实场景验证结果。在合成测试集上，FEF NCL将加权平均绝对百分比误差从最优联邦基线的13.9%降至12.4%，将延迟风险宏F1值从0.755提升至0.801，与SCAFFOLD联邦优化算法相比，高波动五分位场景下的误差降低了2.1个百分点。分析表明，当客户端面临不同的供应商、货运和大宗商品条件时，负相关的模型专业化策略可发挥显著作用，不过实际部署还需开展更深入的隐私分析、实时漂移监测和运营校准。

title: A Deep Causal Inference Approach to Measuring the Effects of Forming Group Loans in Online Non-profit Microfinance Platform
title_zh: 面向在线公益小额信贷平台组贷效应测度的深度因果推断方法
authors: Thai T. Pham, Yuanyuan Shen
abstract: Kiva is an online non-profit crowdsouring microfinance platform that raises funds for the poor in the third world. The borrowers on Kiva are small business owners and individuals in urgent need of money. To raise funds as fast as possible, they have the option to form groups and post loan requests in the name of their groups. While it is generally believed that group loans pose less risk for investors than individual loans do, we study whether this is the case in a philanthropic online marketplace. In particular, we measure the effect of group loans on funding time while controlling for the loan sizes and other factors. Because loan descriptions (in the form of texts) play an important role in lenders' decision process on Kiva, we make use of this information through deep learning in natural language processing. In this aspect, this is the first paper that uses one of the most advanced deep learning techniques to deal with unstructured data in a way that can take advantage of its superior prediction power to answer causal questions. We find that on average, forming group loans speeds up the funding time by about 3.3 days.
summary_zh: Kiva是一个面向第三世界贫困群体募资的在线公益众筹小额信贷平台，平台上的借款人均为急需资金的小企业主和个人。为了尽可能快速完成募资，借款人可选择组成团体，以团体名义发布贷款申请。尽管普遍认为团体贷款相比个人贷款对投资者而言风险更低，本研究针对公益类在线市场场景验证该结论是否成立，重点在控制贷款额度等其他变量的前提下，测度团体贷款对募资耗时的影响。由于文本形式的贷款描述是Kiva平台上贷款人决策过程的核心参考信息，本研究通过自然语言处理领域的深度学习技术充分利用该类信息。本研究是首项利用前沿深度学习技术处理非结构化数据、借助其优异的预测能力回答因果问题的相关工作。研究结果显示，平均而言组成团体申请贷款可将募资耗时缩短约3.3天。

title: On the Threat Model of Weird Generalization and Emergent Misalignment
title_zh: 怪异泛化与涌现性失配的威胁模型研究
authors: Miriam Wanner, Mark Dredze, William Walden
abstract: Narrow fine-tuning on small, domain-specific datasets can produce broad and surprising changes in model behavior-a phenomenon called weird generalization (WG). Yet, it remains unclear what features of the fine-tuning data are necessary for WG to arise.
